jobs.description:
Job Title: People Operations Coordinator - Temp to FTE Opportunity, 3 month contract

Job Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our People Operations Coordinator is foundational to a high-performing People team. Each coordinator embeds with their assigned business function(s) (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Sales) to provide full employee lifecycle support, from offer through exit. As the first point of contact for employees and managers, coordinators deliver high-volume, high-accuracy service across HR transactions, data, leave, employee relations support, and employee questions, creating a consistently excellent employee experience. They partner closely with People Business Partners, keeping the work moving, the data clean, and the PBP fully informed, and work alongside Total Rewards, Benefits and Mobility, and Talent Acquisition so programs run smoothly.

Each coordinator also serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing local compliance knowledge, language, and time zone coverage to the team. Working within a shared services model, coordinators cover for one another across functions during peak periods and absences, and bring back improvements that strengthen the whole team. This is a broad, high-visibility role and a clear path toward People Business Partner or People Operations leadership.

About 60 - 70% of your time supports your assigned business function(s) and their People Business Partner. That includes lifecycle transactions, employee data, questions, ER support, and the people programs for your pod.

The remaining 30–40% supports the broader People team. You will help Total Rewards with compensation and benefits cycles, partner with People Systems on HiBob, data, and reporting, and support Talent Acquisition through the handoff from offer to onboarding. You’ll also serve as the expert for your assigned country and cover for teammates during peak periods.

The balance shifts with the business calendar. Expect more Total Rewards work during open enrollment and compensation cycles, for example. We review it regularly throughout the year.

This role begins as a three-month contract with the opportunity to convert to a full-time, permanent Salesloft position based on business needs and performance. The contract period gives you the chance to learn the team, the systems and the business function you support, and gives us the chance to work together before making a long-term commitment. We will check in with you along the way so you know how things are going.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

  • Lifecycle Administration. Manages the employee lifecycle for the assigned business function, from offer through exit. Prepares offer letters, coordinates background checks and I-9 and right-to-work verification, and runs onboarding and offboarding, including exit surveys, so every transition is accurate and on time.
  • Employee Data & Records. Maintains accurate employee data in HiBob and ADP for the assigned business function. Processes hires, changes, promotions, transfers, terminations, and org updates, and audits records and personnel files to keep data clean and audit-ready.
  • HR Case Management. Serves as the first point of contact for employee and manager questions through people@ and HappyFox. Resolves routine requests promptly and escalates complex or sensitive issues to People Business Partners and specialists.
  • Mobility, & Benefits Support. Serves as the first point of contact for benefits questions and partners closely with the Benefits and Mobility Specialist to keep PBPs informed on mobility cases.
  • PBP, ER & Programs Support.
    • PBP Partnership & Employee Relations Support. Partners with the assigned People Business Partner through weekly syncs, sharing context so they have full visibility without having to ask. Supports ER cases under PBP direction by maintaining documentation and the ER tracker, coordinating investigation logistics, and preparing PIP and termination paperwork.
    • Program administration: Project manages the promotion process for the assigned business function, tracking and documenting each promotion through processing. Supports compensation cycle execution and submits roles for compensation analysis, following up with leaders and tracking turnaround.
    • Survey, QBR & Talent Support. Manages the engagement survey in the system and compiles data and pre-reads for leadership reviews. Supports the QBR process and prepares data and insights for talent calibration conversations.
  • Reporting, Analytics & Compliance Support. Fulfills data requests and runs standard reports and headcount reconciliations, providing analysis that supports business reviews and People programs. Supports audits, country-specific filings, I-9 compliance, record retention, and policy acknowledgments, and manages vendor invoices.
  • Process Improvement. Establishes and maintains SOPs so the team delivers consistent service across pods. Flags recurring case themes and tests HRIS and workflow changes, turning patterns from the assigned business function into improvements for the whole team.
  • Country Expertise. Serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing knowledge of local employment practices and compliance requirements, along with language and time zone coverage. Reviews country-specific documents prepared by other coordinators, supports local filings and vendor relationships, and keeps the team current on changes in local requirements.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for a service-minded, detail-obsessed People professional who takes pride in getting the work right the first time. You understand that every offer letter, record update, and employee question is someone’s experience of the company, and you treat each one that way. You are comfortable being the first point of contact for employees and managers, and you know when to resolve a request yourself and when to bring in a People Business Partner or specialist. You handle confidential information with discretion and communicate clearly in writing. You are equally at home working through a high volume of transactions and spotting the pattern behind them, and you bring ideas back that make the whole team better. You enjoy partnering with business leaders, adapt easily across time zones and cultures, and want to build toward a career as a People Business Partner or in People Operations leadership.

THE TEAM:

Our People Operations Coordinators, PBPs and specialists work as one team on a shared goal, and each role has clear ownership. Coordinators are the front door of the People organization: warm, responsive and exact, with the pride in getting it right that earns managers’ and employees’ trust. We are a global team across India, Mexico and the United States, we cover for one another, and we share what we learn so every pod gets better. We take on hard problems together, and we hold ourselves to a high bar for accountability, empathy and execution.Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired

THE SKILL SET:

  • 2-4 years in HR operations, shared services, or HR administration
  • Hands-on HRIS experience and a case management tool (JIRA, happy fox, service now, etc.)
  • Strong attention to detail, discretion with confidential data, and clear written communication
  • Comfort supporting business leaders and managers, and working across time zones and cultures
  • Exposure to global employment practices and multi-country HR administration is preferred
  • Experience supporting a high-growth or sales-led organization is preferred
  • Experience with process documentation, reporting, or workflow automation is preferred

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from @ email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable. The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.

The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

Base Pay Range
$50,000—$70,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Manager, GTM Data Science
jobs.excerpt: Job Requisition ID # 26WD101004Position OverviewThe Go-to-Market Data & Intelligence (GDI) organization empowers Autodesk teams to make better customer decisions using trusted data, analytics, and data science.
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101004

Position Overview

The Go-to-Market Data & Intelligence (GDI) organization empowers Autodesk teams to make better customer decisions using trusted data, analytics, and data science. The Data Science team develops Machine Learning products that help Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams determine which customers to engage, when to engage them, what actions to take, and how to measure the impact of those actions.

We are looking for a dynamic Senior Manager, GTM Data Science to join the GDI leadership team. You will lead a diverse team of data scientists and own the portfolio, execution, adoption, and measurable business impact of data science initiatives across customer intelligence domains. This role requires deep technical credibility, strong people leadership, operating discipline, and the ability to influence senior business and data leaders.

The data science team applies descriptive, predictive, and experimental methods to customer data to optimize decisions related to customer renewals, expansion, and segmentation. The data science team partners closely with GDI program management, analytics, ML engineering, and GTM teams and their operational partners to create customer intelligence experiences that are embedded in GTM workflows.

Success in this role is not measured only by the quality of models or insights delivered. You will be accountable for translating ambiguous business objectives into the right problems and products, prioritizing opportunities by expected business value, working across functions to integrate data science products into how GTM teams work, and demonstrating that those products improve decisions and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Shape the multi-quarter Data Science roadmap for customer engagement use cases, aligned with GDI priorities and Autodesk business objectives

  • Partner with senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to identify and prioritize the decisions where data science can create the greatest customer and business value

  • Translate ambiguous strategic questions into clear decision frameworks, analytical problem statements, intervention strategies, success metrics, and business cases

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to executives and cross-functional leaders; challenge assumptions, make clear recommendations, and communicate tradeoffs in a way that supports timely decisions

  • Define success measures before development begins and hold the team and partners accountable for adoption and realized outcomes, including customer retention and growth, conversion, engagement effectiveness, seller and marketer productivity, and resource allocation

  • Own and actively manage a portfolio of Decision Intelligence initiatives across areas such as retention and churn, growth potential, upsell and cross-sell, segmentation, propensity and lead prioritization, license compliance, attribution, benchmarking, what-if scenarios, and next-best action

  • Lead the end-to-end lifecycle from problem formulation and data readiness through modeling, validation, deployment, workflow integration, experimentation, impact measurement, and post-launch monitoring

  • Make explicit portfolio tradeoffs, sequence work based on expected value and feasibility, and redirect or stop initiatives when evidence indicates that the opportunity is no longer compelling

  • Partner with GDI program management, analytics engineering, data engineering, product managers, and federated analytics teams to define requirements, operating dependencies, delivery plans, and adoption mechanisms

  • Establish clear operating rhythms and quality standards for the team, including roadmap reviews, technical reviews, launch readiness, outcome reviews, and escalation of material risks

  • Provide technical leadership that ensures the problem formulation matches the decision need - including when to use prediction, experimentation, causal inference, optimization, ranking, simulation, or other approaches

  • Guide the team across statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, causal methods, propensity and uplift modeling, scoring and prioritization, and related advanced analytics techniques

  • Maintain a high technical bar for data quality, leakage prevention, model evaluation and calibration, reproducibility, explainability, bias and fairness considerations, drift monitoring, and offline versus online performance

  • Ensure machine learning products connect predictions or insights to specific actions, interventions, or policies and that their incremental impact can be measured whenever practical

  • Stay current on advances in machine learning, AI, experimentation, causal inference, and decision intelligence, and apply the appropriate methods when to improve customer or business outcomes

  • Lead, recruit, retain, and develop a high-performing team of data scientists with clear roles, standards, accountability, and career expectations

  • Coach senior individual contributors and emerging leaders, developing both deep technical capability and the judgment required to operate effectively with business stakeholders

  • Conduct performance and talent reviews, provide candid and actionable feedback, identify development opportunities, and build succession and hiring plans for critical capabilities

  • Create an inclusive team environment that values rigorous technical debate, curiosity, continuous learning, cross-functional collaboration, and accountability for outcomes

  • Build organizational capability beyond individual projects by improving reusable methods, decision frameworks, operating practices, and partnerships across the broader EDA organization

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, advanced analytics, or a related quantitative field, including significant hands-on applied experience

  • 3+ years of experience managing data science, machine learning, or advanced analytics teams

  • Advanced degree in a quantitative discipline such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Strong technical fluency in Python or R and SQL, with the ability to engage in detailed technical design and model-review discussions

  • Demonstrated experience taking analytical or machine learning products from an ambiguous business problem through development, deployment, adoption, and measurable impact

  • Strong knowledge of statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and model evaluation techniques

  • Demonstrated ability to identify the right business problems to solve and translate business objectives into decision, measurement, and analytical frameworks

  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders with data and analysis and leading cross-functional initiatives that depend on contributions from multiple disciplines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts, recommendations, risks, and tradeoffs to audiences ranging from technical practitioners to executives

  • Strong judgment, ownership, and execution: you proactively identify gaps, resolve ambiguity, make clear recommendations, and remain accountable for outcomes across organizational boundaries

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with B2B SaaS, subscription, customer lifecycle, or commercial analytics supporting Sales, Marketing, and/or Customer Success

  • Experience building or scaling decision intelligence, next-best-action, propensity, prioritization, experimentation, or other analytical products embedded in operational workflows

  • Experience with production machine learning and the operational lifecycle of models, including monitoring, retraining, and collaboration with engineering or MLOps teams

  • Experience managing a portfolio of analytical products and making prioritization decisions based on expected customer or business value

  • Experience developing senior technical talent, organizational capability, and operating mechanisms in a growing data science organization

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Canada based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $158,000 and $231,000. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging
We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here:


In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

Are you an existing contractor or consultant with Autodesk?

Please search for open jobs and apply internally (not on this external site).

jobs.title: Demand Generation Director - 11940
jobs.excerpt: Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small.
jobs.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  • Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.
The Impact of a Demand Generation Director at Coupa:
The Demand Generation Director is accountable for the integrated demand strategy and its execution across the Americas. The position owns the regional demand process end to end, including demand planning, sales play and outreach cadence design, pipeline health, and lead-to-deal conversion, and sets the foundation for how demand is generated and progressed in the Americas.

The position is the primary point of coordination between Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Advisory Services and Revenue Operations for demand matters in the Americas. It chairs the regional Demand Board, holds the integrated demand plan, and is accountable for the pipeline health and conversion outcomes that result. This is an individual contributor position that operates through influence across the demand ecosystem rather than through direct authority.

What You'll Do:

    Demand strategy and planning

  • Leads the regional demand process, including planning, coordination and analysis, and is accountable for the integrated demand plan for the Americas.
  • Develops integrated demand strategies that align marketing, sales and partner activity to regional pipeline and revenue objectives.
  • Sets the demand planning calendar and the inputs required from each contributing function, and holds those functions to the agreed plan.
  • Determines where demand investment is directed by segment, solution and route to market, and recommends reallocation where performance requires it.

    • Demand execution and sales plays

  • Designs tactical sales plays and outreach cadences tailored to specific target audiences and aligned to business priorities, in partnership with Sales, Marketing and Sales Enablement.
  • Accountable for the execution of the demand plan in the Americas, including sequencing, coverage of priority accounts and segments, and completion against the agreed calendar.
  • Partners with the Revenue Systems directors on the platforms and configuration that support demand motions, including prospecting and contact data, sales engagement and cadence management, and submits requirements through the established intake process.
  • Accountable for adoption and performance of the sales plays and cadences released into the region, and for revision or retirement of those that do not perform.

    • Pipeline health and conversion

  • Accountable for a healthy and predictable pipeline of qualified opportunities for the regional sales organization, measured against defined coverage and quality standards.
  • Uses data and analytics to track the performance of demand generation initiatives, and identifies the drivers of variance between plan and actual.
  • Accountable for lead-to-deal conversion improvement in the Americas, including diagnosis of conversion loss by stage, source and segment, and the remediation plan.
  • Tracks performance and progress of demand activity against pipeline health metrics, and reports status on a defined cadence.

    • Cross-functional coordination and governance

  • Collaborates with Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Advisory Services and other functions to develop a coordinated and integrated demand plan that meets business goals.
  • Hosts the regional Demand Board and associated planning activities to track progress and align the demand ecosystem on priorities, commitments and outcomes.
  • Escalates to the Leader, Demand Orchestration where cross-functional commitments, resourcing or prioritization cannot be resolved in the Americas.
  • Fosters a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement and excellence across the demand ecosystem, and drives improvement of the processes and tools the ecosystem depends upon.

    • Market insight and solution knowledge

  • Monitors and analyzes market trends, customer behaviors and the competitive landscape, and applies that analysis to demand planning and play design.
  • Maintains a working understanding of areas of strength and weakness across the relevant solution portfolio, and reflects that understanding in targeting and messaging priorities.
  • Partners with Product Marketing and Competitive Intelligence to keep demand activity current with positioning and competitive changes.

    • Insight to leadership

  • Provides proactive insight to leadership on demand planning, forecasting and execution, including risks to pipeline coverage and the actions required.
  • Represents the regional demand position in planning and review cycles, including quarterly business reviews and annual planning.
  • Translates demand performance into the commercial implications leadership requires for decision-making.

Performance Measures

  • Pipeline coverage and quality against regional targets, by segment and solution.
  • Lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-close conversion rates against baselines.
  • Contribution of demand activity to qualified pipeline and closed revenue in the Americas.
  • Delivery of the demand plan against committed scope and calendar.
  • Adoption and performance of released sales plays and outreach cadences.
  • Demand Board and planning cadence operating as designed, with documented commitments and follow-through.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of demand reporting and insight to leadership.

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

  • Bachelor's degree in an analytical discipline such as Finance, Business, Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ten or more years of experience in business-to-business demand generation, demand management or a closely related go-to-market function.
  • Demonstrated track record of developing and implementing successful demand management strategies at scale.
  • Strong analytical capability, including the ability to interpret complex data sets and make data-driven decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience designing sales plays and outreach cadences, and measuring their performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and to build durable internal relationships, including with senior stakeholders, without direct authority.
  • Strong financial and business acumen, and demonstrated problem-solving capability, including the ability to translate process into value-adding business activity.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Demonstrated leadership capability, including the ability to set direction, and to inspire and motivate teams the position does not manage.
  • Demonstrated commitment to challenging, improving and innovating at both a personal and an organizational level.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in large technology companies, in a multi-segment, multi-region organization with an established partner channel.
  • Working knowledge of the platforms that support demand motions, including CRM, sales engagement and cadence management, prospecting and contact data, and intent or account-based marketing platforms.
  • Experience integrating partner and advisory motions into demand planning and execution.
  • Prior experience in a quota-carrying, sales management or field-facing role.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:
Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)
  • Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .
  • Birthday Time-Off: Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month .
  • Volunteer Time Off (VTO): Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .

  • Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
  • Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .
Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Director, Regional Pharmacy Operations - Europe The START Center for Cancer Research (“START”) is the world’s largest early-phase oncology clinical research site network.
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Regional Pharmacy Operations - Europe

The START Center for Cancer Research (“START”) is the world’s largest early-phase oncology clinical research site network. For more than two decades, START has been dedicated exclusively to oncology research, providing cancer patients with access to cutting-edge clinical trials and helping bring innovative therapies to market faster. Through our mission of "Hope Through Access", we deliver world-class research across the United States and Europe.

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Senior Director, Regional Pharmacy Operations to provide executive leadership and strategic oversight of pharmacy services across our European network. This role is responsible for leading Investigational Drug Services (IDS), clinical pharmacy operations, and regulatory compliance while driving operational excellence, standardization, and continuous improvement across multiple countries and sites.

The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in investigational medicinal product (IMP) management, clinical trial pharmacy operations, sterile compounding, and regulatory compliance. As a key member of the leadership team, the Senior Director will play a critical role in shaping the future of pharmacy operations, supporting organizational growth, and ensuring the highest standards of patient safety and quality across the region.

This role requires a strategic and collaborative leader who can successfully drive alignment across geographically distributed sites, balancing operational efficiency and growth with uncompromising regulatory compliance and patient care standards. Success in this position will depend on the ability to build strong partnerships across functions and regions while fostering consistency in pharmacy operations, quality standards, performance metrics, and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight for pharmacy operations across all European sites.
  • Drive consistency in pharmacy standards, SOPs, KPIs, quality systems, and compliance practices.
  • Oversee investigational medicinal product (IMP) management, including procurement, storage, distribution, accountability, and disposal.
  • Ensure compliance with EU Clinical Trial Regulation (CTR), EU GMP, GDP, GDPR, and applicable national regulatory requirements.
  • Lead quality, inspection readiness, and audit preparedness initiatives across the region.
  • Develop and mentor pharmacy leaders while fostering a high-performing, collaborative, and service-oriented culture.
  • Champion operational excellence through process improvement, innovation, and technology adoption.
  • Partner with clinical, operational, and executive leadership teams to support strategic growth objectives.
  • Establish operational metrics and data-driven decision-making frameworks to improve performance and scalability.
  • Support new site integrations, protocol activations, and organizational change initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • PharmD, MPharm, or equivalent recognized pharmacy degree.
  • Current pharmacist registration/licensure within an EU member state.
  • 10+ years of progressive pharmacy leadership experience, including investigational or clinical research pharmacy operations.
  • Proven experience leading multi-site pharmacy or healthcare operations.
  • Deep knowledge of clinical trial pharmacy services, IMP management, GCP, ICH, EU GMP, GDP, and quality management systems.
  • Demonstrated success leading organizational change and strategic initiatives.
  • Strong leadership, financial management, stakeholder engagement, and team development skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

Preferred

  • Board Certified Oncology Pharmacist (BCOP) certification.
  • Oncology or Health-System Pharmacy residency training.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification.
  • Experience supporting early-phase oncology clinical trials.
  • Experience working across multiple European countries and regulatory environments.
  • Fluency in Spanish, English and/or other European languages.

Travel Requirement: Approximately 50% travel across Europe.

Why Join START?

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of pharmacy operations within one of the world's leading oncology research organizations. You will work alongside exceptional clinical and operational leaders dedicated to accelerating access to innovative cancer therapies while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance, and patient care.

If you are passionate about advancing oncology research, building high-performing teams, and driving operational excellence at scale, we invite you to join START and help transform cancer care across Europe.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Remote Customer Service Representative

About the Role

Invicta Software is seeking a dedicated and proactive Remote Customer Service Representative to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be the frontline ambassador for our brand, providing exceptional support and building lasting relationships with our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for delivering outstanding service, this opportunity is perfect for you.

As a key member of our customer experience team, you will play a vital role in ensuring customer satisfaction and helping to drive the success of our software solutions.

Key Objectives

  • Deliver timely, accurate, and professional support to customers through various communication channels.

  • Resolve inquiries, troubleshoot issues, and provide product information to enhance customer experience.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to escalate and resolve complex concerns efficiently.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing customer feedback and insights.

Responsibilities

  • Respond promptly and courteously to customer inquiries via phone, email, and chat.

  • Identify customer needs and recommend appropriate solutions or products.

  • Document and track customer interactions and issues using CRM tools.

  • Assist customers with account setup, product usage, and troubleshooting technical problems.

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of company products, services, and policies.

  • Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless resolution of customer concerns.

  • Meet or exceed individual and team performance targets.

Qualifications & Skills

  • High school diploma or equivalent; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.

  • Minimum 1-2 years of experience in customer service or a related role, preferably in a software or technology environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a customer-centric mindset.

  • Comfortable using CRM software and other customer support tools.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting with reliable internet access.

  • Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

  • Flexible schedule availability to accommodate various time zones is a plus.

Benefits

jobs.description:
About the role

Our largest enterprise clients need their content to flow from code repositories and CMS platforms into our platform and back, and to work when it gets there. As Senior Pre-Sales Engineer, you'll make that happen in a dual role that combines pre-sales engineering and solutions architecture. You won't just suggest a solution; you'll design it, build the proof of concept, and show clients how it delivers outcomes that help them grow globally. You'll be the primary technical architect for our largest enterprise accounts and the technical partner to the Strategic Account Managers and Business Development Directors in your region, working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product, and Engineering, and reporting to our VP, Sales. You'll do well here if you're as comfortable in a terminal as you are in a client presentation.

What you'll do

  • Act as the technical authority in the sales cycle for the Strategic Accounts and Business Development teams, presenting confidently to senior client leaders and enterprise IT teams, and lead product demos of our platform.
  • Lead requirements workshops with enterprise clients to define integration points, data models, and orchestration patterns, and produce technical blueprints and data-flow diagrams that balance security, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Design, implement, and improve end-to-end workflows that connect translation management systems (TMS) and Acclaro technology with client content management systems (CMS), document management systems (DMS), and other core enterprise platforms, and advise on API architecture, webhooks, and secure middleware development.
  • Build proofs of concept that validate proposed solutions and win client buy-in.
  • Deploy our content intelligence workflows, combining our platform, large language models, and human-in-the-loop feedback cycles, to deliver measurable outcomes and faster turnaround for clients.
  • Turn complex content intelligence architectures into simple, compelling business value for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to follow current trends and develop solutions for customer needs, and with Delivery and Operations to confirm technical viability, align Sales expectations with what we can deliver, and make sure handover and execution go smoothly.
  • Keep improving our processes by automating manual QA gates and removing technical bottlenecks in the content lifecycle.

What you'll bring

  • typically 7+ years of progressive experience in localization engineering, pre-sales engineering, or solutions architecture at a large language service provider (LSP), language technology vendor, or global tech company, or equivalent experience
  • excellent communication across functions, with the ability to align Sales, Delivery, Product, and Engineering teams, linguists, and project managers
  • confidence handling complex enterprise procurement and IT security discussions
  • strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including turning complex manual processes into simple, automated ones
  • a clear understanding of content intelligence, where the question is moving from "did we deliver it?" to "did it work?", and the ability to design and sell solutions for that shift

Nice to have

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of at least two enterprise TMS platforms, such as Phrase, Lokalise, Trados Enterprise, Smartling, XTM, or memoQ
  • Hands-on experience designing or scoping translation workflows that combine machine translation, large language models, and human-in-the-loop review
  • Development skills: at least one scripting language (such as Python, JavaScript, or Ruby) for automation, Git workflows and CI/CD pipelines, and regular expressions (regex) and XPath for advanced text extraction
  • Expert knowledge of localization standards, including XLIFF, TMX, TBX, and SRX
  • An understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and data privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA
  • If you have some of these, great. If you don't, we'd still like to hear from you.

Who we are

At Acclaro, we're more than a localization company — we're a content intelligence solutions company, and a global team of language enthusiasts, cultural connectors, and technology innovators. Our mission is to help brands speak the world's languages and resonate deeply across cultures by blending human expertise with cutting-edge technology, delivered through a follow-the-sun model that keeps our teams moving around the clock and around the globe.

With over two decades of experience, we support some of the world's most recognizable brands in expanding their global reach. And we're scaling: we've been making material investments in our own AI-native platform, one that's already reshaping how our business — and the localization industry more broadly — works. Join us on our journey to be the model localization company of the next decade, one that's loved by clients, colleagues, and communities alike.

How we work

Our values shape how we work with customers, colleagues, and partners. Here's what you can expect from us, and what we'll look for in you.

  • Be Accountable. We own our work, learn from our mistakes, and come with solutions.
  • Be Proud. We care about the work, hold a high standard, and celebrate each other's wins.
  • Be Resilient. When things get hard, we stay calm, adapt, and ask for help when we need it.
  • Be Curious. We ask why, keep learning, share what we know, and explore new ways of working, including AI.
  • Be Kind. We assume good intent, give honest feedback with care, and look out for each other.

Inclusion and equal opportunity

Acclaro is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

About Global Technology Services

GTS is technology at MPLC, all of it. And we are honest about where we are: we are rebuilding and elevating our technology capability, from the ground up and by design. New platforms, new data foundations, new roles: this team is being built for what MPLC becomes, not what it was. You will own real outcomes early, automate the repetitive rather than absorb it, and help shape the rebuild rather than inherit someone else’s. Technology is the engine of how MPLC grows. People are the fuel. AI is the turbocharger. That is where you come in.

The Role in Two Bullet Points
  • Define and own the architecture that connects MPLC's systems, data and platforms, ensuring the technology estate scales in a structured and sustainable way.

If you need more information

Reporting to the CIO, you'll take ownership of the overall architecture of our technology estate, covering systems, data, integrations and platform design. You'll help define how our applications fit together, where critical business data should live and how information moves across the organisation.

Working closely with key business stakeholders, you'll ensure technology decisions support the wider goals of the business. You'll establish standards, guide platform selection, design integration patterns and help create a technology estate that's easier to maintain, scale and evolve.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys turning strategy into reality. You'll be expected to influence direction, document decisions, test ideas and work alongside the team to bring architectural designs to life.

You'll Love This Role If...
  • You have experience designing and managing architecture across multiple platforms, systems and data environments.

  • You have strong knowledge of Salesforce from a platform and integration perspective.
  • You're comfortable working with APIs, integrations and modern approaches to connectivity.
  • You enjoy solving complex problems and bringing structure to environments that have evolved over time.
  • You can balance technical best practice with practical business needs.
  • You like taking ownership, making evidence-based decisions and seeing your ideas delivered.

Benefits

• Salary band: £85,000-£120,000 depending on experience.
• Remote Working with occasional travel.
• 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays
• Private medical insurance (AXA), including dental, optical and 24/7 GP access.

About the opportunity

Join our Embedded Payments team as a Full Stack Software Engineer and make a real impact every day. Reporting to the Software Engineering Manager, you'll help build and scale our cloud-native payment orchestration platform that processes significant transaction volume across multiple Xplor brands.

You are passionate about building scalable systems and great user experiences while maintaining software development best practices. You write code that is thoughtful end-to-end — from the API contract down to the database, and from the data model up through the UI. You're comfortable owning features across the stack and collaborating closely with backend, frontend, QA, and DevOps engineers to deliver high-quality software.

Our Tech Stack

  • Frontend: React (Vite), MUI, JavaScript
  • Testing: Jest, ESLint, Prettier, Storybook, Playwright, K6

  • DevOps: Bitbucket Pipelines, Terraform
  • Payments: Worldpay, Stripe, Apple Pay / Google Pay

Responsibilities & Duties

  • Produce technical specifications and assess operational feasibility for new payments features
  • Integrate components into cohesive, production-ready systems with appropriate observability
  • Contribute to verification plans, quality assurance procedures, and deployment guardrails
  • Maintain and improve existing functionality, including documentation
  • Participate in deployment planning, on-call rotations, and incident response as part of running a payments platform
  • Use AI-assisted development tools effectively to improve velocity without compromising quality
  • Stay current with platform updates, security practices, and PCI compliance requirements

What would make you a good candidate?

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

You'll need:

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a Computer Science/Engineering degree or equivalent
  • Strong Node.js experience and demonstrated ability to ship production backend services
  • Experience building React-based frontends that consume RESTful APIs
  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices
  • Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and clear understanding of separation of concerns in service design
  • Hands-on experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar)
  • Proficiency with Git, agile delivery (Scrum preferred), and testing frameworks like Jest
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and an articulate point of view on where they help and where they don't
  • Comfortable working on a 100% remote team and able to operate independently within an agile group

It would be great if you also have:

  • Experience building or operating payments systems — payment orchestration, tokenization, acquirer integrations (Worldpay, Stripe, Adyen, Finix, Basis Theory), or PCI-compliant environments
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures (SQS, EventBridge, Kafka)
  • Exposure to observability tooling (SigNoz, Grafana, Datadog, etc.)
  • Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform)

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

  • Find a better way
  • Do the right thing
  • Say it straight
  • Win together
  • Own the outcome

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.

Some of our perks and benefits are:

Ready to apply?

Before you apply

To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This applies to remote roles too, as we can only employ people who reside within the US. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time. We're also not able to offer contractor arrangements or Employer of Record engagements for this position at this stage.

Please apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. We're unable to upload emailed applications, as our process requires you to answer screening questions directly.

jobs.excerpt: About the Role We at Innovaccer are looking for a Head of Payer Marketing to own marketing for our payer-facing portfolio — Galaxy (Payer Risk & Quality, Payer Utilization Management) in full, plus the Payer Interoperability swimlane within Gravity — end to end, the way a General Manager owns a business: strategy, story, pipeline, and reputation, not just a set of campaigns.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We at Innovaccer are looking for a Head of Payer Marketing to own marketing for our payer-facing portfolio — Galaxy (Payer Risk & Quality, Payer Utilization Management) in full, plus the Payer Interoperability swimlane within Gravity — end to end, the way a General Manager owns a business: strategy, story, pipeline, and reputation, not just a set of campaigns.

Strategy, flight plan, execution, and messaging all sit with one person in this role — a combination that is rare at this level. Most marketing leadership roles own execution against someone else’s plan, or own messaging without the mandate to act on it. This role owns the whole payer-facing arc, from go-to-market strategy through to how Innovaccer is positioned with payer buyers. You are not the person running campaigns day to day — you set the plan and the standard, and a team you build and lead executes to it.

A Day in the Life

  • Set the payer go-to-market strategy across Galaxy and Payer Interoperability: target payer segments (health plans, MCOs, government programs), competitive positioning, and priority use cases, informed by Product roadmap, Sales signal, and payer market research.
  • Define the annual and quarterly flight plan for the payer portfolio and own the marketing budget behind it, deciding what the portfolio will and will not pursue.
  • Ensure a continuous flow of payer-specific research grounds the strategy — payer buyer interviews, win/loss analysis, regulatory and reimbursement shifts, competitive scans — and convert that research into decisions, not decks.
  • Own the pipeline generation number for the payer portfolio directly. Identify the portfolio’s Big Bets — the largest, most strategic payer deals — and build a dedicated plan around each: account-based engagement, executive touchpoints, and reference activation.
  • Own payer-facing messaging and positioning directly, backed by real payer domain fluency (risk adjustment, utilization management, quality/Stars, interoperability mandates) — you write and set the narrative yourself.
  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to the Galaxy Product leader (Michelle) and Sales leadership — sit in Product’s planning cadence, own payer product launches end-to-end from a marketing standpoint, and equip Sales with what they need to win payer deals.
  • Coordinate with Gravity’s and Flow’s Heads of Marketing on payer-adjacent messaging — Gravity’s Payer Interoperability swimlane sits under this role directly, and Flow’s PA/Coding/Denials work touches payers operationally even though it stays under Flow’s Head of Marketing.
  • Represent the payer portfolio externally — payer conferences, health plan briefings, industry events, analyst calls, media, and LinkedIn — building a reputation as a payer-market voice, not only an internal operator.
  • Lead the payer portfolio’s swimlane owners and the associates running flight-plan execution. Delegate the operational engine with clear ownership, set goals aligned to the flight plan, and grow the team under you.

What You Need

  • 10+ years of experience in category or product marketing, with direct experience marketing to health plans, MCOs, or government payer programs — not provider-only healthcare technology experience.
  • Strong understanding of payer operations and economics: risk adjustment, utilization management, quality/Stars ratings, government program administration (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid), and the regulatory and reimbursement trends shaping payer technology decisions.
  • A proven track record of setting go-to-market strategy and being accountable for the pipeline and revenue outcome it produces — not just executing a plan set by someone else.
  • Direct experience writing and owning payer-facing messaging and positioning yourself, with the payer domain fluency to make an independent, defensible call on it.
  • Experience as a primary marketing partner to Product and Sales leadership selling into payers — sitting in planning cadences and roadmap conversations, not being briefed after decisions are made.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and lead a team, delegate operational execution, and be judged on outcomes rather than personal output.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to represent the payer portfolio externally to payer-market analysts, media, and industry audiences.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

Here’s What We Offer

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work-life balance fuels performance.
  • Best-in-Class Parental Leave: Spend quality time with your growing family. We offer one of the industry’s most generous parental leave policies to support you during life’s most important moments.
  • Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins—big and small. Get rewarded with monetary incentives and company-wide recognition for your impact and dedication. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed.
  • Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Stay covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance. Optional perks include discounted legal aid and pet insurance.

jobs.excerpt: About Command|Link Command|Link is a global SaaS Platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions, helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform.
jobs.description:
About Command|Link

Command|Link is a global SaaS Platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions, helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform. Command|Link has revolutionized the IT industry by tackling the problems our competitors create. In recognition for our unprecedented innovation and dedication, Command|Link was recognized as the SD-WAN Product of the Year, ITSM Visionary Spotlight, UCaaS Product of the Year, NaaS Product of the Year, Supplier of the Year, and the AT&T Strategic Growth Partner. Command|Link has built the only IT platform for scale that solves ISP vendor sprawl and IT headaches. We make it easy for our customers to get more done, maximize uptime and improve the bottom line.

Learn more about us here!

This is a 100% remote position

About your new role:

CommandLink's monitoring product is how customers see their network: every device, service, and dependency, surfaced through an API and UI they use every day. Today that experience is harder to build well than it looks, most platforms in this space bury the signal in flat device lists and dated interfaces. We want to build something clearer and faster, grounded in real network topology instead.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll own that surface end to end: the architecture that determines how it scales, how it consumes the classification and telemetry layers beneath it, and how it evolves as the platform grows. This is full-stack work with a strong network domain emphasis. You'll need to reason clearly about both system design and the experience it produces for someone troubleshooting their network in real time.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the architecture and long-term direction of the monitoring product's API and UI, including the roadmap for how it scales and evolves.
  • Surface the full account and device hierarchy, from company down through site, probe and collector, device, and service, along with the dependency relationships between them, in a way that stays navigable at scale.
  • Lead the discovery and inventory experience: how new devices and hosts are found and billed (Host Discovery), how correlated system summaries are built (System Discovery), and how customers onboard new sources.
  • Build the screens customers use to create, edit, and review alert history through the alert service.
  • Define the data contracts between the monitoring product and the classification, telemetry, and alert services it depends on, and hold the line on their quality as the platform grows.
  • Set the technical patterns other engineers follow for rendering and interacting with complex, hierarchical network data, including topology visualizations that are genuinely performant, a known weak point across competing platforms.

Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to join the leadership of one of our engineering tracks. This is a leadership role, not delivery management. People management is the baseline here, not the job. What we are actually hiring for is the person who sees what needs to change across the engineering organization and changes it, without being asked and without waiting for permission.

Responsibilities

  • Drive engineering-wide initiatives. Technical and non-technical, beyond the boundary of your own teams. You spot what is slowing the organization down, you take it, you change it, and you can show the before and after in numbers.
  • Enable engineers instead of directing them. Our engineers own their delivery, their hiring decisions and their technical direction. Your job is to create the conditions where good ideas surface, get heard and move forward, and to remove what blocks them, not to become the layer they route through.
  • Own the people baseline. Hire, onboard, grow engineers at multiple levels. Set a clear bar for individual performance and address underperformance early, openly and fairly. This part is expected to be solid, and it is not what makes the difference in this role.
  • Make AI a lever for the organization, not for yourself. Every engineer here generates most of their code with agents. You are expected to push that further: adoption, practices, and what we can do now that we could not do a year ago.
  • Partner with product managers to ship user experiences that are intuitive, reliable and well built, while teams stay autonomous in how they execute.

﻿This role is not for you if

  • You measure your success as an EM by delivery timelines and sprint velocity.
  • You want to review code, own architecture, or be the technical authority.
  • You need a task list from leadership, or a PM/BA layer to hand you requirements.
  • You expect team leads, architects, or a management layer to work through.
  • Your background is primarily delivery management, project management, or agency work.
  • You don't use AI agents in your daily work and don't want to.
  • Your strongest impact story is about getting people to talk to each other.

Requirements

  • 3+ years managing engineers in a product company (not agency, not outsourcing).
  • Two or three examples of engineering or process change you started yourself, drove end to end, and measured, where the effect reached beyond your own team.
  • Comfortable being hands-off: no code, no architecture ownership, no technical authority, and you won't miss it.
  • Experience working without a layer of team leads and architects between you and the engineers, or experience removing that layer yourself.
  • You have handled underperformance early and transparently, and you have grown senior-level engineers.
  • Agentic AI is already part of how you work, and you have driven its adoption beyond yourself.
  • You make decisions without complete information, prioritize sharply, and say so when you have taken on too much.
  • You communicate openly: full context, your own mistakes named first, correctness over personal preference.
  • Decisions grounded in logic, data and multiple perspectives; "best practice" is not an argument until you explain why it applies here.
  • Fluent Russian.

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 22 paid vacation days annually, 5 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

﻿

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family. We make Skylight Calendar, the smart calendar loved by millions of families (plus Wired and Wirecutter). Calendar 2 launched earlier this year to rave reviews, and our newest product, Skylight Buddy, was just named one of TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026.

Our mission is to connect loved ones by creating the world’s simplest products and services that improve family life. Our founders are former venture capitalists and serial entrepreneurs who have scaled this business to $300M+ in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped and profitable. We get to grow a happy, healthy company focused on making products our customers love without investors breathing down our necks.

Smart, hardworking people who care about making actually meaningful products love working here. People like you. We’re busy inventing new ways to simplify family life and help parents raise great kids – and we need your help! Come invent something new with us.

About the Role:

The 3PL Manager will own our relationships with every third-party warehouse we use, in the US and internationally. You will be responsible for how well each warehouse performs for retail, direct-to-consumer, and wholesale orders: accuracy, speed, cost, and inventory you can trust. You will run the weekly and monthly reviews, hold each partner to its contract, and be the person who knows the real numbers before anyone asks. When we open a new site, move inventory between sites, or run an RFP, you lead it.

This is a hands-on role at a small, fast team. You will build the scorecards, reconciliations, and SOPs yourself. The ideal candidate is analytical, direct with partners, comfortable with a contract, and likes fixing things at the root.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the day-to-day and strategic relationship with each 3PL partner, including weekly operating reviews, monthly business reviews, and a clear escalation path.
  • Build and run a 3PL scorecard: ship-same-day %, order cycle time, dock-to-stock time, inventory accuracy, damage and shrink, error rates that lead to retailer chargebacks, and cost per order and per unit.
  • Hold partners to their contracts: SLAs, KPIs, liability terms, and rate cards. Manage amendments and renewals with Finance and Legal.
  • Audit 3PL invoices against the rate card and contract each month. Own claims and credits for lost, damaged, and missing inventory and for missed SLAs.
  • Own inventory accuracy between each 3PL’s WMS and NetSuite: cycle counts, location-level reconciliations, and adjustments with Accounting.
  • Lead new site onboarding and transitions between sites: cutover plans, inventory transfers, system and EDI integration, SOPs, and go-live readiness.
  • Run 3PL RFPs end to end: scope, bid analysis, site visits, and total-cost modeling.
  • Own our international 3PL network and work with forwarders and customs brokers on inbound flows.
  • Own value-added service programs at the warehouses (relabeling, kitting, sleeving, repack, rework) including SOPs, pricing, and quality checks.
  • Run capacity and peak planning with each partner: space, labor, forecast sharing, and holiday cutoffs.
  • Work with the Retail Logistics team on retailer requirements (labels, routing guides, appointments) so the warehouse can execute them.
  • Work with Planning and Purchasing on inbound receipts, dock appointments, and PO-to-receipt lag.
  • Lead continuous improvement across the 3PL network.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in warehouse, fulfillment, or supply chain operations, with 3+ years managing 3PL vendor relationships
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi-site 3PL performance with scorecards and business reviews
  • Experience reading and enforcing a 3PL agreement: SLAs, rate cards, liability, shrink, and insurance terms
  • Experience reconciling WMS inventory to an ERP
  • Experience auditing 3PL invoices and recovering overbilling or claims
  • Proficiency as a user of warehouse management systems
  • Advanced analytical skills (Google Sheets required, SQL a plus) and clear written communication

Bonus Points for:

  • Experience standing up a new 3PL site or exiting an old one
  • Experience with international 3PLs, cross-border flows, and customs brokers
  • Experience with NetSuite (SuiteQL a big plus)
  • Experience running a 3PL RFP and building a total-cost model
  • Experience with retail compliance (Target, Best Buy, Costco, Walmart, Sam’s Club)
  • Experience with e-commerce parcel fulfillment and consumer electronics
  • MBA or MS in Supply Chain Management or related field
  • Six Sigma certification or similar process improvement qualifications

Our Commitment:

We value diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives—and we hire kind, thoughtful people who care deeply about their work. If you're reading this and think, “I don’t check every box,” but still feel excited about the role: Apply. We want to hear from you.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package includes:

  • 401K matching

  • Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans
  • Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Excluding November, December, and January)

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $120k-$150k per year. This range reflects the compensation Skylight reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, which may include experience, qualifications, skills, education, geographic location, and internal equity. Skylight also offers benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and paid time off.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Skylight is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. jobs.description:
We’re building something ambitious at Fly.io: a new public cloud, running on our own hardware all over the world, built to make it easy to run apps close to users anywhere in the world.

Unlike the vast majority of our roles, this role is geographically specific; field marketing here is in large part about engaging local communities. We’re currently hiring a field marketer who can deliver work full time in North America and Europe, where our Developer Relations Engineers are located.

So far, we’ve focused a lot on self-serve growth: developers (our users) can find us, sign up, and build things on their own. Now, we want to meet developers where they are, out in the world. We’re looking for a Senior Field Marketing Manager to drive our presence in ecosystem events and Developer Relations.

This role combines event management, strategic planning, budget control, and audience engagement. You’ll manage field marketing events from conception through execution, making sure that Fly.io is showing up in an impactful way that’s aligned with who we are as a company. You’ll need to provide calm leadership in high-pressure situations and make sure that events run smoothly, even when challenges (inevitably) occur.

If you’re a community builder, this role should feel magical. Fly.io’s a group of really fun, genuine people, and we need you to help us reach more people like us. We don’t want you to shill; we want you to gameplan how to create over-the-top fun for developers, and then engage with them—using beautiful swag, good conversation, and great food and drinks—so that they become evangelists.

This role will be a good fit for you if:

  • You’ve done field marketing, event management, or something similar. (We want you to be able to show us the ropes on Day One.)
  • You’re super organized (no details gets past you) and great at project management.
  • You can translate Fly.io’s company goals into marketing strategies that resonate with technical audiences.
  • You like managing a budget, and know how to get the most “bang for your buck” when it comes to event planning.
  • You like to travel. We want to show up in person, all over the US and EU. (You can work from anywhere in North America or Europe, but we expect most of the events you’ll attend will be US/EU!)
  • You’re good at remaining poised and effective under stress. You can manage a crisis without disrupting an event or letting the audience know there’s an issue.
  • You’re good at managing expectations and pushing back when necessary. We need to keep initiatives on-brand and within budget, even when our internal stakeholders get excited.
  • You find it easy to build and sustain relationships, in any medium: in person, over Slack, over email, etc. Do folks call you a “people person?” If so, let’s talk.

You’ll know you’re succeeding in your job if:

  • Fly.io’s culture and public persona is consistent across all our field marketing activities.
  • You’re managing the field marketing budget so well that we’re getting far more valuable events than we thought were possible out of it.
  • Your field marketing strategy is enhancing Fly.io’s visibility and engagement within the developer community.
  • You’re planning and managing all aspects of our events, including logistics, vendor relationships, and on-site coordination.
  • You’ve built strong relationships with internal stakeholders, our ecosystem partners, and the broader developer community.

More Details

This is a mid-senior level, full-time salaried position. You can live anywhere in the North America or Europe. In order to optimize for pay equity,Fly.iodoesn’t negotiate salaries. We have standardized salaries for each employee level. The salary for this role is $134k-190k USD. We offer competitive equity grants with a long exercise window. US employees get health care, everyone gets flexible vacation time (with a minimum), hardware/phone allowances, the standard stuff.

We’re weird about hiring. We’re skeptical of resumes and we don’t trust traditional interviews. We respect career experience but we’re more excited about potential.

The premise of our hiring process is that we’re going to give you three challenges, a “work sample”, a “written challenge”, and a “work day”, that each simulate the kind of work you’ll actually be doing here. Unlike a lot of places that assign “take-home problems”, our challenges are the backbone of our whole process; they’re not pre-screeners for an interview gauntlet.

If you’re interested, . You can tell us a bit about yourself, if you like. Please also include 1. your location and 2. your favorite industry euphemism for “customer”, so we know you’re not a bot.

  • Experience working with external relocation vendors or global mobility service providers, including coordinating services, monitoring case progression, and resolving operational issues

  • Strong problem-solving and interpersonal skills, with the ability to exercise sound judgment, identify potential issues, and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and external service providers
