jobs.excerpt: School of Medicine Established in 1930, Duke University School of Medicine is the youngest of the nation's top medical schools.
jobs.description:
School of Medicine Established in 1930, Duke University School of Medicine is the youngest of the nation's top medical schools. Ranked sixth among medical schools in the nation, the School takes pride in being an inclusive community of outstanding learners, investigators, clinicians, and staff where interdisciplinary collaboration is embraced and great ideas accelerate translation of fundamental scientific discoveries to improve human health locally and around the globe. Composed of more than 2,600 faculty physicians and researchers, nearly 2,000 students, and more than 6,200 staff, the Duke University School of Medicine along with the Duke University School of Nursing, and Duke University Health System comprise Duke Health, a world-class academic medical center. The Health System encompasses Duke University Hospital, Duke Regional Hospital, Duke Raleigh Hospital, Duke Health Integrated Practice, Duke Primary Care, Duke Home Care and Hospice, Duke Health and Wellness, and multiple affiliations.

Be You.

Occupational Summary

This position has the option to be 100% remote. Candidates must reside in one of the approved states for remote work, which can be viewed here:

This position will be located within the School of Medicine Shared Research Administration Resource Group and will play an active role in working with specifically identified departments to manage their portfolio of grants and contracts.

Pre-award activities include assisting departmental faculty/PI in the development, preparation, and submission of grant and contract proposals. Ensure all applications and contracts meet agency and university guidelines and published time tables and deadlines. Ensure proposals are entered and routed in a timely manner for further review. Post-award activities include detailed reconciliation of assigned project budgets, preparing complex budget reports, preparing adjustments and corrections in assigned project budgets for further review and approval in order to meet project goals and federal requirements.

This position is responsible for managing and overseeing an assigned portfolio of complex grants and contracts using knowledge of grant and contract management rules and regulations, technical expertise, and analytical skills.

Required Qualifications at this Level

Education/Training: Work requires communications, analytical and organizational skills generally acquired through completion of a bachelor's degree program. Research or grants education and/or certification is preferred.

Successful completion of Financial Services Introduction to R3, Introduction to Duke GL, Introduction to Accounting, Sponsored Research Reporting, Research Administration at Duke (online), Basic Compliance (online), Duke Human Research Training (online), Budget Development and Negotiation Training, and Industry Funded Clinical Research—Process for Contracts within first six months of hire is required.

Successful completion of the Research Administration Academy (RAA) is expected. Employees hired into this classification without RAA training will work closely with their manager to schedule and complete the training within 12 months of start date. The expectation is that the staff members will maintain the requirements for their level. Failing to meet these requirements will be addressed through the performance review process.

Upon successful completion of expected training, the employee must maintain certification(s) by completing continuing education requirements.

Experience: No experience is required for candidates who possess a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a field of study directly related to the specific position.

Skills: Ability to analyze data and formulate conclusions.

- Ability to learn changing technologies related to grants and contracts management.

- Proficient use of computers; requires solid working knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Access, Excel, Power Point).

- Ability to communicate both verbally and in writing with all levels of the organization.

- Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects/tasks simultaneously.

- Ability to create verbal and written reports.

- Knowledge of federal rules and regulations relating to research grant and/or contract activity

- Knowledge of Duke University policies and procedures relating to grant and contracts activity

- Knowledge of Duke University processes, systems and offices related to and/or involved in grant and contract submission and management.

- Understand and be able to apply federal and university rules to management of effort allocation for individuals compensated whole or in part from federal awards.

- Understand and be able to apply costing rules and regulations to federally funded projects.

- Experience with/Ability to perform required functions in SPS, R3, grants.duke and SES relating to assigned duties.

- Understand financial processes and controls including the reconciliation process

Tier Structure

Associate: Proficient as a grants and contracts administrator.

Advanced: Experienced, highly capable, and requires minimal oversight of work. Experience - 3 years of relevant experience (2 years for internal employees who have received 2 Exceeds Expectations on performance reviews). Training - RAA required in addition to 2 electives to prepare for AGM is required. AGM must be completed within 12 months.

Senior: Subject matter expert. May be responsible for mentoring and developing others. Experience - 6 years of relevant experience (5 years for internal employees who have received 4 Exceeds Expectations on performance reviews. CRA certification can also reduce the years of experience requirement to 5 years). Training - RAA and AGM required. Expected to attend all the appropriate internal updates.

Lead: Advanced tier competencies as well as responsibilities for mentoring and developing staff. Oversees work of others. May or may not carry same responsibilities as a full supervisor. Experience - 3 years of relevant experience (2 years for internal employees who have received 2 Exceeds Expectations on performance reviews). Training - RAA and AGM required. Expected to attend all the appropriate internal updates.

Be Bold.

Work Performed

Pre-award Job Responsibilities (30%)

  • Develop budgets and budget justification which include proofing the budget for inconsistencies and ensuring accuracy.
  • Prepare and submit grants and contracts through pre-award process utilizing both Sponsor and Duke regulations. Follow through to submission to Sponsor.
  • Advise the faculty/PI on administrative requirements in preparing proposal submissions.
  • Assist faculty/PI and study team with development of internal cost assessment and subsequent budget development and negotiation with sponsor including the use of the Clinical Research Management System, if applicable.
  • Prepare, coordinate and review proposal elements such as biosketches, justifications and facilities & resources for consistency, accuracy, and completeness.
  • Monitor compliance with agency and University regulations regarding submission; verify all financial information, including the application of the appropriate overhead rate for the project.
  • Review sponsored projects through Sponsored Projects System to Office of Research Administration to ensure compliance with University procedures and institutional signatures.
  • Participate, as necessary, in study initiation meetings to help facilitate internal cost assessment development and budget negotiations.

Post-award Job Responsibilities (50%)

  • Manage assigned projects and financial project portfolios.
  • Ensure understanding of the current fiscal performance of studies and identify areas of concern that need resolution. Advise faculty/PI on budget adjustments and revisions necessary to meet the sponsor requirements.
  • Monitor proposal status and advise faculty/PI on requirements and deadlines associated with research protection protocols
  • Manage budget, reporting and compliance timelines through the lifecycle of the grant or contract; communicate new WBSEs to appropriate department personnel.
  • Establish sub-recipient financial and reporting requirements; coordinate issuance of sub-agreements with ORA.
  • Reconcile monthly budget reports and inform faculty/PI and/or supervisor of corrections/adjustments that have been made.
  • Identify and submit the cost transfers resulting from budget reconciliation.
  • As requirements change, prepare and submit requests for re- budgeting/modifying the funded project. Reconcile and close all sub-recipient cost objects and obtain all sponsor-required reports.
  • Monitor compliance with agency and University regulations regarding reporting.
  • Maintain financial records per the institutional documents retention guidelines.
  • Monitor and determine appropriate charging of patient care expenses to the study cost object(s).
  • Manage overdrafts in line with unit procedures and institution guidelines.
  • Ensure proper recording of revenue associated with all projects; applying revenue management standards.
  • Close all funded projects consistent with university processes and timelines.

Administrative Job Responsibilities (20%)

  • Develop project management plan for review by the faculty/PI or senior level grants administrator.
  • May make cost-sharing adjustments to reflect appropriate labor distribution or related cost-sharing obligations.
  • Ensure process (SOP) is in place within the unit for proper handling and tracking of Sponsor payments into the project cost object. This process must be handled in accordance with the institution’s current policy.
  • Interpret departmental policies and procedures, making decisions on specific operating problems and issuing instructions on behalf of unit.
  • Apply federal and university rules to appropriately manage effort for individuals compensated, in whole or in part, from sponsored awards
  • Submit reports to the Grants and Contracts Manager/Divisional Administrator/Business Manager when requested

Choose Duke.

The intent of this job description is to provide a representative and level of the types of duties and responsibilities that will be required of positions given this title and shall not be construed as a declaration of the total of the specific duties and responsibilities of any particular position. Employees may be directed to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description.



Anticipated Pay Range: Duke University provides an annual base salary range for this position as USD $61,026.00 to USD $98,838.00. Duke University considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position; candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills; internal peer equity; as well as market and organizational considerations when extending an offer.


Your total compensation goes beyond the dollars on your paycheck. Duke provides comprehensive and competitive medical and dental care programs, generous retirement benefits, and a wide array of family-friendly and cultural programs to eligible team members. Learn more at:

Data Insights & Operations Manager

Location: Remote within the United States

ABOUT ANET

Achievement Network (ANet) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping all students achieve strong educational outcomes. We partner with school and system leaders to strengthen teaching and learning through the strategic use of assessments, coaching, and tools that drive meaningful results. Individuals who join ANet become part of a dynamic, mission-driven, and collaborative organization focused on making a lasting impact in schools. We are committed to supporting one another and growing together as a team.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is an Exempt, Full-Time role, expected to work approximately 40 hours per week.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Partner Insights & Operations, the Data Insights & Operations Manager will lead how ANet turns data into insights that school and system leaders use to make decisions. Insights is one of ANet’s biggest bets: data is only as valuable as the insights drawn from it, and this role makes sure decision makers can make meaning of relevant data quickly and at scale.

The Data Insights & Operations Manager will be responsible for shaping and leading the production of insights for our partners, and ensuring there is the right data to create those insights through cross functional collaboration.

TRAVEL

Approximately 2 times a year

RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead the production of standardized and partner insights

  • Shape and execute the approach for content and delivery of partner insights - standardized and partner specific
  • Ensure clear roles and responsibilities for production and distribution of insights
  • Review qualitative and quantitative data alongside the team to ensure insights are achieving intended outcomes
  • Identify opportunities to build efficiency, precision, and actionability into partner insights (standardized and partner specific)
  • Pilot other approaches to insight generation and visualization aimed at scaling standardized insight delivery
  • Build efficiency, precision and actionability into insights, and pilot new approaches to generation and visualization (including AI) to scale delivery without proportional headcount.

Ensure the right data exists to produce those insights

  • Partner with Product, Partner Experience & Impact, Design & Innovation, Marketing and Sales so insight needs are reflected in what’s collected and how systems connect.
  • Define and maintain ownership, access and quality standards for the data that feeds insights.
  • Collaborates with Product, Partner Experience & Impact, Design & Innovation, Marketing, and Sales to ensure organizational measurement needs are captured and reflected in systems

Manage and develop the analyst team

  • Manage and develop Data & Insights analysts
  • Build tools, templates, and QA routines that let analysts scale work

COMPETENCIES

In order to be successful in this role, candidates must demonstrate the following:

  • Critical Thinking & Data Orientation:
    • Prioritizes which information is of greatest value, recognizes and reconciles discrepancies across sources, and extracts sophisticated insight from complex, multi-source data.
    • Considers the implications of data disaggregation and ensures they are routinely applied when generating solutions or making decisions.
    • Communicates the implications of data within the department and offers tailored guidance based on insights.
  • Planning and Prioritization:
    • Builds contingencies into plans for known barriers so nearly all work is delivered on time, and organizes complex work that needs input from across the team and other departments.
    • Brings a solution orientation to harder obstacles and asks for help early to keep project goals and timelines on track.
  • Communication:
    • Produces concise, professional writing and communicates with precision; speaks fluently about the team’s goals and how they map to day-to-day decisions.
    • Actively seeks out stakeholders’ points of view across functions (Product, Engineering, Marketing, analysts), with empathy and awareness of how bias affects interpretation.
  • Management
    • Has experience managing and developing a team, and will manage and develop the Data & Insights analysts
    • Adjusts management style to the needs of each direct report
    • Allocates time to grow analysts’ skills and remove barriers, with attention to equitable coaching and development
    • Develops structures, systems, and practices that let analysts work autonomously without sacrificing quality

Ideal candidates may also demonstrate the following preferred qualifications:

  • 4+ years of related experience.
  • Experience using technical tools and analyzing data in spreadsheets across sources such as Retool, Salesforce, Tableau, and HubSpot
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude
  • Experience working in education or the education sector

BENEFITS & COMPENSATION

We offer comprehensive benefits to best support our people. Benefits include: medical, dental and vision insurance where ANet pays a portion of the cost of these benefits for employees and their families/domestic partner; generous paid time-off including 10 paid holidays and paid days off between the Christmas and New Year’s holidays; paid parental leave; educational expenses reimbursements; flexible spending accounts; professional development; a 401(k) plan with a 4% match; short and long-term disability coverage; and basic life and personal accident insurance.

The salary range for this position is between $80,376 - $120,564. New hires will start between the range minimum and midpoint ($80,376- $100,470) based on qualifications assessed during the hiring process, past experience, and internal equity. In order to uphold our commitment to transparent, equitable, competitive, and sustainable compensation, ANet does not negotiate pay.

APPLY

We are now accepting applications for this position through 5:00 pm ET on November 6. Please submit your application online. Learn more about the application process here.

Internal Candidates: If interested, please notify your manager of your interest and submit your application on ANet’s Career page.

ANet is committed to maximizing the diversity of our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage individuals of all ethnic and racial backgrounds and gender identities to apply to our positions.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Job Title: Senior Certification Lead

Location: Remote - US

Salary Range: $122,400 - $183,600, plus bonus eligible

Who we are: Lynx delivers modular, open standards–based software that transforms how high-assurance, mission-critical edge systems are built, deployed, and maintained. Our secure edge computing solutions enable innovation and operational excellence in the world’s most demanding environments, from aerospace and defense to commercial and industrial systems. We partner across industries including automotive, medical, and critical infrastructure to deliver tailored solutions aligned with each customer’s mission and operational requirements. Our key products and services are:

  • MOSA.ic: LYNX MOSA.ic™ is a modular software framework and architecture purpose-built for mission-critical edge computing. Based on the Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA), it provides a flexible foundation for building secure, scalable, and certifiable edge systems.
  • LYNX MOSA.ic.AI: LYNX MOSA.ic.AI is a unified CPU and GPU software platform that enables deterministic, certifiable deployment of AI and advanced workloads in mission-critical edge systems. It brings control, performance, and lifecycle governance together, allowing AI to operate predictably within safety-critical environments without compromising certification or system integrity.
  • CoreSuite 2.0: CoreSuite 2.0 is Lynx’s safety-critical GPU for graphics enablement framework designed for mission-critical edge computing systems. It provides hardware-accelerated graphics, visualization, and video processing capabilities that can be certified for high-assurance systems.
  • Services: Lynx Services is Lynx’s professional services organization that helps customers design, integrate, certify, deploy, and maintain safety- and security-critical systems. It supports industries like aerospace, defense, automotive, and industrial computing through consulting, engineering, integration, and lifecycle support, reducing development risk and accelerating certification in standards-driven, mission-critical environment.

Main Responsibilities:

·Certification Planning & Execution: Refine and implement process development processes in accordance with DO-178C (software) standards.

·Process Document Creation: Write and update DO-178C process documents.

·Documentation Management: Oversee the preparation, review, and submission of key certification artifacts, including Plans for Software Aspects of Certification (PSAC), Software Plans, Compliance Checklists, and Compliance Reports.

·Process Coordination: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate certification requirements into the system development lifecycle.

·Technical Leadership: Provide guidance on best practices for software certification, ensuring compliance with industry standards such as ARP 4754A, ARP 4761, and AC 20-152A.

·Verification & Validation Oversight: Ensure robust verification, validation, and traceability processes are implemented for software components.

·Audit & Review Support: Prepare for and participate in certification audits, including SOI (Stage of Involvement) audits conducted by regulatory authorities including DERs.

·Risk Management: Identify and mitigate certification risks, ensuring project deliverables meet safety and compliance requirements.

·Stakeholder Communication: Act as a primary liaison between engineering teams, certification authorities, and customers to address certification-related concerns

Required Skills:

·Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.

·Minimum of 7 years of experience in aerospace certification with a strong background in DO-254 or DO-178C.

·Hands-on experience in preparing certification artifacts and supporting compliance activities.

·Strong understanding of safety assessments, system engineering practices, and quality assurance standards.

·Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

·Ability to clearly write and review complex documents.

·Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.

·Proven leadership skills within a software development team.

·Fluent in American English (spoken and written).

·Having supported at least one external audit of a project they lead.

Nice to Have Skills:

·Experience with avionics software lifecycle processes.

·Knowledge of Configuration Management and Change Control processes.

·Understanding of emerging trends in software certification methodologies.

·Certification experience with DAL A/B systems is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Imagine WorldwideAll children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need.
jobs.description:
About Imagine Worldwide

All children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need. Imagine Worldwide believes that every child should be empowered with the basic right to literacy and numeracy. We provide an innovative education technology solution and implementation model to the global literacy/numeracy learning crisis using the onebillion application and various toolkits and systems to support implementation. Our model is massively scalable, evidence-based, and can deliver foundational learning to millions of the most marginalized children.

Imagine Worldwide partners with governments, organizations, and communities to provide child-directed, tablet-based learning that is accessible, effective, and affordable. We are incorporated in California (United States) as a nonprofit organization, but operate in Sub-Saharan Africa through locally-registered entities in Malawi, Sierra Leone, and Tanzania. Learn more on our website.

Role Overview

The Senior Analytics Engineer builds, runs and improves Imagine’s analytics platform: the infrastructure, pipelines and core data models that the organisation’s reporting and analysis depend on. The central task is to scale the platform as data volumes grow, keeping costs under control without giving up performance. In a small team, that means covering the infrastructure underneath the data as well as the data engineering itself.

Imagine’s data comes from many sources. The largest is tablets in more than 1,500 schools across Malawi, Tanzania and Sierra Leone, which record learning activity as individual events, adding up to billions of records. These only become meaningful when joined with programme context, such as active schools per term, device allocations and enrolment, and with operational data from inventory and field data collection. Turning all of this into reliable data on a non-profit budget calls for careful decisions about where processing happens and what each workload costs.

The role reports to the Director of Analytics, who sets the platform’s architecture and technical standards, and works alongside the rest of the Analytics Team. We are looking for someone senior who takes initiative, turns architectural direction into working systems, and brings forward evidence-based proposals for improving them. As the engineer builds context, they take on increasing ownership of the platform’s day-to-day running and technical decisions.

Key Responsibilities

The Senior Analytics Engineer’s responsibilities fall into four pillars. The first two cover the platform itself: the infrastructure it runs on, and the pipelines that bring data in from many sources and process it at scale. The third covers orchestration and the core data models that the rest of the Analytics Team builds on. The fourth covers the practices that keep the platform reliable, secure and affordable to run.

Data Platform and Infrastructure

Imagine’s analytics platform runs on AWS and ClickHouse Cloud, with infrastructure managed as code. In a small team, this role carries the infrastructure work that a larger organisation would split across dedicated platform or DevOps staff, limited to the scope of the analytics platform.

  • Build and maintain the platform’s AWS infrastructure, including storage, compute, networking, the data catalogue, secrets and access management (S3, EC2, Glue Data Catalog, Lake Formation, IAM, Secrets Manager).
  • Manage infrastructure as code in Terraform, keeping environments reproducible, version-controlled and reviewable.
  • Administer the ClickHouse Cloud warehouse, including service configuration, user and role management, and monitoring of performance and capacity.
  • Host and maintain the team’s self-hosted tools, including Apache Superset for BI and Apache Airflow for orchestration. This covers deployment, upgrades, authentication and availability. The Senior BI & Data Analyst manages the dashboards and content within Superset.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions on how the platform evolves, setting out options and trade-offs for review with the Director of Analytics.

Large-Scale Data Processing and Pipelines

Data reaches the platform from application databases, operational systems and field data tools, and lands in an Apache Iceberg data lake on S3. Spark-based processing on AWS Glue does the heavy work before the data moves into ClickHouse for analysis. The aim is to do expensive processing once, as far upstream as practical, so that downstream models and queries stay fast and affordable.

  • Build and maintain ingestion pipelines from the platform’s sources, including application databases, APIs and operational systems, using tools such as AWS Glue, Airbyte and AWS Lambda.
  • Implement incremental loading patterns that stay efficient and recoverable as volumes grow, landing raw data in the lake in a form that preserves its full history.
  • Develop and optimise Spark jobs that process billions of device events into learning sessions and higher-level aggregates, paying close attention to partitioning, skew and compute cost.
  • Bring in and model the programme context that gives event data its meaning, such as schools, terms, device allocations and enrolment, and handle how that context changes over time.
  • Design and maintain Iceberg tables for performance and cost, including partitioning strategy, file sizing, compaction and snapshot management.
  • Validate data at ingestion and surface quality issues early, working with the Analytics Team to trace them back to their source.
  • Contribute to evaluating new processing approaches as volumes grow, including moving more work upstream and assessing where streaming would add value.

Orchestration and Transformation

Apache Airflow orchestrates the platform’s pipelines, and dbt transforms data in ClickHouse into the models that reporting and analysis rely on. This role builds and maintains the foundational layers of those models.

  • Build and maintain Airflow workflows that coordinate ingestion, processing and transformation, with clear dependencies, retries and alerting.
  • Develop and maintain dbt staging and core models in ClickHouse, following consistent conventions for naming, structure and materialisation.
  • Implement incremental models for high-volume tables, choosing materialisation strategies and table designs that balance freshness, correctness and cost.
  • Write and maintain dbt tests and model contracts for core datasets, so that changes that would break downstream reporting are caught before they reach production.
  • Document core models such as learning sessions as agreed definitions, including their lineage, and make clear where a model applies an approximation rather than a direct transformation.
  • Work with the Senior BI & Data Analyst on the boundary between core and reporting models, and with the Data Scientist on datasets for research and evaluation.

Reliability, Cost and Engineering Practice

A small team needs a platform that runs predictably and that more than one person understands. This pillar covers the engineering practices that make that possible.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for infrastructure, pipeline and dbt code, including automated checks that stop unsafe changes from reaching production.
  • Implement monitoring and alerting across pipelines, the warehouse and hosted tools, so that failures and delays are visible quickly and reach the right people.
  • Respond to platform incidents and data issues, carry out root cause analysis, and contribute to the team’s data quality incident process.
  • Apply and maintain access controls and security practices across the data lake, warehouse and BI layer, in line with Imagine’s data governance policies.
  • Monitor platform costs across AWS and ClickHouse, track the cost and performance of individual workloads over time, and use that evidence to identify savings and prioritise optimisation work.
  • Maintain and periodically test backup and recovery procedures for the platform’s core components.
  • Take part in code review and write clear runbooks and technical documentation, following the team’s documentation standards, so that knowledge of the platform is shared across the team.

Requirements

The qualifications below are grouped by importance. Core requirements are needed to do the role from the start. Strongly preferred skills shorten the time it takes to become effective on Imagine’s platform. Advantageous experience adds value but is not expected. We do not expect any one candidate to bring everything listed here.

Education

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Demonstrated experience is weighted equally to formal credentials.

Experience

  • At least 7 years in data engineering, software engineering or platform engineering roles, including at least 3 years building and running distributed data processing (Spark or equivalent) in production.
  • A track record of taking responsibility for a production data platform, or major parts of one, including its reliability, performance and day-to-day operation.
  • Experience working with datasets in the hundreds of millions to billions of records, and designing processing that stays efficient as volumes grow.
  • Experience running data workloads within real budget constraints: making deliberate trade-offs between compute, storage and performance, and being able to show the effect of those decisions.
  • Experience managing the cloud infrastructure that data workloads run on, not only using managed services.
  • Experience in small teams where engineers cover a broad scope and work with limited supervision.
  • Experience working with remote teams across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Experience in the non-profit, international development or social sector is an advantage but not a requirement.

Technical Skills: Core

  • Strong Python, written to production standards, with testing and modular design.
  • Advanced SQL, including writing and optimising queries against analytical databases.
  • Spark (PySpark), including performance tuning for partitioning, shuffles and data skew.
  • A solid understanding of data lake design, including columnar formats such as Parquet, partitioning strategy, and when to process in the lake rather than the warehouse.
  • Hands-on AWS experience with data services and the infrastructure around them, such as S3, Glue or EMR, IAM and EC2.
  • Infrastructure as code, using Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK or similar.
  • Linux administration and Docker, to the level needed to deploy and maintain self-hosted services.
  • dbt in production, including incremental models and testing.
  • Workflow orchestration with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect or similar.
  • Git, CI/CD and code review practice.

Technical Skills: Strongly Preferred

  • Apache Iceberg, or another open table format such as Delta Lake or Hudi.
  • ClickHouse, or a comparable columnar warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift.
  • Terraform specifically.
  • Apache Airflow specifically.
  • AWS Glue and Lake Formation.
  • Data modelling for analytics, including handling reference data that changes over time.

Technical Skills: Advantageous

  • Managed Spark platforms such as Databricks.
  • Streaming technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Kinesis or Spark Structured Streaming.
  • Event, telemetry or IoT data, particularly from devices that sync intermittently.
  • Ingestion tools such as Airbyte.
  • Administering BI tools such as Apache Superset.
  • Software development beyond data pipelines, such as building APIs or system integrations.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary is competitive and commensurate with experience.

Location

The Senior Analytics Engineer must be based in Africa. The role will frequently collaborate and coordinate with operations teams across Africa, the US, and the UK.

This is a full-time remote position; the role can be based anywhere in Africa with reliable internet access and alignment with core working hours across time zones. The role may involve occasional international travel for in-person team meetings, field support or training, as needed. Candidates should be comfortable working independently in a virtual environment and coordinating with colleagues across global teams.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis

jobs.description:
Job Title: Client Success Point of Contact (POC)

Position Overview

The Client Success Point of Contact (POC) serves as the primary liaison between clients, remote talent professionals, and internal teams. This role is responsible for managing the health of the client–talent partnership throughout the entire engagement lifecycle — from pre-onboarding to ongoing performance support, risk management, and transitions when needed.

The POC plays a critical role in ensuring both the client and the remote talent professional are aligned, supported, and set up for long-term success. This requires someone who understands the remote staffing / virtual talent industry, including the operational challenges, expectations from both clients and remote professionals, and the dynamics of remote working relationships.

Beyond coordination, the POC must demonstrate strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills. They must be able to identify early warning signs in client or talent relationships, recognize underlying causes of issues, and proactively intervene before small concerns escalate into larger problems.

This role requires a balance of relationship management, operational oversight, and strategic thinking to maintain service quality and client satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Client & Remote Talent Lifecycle Management

  • Manage the full client and remote talent professional journey from pre-onboarding to offboarding.
  • Review client requirements, job descriptions, and internal records to ensure alignment before onboarding begins.
  • Confirm all documentation and contracts are completed prior to onboarding schedules.
  • Prepare and facilitate onboarding discussions to ensure both the client and the remote talent professional have clear expectations.
  • Document important client preferences, workflows, communication styles, and expectations to support long-term success.
  • Ensure that new engagements start with a clear structure and strong operational foundation.

Partnership Health & Performance Monitoring

  • Conduct regular check-in calls with both clients and remote talent professionals to monitor engagement health.
  • Evaluate the quality of the client–talent partnership, including communication, workload balance, expectations, and performance alignment.
  • Monitor deliverables, KPIs, and operational feedback to ensure service quality is maintained.
  • Identify early signs of potential risks such as misaligned expectations, communication breakdowns, workload concerns, or performance issues.
  • Provide feedback summaries and recommendations to help maintain productive working relationships.
  • Support coaching conversations where necessary to improve collaboration and performance.

Risk Identification & Problem Solving

  • Apply critical thinking to identify underlying factors affecting client satisfaction or talent performance, rather than addressing only surface-level issues.
  • Recognize patterns that may lead to disengagement, partnership breakdowns, or service dissatisfaction.
  • Proactively propose solutions to stabilize or improve partnerships before escalation becomes necessary.
  • Act as an objective problem solver who balances the needs of both the client and the remote talent professional.

Replacement, Transition & Offboarding Management

  • Manage replacement or transition processes when needed based on client requests or operational considerations.
  • Coordinate closely with recruitment, HR, and internal teams to ensure smooth transitions.
  • Ensure proper handover of tasks, documentation, and knowledge transfer between professionals.
  • Oversee completion of all required documentation and closure procedures when engagements end.

Cross-Department Coordination

  • Work closely with Recruitment, HR, Finance, and Operations to support client and talent needs.
  • Ensure all stakeholders are informed of important updates, concerns, or changes in engagement status.
  • Facilitate efficient communication between departments to resolve issues quickly and effectively.
  • Maintain accurate records of client and talent interactions within internal systems.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience working within the remote staffing, outsourcing, or virtual talent industry is strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience in client success, account management, partnership management, or operations roles.
  • Strong understanding of the dynamics between clients and remote talent professionals in a service-based model.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational risks and proactively resolve partnership issues.
  • Experience conducting performance discussions, check-ins, and engagement reviews.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to identify root causes and underlying partnership risks.
  • Excellent communication and relationship management skills.
  • High emotional intelligence and ability to navigate sensitive conversations.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment with cross-functional teams.

Why This Role Matters

The Client Success POC is essential in maintaining healthy, long-term partnerships between clients and remote talent professionals. By proactively identifying risks, improving communication, and ensuring alignment between both parties, this role directly contributes to client retention, service quality, and the long-term success of the organization.

Position Overview

Autodesk is looking for a Communications Manager to join our Customer & Partner Communications team. In this role, you will help connect employees and partners with the information they need to understand Autodesk's priorities, navigate change and take action.


You will lead the strategy and editorial direction for high-visibility communications reaching Autodesk's global go-to-market audiences, with an initial focus on recurring communications for Autodesk’s field teams and our partner ecosystem. You will determine what our audiences need to know, help stakeholders turn complex information into clear and useful communications, and continuously improve how and when we reach these audiences.


This is a role for a strong communicator with excellent editorial judgment who is comfortable moving between strategy and hands-on execution. You will write and edit content, manage editorial priorities, advise stakeholders on communications approaches, and partner with colleagues responsible for channel production and delivery.


In addition to owning core communications channels, you will have opportunities to support other internal communications, go-to-market initiatives, business changes and strategic priorities.



Responsibilities

Communications Strategy and Editorial Leadership

  • Lead the communications and editorial strategy for recurring channels serving Autodesk's global field and partner audiences
  • Develop editorial calendars and content plans that connect business priorities with the information audiences need to be successful
  • Make thoughtful decisions about what to communicate, when to communicate it, and which channels and formats will be most effective
  • Identify themes, stories, and opportunities that help audiences understand the broader context behind individual business updates
  • Maintain a strong editorial standard across communications, ensuring content is clear, relevant, concise, actionable, and appropriate for the audience
  • Help evolve existing communications channels and identify opportunities to improve the overall audience experience

Writing and Content Development

  • Write, edit, and shape communications on a range of business topics, from strategic initiatives and organizational changes to programs, launches, events, and operational updates

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across Communications, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and other internal business teams

  • Bring stakeholders together around coordinated communications plans and identify opportunities to reduce duplication, noise, or conflicting messages

Channel and Program Management

Measurement and Continuous Improvement

About the Role

We are looking for a Technical Customer Experience Specialist to join our growing digital business and provide high-quality online support to our customers.

This role is ideal for someone with previous technical support experience who enjoys investigating problems, helping customers, and working closely with technical and operational teams to resolve issues.

You will be one of the primary points of contact for customers requiring assistance with our digital platform and services. You will take ownership of support requests from initial contact through investigation, resolution and follow-up.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide professional technical support to customers through online support channels including ticketing systems and email.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot technical and application-related issues reported by customers.
  • Take ownership of support tickets and manage them through to resolution.
  • Gather relevant information, logs, screenshots and other diagnostic information to help identify the cause of technical issues.
  • Reproduce reported problems and distinguish between user, configuration, connectivity and software-related issues.
  • Resolve issues directly where possible and escalate more complex problems to engineering or other specialist teams.
  • Clearly document issues, investigation steps, findings and resolutions within the support platform.
  • Keep customers informed of progress, particularly when an issue requires escalation or additional investigation.
  • Prioritise support requests according to severity, customer impact and agreed service levels.
  • Monitor outstanding support requests and ensure appropriate follow-up.
  • Identify recurring issues and work with product and engineering teams to address underlying causes.
  • Create and maintain FAQs, troubleshooting guides, knowledge-base articles and other customer support documentation.
  • Provide feedback to Product and Engineering teams based on customer issues and recurring support trends.
  • Assist with customer onboarding, configuration and implementation where required.
  • Contribute to improving support processes, tools, reporting and overall customer experience.

Experience & Skills

Required

  • Previous experience in a technical support or service desk role.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working with web-based applications and digital platforms.
  • Ability to investigate technical issues logically and methodically.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Strong customer communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users.
  • Experience working with ticketing or customer support systems.
  • Ability to manage multiple support requests and prioritise effectively.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
  • Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with colleagues across different countries and time zones.
  • Based within the European Union with the right to work in the country of employment.

Desirable - Experience in some of the following would be beneficial:

  • SaaS or cloud-based platforms

  • Working with software development or engineering teams

What We’re Looking For

You are naturally curious and enjoy understanding why something isn’t working rather than simply passing the problem to somebody else. You are comfortable communicating directly with customers while also being able to work effectively with engineers and other technical specialists. You take ownership of problems, communicate clearly and understand that keeping a customer informed can be just as important as resolving the technical issue itself. You should be comfortable working in a fast-moving digital environment where priorities can change and where support often requires collaboration across Customer Success, Operations, Product and Engineering.

  • Remote and flexible working environment.
  • Exposure to modern digital and cloud technologies.
  • Direct interaction with international customers and partners.
  • Close collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.

  • Employer Pension Contribution
  • 25 Days Annual Leave per year

  • Qualify, Manage, and Win Expansion: You own expansion from identification through qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close across departments, projects, and offerings. You explain why the relevant offering fits and address concerns, bringing in teammates as subject-matter experts for specialized offerings and working with internal specialists and experts for solution expertise and scoping. You own the client relationship. You maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in Salesforce (SFDC).
  • Uncover Value Early: You monitor demand signals and platform data to offer “uncovered value,” identifying needs before the client voices them, and you use outreach and engagement campaigns, including Salesloft cadences, to educate clients on Toptal’s full breadth of services.
  • Own the Client Experience: You own the client relationship and the client’s experience of every engagement, from kickoff onward. You stay close to active work, address concerns with a client-first mindset, and partner with Talent Operations and Delivery, who execute the work, to keep engagements on track so that retention is earned through results.
  • First Line of Defense: You are the first to respond when a client raises an issue, resolving smaller concerns yourself and escalating to Client Experience when an issue needs more than you can solve on your own. You partner with Talent Operations, Delivery, HireGlobal, and services experts to bring the right expertise into an account at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Meet colleagues across Customer, Talent Operations, Delivery, and HireGlobal to begin your onboarding journey.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the Account Manager did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales and vertical-specific training, demonstrating fluency in our full range of talent, HireGlobal, and services offerings, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Begin joining client calls, learning who the business partners are on both sides of each relationship and where Toptal can help them grow.
  • Review and prioritize your portfolio, and draft an initial account plan for each of your accounts.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Complete all onboarding and portfolio transitions, and establish yourself as the primary point of contact for your accounts through introduction and discovery calls.
  • Establish a working cadence with key clients and with the team members supporting those accounts, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. Run account health check-ins that surface at least one new business need beyond the client’s original request.
  • Build a qualified expansion pipeline across your portfolio based on priority account plans with consistently high-performing call-quality metrics and accurate forecasts maintained in SFDC.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Execute your account plans and consistently meet or exceed your defined revenue and expansion metrics, with a clear pattern of organic growth across your portfolio.
  • Expand the scope of engagements to include new departments, projects, and offerings, including HireGlobal and services opportunities.
  • Identify where expansion opportunities lose momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Demonstrate portfolio net revenue growth through sustained retention and expansion performance, with a consistent qualified pipeline of new opportunities across your accounts.
  • Be a trusted advisor to your clients, and a reference point for the team on maintaining forecast accuracy, account planning excellence, and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Mentor new team members, sharing best practices on Toptal’s model and on moving from transactional to consultative account management.
  • Position yourself for senior-level partnership responsibilities.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 3+ years of B2B account management or sales experience, with a demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding revenue-based quotas.
  • 1+ years of experience in a software consulting or tech sales role, with proficiency navigating the software project lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated experience growing and retaining existing client accounts, including proactively creating and closing expansion opportunities, reaching new decision makers, and connecting new business needs to additional solutions.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of accounts in parallel and maintaining momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Ability to translate a client’s business objectives into recommendations and actionable project scopes that demonstrate Toptal’s value.
  • Experience maintaining accurate pipeline, forecast, and account data in a CRM.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a diverse array of clients and competing deadlines. Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to a named sales methodology, such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

These are what we assess for in interviews and coach against after you join.

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You uncover the “why” behind a client’s request.
  • Proactive ownership. You do not wait for a client to name a new opportunity or voice dissatisfaction. You analyze their trajectory, spot gaps, needs, and roadblocks before they occur, and you own the outcome, successes and failures alike.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk, and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation, stay current on industry trends, and are willing to respectfully reframe a client’s thinking when their stated request is not the best path to their goal.
  • Portfolio thinking. You see beyond the single engagement and can position specialized talent, HireGlobal, and services offerings as parts of one growth plan.
  • Account discipline. You bring consistent, disciplined account management and process adherence, including rigorous SFDC hygiene, to execute account strategies and long-term growth.
  • Client-centricity. You are committed to the client’s success, across the talent we provide, the experience we offer, and the outcomes we deliver, and you are direct about fit when Toptal is not the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive, with yourself first, and optimistic and ambitious in the face of change. You want to exceed targets, not just meet them.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You seek feedback, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Collaborative and grounded. Nothing we do is done in isolation. You work as a team within Toptal and within client accounts, and you don’t take yourself too seriously. We are a high-performance team that values authenticity and wit.

Gong is hiring a Email Marketing Manager to lead the execution of how Gong shows up in the inbox, which can include both marketing nurture programs and 1:1 marketing-supported outbound. This is a craft role for someone who treats email as a conversion channel, not a delivery task, and who is equally fluent in brand-led nurture, lifecycle messaging, and the kind of sharp, sales-style emails that get replies. You think in audiences and angles, you use data to drive messaging relevance, and you use AI to explore options and accelerate iteration without sacrificing voice or judgment.

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead and execute email programs across the full lifecycle, from 1:many brand and nurture programs to 1:few segment campaigns to 1:1 sales-style outreach that drives MQL conversion, ensuring every send has a clear audience, purpose, and next action
  • Write, edit, and continuously optimize email copy that drives engagement and conversion: nurture flows, lifecycle programs, behavioral triggers, event follow-ups, MQL re-engagement, closed-lost reactivation, and high-intent sales sequences

  • Execute a structured testing program (subject lines, send times, angles, CTAs, length, format, personalization depth), track results against KPIs, and use the learnings to optimize programs
  • Partner closely with the Senior GTM Automation & Systems Manager to translate audience strategy and segmentation into messaging that matches the moment, the signal, and the buyer's stage
  • Manage email engagement quality and deliverability from a content perspective: sender reputation, engagement rates, list health signals, spam triggers, and brand consistency across every send
  • Use AI tools as a core part of your craft, to generate variants, pressure-test angles, accelerate first drafts, and explore creative directions
  • Collaborate with Demand Gen, Content, Product Marketing, and Field Marketing to ensure email programs reflect current GTM priorities, campaigns, and segment narratives
  • Apply and uphold QA standards and copy review processes so every email that goes out, whether from Marketing or through Engage, meets a consistent quality bar
QUALIFICATIONS
  • 5+ years in email marketing, lifecycle marketing, or a closely related role in B2B SaaS or enterprise software, with hands-on experience executing both marketing nurture programs and sales-style 1:1 email motions
  • Strong understanding of the difference between marketing email and sales emails as channels
  • Hands-on experience writing and optimizing email programs inside Marketo and sales engagement platforms like Gong Engage, Outreach, or Salesloft
  • Proficiency in AI to write, test and improve
  • Hands-on experience executing A/B and multivariate tests, with the analytical rigor to interpret results and apply learnings to optimize programs
  • Working knowledge of email deliverability fundamentals, including engagement-based reputation, list hygiene, suppression strategy, CAN-SPAM and GDPR
  • Working understanding of GTM strategy fundamentals, including ICP, personas, buying stages, and signals
  • Background working in environments where marketing email and SDR outreach are tightly coordinated (e.g., Marketo + Gong + Salesloft/Outreach + Salesforce); experience writing for or partnering with sales teams is preferred
  • Strong editorial instincts paired with strong data instincts; you obsess over the narrative, a single subject line, and the conversion rate of a 12-step nurture with equal energy
  • Collaborative systems thinker who can partner closely with a technical automation counterpart, translate strategy into messaging, and clearly document your work
PERKS & BENEFITS

The annual salary hiring range for this position is $121,000 - $175,000 USD.

Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. Minimum requirements for the role:

7+ years of experience in technical account management, customer success, or a similar role.

jobs.title: Stock Administration Lead
jobs.excerpt: Soluna is on a mission to solve one of renewable energy’s biggest challenges: wasted power.
jobs.description:
Soluna is on a mission to solve one of renewable energy’s biggest challenges: wasted power. Our data centersconvert excesssolar, hydro, and windenergy into productive computational work, such as Bitcoin mining, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. By co-locating with renewable power sources, we bring demand directly to the source,helping power plants increase revenue while contributing more megawatts to the grid.

We are looking for a Stock Administration Lead to join our world-class team.

As Soluna's first dedicated equity hire, you will own and operate our equity programs end-to-end — from day-to-day grant processing and Section 16 compliance to a high-visibility transfer agent transition project. This is a build role at a NASDAQ-listed public company where the programs are growing faster than the infrastructure that supports them. You'll bring institutional discipline, upgrade our equity incentive plans, and partner directly with Finance, Legal, and the Board to get it done right.

You'll be the internal expert employees, directors, and executives turn to for everything equity-related — someone who has seen what good looks like at a scaling public company and knows how to build toward it. This role is fully remote.

What You'll Do

Plan Administration & Grant Processing

  • Own all equity plan administration across Soluna's 2021 and 2023 Stock Incentive Plans, including RSU grants, restricted stock awards, and stock option processing for employees, directors, and consultants
  • Administer and maintain our equity management platform, ensuring grant data, vesting schedules, and participant records are accurate, current, and audit-ready
  • Build and document scalable processes for grant approvals, equity onboarding for new hires, and a participant education program that helps employees understand what they own

Transfer Agent Transition

  • Lead the transfer agent transition project from vendor evaluation and selection through data migration, legal coordination, and shareholder communications — bringing it in on time and with zero errors
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with our transfer agent (currently Equiniti Trust Company) on day-to-day shareholder recordkeeping, DTC activity, and registered holder communications
  • Evaluate equity technology upgrades that improve participant experience, reduce manual work, and support Soluna's growth

Compliance & Reporting

  • Develop a working understanding of Soluna’s capital table and provide inputs to calculate the EPS & diluted EPS
  • Act as backup support for other stock issuances (ATM, SEPA, warrants, etc.) as needed
  • Manage all Section 16 compliance: prepare and file Form 4s, maintain the insider trading window calendar, and serve as the go-to resource for officers and directors on trading and equity questions
  • Coordinate Drive coordination with outside counsel, CFO, CAO and Financial Reporting Manager on proxy statement equity disclosures, including executive and director compensation tables and plan share reserve calculations under Soluna's dynamic share pool structure; contribute to content creation and preparation of all needed documentation
  • Partner with Payroll and Tax on income reporting for equity award vesting and exercises (W-2, 1099, supplemental withholding, FICA)
  • Stay current on SEC rules, Nasdaq listing standards, and ASC 718 requirements to keep Soluna's program compliant and audit-ready as the company scales

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years of stock plan administration experience at a public company, with direct ownership of day-to-day plan operations
  • Certified Equity Professional (CEP) designation, Level 2 or Level 3
  • Hands-on experience managing a transfer agent relationship
  • Deep familiarity with Section 16 / Form 4 filing obligations and insider trading policy administration
  • Proficiency with a major modern equity management platform (Shareworks, Equity Edge Online, Carta, or equivalent)
  • Subject matter expert of ASC 718 and the tax implications of equity awards
  • Strong judgment and discretion — you will routinely handle material non-public information
  • Power user of AI tools Claude and/or Gemini to create efficiencies and internal tools
  • Exceptional attention to detail paired with the ability to manage competing deadlines without dropping anything

Preferred

  • Experience leading or supporting a transfer agent transition
  • Background at a scaling tech company
  • Experience working through a plan amendment, restatement, or S-8 registration
  • Familiarity with dynamic share pool structures or evergreen equity plan mechanics

Why join Soluna?

We are a diverse, driven team of entrepreneurs, energy experts, private equity leaders, storytellers and engineers. We are passionate about making the world greener and we have conviction about how we will bring change on a global scale.

We are equally as zealous about championing our teams, relentless about developing our people, and believe strongly that Soluna’s goals and commitment to our mission are strengthened by our employee’s voices.

  • Define the workflows, procedures, and systems that support Trust Services, including new trust intake and partner handoffs.

  • Conduct periodic reviews of clients served by Trust Services with wealth advisors to maintain client satisfaction.
  • Coordinate across departments on trust matters.
  • Report to senior management on volume, productivity, revenue, and business development.

Trust Operations Leadership

  • Serve as the business leader for the Trust Operations team, which is moving to the Client Service organization, providing direction and support.
  • Set business priorities, service standards, and workflows for trust intake, partner handoffs, and case management, and partner with Client Service leadership on execution.
  • Provide trust expertise and decisions on complex cases and partner questions that the team escalates.
  • Review volume, cycle times, and client and advisor feedback with the team and Client Service leadership to guide improvements and capacity needs.

  • 12+ years in trust, estate, or private wealth services.

jobs.description:
Our everyday digital experiences are in the middle of a realtime revolution: chatting alongside a livestream, getting realtime financial updates, or working with colleagues in a shared online space. Consumers now expect realtime as standard, and Ably powers a large part of it.

We put developers first. Our products help teams build, extend, and deliver realtime digital experiences, delivering over 700 billion messages to more than 2 billion devices every month. Teams at HubSpot, Fin, Dialpad, NASCAR, Sportsbet, and General Motors all build on Ably.

Working at Ably means helping build the infrastructure that will shape the next generation of the internet. More of what people do online is becoming live, shared and interactive, which only makes what we build more relevant and more necessary. AI is the latest place that shows up. There's still so much to build, and we'd like your help with it.

About this role

As the Senior Talent Partner at Ably, you'll be our sole in-house recruiter, reporting to our VP of People and owning hiring end-to-end, from calibrating the brief with the hiring manager through to signed offer. You’ll be responsible for everything that makes hiring work: how we interview, the tools we use, how we source, and how candidates experience Ably. There’s a good foundation in place, and you’ll decide what to sharpen first and have the autonomy and backing to do it.

In a 60-person company, every hire changes the team, so this role exists to raise the bar: looking wider than the first good candidate, pushing back when a brief is off, making the case for waiting when the evidence isn't there, and judging your success by who is still thriving a year in, not how fast we filled the seat.

Ably is an infrastructure company, and a large share of our team are deeply technical engineers. You'll run full-cycle recruiting across the company, but engineering is where the depth matters most. You'll understand what we build well enough to hold a credible conversation with distributed systems engineers, tell depth from polish, and explain why our problems are worth their time. You'll work closely with hiring managers, right up to our CTO.

Day to day, you will

  • Calibrate hiring briefs before we go to market. Work with each hiring manager to turn complex technical requirements into a clear picture of who we need, and give honest feedback when the brief needs to change.
  • Find and close great people. Run outbound sourcing, screens and interviews, and close offers for engineering, GTM and other roles, supporting offers and compensation conversations alongside our People team.
  • Make our interviews better. Build on our structured interviews and scorecards so every process is fair, consistent and good at telling depth from polish.
  • Get more out of our tools, with AI at the centre. Make the most of Greenhouse and our hiring reporting, and put AI to work across sourcing, outreach, screening and admin so more of your time goes to the conversations that need a person. Use it as much as you can and show us what works.
  • Manage and negotiate our agency relationships. Decide where agencies add the most value, set the terms, and hold them to account.
  • Be Ably’s voice with candidates and the technical community. Shape our employer brand and candidate experience, and make sure new hires land well before they start.

We'd love to hear from you if you have

  • A track record of finding and closing high-calibre engineers, ideally in infrastructure or distributed systems, and the technical grounding to earn engineers' respect.
  • Strong judgement when partnering with hiring managers: calibrating a brief, giving honest feedback, and running a structured, fair interview process.
  • Proven full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally as the sole or lead recruiter in a start-up or scale-up, hiring across the UK and Europe.
  • Hands-on outbound sourcing and market mapping, with the numbers to show what works, and a habit of using AI in how you work.
  • Experience managing recruitment agencies, including negotiating terms and holding them to account.

Bonus points if you have

  • Experience hiring for developer tools, AI, or open source companies.
  • A background in agency recruiting.
  • Familiarity with Greenhouse ATS.
  • An active presence in tech or recruiting communities, online or in person, and comfort being a public face for Ably.

What’s it like to work at Ably?

You'll join a team of around 60 people, working directly alongside senior engineering and leadership. No layers, no bureaucracy, and real ownership from day one.

Remote-first

We hire the best people wherever they are across the UK and Europe, trust them to own their work, and share decisions and feedback openly. Twice a year, in February and August, we all meet in person, and we expect everyone to be there.

Remote-first comes with trade-offs. On one side: flexibility, no commute, long stretches of focus time, and a wider pool of people to hire from. On the other: it can feel isolating, relationships take effort to build, and you miss the chance conversations an office creates. As our only recruiter, you'll need to manage your own time and stay close to the hiring managers and candidates you work with.

If you do your best work with trust and autonomy, this will suit you. If you'd rather have an office around you every day, it probably isn't the right fit.

Our six values shape how we work day to day:

  • Open for all. We default to sharing openly: source, decisions, and feedback, with open minds to match.
  • Tech needs humanity. We build with empathy, for colleagues and developers alike.
  • Even the best do better. We keep raising our own bar, driven by curiosity, not complacency.
  • Bias for action. Once we know enough to act, we act, rather than waiting for certainty.
  • Dependable by default. We take real ownership of what we ship and what we promise.
  • Bold creativity wins. We treat big constraints as a reason to think differently, not less.

You can read more about how we defined these values on our blog, and see the team behind them on our careers page.

Diversity, inclusion, and belonging at Ably

We believe our differences as individuals are what make us great. Our people are at the heart of what we do, and we encourage everyone to be their most authentic self at Ably: we see inclusivity and openness as fundamental to our long-term success. We encourage applications from all backgrounds regardless of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, parental status, race, religion, educational background, or neurodiversity. Ably has an amazing opportunity ahead of us, and we want anyone to be able to contribute to it.

If you enjoy working as part of a technology company, value open source, and love solving hard problems, we'd love to hear from you, regardless of whether you fit the job description exactly or not. If in doubt, drop us an email;; we're happy to give you advice on your application.

What you'll get

  • A remote-first and flexible work environment. Our London office (next to Old Street) is there whenever you want it. Aside from our company get-togethers, you're welcome to work wherever suits you best.
  • Equity. We're a growing start-up, and we want everyone to share in the company's success through our EMI share options programme.
  • Enhanced holiday allowance: 28 days of paid annual leave (27 regular days, plus a day off to enjoy your birthday).
  • Enhanced parental leave, so you can spend time with your new family member: up to 16 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary, depending on length of service.
  • A home workstation budget of £500 on joining (and £150 per year after that), so your home office serves you well.
  • A personal learning and development budget of £1000 a year, plus 5% L&D time during working hours to build your skills.
  • Private healthcare with BUPA.
  • A medical cash plan covering a range of medical and dental costs.
  • Mental wellbeing coaching and counselling from Self Space.

  • Life assurance and income protection.
  • Access to Tech and Cycle to Work schemes.

SUMMARY

We are looking for a Machine Learning Scientist who is passionate about applying AI and ML to solve high-impact societal challenges. The ideal candidate will have a strong research and/or applied background with 6+ years of relevant experience or a PhD, and expertise in designing and implementing machine learning models, data analysis, and simulations. Candidates with experience in Automated Speech Recognition (ASR) are preferred for this role. A demonstrated commitment to social good, strong communication skills, and the ability to translate complex problems into deployable ML solutions are essential.

Preferred Location - Delhi

ABOUT US -

Wadhwani AI is a nonprofit institute building and deploying applied AI solutions to solve critical issues in public health, agriculture, education, and urban development in underserved communities in the global south. We collaborate with governments, social sector organizations, academic and research institutions, and domain experts to identify real-world problems and develop practical AI solutions to tackle these issues with the aim of making a substantial positive impact.

We have over 30+ AI projects supported by leading philanthropies such as Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation and Google. With a team of over 200 professionals, our expertise encompasses AI/ML research and innovation, software engineering, domain knowledge, design and user research.

In the Press:

  • Our Founder Donors are among the Top 100 AI Influencers

  • G20 India’s Presidency: AI Healthcare, Agriculture, & Education Solutions Showcased Globally.

  • Unlocking the potentials of AI in Public Health

  • Wadhwani AI Takes an Impact-First Approach to Applying Artificial Intelligence - data.org

  • Indian Winners of the 2019 Google AI Impact Challenge, and the first in the Asia Pacific to host Google Fellows

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • As an ML Scientist, you will be responsible for building machine learning solutions to problems of societal importance, and mentoring other team members in this effort. You will participate in problem definition and the development and execution of algorithms and solutions to the problems.

  • As an ASR expert, you will also be assisting in the design of evaluations for ASR solutions submitted for funding to the India AI mission at the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MEITy). You will play an advisory role in the execution of these evaluations.

  • In order to apply machine learning and related technologies for social good, you will need to understand user challenges and their context, curate and transform data, train and validate models, run simulations, and broadly derive insights from data. In doing so, you will work in cross-functional teams spanning engineering, solutions, domain experts, and designers. You will also work closely with social sector organisations, and are encouraged to collaborate with researchers across the world.

  • At Wadhwani AI, excellence as an individual contributor goes hand-in-hand with good teamwork and collaboration. You will mentor junior researchers and interns, and participate in recruiting and hiring activities. You will also be expected to interact with external partners of Wadhwani AI when required, and to make periodic visits to the communities from where challenges are derived and where the solutions will be deployed.

REQUIREMENTS

  • M.Tech./M.E./M.S./M.Sc. or equivalent in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or a relevant quantitative field with work experience of 6+ years or a PhD from a reputed institute. Experience and expertise in ASR are preferred. Experience and expertise with LLMs are nice-to-have.

Ideal candidates should have a strong research background, have experience in mentoring junior researchers through strong code practices and ideation, and be adept at a variety of data mining/analysis methods and tools, building and implementing models, visualising data, creating/using algorithms, and running simulations. Familiarity with popular deep learning algorithms is a strong plus; however, demonstrated willingness and ability to learn will also be considered.
