jobs.description:
About Thatch

For most people, health insurance is something that happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. We help companies give every employee a real healthcare budget instead of a one-size-fits-all plan, so people can choose the coverage and care that works for them, and employers get predictable costs they can control.

It’s a simple idea, but making it real means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology, and we’re just getting started. We look for people who like solving complex problems, use good judgment, and are comfortable working through ambiguity. People here care deeply about our customers, take real responsibility for what gets built, and are driven by doing work that matters.

About the role

Thatch is changing how health benefits work. We're building software that makes it easier for businesses to offer health coverage and gives employees more choice and control.

We're looking for a Data Scientist to help our GTM and Marketing teams understand what's driving growth and where to invest next. You'll build the data models and measurement systems behind our growth funnel, from acquisition and conversion to enrollment, retention, and expansion.

You'll dig into performance, uncover opportunities, and design experiments to help us make smarter growth decisions. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with teams across the business, turn complex data into clear recommendations, and help shape Thatch's growth strategy.

What you will do

  • Partner with GTM and Marketing to answer important business questions and guide growth decisions.
  • Analyze acquisition, conversion, retention, and marketing performance to identify opportunities.
  • Own GTM measurement, connecting attribution, CRM, and product data into trusted metrics.
  • Build and maintain dbt models, dashboards, and analytical tools that teams rely on.
  • Design and evaluate experiments to understand what's working and where to invest.
  • Improve data quality and make insights more accessible through self-serve analytics and automation.

What we are looking for

  • Experience using analytics, data science, and experimentation to drive growth, marketing, or GTM outcomes.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with dbt or similar data transformation tools.
  • Experience building analytical data models and dashboards using BI or visualization tools.
  • Proficiency in Python for analysis, experimentation, or statistical modeling.
  • Strong business judgment and the ability to turn complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Comfortable working independently, navigating ambiguity, and partnering across teams.

Tools and tech stack

  • dbt and SQL for modeling.
  • Snowflake as our data warehouse (migrating from Redshift).
  • Omni for BI, with tools like Hex for ad hoc analysis.
  • GitHub with CI/CD for version control.
  • AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) are woven into our daily development and analysis workflow.

You won’t work directly in our application layer day-to-day, but understanding source data from systems like Ruby on Rails is important.

Experience that stands out

  • Experience with Growth, Marketing, or Revenue Operations analytics, including acquisition, attribution, and lifecycle performance.
  • Measuring marketing incrementality through holdouts, geo experiments, lift tests, or similar methods.
  • Building statistical or machine-learning models for forecasting, segmentation, lead scoring, or churn.
  • Creating tools and automations that help teams make better, faster decisions.
  • Experience in healthcare, fintech, or other regulated industries.

What to expect

We aim to move quickly, and most candidates complete the process within 2–3 weeks. You can expect:

  • An initial conversation with a recruiter.
  • A conversation with the hiring manager and a lightweight Python coding exercise.
  • A take-home analytics exercise.
  • A review of your work, a data modeling and metrics exercise with the team, and a discussion with cross-functional partners.
  • A final conversation with engineering and company leadership.

Our team moves fast, holds a high bar for quality, and is always looking for better ways to deliver results for our clients.

Role Overview

DREAMLABS is looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Email Marketing Coordinator to support the execution of email and SMS marketing across our client portfolio. This is an execution-focused role for someone who is comfortable working inside Klaviyo and can take a finalized strategy, brief, and creative assets and turn them into accurate, fully functional campaigns and automated flows.
You will be responsible for building, QAing, scheduling, and maintaining email and SMS programs while keeping projects organized and communicating clearly with the internal team and clients. The ideal candidate understands the mechanics behind lifecycle marketing, takes ownership of their work, and can be trusted to execute accurately without constant oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Campaign Implementation: Build, schedule, and launch email and SMS campaigns across multiple clients based on finalized strategic briefs and provided creative assets.
  • Flow Logic & Automation: Build, update, and maintain automated customer journeys in Klaviyo, including welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, winback, and other lifecycle flows.
  • Audience Segmentation: Build and apply accurate audience segments based on campaign objectives, customer behavior, purchase history, engagement, and other relevant criteria.
  • Pop-Ups & On-Site Capture: Build and maintain Klaviyo forms and pop-ups, including targeting rules, triggers, and integrations with email and SMS programs.
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough self-QA before anything goes live, including links, UTMs, segmentation, exclusions and suppressions, flow logic, copy, creative, mobile and desktop rendering, test sends, and scheduling.
  • Project & Account Coordination: Keep campaign and flow builds organized and on schedule, proactively communicate status and blockers, and ensure deliverables move smoothly from brief through launch.
  • Client Communication: Support day-to-day client communication in Slack or Teams by acknowledging requests, providing clear status updates, and escalating strategic questions to the appropriate team member.
  • Platform Management & Troubleshooting: Work confidently within Klaviyo and our broader lifecycle marketing tech stack, including SMS platforms such as Postscript, and help troubleshoot implementation issues as they arise.
  • Deliverability & Compliance: Follow email and SMS best practices around consent, suppression, list hygiene, sending practices, and basic deliverability to help protect client programs and customer experience.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • 1+ years of hands-on email marketing experience, ideally within an agency or e-commerce environment.
  • Hands-on experience building campaigns, segments, and automated flows in Klaviyo is required.
  • Experience with Postscript or another SMS marketing platform is a strong plus.
  • Solid understanding of lifecycle marketing fundamentals, including segmentation, customer retention, and automated customer journeys.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership over the accuracy of your work.
  • Highly reliable and communicative, with the ability to manage deadlines, keep your calendar organized, and proactively update the team on progress or blockers.
  • Comfortable communicating professionally with clients through Slack, Teams, or similar platforms.
  • Able to take a finalized brief and run with it independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate an issue.
  • Comfortable working across multiple clients and priorities in a fast-paced agency environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Campaigns and flows are built accurately, QA'd thoroughly, and launched on time.
  • The Lead Strategist can hand you a finalized brief and creative and trust that execution will be handled correctly from build through launch.
  • You proactively communicate progress, questions, and blockers before they become problems.
  • Clients and internal team members view you as reliable, responsive, and detail-oriented.
  • You continue to deepen your technical expertise and take on increasingly complex lifecycle marketing execution over time.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to grow and deepen your technical lifecycle marketing expertise within a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Exposure to high-level strategy and leading consumer and e-commerce brands.
  • Hands-on experience across a wide range of email and SMS programs, customer journeys, and client business models.
  • A collaborative team with a high bar for quality, ownership, and performance.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role

You will support infrastructure capacity operations by managing incoming requests through a case tracking system, ensuring each request is complete, accurate, and routed to the appropriate owner. This role focuses on escalation triage, data validation, queue management, and operational reporting in a high-volume environment. You will resolve routine cases by following established procedures, track outstanding actions, maintain accurate records and budget trackers, and prepare weekly metrics on request volumes, backlogs, and escalations. You will also identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements. All capacity allocation decisions, exception approvals, and policy determinations remain with authorized internal personnel.

Responsibilities

  • Review, triage, prioritize, and route incoming infrastructure capacity requests through a case management system.

  • Maintain accurate case records, budget trackers, capacity logs, and related operational documentation.

  • Use Microsoft Excel to reconcile data, maintain tracking spreadsheets, and prepare recurring operational reports.

  • Coordinate with account teams and capacity owners to track outstanding actions and support timely case closure.

  • Prepare case queues, meeting notes, and action items for team working sessions and operational reviews.

  • Report on request volumes, backlog aging, triage timeliness, escalation trends, and record accuracy.

  • Identify recurring issues, process gaps, and opportunities to improve queue management and operational procedures.

  • Follow established processes and escalation guidelines without making independent capacity allocation or policy decisions.

  • High attention to detail when reviewing request information, validating records, and maintaining tracking systems.

  • Clear written communication skills, including the ability to request missing information and prepare concise escalation summaries.

  • Ability to follow established procedures, exercise sound escalation judgment, and recognize when a request requires additional review.

  • Strong organizational and stakeholder coordination skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and track actions through completion.

  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in a structured, process-driven environment.

Vibrant Performance is the affiliate partnership agency division of The Aragon Company. If you love owning the entire deal rather than a single slice of the funnel, and you want real influence over how a growing business scales, we want to hear from you.

We're specifically looking for a proven sales professional with experience selling agency services, affiliate marketing, performance marketing, or similar digital marketing solutions. Industry knowledge and an understanding of performance-based business models are essential to being successful in this role.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle — carry every opportunity from prospecting through discovery, proposal, negotiation, close, and contract — no handoffs between stages.
  • Build your own pipeline — self-source opportunities through outbound (email, LinkedIn, calls), competitor and market analysis, and inbound follow-up.

  • Must have agency, affiliate, or performance-marketing sales experience

  • Disciplined CRM and pipeline management, with accurate forecasting.
  • A self-motivated, coachable approach and a track record of thriving in a fast-moving, targets-based environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

We're also open to interviewing salespeople who have sold bespoke or consultative services

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling services, retainers, or other consultative offerings.
  • Exposure to financial services or other regulated, compliance-sensitive verticals.
  • HubSpot proficiency and familiarity with affiliate platforms such as Everflow, Impact, TUNE, Rakuten, or Partnerize.

How You'll Be Set Up to Win

  • Coaching & enablement — dedicated sales coaching, training, and HubSpot enablement to help you ramp fast and keep growing.
  • Line of sight to impact — clear revenue targets and a direct connection between your work and the company's growth.
  • Room to grow — a path toward senior sales roles as we scale.

Compensation

We offer a competitive base salary in the range of $80,000–$95,000, plus uncapped commission. On-target earnings (OTE) are approximately $135,000–$160,000, based on a roughly 60/40 base-to-variable mix. Your base within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. Because this role is remote, the range reflects a national market, and final offers may vary by geography.

Benefits & Perks

As a full-time employee, you'll be eligible for a comprehensive U.S. benefits package, including:

  • Tax-advantaged accounts — Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), and commuter (transit/parking) benefits.
  • Life & disability — company-paid basic life and AD&D insurance, with voluntary supplemental life and short- and long-term disability options.
  • 401(k) — retirement plan with automatic enrollment, administered through Empower.
  • Unlimited paid time off — flexible PTO (after an initial 90-day period), plus paid sick leave.
  • Paid holidays — a generous holiday schedule, including a company-wide year-end closure between Christmas and New Year's.
  • Wellness perks — One Medical membership, Talkspace virtual therapy, an Employee Assistance Program (Health Advocate), Kindbody family-building support, and employee discount programs.

Anything is possible when you imagine everything.

Position Overview

This is an internal position to provide technical expertise in the field of a Chemical Engineering. This position, by way of applying past knowledge and experiences using a wide range of engineering principles, provides recommendations to help solve complex problems within the Resin processes. This position is also responsible to provide senior technical advice in the proper development of new chemical processes within a project team environment. This position will review proposed chemical processes and new recipe additions then make recommendations to ensure process requirements are met and chemical operations meet Hexion’s safety and environmental requirements. Other responsibilities include relief system modelling, providing expertise in troubleshooting existing chemical processes that are not meeting original design entitlement, commission / startup of new chemical operations and individual productivity projects to create capacity / efficiencies in existing plant processes. This position can be asked to collaborate closely with and advise different teams like Innovation, Commercial, Operations and Supply Chain.

Essential Functions

  • Provide expertise in Process Engineering in Resin Production and process capacity
  • Consult and provide technical recommendations in the design of chemical processes with a focus on safety and efficiency in design.
  • Provides technical solutions to problems found at existing locations based upon full understanding of the products being made and the process capabilities at the site. Solutions provided need to be practical in its application as the simplest solutions tend to be the most effective.
  • Advising a project team of potential design or scope changes and the impact / benefit on the process.
  • Leveraging product understanding and process capabilities to work and advise contracted engineering groups on new process design to ensure the best possible design for any new process.
  • Checking calculations to advise on adherence to codes, specifications, design criteria and overall RAGAGEP (Recognized And Generally Accepted Good Engineering Practices) adherence.
  • Collaborate on the development of a business case for any new product / process development. Leveraging those technical skills to present a cohesive business case for Leadership approval.
  • Develop best practices and design standards to improve reliability and / or efficiency of existing chemical processes.
  • Competent in the different Process Hazardous Analysis (PHA) and hazard review techniques. Need to participate in different HAZOPs and engage teams when either reviewing old HAZOPs to ensure existing processes have not deviated from the original design or from the earliest stage of a project through commissioning.
  • Senior level expertise in techniques to successfully commission and startup chemical processes.
  • Senior level expertise in relief system modelling.
  • Investigate and provide written technical guidance on deviations from expected production within Hexion’s chemical processes.
  • Capable of organizing and leading new commissioning efforts including the closure of PSSR action items and following the MOC process.
  • Capable of establishing good communication channel with operation and provide education and training to upskill operation.
  • Capable of representing the team to Leadership on difficult technical issues in a clear and concise manner with recommendations to solve.

ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS: This position reports to the Resin Technology Team Manager

SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITY:

The Scope of Responsibility will focus on the Resin and Formaldehyde production processes.

Job Qualifications & Experience

  • Capable of networking within a matrix organization and working remotely.
  • 5+ years of relevant chemical processes experience.
  • Must have good organizational and communication skills.
  • Must be familiar with process safety, environmental, and Industrial Hygiene rules and regulations associated the production of chemicals.
  • Capable of working with 3rd party engineering firms to represent Hexion during Front End Engineering efforts.
  • Worked on plant floor in chemical operating company
  • Analytical and Critical thinking
  • Batch manufacturing experience
  • Extensive solid material handling and equipment design.
  • Demonstrate project management experience especially FEL efforts.
  • Personal skills with the ability to communicate with different layers in the organization from the business leads to local site personnel. Important to have the ability to relate with all types of people.
  • Must understand the application and use of Fault Trees, Failure Mode & Effects Analysis (FMEA), Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA), and Layer of Protection Analysis (LOPA) techniques. · Chemical Reaction Relief system modelling.

Education & Skills

  • BS Chemical or Process Engineering
  • Must be able to operate Excel spreadsheets and develop PowerPoint presentations. Advance skills in Excel and intermediate skills in PowerPoint are required.
  • Must be able to collect data and interpret it.
  • Must have advanced computer skills.
  • Familiarity in the Stage Gate Process for projects and their front-end development.
  • Understand Gantt Charts and the development in Microsoft Project.
  • Mini-Tab experience is desired but not required.
  • Familiarity with enterprise system software such as SAP

Travel can vary depending upon project location and requirements. Expected travel can be up 50% but can be higher pending business needs at the time.

Other

jobs.description:
Lead Content Engineer, Create

College Board - Technology

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position


About the Team

The Content Engineering team sits within a multidisciplinary technology team that integrates design, content, and engineering to deliver consistent, scalable user experiences. We support structured content models, authoring ecosystems, metadata standards, and content workflows that power College Board’s digital products and websites.


Our team partners with platform product leadership and serves a broad community of content creators, including assessment and item authors and developers. We aim to unify practices, strengthen the discipline, and support content systems that are robust, maintainable, and flexible for the future.

About the Opportunity

The Lead Content Engineer leads the design, governance, and evolution of structured exam content and metadata across the full assessment lifecycle within College Board item creation systems and with external and internal consumers. This role drives standards compliance, interchange status and metadata alignment across a complex ecosystem.

Operating at the intersection of content strategy, data modeling, and technical specification, this role establishes shared structures and terminology, aligns disparate authoring tools within a common architecture, and ensures content can function seamlessly as both machine-readable data and human-consumable artifacts.

The role's near-term priority is content standards and interchange: defining ingestion and translation layers for QTI and related edtech content standards, allowing us to integrate with external vendors and customers, and supporting the development of a global item bank crossing our various assessments. This role partners with content or domain experts, and owns the schema, standards, and translation architecture that make migrations correct and repeatable, and that allows consistent internal interchange of items and item metadata.

This is a systems leadership role with enterprise impact.

In this role, you will:

Own content interchange architecture (30%)

  • Take responsibility for quality and integrity for exchange of item and other assessment content between College Board and external or legacy systems, grounded in QTI and related edtech content standards.
  • Lead near-term content migrations from several vendors and legacy systems, partnering with a content or domain expert who owns subject-matter accuracy while this role owns schema mapping, structural validation, and standards compliance.
  • Lead evolution of a unified content model to support the development of universal item bank, as a common directory of metadata and content.
  • Design translation layers as reusable interchange capabilities rather than one-off interfaces, so future providers and systems can extend the same pattern.
  • Define validation checkpoints that catch structural or metadata loss during interchange or translation, before content reaches production.
  • Represent College Board in relevant edtech standards groups, tracking and influencing the evolution of standards as they affect the platform.

Define and evolve metadata standards (30%)

  • Analyze, compare and identify gaps in existing schemas for item, form and course metadata.
  • Develop structured content specifications that support downstream form assembly, assignment, scoring, and reporting systems.
  • Ensure interoperability and security across applications and platforms through consistent data modeling and governance.
  • Balance machine-readable formats, such as JSON, with human-readable outputs for stakeholder validation and quality assurance.
  • Support practical usage and development based on stakeholder needs and system evolution.

Maintain metadata integrity (30%)

  • Ensure consistency and correctness of metadata from item authoring through form build, assignment, scoring, and score reporting. Diagnose problems and create tickets.
  • Anticipate and mitigate structural risks before they affect production or stakeholder trust.
  • Define quality checkpoints and validation mechanisms across the content lifecycle.

Cross-functional influence (10%)

  • Act as a strategic liaison between content teams, engineering, psychometrics, scoring, reporting, and platform stakeholders.
  • Communicate complex data structures in clear, actionable terms for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Lead alignment efforts when standards or system changes affect multiple teams.
  • Work closely with the platform Content Engineering Director to support external interchanges and interfaces.

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in structured content systems, assessment production, publishing technology, or comparable environments.
  • Deep understanding of metadata modeling, content schemas, and data governance, especially in the assessment space.
  • Direct experience with QTI or a comparable edtech content interchange standard, including export/import translation between systems with different content models.
  • Experience working with machine-readable formats, such as JSON and XML, and system integrations.
  • Proven ability to define standards and drive cross-team adoption in complex ecosystems.
  • Strong systems thinking and precision in terminology and specification writing.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • The ability to travel 2-4 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience in large-scale assessment or high-stakes exam production environments.
  • Familiarity with item banking, form assembly tools, scoring workflows, and reporting systems.
  • Experience aligning multiple legacy tools or workflows under a unified data model.
  • Active participation in edtech standards bodies or working groups, such as those governing QTI.
  • Exposure to automation, validation frameworks, or content engineering best practices.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success.
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

  • At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $80,000–$140,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

About Prosper Global

Barely enough is not enough for anyone. Prosper Global is a humanitarian organization working alongside communities facing conflict, climate change, and economic hardship to meet urgent needs and create the conditions for lasting progress. Today's challenges demand new solutions, so we pair local knowledge with global resources to help communities build what's needed, test what's possible, and scale what's proven so that people everywhere can pursue a full life on their own terms. In 2026, we changed our name from Mercy Corps to Prosper Global, to reflect our belief that when every community can prosper, all of humanity moves forward.

The Department: Programs
The Program Function is composed of headquarters and regional departments which are guided by the global strategy, Pathway to Prosperity (P2P), and works in close partnership with all other departments to deliver the highest quality programming and impactful results. The Program Team aligns closely with the Pathway to Prosperity and works to deliver on increased accountability, alignment, and fair and transparent resource allocation, while acting with its Core Behaviors of collaboration, curiosity, inclusion, and integrity at the forefront. The Programs function is a key steward of the strategic commitments of Prosper Global and the integration of these commitments into programming.

About TEQ

The TEQ Unit sits within Programs and supports program impact at scale through three areas of work: 1) Program Support, including support for proposals, program design and implementation, and learning and capacity building; 2) Program Strategy, by stewarding the technical and sectoral approaches utilized by the organization and managing programmatic enterprise systems; and, 3) Influence, through technical analysis, evidence, and engagement with internal and external stakeholders. TEQ teams include technical specializations related to P2P Impact Priorities and cross-cutting sectors, as well as program quality and evidence teams. TEQ also supports the two P2P commitments areas: Locally Led and Safe, Diverse, and Inclusive.

The Position

The Operations Manager is a critical central support position within the TEQ unit. Reporting to the VP, the Operations Manager is responsible for the design and maintenance of TEQ-managed unit-level systems, coordination and communication mechanisms, and administrative support processes, and also backstops TEQ team-led systems and processes. The incumbent works across all TEQ teams to streamline coordination, ensure efficient and consistent operations, and promote effective communication.

Essential Responsibilities

SYSTEMS AND PROCESSES

  • In collaboration with the unit leadership team, design and manage accountability and operations systems, including but not limited to the Support Request Tool (SRT) and associated follow-up; new business pipeline tracking and assignment mechanisms; and work planning processes.
  • Periodically assess the effectiveness of these tools and update and improve them as needed. When relevant, develop new and/or coordinate major overhauls to existing systems and processes (or drop systems and processes that are no longer necessary) to ensure they are serving team management and strategic needs.
  • Support the design of, and backstop the management of, team-managed systems or resources that are used by the broader organization (for example, the Evidence & Learning Center, the Outcome Area Hub, Program Models, the PMD App, or consultant rosters), ensuring that these run smoothly and are continuously improved.
  • Disseminate, collect, share, and analyze feedback forms following support assignments.
  • Develop and disseminate analytical reports related to TEQ operations and performance.

COORDINATION AND COMMUNICATIONS

  • Manage the agendas and preparation for recurring All-Unit, leadership team, TEQ-Innovation & Investment Coordination, and other recurring and ad hoc meetings, ensuring that these remaining engaging and evolve over time to meet needs. Curate presentations and agenda items for these meetings with team members. Capture and disseminate notes with a focus on action points. Chair or facilitate meetings as needed.
  • Convene ad hoc coordination structures when needed to advance cross-functional areas of work, and set-up and manage communication platforms for these. Communicate about the purpose of these structures, and sunset them once their purpose has been served. Chair or facilitate meetings as needed.
  • Maintain the TEQ SharePoint Communications sites and TEQ Operations SharePoint Teams sites and Teams channels, and TEQ Hub pages, ensuring that content remains current and engaging. Support TEQ teams with their individual SharePoint sites and Teams channels, including ad hoc sites or channels as needed.
  • Support the posting of blogs on individual Communications sites and the regular collection and dissemination of blog posts via the TEQ Digest. Assess blog and Digest analytics on a regular basis and devise ways to improve circulation and readership. Support the drafting of compelling individual blogs as needed.
  • Support preparation for and hosting of webinars and other information dissemination events managed by the team.
  • Lead or support event planning and management for team or unit-level special events (for example, workshops or training).
  • Incorporate accessibility considerations into communications protocols.
  • Provide filing, document formatting, and production quality guidance and support to ensure consistently high product quality.

PROJECT, BUDGET AND AWARD MANAGEMENT

  • Project manage team, unit, and inter-departmental projects or change management processes as requested by the VP. This may include intensive, timebound projects requiring high-level organization, communication, tracking, process management, and documentation skills.
  • Work with budget holders to coordinate the unit-level budgeting process, team budgeting, budget reforecasts, and budget management.
  • Support (or, occasionally, lead) award management processes and requirements for unit- or team- managed, donor funded headquarters-managed awards (HQMA).

OPERATIONAL SUPPORT

  • Lead procurement and contracting support services for TEQ teams, working with individual team members and administrative counterparts in other departments as needed.
  • Support the administration of direct costing engagements by TEQ members as needed.
  • When organizational policies change, interpret implications for TEQ unit members and share relevant information.
  • Manage team member onboarding materials, scheduling, processes and overall onboarding quality and consistency. Maintain and strengthen onboarding processes over time.
  • Manage shared subscriptions for the unit, renewing, updating, or dropping these based on usage levels and team needs.
  • Manage the unit and team organizational chart.
  • Backstop selected TEQ members as needed during times of turnover or when surge support is required.

PERSONAL LEADERSHIP

  • Demonstrate exceptional leadership by consistently delivering on expectations and maintaining composure, even in challenging situations.
  • Embrace a growth mindset, actively seek diverse perspectives, and welcome feedback to drive continuous improvement.
  • Maintain the highest ethical standards, treating all individuals with respect and dignity.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, ensuring that your conduct reflects positively on Prosper Global and does not compromise its mission or work.

SAFEGUARDING RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Actively learns about safeguarding and integrates it into their work, including safeguarding risks and mitigations related to their area of work.
  • Practices the values of Prosper Global including respecting the dignity and well-being of participants and fellow team members.
  • Encourages openness and communication in their team; encourages team members to submit reports if they have any concerns using reporting mechanisms e.g., Integrity Hotline and other options.

None
Accountability

  • Works directly with: Senior Directors, all Unit members, counterparts in departments such as OCOO, Institutional Donor Engagement, Finance, People Team, Information Technology, Regions, Award Management Team, Travel, Global Supply Chain Operations, and others.

Accountability to Participants and Stakeholders

Prosper Global team members are expected to support all efforts toward accountability, specifically to our program participants, community partners, other stakeholders, and to international standards guiding international relief and development work. We are committed to actively engaging communities as equal partners in the design, monitoring and evaluation of our field projects.
Minimum Qualification and Transferable Skills
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience providing increasingly proficient support in areas such as:
    • Creating and managing operational systems, especially digital systems
    • Willingness and ability to use AI tools, namely Claude and Copilot
    • Identifying, organizing, analyzing, systematizing, visualizing and summarizing disparate sources of data
    • Proven experience in operations/process creation and management and systems design
    • Successful experience guiding, coaching, orienting and/or training colleagues to adapt and use new or updated business processes and/or systems
    • Managing cross-functional and matrixed projects
    • Managing communications
    • Managing projects
  • Proven ability to build relationships and work constructively with partners.
  • Exceptionally strong verbal and written communication and organizational skills are required.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to Prosper Global locations if required.
  • Familiarity with award management for humanitarian and development donor-funded projects.
  • Fluency in English is required; fluency in Spanish or French is an advantage.
  • Ability to work effectively on matrixed teams and in non-hierarchical settings.

Success Factors

The Operations Manager must be a self-starter who is highly productive and responsive, and who demonstrates leadership in communications, coordination, systems and process design, and planning and project management. The Operations Manager must be a superb team player who has the technical and functional skills to support TEQ as a best-in-class technical unit. They must have proven abilities to multi-task, manage competing priorities, follow procedures, and meet deadlines. They must be a creative thinker and flexible problem solver – bringing structure where needed but also being creative to reach desired outcomes, often in environments of have high levels of ambiguity or involve many stakeholders.
At Prosper Global, we value team members who embrace curiosity, act with integrity, and foster an environment of inclusion and collaboration. Our successful team members work effectively in evolving and dynamic environments, prioritize clear communication, and build collaborative relationships across departments. They interact with all global team members with an inclusive approach and excel at multitasking, meeting deadlines, and processing information to support our changing program activities.
Living Conditions / Environmental Conditions
The position may be based in any of the eligible countries listed at the top of this Position Description. Work is primarily remote (home-based); however, occasional travel may be required for specific events or projects, including travel to countries where Prosper Global operates. The incumbent must demonstrate flexibility in working hours to accommodate collaboration with team members across multiple time zones, including the United States, Europe, Africa, Asia, the Middle East, and South America.
Ongoing Learning
In support of our belief that learning organizations are more effective, efficient and relevant to the communities we serve, we empower all team members to dedicate 5% of their time to learning activities that further their personal and/or professional growth and development.
Team Engagement and Effectiveness
Achieving our mission starts with how we build our team and collaborate. By bringing together individuals with a variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives, we strengthen our ability to solve complex challenges and drive innovation. We foster a culture of trust and respect, where every team member is valued for their contributions, empowered to reach their full potential, and motivated to do their best work.

BuildShare is a new, disruptive tech platform company that combines capital formation with a new construction system to reduce the time and cost of building homes. Our platform connects investors, homebuyers and builders on one system, and our construction company, BuilderK (builderk.com), delivers the homes. We are a lean, fully remote platform (lean manufacturing, lean construction, lean management) growing through builder business owners toward 200 US metro areas, with projects starting in Florida and five initial states. Our team works from different places and meets online every day in our virtual office and project management office.

The mission

Through Ingelica, our R&D unit, we are building the robotics intellectual property behind RoMi, our robotic micro-manufacturing technology. That IP will power more than 500 micro-manufacturing facilities across the United States, which BuildShare will provide to its network of general contractors (GCs) in each state so they can build the more than $10 billion in buildings committed through BuildShare. We are also in final-stage discussions with one of the world's largest real estate capital and investment firms on a program of at least 5,000 units over five years. Your robots will have real demand from day one.

This is a partnership, not a standard job. You join as a co-founder and partner of BuildShare, with real ownership through stock options, a seat at the leadership table and a direct say in how the company is built. You will act as the CEO of our robotics area: you own the robotics vision, the IP and the team. It is posted as a job so you can apply here, and it also comes with a salary from day one.

- Lead BuildShare's robotics area end to end, like a CEO of the robotics business

- Own and grow the robotics IP: automation, robotic cells and production workflows for building components and modules

- Design, prototype and test the micro-manufacturing system that will be replicated across 500+ facilities

jobs.description:
SUMMARY

Under the general supervision of the Vice President of Product & Marketing, the Product Manager, Fire Products will own product strategy, roadmap planning, lifecycle management, and cross-functional execution for Seek Thermal products serving the fire market. This role translates firefighter, department, channel, and market needs into differentiated product requirements and business priorities, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Quality, Customer Service, and Finance from concept through launch and sustaining activities

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Seek Thermal fire products, balancing customer needs, market opportunities, competitive dynamics, technical capabilities, cost, and business objectives.
  • Conduct market assessments and identify opportunities for new products, product innovation, and enhancements across hardware, software, accessories, and the overall user experience.
  • Build a deep understanding of firefighters, fire departments, distributors, and other fire-market stakeholders through voice-of-customer research, field observation, surveys, prototype evaluations, field testing, and ongoing customer engagement.
  • Define target users, use cases, value propositions, features, performance requirements, user experience, and packaging in partnership with cross-functional teams.
  • Drive product planning documentation, including business cases, ROI analyses, MRDs, PRDs, competitive analyses, and launch recommendations.
  • Partner with Engineering and Design to translate market and user needs into clear product requirements, make informed feature/cost/schedule tradeoffs, and maintain alignment throughout development.
  • Lead cross-functional product execution for new product development and sustaining initiatives, helping teams deliver to agreed scope, schedule, quality, and cost targets.
  • Prioritize product requirements and development work across multiple projects and lifecycle stages based on customer impact, strategic value, technical risk, and business priorities.
  • Monitor competitive fire-market offerings, technology trends, customer feedback, field performance, and market changes; use insights to inform roadmap and product decisions.
  • Act as the voice of the customer and market in product decisions and work with Engineering, Quality, Operations, and Customer Service to understand and prioritize field issues and sustaining improvements.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to develop go-to-market strategies, product messaging, training, sales tools, launch plans, and demand-generation activities for fire products.
  • Support launches and post-launch performance by defining success metrics, tracking business and product performance, gathering market feedback, and recommending corrective actions or follow-on investments.
  • Engage directly with customers, channel partners, and the sales team to support product discussions, demonstrations, field evaluations, and market-development activities.
  • Maintain effective communication with executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders regarding roadmap priorities, product decisions, risks, tradeoffs, schedules, and performance.
  • Approximately 20-25% travel may be required for customer visits, field research, industry events, product testing, and internal collaboration.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES

  • Product management experience with physical products, preferably technically complex hardware/software products or professional-use electronics.
  • Success managing products through the full lifecycle, from market discovery and definition through development, launch, sustaining, and end-of-life.
  • Strong customer orientation and ability to convert user needs, behaviors, workflows, and motivations into actionable requirements.
  • Strong strategic thinking, market analysis, organization, planning, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to understand technical tradeoffs and risks and work effectively with engineering counterparts.
  • Ability to develop product and go-to-market strategies and communicate recommendations to technical, commercial, and executive audiences.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, including business cases, ROI, cost tradeoffs, dashboards, and performance metrics.
  • Ability to lead through influence and collaborate across Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Quality, Customer Service, and Finance.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office tools.

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Product Management, or a related technical field; technical degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of product management or closely related product development experience; hardware and integrated software experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience in thermal imaging, fire service products, public safety, rugged professional equipment, or adjacent markets is preferred.
  • Proven product launch experience; global manufacturing, supply chain, or procurement experience is preferred.

Why Join Seek Thermal?
You'll join a high-performing, collaborative accounting team where you'll have the opportunity to build a broad accounting skill set while learning from experienced team members.

Our team values accuracy, accountability, continuous improvement, and working together to get things done well. We encourage people to ask questions, bring forward ideas, and understand the why behind their work.

As Seek Thermal grows, we want this role to grow with it. Our goal is to provide the mentorship, experience, and increasing responsibility needed to develop into a well-rounded accounting professional.

Join Seek Thermal – See the Unseen. Shape What’s Next.

At Seek Thermal, we’re changing the way the world sees heat. Our innovative thermal imaging technology brings visibility to the unseen, empowering professionals and consumers to measure, detect, and visualize heat — transforming how people work, protect, and explore.

About Orchid and IDRE

At Orchid Software Solutions, we build software for the assisted reproduction, healthcare-payments and fintech industries. Our IDRE pod owns the platform that connects VeraTru to the Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) process under the federal No Surprises Act. When a healthcare provider and an insurer disagree on what an out-of-network service should be paid, IDRE moves that dispute through the CMS process. It handles hundreds of new disputes a day and well over 100,000 in the system.

The role. We are looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to run delivery and own the product backlog for the IDRE pod, reporting directly to our CTO. This role combines the Project Manager and Product Owner seats. You will be the bridge between our engineers, our business and operations team, and our client. You will turn complex, ambiguous regulatory and client requirements into clear, sequenced work the team can ship. You will also own the planning horizon: sprints, multi-sprint roadmaps, and the refinement that keeps the backlog ready before each sprint starts.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving, regulated domain. Accuracy and turnaround time directly affect how our clients experience the platform.

What you'll do

  • Own delivery for the IDRE pod. Plan and run sprints, track scope, timelines and risks, and keep releases predictable.
  • Translate requirements into work. Break complex regulatory, operational and client requirements into well-scoped tickets with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Own the backlog and refinement. Keep the backlog prioritized and refined ahead of each sprint, so engineers start with zero ambiguity.
  • Plan beyond the sprint. Build and maintain a multi-sprint roadmap with the Tech Lead and business stakeholders, and make trade-offs visible.
  • Manage the client relationship. Be a primary point of contact for Capital Bridge: run status updates and demos, gather feedback, and manage expectations.
  • Triage and protect focus. Triage incoming issues and requests before they reach engineers, and escalate what is truly urgent.
  • Partner with engineering. Work with the Tech Lead on sequencing and what is realistic. The Tech Lead owns technical scope; you own the plan and the flow of work.
  • Facilitate, don't dictate. Run ceremonies that leave room for the team, and let engineers pull their own work to build ownership.
  • Document decisions. Keep decision logs, requirements and process documentation current in Jira and Confluence.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • Based in the United States and authorized to work in the US (required for compliance), and able to pass a background check.
  • [6+] years as a Project Manager, Technical Project Manager or Product Owner on software teams, including hands-on backlog ownership. Years to confirm.
  • Track record running Agile/Scrum delivery for a distributed engineering team across time zones (US and Latin America).
  • Strong requirements work: you turn messy business inputs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Client-facing experience: you have owned status reporting, demos and expectation management with an external client.
  • Fluent with Jira and Confluence, including cleaning up and organizing a complex backlog.
  • Clear, concise written and spoken English, and comfort pushing back with facts.

Nice-to-haves

  • Healthcare payments, insurance claims, No Surprises Act / IDR, or another regulated domain (fintech, legal, government).
  • Experience with government or CMS-facing systems and compliance requirements.
  • Technical background (engineering or CS) to discuss trade-offs credibly with senior engineers.
  • Comfort with data: SQL or reporting basics to answer your own delivery and client questions.
  • Scrum or PM certification (PSM, CSM, CSPO, PMP).
This is a full-time, US-based W-2 position. Candidates must reside in the United States and be authorized to work in the US without current or future visa sponsorship. We do not work with staffing agencies or C2C arrangements for this role. Interviews are conducted live on video with camera on.

Über Verve Retail Media

Das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende ist der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis. Marken investieren Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale, können aber nicht belegen, ob daraus Käufe generiert wurden.

Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen Coupons und Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum stationären Kauf gehen: Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten.

VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. Wir arbeiten wie ein schnell skalierendes Startup mit einer AI-First-Strategie über alle Funktionen hinweg. Zudem haben wir Zugriff auf die Infrastruktur eines internationalen AdTech-Unternehmens mit über einer Billion ausgelieferter Werbeimpressionen pro Jahr.

Die Rolle in einem Satz

Du gewinnst neue regionale Werbekunden für VRM am Telefon, qualifizierst warme Leads und buchst hochwertige Termine für unsere Account Executives.

Was du tust

  • Telefonische Erstansprache regionaler Werbekunden auf Basis vorqualifizierter Leads
  • Bedarfs- und Entscheiderqualifizierung im Erstgespräch
  • Buchung qualifizierter Termine für die Account Executives im definierten Zielslot

Dein Setup

  • Salesforce als CRM, Aircall für die Telefonie, LLM-gestützte Recherche-Workflows

  • Regelmäßige 1:1-Coachings, Call-Reviews und Pipeline-Calls

Deine Aufgaben

  • Eigene Aktivitäts-Pipeline aufbauen, priorisieren und mit klaren KPIs (Calls/Tag, Termine/Tag, Show-Up-Rate) führen
  • Recherche zu Kunden, Branchen und Standorten als Grundlage jedes Calls
  • Pflege aller Aktivitäten und Opportunities in Salesforce
  • Enge Abstimmung mit den Account Executives: Feedback zur Termin-Qualität, gemeinsame Iteration
  • Aktives Mitwirken an der Weiterentwicklung von Pitches, Skripten und Workflows

So ist die Rolle aufgesetzt

  • Bericht direkt an den Head of Regional Sales
  • Du arbeitest im Team mit anderen SDRs sowie eng mit den Account Executives, an die du übergibst
  • Klare Karriereperspektive: Aufstieg zum Account Executive bei nachgewiesener Performance

Dein Profil

Diese Rolle ist bewusst auf Einsteiger und Quereinsteiger in den Sales zugeschnitten. Du passt, wenn du mindestens eines der folgenden Profile mitbringst:

  • Erste Sales-Erfahrung: Du hast in einer SDR-, BDR-, Inside-Sales-, Outbound-Call-Center- oder Telefonvertriebsrolle gearbeitet und willst auf das nächste Level.
  • Quereinstieg mit Telefonaffinität: Du kommst aus Kundenservice, Retail, Gastronomie, Hotellerie oder einem anderen Umfeld mit viel Kundenkontakt und willst gezielt in den Sales wechseln.

Für beide Profile gilt:

  • Du hast Spaß am Telefon, keine Scheu vor Erstansprache und kannst Menschen schnell für dich gewinnen
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, bereitest dich vor und nimmst KPIs ernst
  • Du bist offen, coachable und willst täglich besser werden
  • Du nutzt LLMs aktiv für Recherche und Vorbereitung, oder bist bereit, das schnell zu lernen
  • Deutsch fließend auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (alle Calls auf Deutsch), Englisch von Vorteil
  • Du willst nicht für immer SDR bleiben, der Aufstieg zum Account Executive ist dein Ziel

Warum diese Rolle

Du steigst nicht in eine fertige Vertriebsmaschine ein. Du baust eine neue Mediagattung im deutschen Markt mit auf — und legst damit die Pipeline-Grundlage für unser komplettes Regional-Sales-Geschäft.

Wenn du Sales lernen willst, wo es ernst gemeint ist und wo gute Leistung sichtbar wird, ist das die richtige Rolle.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101016

Job Title:SOX IT Compliance Analyst [P4]

Location:Canada

Company:Autodesk

Job Type:Full-Time


Job Summary

Autodesk is seeking an experienced Compliance Analyst to lead key aspects of its Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) IT General Controls (ITGC) program. This individual contributor role combines deep technical expertise, independent judgment, and business understanding to strengthen the effectiveness, scalability, and sustainability of the IT control environment supporting financial reporting.

A successful candidate will take end-to-end ownership of significant ITGC workstreams and initiatives, including onboarding new systems into SOX scope, evaluating controls for systems within SOX scope and improving evidence collection and testing through automation. They will interpret complex technical and regulatory requirements, evaluate business and compliance risks, and recommend practical solutions with minimal supervision.

Working closely with control owners, Engineering, IT, Security, Audit & Advisory Services, and external auditors, this individual will influence technical and control decisions, drive cross-functional outcomes, and help shape the ongoing improvement of Autodesk’s SOX ITGC program. The ability to assess IT controls in financial reporting environments and communicate effectively with technical stakeholders and management is essential.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead key aspects of the SOX ITGC program, with end-to-end accountability for assigned control domains, management testing, audit readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Independently assess the design and operating effectiveness of IT controls supporting financial reporting across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on SOX ITGC requirements, evaluating complex control issues, assessing technical and business risks, and recommending risk-based improvements to strengthen SOX compliance.
  • Assess control deficiencies and their business impact, recommend risk-based remediation priorities, and partner with control owners to drive timely and sustainable resolution.
  • Partner with Engineering, IT, Security, and Audit & Advisory Services to onboard new systems into SOX scope, translating compliance requirements into effective and scalable controls and operational practices.
  • Identify and lead automation and standardization initiatives to reduce redundant activities and improve the efficiency, consistency, and quality of SOX control execution, evidence collection, monitoring, testing, and documentation.
  • Lead assigned internal and external audit activities, coordinating evidence requests and testing discussions, providing technical guidance, and resolving complex audit inquiries.
  • Independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives from requirements definition and planning through execution, stakeholder adoption, and delivery of measurable outcomes.
  • Promote best practices through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, training, and mentorship of less experienced colleagues and control owners.

Minimum Qualifications

• 4–5 years of experience in SOX 404 ITGC auditing, IT assurance, security compliance, information security, or a related discipline, including substantial hands-on technical work.

• Strong understanding of SOX 404, IT general controls, financial systems audit requirements, and control design in on-premises and cloud environments.

• Demonstrated ability to independently evaluate complex control issues, exercise sound judgment, and drive significant initiatives or workstreams with limited oversight.

• Experience assessing security controls, explaining requirements to technical control owners, and influencing decisions across cross-functional stakeholder groups.

• Experience with evidence collection or testing automation and evaluating the sufficiency of evidence for access management, change management, segregation of duties, and configuration management controls.

• Practical understanding of ITGC risks and controls in enterprise applications and systems supporting financial reporting.

• Strong written and verbal communication, analytical problem-solving, stakeholder management, and complex-project delivery skills.


Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, or related field.

• Professional certification such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, or CPA.

• Experience applying frameworks and standards such as COBIT, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or PCI DSS to IT control environments.

• Experience with audit and compliance platforms and tools used for control management, automated evidence collection, or continuous monitoring.

• Experience improving compliance processes, leading stakeholder adoption, or reducing duplication in SOX ITGC activities.

• Knowledge of and experience working with SAP, particularly in relation to IT general controls and financial reporting systems.


Benefits

• Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

• Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning.

• Collaborative and innovative work environment.

• Flexible work arrangements.

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product Team

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

About the Role

The ZT1 Labs group is a small, senior team of product and engineering experts working directly with the CEO on the company’s most important new bets. This team takes on highly ambiguous, cross-functional problems where the upside is company-defining.

We are looking for a Group Product Manager to lead a portfolio of ZT1 initiatives in a hands-on builder role, with direct product ownership and with no direct people management responsibilities. You will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for new products and platforms, partnering closely with engineers, analysts, and designers to build and launch, and with revenue and business teams to bring new products to market and scale.

You’ll work closely with the CEO and executive team to turn high-level ideas into durable, scalable businesses.

What You Will Do

Understand Customers & Strategic Context:

  • Build a deep understanding of Affirm’s global network of users, merchants, and partners.

  • Connect customer insights and market trends to long-term company strategy to identify where zero-to-one innovation can drive outsized impact.

  • Track relevant product, technology, and industry shifts and use them to inform product direction.

Set Vision, Strategy, and Roadmap

  • Partner with the CEO and senior leaders to define problem spaces and opportunity areas that matter most for Affirm’s future.

  • Craft a clear product vision and strategic narrative for the innovation portfolio, translating that into a focused and prioritized roadmap.

  • Define crisp outcomes and success metrics tied directly to business impact (GMV, profitability, conversion, retention, long-term moat).

Lead Zero-to-One Product Development

  • Drive the full lifecycle for new products and platforms: discovery, validation, MVP definition, launch, and iteration.

  • Own the full UI/UX, using AI tools to build and iterate on working prototypes that make product ideas tangible and testable.

  • Write and refine customer-facing copy across the product experience, from onboarding to in-product guidance.

  • Independently analyze customer behavior, build funnels, and use data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.

  • Own experimentation end to end, including hypotheses, test design, success metrics, results analysis, and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to sync ZT1 roadmaps with core product roadmaps, ensuring high product quality, an aligned user experience, and cohesive business results.

Cross-Functional & Executive Leadership

  • Lead a cross-functional group (engineering, design, data, risk, capital, operations, revenue, legal and compliance) through ambiguous and complex work.

  • Serve as a thought partner to the CEO and executive team on new product bets, tradeoffs, and prioritization.

  • Communicate clearly and often - framing decisions, risks, and tradeoffs; writing high-quality docs; and maintaining alignment across teams.

Raise the Bar for Product Craft

  • Establish product patterns, decision frameworks, and execution standards that make zero-to-one work repeatable and scalable.

  • Model strong product thinking, rigor, and judgment for senior peers without managing them directly.

  • Help shape the culture and operating model of the ZT1 function.

What We Look For

Experience

  • ~8–10+ years of product management experience with a strong track record shipping and scaling consumer-facing or platform products.

  • Previous ownership of technical software products end-to-end and ability to clearly articulate the business impact.

  • Direct experience leading zero-to-one or highly ambiguous product areas with meaningful outcomes.

  • Experience working closely with engineering, data, design, and other teams without direct authority.

  • Skilled at operating in complex environments where success depends on coordinating cross-functional work across multiple groups.

  • Founder or early-stage startup experience is a plus. Ability to spot opportunities, build from scratch, test quickly, and take ownership of outcomes.

Skills

  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools for prototyping, design, content, and analysis, with the judgment to evaluate and refine the output.

  • Comfortable doing the work directly without dedicated design, analytics, or content partners.

  • Strong communicator capable of securing alignment and decisions from broad groups of senior stakeholders with differing priorities.

  • Adept at influencing engineering teams outside your reporting line - able to guide them toward building what the product needs.

  • High judgment in ambiguous spaces - able to take incomplete or conflicting information and turn it into a clear, actionable plan.

  • Strong commercial instincts - able to contribute to pitches, negotiations, and contract evaluations when product work intersects with business strategy.

Behaviors & Traits

  • Bias toward action; cares about unblocking teams and driving meaningful progress quickly.

  • Comfortable moving between strategy and execution - from long-term roadmap thinking to writing specs or digging into edge cases.

  • Strong organizational discipline and interpersonal skills, able to navigate complex dynamics while maintaining momentum.

  • Deep sense of ownership - holds a high bar for quality and ships products on time.

  • Mission-driven and customer-obsessed, motivated to build honest, transparent financial products.

Pay Grade - REquity Grade - 9

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

CAN base pay range per year: $209,000 - $269,000

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Location - Remote CanadaThis remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Team Description:

The Ads Retrieval ML team builds the machine learning systems that identify relevant advertising candidates for Reddit users. Retrieval sits at the heart of the ads delivery funnel: before downstream ranking and auction decisions, our models determine which campaigns and ads are eligible to compete. We work on large-scale retrieval across multiple objectives, placements, and geographies. Our work combines representation learning, candidate generation, nearest-neighbor search, behavioral and contextual signals, and rigorous offline and online experimentation.

Role Description:

We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to provide technical leadership for the Retrieval and Targeting ML team. You will lead the design and evolution of retrieval models and modeling practices that improve relevance, advertiser outcomes, and user experience at Reddit scale. This is an applied ML role centered on retrieval modeling and end-to-end product impact. You will be expected to stay close to the technical details—from data and objective design through model development, evaluation, experimentation, and launch—while setting direction for other engineers.

Responsibilities:

  • Define the technical direction and multi-year roadmap for ads retrieval modeling in partnership with engineering, product, data science, and ads stakeholders.
  • Design, develop, and launch candidate-generation and retrieval models for campaigns and ads across Reddit’s advertising surfaces.
  • Apply modern approaches such as two-tower architectures, representation learning, embeddings, sequence models, graph-based methods, and other deep learning techniques when they create meaningful product value.
  • Improve the retrieval stack across key modeling decisions, including objectives, labels, sampling strategies, hard-negative mining, feature design, embedding generation, candidate filtering, and retrieval depth.
  • Work with approximate nearest-neighbor and vector retrieval systems, reasoning about recall, relevance, freshness, diversity, coverage, latency, and cost trade-offs.
  • Establish strong evaluation practices that connect retrieval metrics—such as recall, precision, candidate coverage, calibration, and downstream lift—to ads and user outcomes.
  • Lead offline analysis and online experiments, interpret ambiguous results, and translate findings into the next modeling iteration.
  • Partner with downstream ranking, ads platform, auction, measurement, and product teams to ensure retrieval models integrate effectively into the full ads funnel.
  • Write design documents, review code and model changes, and raise the quality bar for modeling, testing, observability, and production ownership.
  • Mentor ML engineers and help grow the team’s expertise in retrieval, recommendation, and representation learning.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of industry experience, including substantial experience building and shipping applied ML products.
  • Deep experience with information retrieval, candidate generation, recommender systems, ranking, or related relevance problems.
  • Strong understanding of retrieval modeling concepts, including DNN, embeddings, two-tower or dual-encoder models, approximate nearest-neighbor search, and multi-stage retrieval.
  • Deep experience training, evaluating, debugging, and deploying deep learning models using TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ownership of ML projects from problem framing and data preparation through offline evaluation, online experimentation, production launch, and iteration.
  • Strong command of experimental design and model evaluation, including how offline retrieval metrics relate to downstream business and user metrics.
  • Experience working with large-scale behavioral, contextual, or content datasets and complex feature pipelines.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to write clear, reliable, maintainable production code.
  • Technical leadership experience: setting direction, leading complex projects, influencing partner teams, and mentoring other engineers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex modeling choices to technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with ads retrieval, ads ranking, ad targeting, ad serving, recommendation, search relevance, or marketplace optimization
  • Experience modeling user, content, campaign, or ad interactions with sequential, graph, or multimodal signals
  • Experience connecting retrieval improvements to downstream ranking, auction, conversion, revenue, or user-experience outcomes
  • Experience in ads marketplaces at peer companies
  • Publications, patents, or industry contributions in applied ML or ranking systems
  • Experience with sequential modeling (e.g., RNNs, Transformers)
