We build the marketing systems that drive profitable growth, and we have posted industry record ROAS results doing it: 10.9X, 8X, and 6X.

Our brand is inspired by Apple, Porsche, REI, and Lululemon: premium, modern, best in class.

We Are an AI First Agency. This Is Not Optional.

Every person here uses Claude daily. We build in Claude with VS Code. Real automations are already running in production: our Weekly Marketing Update system, a client tracker that auto syncs Meta, Google PPC, LSA, GoHighLevel leads and Google reviews every day, an automation health watchdog, and a strategy session deck generator.

We believe this is what a marketing agency looks like going forward. If that excites you, and you want to add to it rather than just tolerate it, keep reading. If AI is something you will get around to learning eventually, this is not your seat.

The Role

You will be our clients' primary point of contact: their coach, their advocate, and the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. You own your book of clients and work alongside our specialists in SEO, Google PPC and Advanced Verification, GoHighLevel, and Meta Ads.

Your week:

  • Tuesdays: Deep dive into client ad performance, lead quality, and campaign health
  • Wednesdays: Send concise Weekly Marketing Updates (WMUs) to every client
  • Thursdays: Run your Scorecard in our L10 meeting (we run on EOS)
  • Monthly: Lead 45 minute client meetings on Zoom plus Loom video reports
  • Daily: Monitor client health, respond inside 1 business day, keep Asana current

What You'll Be Measured On

  • Client meetings held per week. Goal: 10
  • Client show rate. Goal: 90%
  • Escalations to CEO. Goal: 0
  • Escalations with a solution attached. Goal: 100%
  • WMUs groomed before sending. Goal: Yes
  • Client Health Dashboard updated. Goal: Yes
  • Responsive on Slack. Goal: Yes

Must-Haves (No Exceptions)

  • Account Manager experience at a marketing agency. Agency side, owning client relationships directly. Not general marketing experience. Not a coordinator role. Not in house client success. We do not consider candidates without this.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. You will be coaching business owners.
  • Proactive problem solver. You fix things before the client notices.
  • Comfortable explaining PPC, SEO, and Meta Ads to business owners
  • You already use AI in your daily workflow and can show us how
  • Video communication skills (Loom, Zoom)
  • You can commit to the set Arizona hours and the 90 day term

Strong Advantages

  • 7 Figure Agency community member or alumnus. Our single strongest signal.
  • Garage door industry experience. Worked at a garage door company, marketed for one, or sold into the space.
  • Home services or trades marketing experience
  • GoHighLevel, Google Ads, Meta Ads, or LSA familiarity
  • EOS experience (L10s, Rocks, Scorecards)
  • SOP building and process improvement track record
  • Automations you have built yourself

Logistics

Contract: 1099 independent contractor. You handle your own taxes, insurance, and benefits. 90 day initial term.

Eligible locations: USA, Canada, Mexico, or Europe.

Hours: Full time, 40 hours per week, Arizona Time (AZ does NOT observe Daylight Saving Time). These are set hours, not flexible.

  • Offshore: 3:30 AM to 12:30 PM AZ
  • USA: 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM AZ

Pay: $45,000 to $60,000 per year DOE, plus bonuses. Paid weekly via Wise (international) or Zelle (USA).

Target start date: Monday, October 12, 2026.

Tools: Asana, Slack, GoHighLevel, Google Workspace, Loom, Notion, TrackingTime, Claude, Manus.

Meetings: Monday Team Meeting (7:30 AM AZ), Thursday L10 (7:30 AM AZ), weekly 1 on 1.

The First 90 Days

You get a real handover and shadowing window with our current Account Manager, plus structured training on our systems, the garage door industry itself, and how to coach clients toward running better businesses.

By Day 90 you are 100% self sufficient: running accounts, leading meetings, sending WMUs, and managing your Scorecard without daily guidance.

Who This Is For

  • You take extreme ownership of outcomes
  • You overcommunicate rather than assume
  • You build systems instead of relying on heroics
  • You are genuinely excited about AI and want to push it further
  • Closed mouths don't get fed. You ask questions.

Who This Is NOT For

  • You need to be told what to do every day
  • You avoid hard conversations with clients
  • You think that's not my job
  • You treat AI as a box to tick rather than how the work gets done
  • You can't commit to Arizona Time hours

How to Apply

1. Send a 2 minute Loom video. Introduce yourself and tell us why you want this role. You MUST say the word Pineapple within the first 5 seconds of your video. This is how we know you read carefully. Applications without it are not reviewed.

2. Take the Crystal Knows DISC assessment. Free, about 10 minutes, no signup required: Send us your profile link.

3. Take the HIGH5 strengths assessment. Free, about 20 minutes: Send us your report.

4. Tell us your expected pay.

Optional: if you already have Kolbe A results, send them along. Do not buy one. We do not ask candidates to pay for assessments.

Bonus points if you can tell us something about the garage door industry that most people don't know.

Our Interview Process

Three Zoom conversations, all with Andy, our founder. Our current Account Manager joins the first two.

  1. Fit and ownership (30 minutes)
  2. Live mock client meeting (45 minutes). You run a real scenario with Andy playing the owner of a $2M garage door company.
  3. Final conversation and offer (30 minutes)

We move fast. Strong candidates hear back inside 48 hours.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.

  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Senior UX & Product Design Consultant (Part-Time Contract)

2 Days per Week | Remote

About Societ

Societ is a leading software company dedicated to empowering nonprofit organizations. Our integrated platform provides case management, donor management, fundraising, and financial processing solutions that help nonprofits focus on what matters most—their mission.

As we continue to grow our platform, we're looking for a senior product design professional who can help transform how we think about user experience across our product portfolio. This role goes beyond creating mockups or visual designs. We're looking for someone who can influence product thinking, challenge assumptions, advocate for users, and help establish a lasting culture of user-centered design throughout our organization.

The Opportunity

We’re seeking a highly experienced UI/UX professional who can bring industry best practices, challenge our assumptions, and help us build software that is intuitive, efficient, and enjoyable to use.

Our product portfolio spans both modern cloud applications and mature enterprise software. This role offers the unique opportunity to influence the evolution of new products from their earliest stages while also improving the usability and consistency of long-established products used by thousands of nonprofit professionals.

This is more than a design role. We’re looking for someone who can evaluate existing workflows, identify usability issues, establish UX standards, and work closely with our Product and Development teams to ensure user experience becomes a core part of how we build software.

Working approximately two days per week, you’ll become a trusted advisor and partner to our product team.

What You’ll Do

  • Help ensure our products not only function exceptionally well, but also present a modern, polished, and cohesive experience that reflects the quality of our platform and strengthens our position in the market.
  • Conduct comprehensive UX reviews of existing products and workflows
  • Identify friction points and recommend improvements based on established UX principles
  • Evaluate new features before development to ensure they are intuitive and user-friendly
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Developers, and stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle
  • Create user flows, prototypes, and interactive designs where appropriate
  • Introduce UX methodologies and best practices into our product development process
  • Help establish design standards, interaction patterns, and usability guidelines
  • Recommend improvements to navigation, information architecture, accessibility, and overall product consistency
  • Partner with Product leadership to influence roadmap prioritization through a UX lens.
  • Help evaluate product decisions based on customer outcomes, usability, and market competitiveness.
  • Identify opportunities where improved experience creates strategic product differentiation in the market.
  • Help balance usability improvements against technical realities and product priorities.
  • Participate in design reviews and provide constructive feedback
  • Help embed UX thinking into planning, estimation, feature discovery, and product reviews.
  • Mentor developers and other stakeholders on user-centered design principles, helping build lasting UX capability across the organization.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • 8+ years of professional UI/UX design experience
  • Significant experience improving B2B SaaS products
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating complex software applications (not just marketing websites)
  • Expertise in user-centered design methodologiesStrong knowledge of interaction design, information architecture, and accessibility standards
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills
  • Comfortable constructively challenging assumptions and advocating for user needs while balancing business objectives and technical realities.
  • Experience working with Agile product teams

Bonus Experience

  • CRM, ERP, case management, fundraising, or enterprise software
  • Experience modernizing or evolving established enterprise software products
  • Software serving nonprofit organizations
  • Design system creation and governance
  • UX research and usability testing
  • Accessibility (WCAG) expertise

Success in This Role

After six months, you will have:

  • Built strong relationships with Product and Development teams as a trusted design partner.
  • Identified high-impact usability improvements across both our legacy and modern platforms.
  • Introduced practical UX practices that are becoming part of our everyday product development process.
  • Helped establish a shared design language and interaction standards.
  • Increased confidence across the organization in making customer-centered product decisions.

Why This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to make a lasting impact, not just on our products, but on how we build them.

You'll partner closely with Product and Development leadership to influence the user experience across a diverse product portfolio, from modern cloud applications to mature enterprise software. You'll help improve the experience of products relied upon by thousands of nonprofit professionals while shaping the UX direction of emerging products from their earliest stages.

We're looking for more than someone to create mockups or design standards. We want a trusted advisor who will champion the customer, challenge assumptions, raise the quality of our product experiences, and help build a culture where thoughtful, user-centered design is part of every product decision.

Engagement Details

  • Independent Contractor
  • Approximately 2 days (15 hours) per week
  • Flexible schedule
  • Remote
  • Initial 6-month engagement with the opportunity for ongoing work

jobs.description:
We’re building the next generation of atrain: four trainees, one cohort, twelve months. Three of you learn the consulting profession from every angle in our customer teams: design, facilitation and project management. One of you learns how a consulting company runs from the inside, across Marketing & Sales, Finance, HR and IT, and gets to know the consulting profession on the way.

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just want to learn consulting.
We’re looking for someone who wants to become really good at it, fast.

FOUR THINGS YOU’LL GET REALLY GOOD AT
01 Design Experiences, Not Slide Decks
How do you design a workshop or learning journey that changes how people work on Monday, not just how they feel on Friday afternoon?
02 Make Groups Work
What does it take to lead a room of tired, sceptical or very opinionated people to a decision? Facilitation is a craft. You’ll practise it until the room is yours.
03 Keep Complex Projects Moving
Clients, deadlines, stakeholders and a plan that never survives day one. Take ownership of a real piece of a customer project and deliver it.
04 Run the Machine Behind the Magic
How does a consulting company win clients, get paid, hire great people and keep its tools running? Rotate through the teams that make it happen and fix something real.

YOUR MISSION
  • Learn the craft by doing it, not by watching it.
  • Rotate, so you see more than one way to get things done.
  • Grow with a cohort, not alone.

Track A: Consulting Trainee
You will:
  • Spend six months each in two of our three customer teams
  • Design workshops, learning formats and materials with real customers in mind
  • Co-facilitate first, then lead your own sessions
  • Take ownership of project work: planning, coordination, stakeholder communication, reporting
  • Learn how design, facilitation and project management fit together in one engagement

Track B: Corporate Service & Enablement Trainee
You will:
  • Rotate through Marketing & Sales, Finance, HR and IT
  • Work on real tasks in each area, from sales process and proposals to project calculation, recruiting and onboarding, and the tool landscape
  • Learn the consulting profession from the inside through the cohort and a stint in a customer team
  • Improve something that makes atrain run better, and present it to our leadership at the end of the year

Both tracks
  • Start together in a shared onboarding
  • Meet your cohort every month for a Cohort Day
  • Help shape what becomes possible, not just what gets built

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
  • Real ownership from day one
  • A cohort of four people who are learning exactly what you are learning
  • An EC Lead in every rotation and a senior mentor
  • Regular skill checks and development conversations, so you always know where you stand
  • A culture focused on impact rather than bureaucracy
  • Long-term development opportunities far beyond the programme
We’re less interested in the perfect CV than in evidence that you can learn fast and work well with people.

We’d also love to see:
  • Business-level English and German
  • Experience leading, presenting or facilitating a group, whether in a student initiative, a team, a project or anywhere else
  • Structured thinking and a hands-on attitude
  • Curiosity about how businesses and people really work
  • The ability to give and receive feedback without taking it personally

WHAT WE DO CARE ABOUT IS:
  • How you think.
  • How quickly you learn.
  • How you work with other people.
  • Whether you turn ambiguity into action.
  • Whether you’re curious enough to ask the question nobody else asks.

You don’t need consulting experience.
You don’t need a specific degree.
You don’t need to have held a job like this before.
What matters is your ability to learn, work with people and take responsibility.

Sounds interesting? Let’s talk. All we need is your CV and a cover letter that tells us why this programme and what you want to learn. Please also indicate in our cover letter which track of the program you are interested in.

jobs.title: Head of Go-to-Market Operations
jobs.excerpt: Very Big Things · Remote · Eastern Time ±2 hours preferred · South Florida a plus · Reports to the CEO ABOUT VERY BIG THINGSVery Big Things is an enterprise AI transformation company headquartered in Fort Lauderdale.
jobs.description:
Very Big Things · Remote · Eastern Time ±2 hours preferred · South Florida a plus · Reports to the CEO

ABOUT VERY BIG THINGS

Very Big Things is an enterprise AI transformation company headquartered in Fort Lauderdale. We help large companies adopt AI successfully at scale by redesigning critical workflows and building AI directly into the work. We do that through Transform Work, our engagement model; SHIM, the open-source methodology we created; and TrackFrame, the platform backbone beneath the workflows we build. Our clients range from PE-backed mid-market companies to Fortune 100 enterprises, and we have grand ambitions for growth. That’s where you come in.

JOB PURPOSE

VBT has a documented go-to-market strategy, a set of committed bets, and a senior team with deep relationships and real deal flow. What it needs is an operator: the person who turns strategy into a weekly operating rhythm and keeps it running at full pressure.

You will own the go-to-market operating system end-to-end: the cadence, the scorecard, the pipeline hygiene, and the execution of each bet, working with the team members who own relationships and revenue.

The CEO currently carries much of this. Your job is to take it off his plate and build a machine that no longer depends on him to keep it running.

Success looks like: bets executed on cadence, a dashboard the whole team trusts, and a steady, measurable flow of qualified conversations that become revenue-generating client relationships.

To be successful in this role, you need a bias for action. Ideas are not the constraint; consistent execution is. You should be energized by turning a plan into owners, dates, fields and dashboards, then relentlessly making sure all of it gets done with autonomy and agency.

This starts as a highly hands-on operating role, but the mandate is bigger than maintaining the current system. As VBT grows, you will help build and ultimately lead the GTM operations function around it.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Run the GTM operating rhythm: own the weekly go-to-market meeting, deal reviews, and a scorecard review cadence that drives decisions.
  • Own the scorecard: define and track the leading indicators for every live bet, including qualified conversations, second meetings inside 14 days, partner-sourced briefs, room and event outcomes, and make HubSpot the single source of truth the team actually trusts.
  • Operationalize the bets: for each committed motion, including relationship re-engagement, partner and reseller enablement, executive events, consultant strategy, and demand generation marketing, ensure there is an owner, a backup, next actions with dates, and follow-up sequences that run to completion. Seven or eight touches, not one.
  • Own the executive event production line: including vendor management for audience generation and syndication, pre-booked 1:1 meeting management, and post-event follow-up outreach.
  • Run the consultant channel operating system: own briefing materials, touch cadence, brief intake and attribution. Senior leadership owns the relationships; this role makes sure the channel actually operates.
  • Manage the partner operating cadence: keep relationships with ServiceNow, AWS, resellers, and other strategic partners moving through enablement materials, deal registration, standing presence at partner sales meetings, certification and program requirements, and consistent follow-through.
  • Run trigger intelligence: maintain the account list and the signals that time our outreach, including new executive mandates, stalled AI pilots, funding and regulatory events, and turn them into a weekly call order for the revenue team.
  • Own GTM tooling and data hygiene: required fields, source attribution from day one, meeting grading, workflows, automation, and the reporting the CEO and leadership team use to run the business.
  • Build the GTM operations function as VBT scales: determine where internal hires, agencies, fractional resources, technology, and automation are needed, and ultimately manage the people and resources responsible for running the system.
  • Coordinate marketing execution: manage the fractional, agency, and internal resources behind our media, content, and events programs and connect their output to pipeline. Support case study content production and award programs.
  • Prepare the weekly leadership view: what’s working, what’s stalled, what gets cut, and what should change. Bring a recommendation, not just a report.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 6–8+ years in revenue operations, GTM operations, or growth/business operations for a B2B services, consultancy, or agency business, ideally one selling complex work into mid-market and enterprise clients. Exceptional candidates with less traditional experience but a strong track record of operating at this level are welcome.
  • Proven experience running an operating cadence for a revenue team: pipeline reviews, scorecards, and QBR-style reporting that leadership actually used.
  • Experience running partner or consultant channels to generate pipeline.
  • Hands-on HubSpot fluency, or equivalent CRM experience at an admin level: fields, workflows, sequences, attribution, dashboards.
  • Experience working directly with a founder or CEO: comfortable taking a system off their plate, disagreeing constructively, and holding senior colleagues to commitments without owning them hierarchically.
  • An operator’s temperament: organized, persistent, detail-oriented, and allergic to loose ends. You’d rather close eight loops than open eight new ones.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and the ability to learn quickly. You do not need to arrive as an expert in enterprise AI transformation, but you should be interested enough in the space to become fluent over time and eventually speak credibly about what we do and why it matters.
  • An AI-native approach to your own work: actively looking for ways to use AI and automation to improve research, reporting, follow-up, analysis, and GTM execution.
  • Comfort with a small, fast, remote-first team where the playbook exists but the machine is still being assembled.

HOW THIS ROLE IS JUDGED

First 90 days: the operating cadence is running and respected; the scorecard is live with agreed definitions of “qualified”; every committed bet has an owner, a backup, and current next actions; the dashboard is trusted enough that leadership decisions cite it.

Ongoing: leading indicators trend up quarter over quarter, follow-up sequences complete rather than stall, the GTM operations function gets stronger as the company scales, and the CEO spends his go-to-market time in rooms with clients rather than running the machine.

POSITION DETAILS

This is a full-time position.

Remote. Candidates located within roughly two hours of Eastern Time are preferred. South Florida is a plus given our client, partner, and leadership footprint, but we will prioritize exceptional talent over location.

jobs.description:
🌍 Location: 100% Remote – Philippines

💰 Salary: Competitive, based on experience

⏰ Working Hours: Monday to Friday, aligned with US business hours, with occasional flexibility as we operate globally

📝 Contract Type: Full-time Contractor Agreement

🤝 Reporting To: Sales Team Lead

📅 Start Date: As Soon as Possible

Role Impact 🎯

As a B2C Outbound Sales Specialist at Nexford, your role goes beyond just closing enrollments – you’ll be a key player in driving our mission to provide accessible, high-quality education globally.

This is a highly targeted, consultative sales position where you’ll manage both inbound and outbound calls, primarily engaging prospective learners in the US and other international markets. You’ll work directly with prospective learners to understand their goals, overcome objections, and guide them toward the Nexford program that best fits their career aspirations.

The role requires balancing productivity and quality: not only exceeding enrollment targets but also upholding Nexford’s standards through rigorous QA call marking during downtime. Every enrollment you secure contributes directly to Nexford’s growth, helping us expand our reach and impact.

We’re looking for exceptional sales professionals who bring end-to-end sales experience, education sales expertise, resilience, consultative-selling skills, and a passion for making a measurable difference in a high-impact EdTech environment.

Why You’ll Love This Role 💛

  • Meaningful Impact: Help make high-quality education accessible worldwide by guiding learners to achieve their career goals with Nexford’s programs.
  • Consultative Sales: Use a targeted, consultative approach to connect with learners, meet sales goals, and optimize enrollment strategies.
  • Global Reach: Engage with learners from over 110 countries, making a tangible difference in lives across diverse communities.
  • US Market Exposure: Work directly with prospective learners in the US market and develop your experience in a global B2C sales environment.
  • Purpose-Driven Growth: Join a mission-focused startup where your contributions are valued, and participate in continuous learning to support Nexford’s vision of accessible, career-focused education.

What You'll Be Owning 🎯

  • 80% of your day is on calls — outbound, inbound, and follow-up. This is a phone-first role.
  • Own the full sales cycle, from initial conversation and qualification through consultation, objection handling, follow-up, and closing the enrollment.
  • Convert high-priority leads by understanding learners’ goals and recommending the program that best fits their needs.
  • Follow up persistently and adapt your approach until the right decision is made.
  • Manage your pipeline across all channels and respond within SLAs — every time.
  • Consistently work toward and exceed individual enrollment and revenue targets.
  • Review sales interactions and calls to maintain and improve quality standards across the team.

Skills and Qualifications 🌟

We care more about what you've achieved than ticking every box:

  • 4+ years of end-to-end outbound telesales experience, including prospecting, conducting sales conversations, handling objections, follow-up, and closing deals.
  • Lead generation or appointment-setting experience alone is not sufficient — you must have hands-on experience owning and closing the full sales cycle.
  • At least 2 year of sales experience in Education or EdTech is required.
  • Previous experience selling to customers in the US market is important, preferably in a B2C environment.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets in a KPI-driven environment. You own your numbers.
  • Strong consultative selling, objection-handling, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • The discipline to manage your own performance remotely and deliver without being chased.
  • Exceptional English, both written and verbal, with strong listening and communication skills.
  • Must be based in the Philippines.
  • Must be available to work US time zones / US business hours.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Education, or a related field.

Why Nexford University 🎓

Join a forward-thinking team dedicated to reshaping education. This is your chance to bring positive social impact to a global audience.

At Nexford, you'll thrive in an innovative and flexible work environment. We offer a competitive salary, performance-based bonuses, stock options, professional development opportunities, and more.

Salary: Competitive, based on experience

jobs.title: Senior Client Solution Architect
jobs.excerpt: Who You AreYou are a seasoned solutions architect who thrives in complex, multi-domain environments and enjoys guiding clients towards outcomes that align technology with business strategy.
jobs.description:
Who You Are

You are a seasoned solutions architect who thrives in complex, multi-domain environments and enjoys guiding clients towards outcomes that align technology with business strategy. You bring a consultative mindset to every engagement, asking the right questions and influencing decisions rather than leading with products. You are comfortable owning solution strategy end to end, partnering closely with Account Executives and technical leaders to drive successful deal outcomes. You also take pride in mentoring others, helping elevate technical rigor and consultative skills across the organization.

About The Role

The Senior Client Solutions Architect plays a critical role in shaping technical strategy for high-value, multi-practice opportunities at Myriad360. This role carries full ownership of solution architecture from discovery through design validation and deal progression. You will collaborate closely with Account Executives, Practice Directors, and Principal Architects to deliver cohesive, scalable solutions that align with client goals and business priorities. As a senior technical leader, you will serve as a trusted advisor to clients and a mentor to CSAs and engineers across the organization.

Must be based in the United States and reside in Pittsburgh, PA. Travel up to 40% may be required.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Lead sophisticated, multi-practice discovery sessions centered on achieving business outcomes rather than focusing solely on products
  • Assume full ownership of solution architecture and technical strategy for medium to large-scale opportunities
  • Proactively identify cross-practice opportunities spanning networking, data center, cloud, security, and platform engineering
  • Ensure alignment across practices by driving cohesive architectural solutions and well-defined execution pathways
  • Partner with Account Executives to influence deal strategy, qualification, and positioning
  • Collaborate with Practice Directors and Principal Architects to validate solution designs, bills of materials (BOMs), and statements of work (SOWs)
  • Serve as a key technical escalation point during advanced stages of the sales cycle
  • Mentor CSAs and engineers in best practices for solution design, discovery methods, and consultative selling
  • Contribute to the development of reusable solution patterns, reference architectures, and enablement resources
  • Represent Myriad360 in senior-level client discussions, workshops, and technical briefings
  • Complete ongoing security awareness training and comply with company policies to the requirements section
  • Identify and escalate security risks to the appropriate Executive Leadership Team member and actively contribute to remediation efforts
  • Other duties as assigned

Desired skills and experience:

  • 7–10 years of experience in solution architecture, pre-sales engineering, or technical consulting
  • Demonstrated success in designing and selling comprehensive, multi-domain enterprise solutions
  • Advanced consultative discovery skills with a proven ability to guide client decision-making processes
  • Broad technical proficiency across at least two Myriad360 core practice areas
  • Capability to independently manage complex technical sales cycles
  • Relevant OEM certifications are highly preferred

A Little About Us

Our mission is to challenge and enable our employees to achieve great things.

We live and breathe our core values:

  • We Before Me: We demonstrate empathy through our actions and solicit diverse voices and opinions. We put ourselves in each other’s shoes, readily admit our mistakes, and generously share our time and knowledge.
  • Dare To Be Great: We are big-picture thinkers who focus on solutions to problems. We solicit and offer actionable feedback to others without hesitation. We embrace opportunities to improve ourselves, our teams, and our work. We aim to be the best of the best.
  • Own It: We set clear expectations, communicate proactively, and follow through on our commitments. We take pride in the experiences we create and the outcomes we deliver. We are personally invested in the success of our team and our clients. We iterate to deliver ever better results.

We are consistently listed among Inc & Crain's "Best Places to Work" and we're proud of our accessible & engaged executive team. We believe in cultivating an atmosphere of inclusion and providing an environment that enables every employee to work to the best of their ability.

Some of Our Benefits

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Incentive compensation plans for all employees
  • Company-funded 401k contributions
  • Zero-cost employer-covered health insurance
  • Annual BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) reimbursement up to $500
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Transparent, candid culture with 1:1 coaching, performance reviews, and a consistent feedback loop
  • Quirky, diverse, respectful, high-performing coworkers you’ll want to achieve greatness with!

Pursuant to the NYC Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range in New York City for this position is $250,000- $275,000 OTE, (base salary plus opportunities for bonus and/or commission). Compensation in other geographies may vary.

Myriad360 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Account Supervisor
jobs.excerpt: 🌍 Join Our Global Team Gravity Global is the world’s most awarded marketing consultancy specialising in brands operating in complex markets.
jobs.description:
🌍 Join Our Global Team
Gravity Global is the world’s most awarded marketing consultancy specialising in brands operating in complex markets. Led by strategy, innovation, technology, data, and creativity, we create brand-and-demand marketing programmes that drive transformational growth for our clients.
With 14 wholly owned offices across the US, Europe and APAC, and our Global Talent Hubs in emerging markets, you can build a truly global career in a rapidly scaling organisation that’s shaping the future of marketing.
At Gravity Global, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We’re a collective of creative thinkers, strategic storytellers, and data-driven innovators united by one mission – to deliver exceptional work that makes an impact. We’re growing fast – across continents and disciplines – and we’re looking for passionate individuals who want to make a difference: for our clients, our teams, and the world around us.
About the role
We're seeking an experienced and strategic Account Supervisor to lead a portfolio of integrated marketing accounts and drive exceptional client results.
In this role, you'll oversee a dynamic mix of clients representing approximately $1M in revenue, guiding campaign development, client strategy, and cross-functional execution across media, digital, and creative.
You'll own key relationships, deliver high-impact solutions, and ensure projects meet their objectives -- while playing a mentorship role within the account team to ensure quality and collaboration across deliverables.
This role is ideal for someone who excels at both big-picture thinking and hands-on execution in a fast-paced agency environment.

Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship & Growth
• Serve as the senior relationship lead across a portfolio of client accounts, acting as a trusted advisor and strategic partner.
• Lead the development of long-term account roadmaps, guiding the team and the client toward long-term, strategic growth.
• Anticipate client needs, identify opportunities to expand services, and unlock new ways to deliver value.
Program Strategy & Execution
• Own the strategic direction and execution of integrated marketing campaigns across digital, media, and creative channels.
• Translate complex business goals into actionable marketing plans and ensure cross-functional alignment around key objectives and deliverables.
Team Leadership & Mentorship
• Provide informal leadership and mentorship to account team members (such as Account Managers and APMs), helping guide prioritisation, decision-making, and executional excellence across accounts.
• Foster a strong internal team dynamic without direct line management.
Project Oversight
• Manage scopes of work, timelines, budgets, and resource planning across your book of business.
• Ensure operational precision while proactively identifying risks, gaps, and optimisation opportunities across workflows and deliverables.
Collaboration & Communication
• Lead communication across internal teams and external client stakeholders, ensuring visibility, alignment, and strategic focus throughout every campaign lifecycle.
• Prepare and deliver high-level presentations and client-facing materials with clarity and polish.
Performance Analysis & Optimisation
• Oversee reporting outputs and provide strategic interpretation of campaign performance.
• Partner with analytics and media teams to assess impact, offer insights, and recommend optimisations rooted in client KPIs and business priorities.
Proposals & Strategic Scoping
• Lead proposal development and scope refinement.
• Support revenue retention and growth by recommending project expansions, service enhancements, and forward-looking strategic initiatives.
• Collaborate with leaders across departments to ensure solutions are scoped accurately and reflect the full breadth of the agency's capabilities.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• 6–8 years of experience in a marketing or advertising agency environment.
• Proven ability to lead integrated marketing campaigns across digital, media, and creative.
• Demonstrated success managing multiple mid-to-large accounts with varying scopes and team structures.
• Strong strategic thinking skills and the ability to independently translate client goals into actionable plans.
• Confident communicator with experience leading senior-level client conversations and executive presentations.
• Skilled in managing scopes of work, timelines, and budgets with cross-functional teams.
• Experience mentoring team members and fostering collaboration in a project-based or matrixed environment.
• Adept at balancing long-term planning with short-term delivery in a fast-paced setting.
• Proficient in tools such as Monday.com, Airtable, or Asana; familiarity with marketing automation or analytics platforms is a plus.

💫 What We Offer

While specific benefits may vary by region due to cultural norms, all team members at Gravity Global can expect a supportive, inclusive, and rewarding environment designed to help you do your best work and grow your career.
Key aspects of being part of the Gravity Global community:
  • 💰 Competitive Reward & Pay – we recognise and value your contribution with fair and competitive rewards aligned to local market practices, designed to celebrate excellence and support long-term success.
  • 🚀 Career Growth & Development – we believe development is ongoing, not annual. Through our Continuous Performance Management (CPM) process, which includes regular feedback and coaching, we help you refine your skills, celebrate your achievements, and plan for future success enabling you to reach your full potential.
  • 🤝 Collaboration – be part of a cross-functional, global team that values sharing insights, ideas, and best practices to drive collective success.
  • 🎓 Professional Development – we invest in you through ongoing training and learning programmes designed to expand your expertise and confidence.
  • 🌴 Work-Life Balance – while we expect dedication to client success, we also value your wellbeing, offering flexible working arrangements and plentiful paid time off.
  • 🎉 Community & Recognition – we celebrate our people through social and team-building events, recognise length of service and life milestones, and appreciate individual contributions through our Gravity Gratitude ‘kudos’ recognition programme.
  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family Support – we understand family matters and our people benefit from family-friendly policies such as parental leave, and access to wellbeing resources to help you balance work and family life.
  • 🌱 Purpose & Belonging – we are committed to Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) principles, fostering a workplace where positive impact matters. Our people are encouraged to get involved in employee resource groups that champion wellbeing, sustainability and culture.
Important Disclosure:
At Gravity Global, we believe in recognising every team member’s contribution. Your total rewards package – including salary and benefits – will align with country specific labor laws and our company policies. We’ll walk you through all the details during the offer stage.
Gravity Global is an equal opportunities employer and we do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion, age, sexuality, disability and other protected status as required by applicable law.
If your experience doesn't align perfectly with the job criteria, but you meet some of the criteria and are excited about the role and Gravity, please don't be put off applying! We would encourage you to apply for the role as you may be just the right person for this role or other roles.

jobs.title: Arity - Data Science Intern (Core Telematics)
jobs.excerpt: At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties.
jobs.description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Arity is a part of the Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. We collect and analyze enormous amounts of data in order to provide cutting-edge solutions to companies invested in transportation.

Analytics

At Arity, our Analytics team is at the core of helping us transform mobility. They not only know how to analyze and find meaning within the data but are passionate about how it affects the end-users of our products. They work with a treasure trove of massive data sets every day—after all, Arity is constantly collecting and deciphering billions of miles of driving data. And as our data continues to grow by the second, our Analytics teammates grow right alongside it. We give them the opportunity to model and visualize that data to create innovative products, working side-by-side with our diverse product teams. The insights uncovered by the Analytics team help catalyze groundbreaking solutions for our customers and are a driving force in making transportation smarter, safer, and more useful for everyone. Personally, we think that’s pretty game-changing stuff.

The Role

As a Data Scientist Intern on the Core Telematics team, you'll get hands-on experience analyzing real-world sensor and driving event data collected from millions of trips. You'll work side-by-side with data scientists and engineers on projects — from exploratory analysis through prototyping — and present your findings to the broader team. This is an opportunity to apply classroom knowledge to messy, large-scale data and see your work influence how Arity understands and improves the driving experience.


Responsibilities

  • Conduct exploratory data analysis and data cleaning techniques on large-scale sensor datasets to identify patterns, trends, labels, and data quality issues
  • Build clear visualizations and summaries that communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Prototype and evaluate models for detecting patterns or events in sensor data
  • Contribute clean, well-documented code and participate in the code review process alongside data scientists and engineers
  • Document methodology, findings, and recommendations in Confluence for the broader team

Required Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
  • Proficiency in Python (e.g. pandas, numpy) for data analysis and manipulation
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g. Matplotlib, Plotly, Folium)
  • Foundational understanding of statistics and exploratory data analysis techniques
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort working through ambiguous, real-world data
  • Critical thinking and intellectual curiosity, with a drive to dig into open-ended problems and ask good questions
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills for presenting technical work

Preferred Qualifications

  • Target Start Date: May/June 2027
  • Rising Junior or Senior 
  • Coursework or project experience with time-series or sensor data
  • Working knowledge of SQL for querying large datasets
  • Exposure to machine learning concepts/libraries (e.g. scikit-learn, TensorFlow)
  • Experience with Git or other version control in a collaborative setting
  • Familiarity with big data tools (e.g. PySpark) or geospatial data is a plus

At Arity, great things happen when our people work together.

That’s why when you join our team, we make sure it isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. And one where you can impact the future for the greater good.


Compensation offered for this role is between $22 and $33 an hour and is based on experience and qualifications.

Skills

Analytics, Big Data, Data Science, Data Visualization Tools, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Machine Learning (ML), Structured Query Language (SQL)

Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.

jobs.excerpt: About Us: CALSTART is now Catalyst Mobility.  We are a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.
jobs.description:
About Us:

CALSTART is now Catalyst Mobility. We are a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all.

For over 30 years, it’s been Catalyst Mobility’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. Catalyst Mobility works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. Catalyst Mobility provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration.

Position Summary:

The Manager, Operations & Research serves as the operational and analytical backbone of Catalyst Mobility's philanthropy function. This role ensures the systems, processes, financial planning, data management, and prospect intelligence necessary to support sustainable philanthropic growth and high-performing fundraising operations.

Reporting to the Head of Philanthropy & Private Funding, this position is responsible for forecasting, budgeting, CRM administration, pipeline management, reporting, prospect research, and fundraising analytics. The role works closely with the Manager, Emerging Partnerships & Growth and the Manager, Engagement & Stewardship to provide the infrastructure, information, and operational discipline needed to strengthen fundraising performance.

This position combines philanthropy operations, business planning, financial management, and prospect intelligence into a single function focused on enabling growth, improving decision-making, and strengthening organizational effectiveness.

Core Responsibility: Build and maintain the systems, data, processes, and market intelligence necessary to support philanthropic growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Planning, Forecasting & Budget Management:

  • Develop and maintain philanthropy revenue forecasts, pipeline projections, and fundraising performance models.

  • Coordinate grant budget development and philanthropic financial planning processes.

  • Track progress toward annual fundraising goals and revenue targets.

  • Develop financial reports and analyses to support leadership decision-making.

  • Support annual planning, portfolio reviews, and departmental performance tracking.

  • Monitor portfolio health and identify revenue risks and growth opportunities.

  • Partner with Finance to support forecasting, grant budgeting, revenue tracking, and financial reporting.

Operations, CRM & Systems Management:

  • Serve as primary administrator of philanthropy CRM systems and related reporting tools.

  • Maintain data integrity, portfolio tracking systems, fundraising records, and pipeline management processes.

  • Develop and manage dashboards, reporting systems, and performance metrics. 

  • Establish and maintain operational procedures, workflows, templates, and documentation.

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across philanthropy operations.

  • Coordinate operational processes across philanthropy, finance, communications, and program teams.

  • Ensure leadership has accurate, timely, and actionable data to support decision-making.

Prospect Research, Pipeline Development & Intelligence:

  • Conduct research on foundations, corporations, family offices, donor-advised funds, and individual giving prospects.

  • Identify, qualify, and prioritize prospective philanthropic funding opportunities.

  • Build and maintain prospect pipelines aligned with Catalyst Mobility's strategic priorities and growth objectives.

  • Monitor philanthropic trends, funding opportunities, and emerging funders.

  • Develop prospect profiles, briefing materials, relationship maps, and funder intelligence reports.

  • Support cultivation planning through targeted research and opportunity analysis.

  • Partner with the Senior Manager, Emerging Partnerships & Growth to identify and advance high-potential opportunities.

  • Conduct portfolio gap analyses and recommend prospecting priorities.

  • Maintain prospect and opportunity dashboards, tracking tools, and pipeline reports.

  • Support development of annual prospecting goals, pipeline targets, and revenue growth strategies.

Portfolio Analysis & Performance Reporting:

  • Analyze fundraising performance, pipeline health, and portfolio trends.

  • Develop reports and presentations for leadership, executive audiences, and board reporting.

  • Track key fundraising performance indicators and organizational metrics.

  • Identify trends, opportunities, and areas of risk across the philanthropy portfolio.

  • Provide recommendations based on fundraising, prospecting, and portfolio data.

  • Support continuous improvement efforts through analysis and performance measurement.

Qualifications:

Required Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in philanthropy, fundraising operations, grant management, nonprofit administration, business operations, prospect research, or a related field.

  • Experience managing CRM systems and fundraising databases.

  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting, reporting, or financial planning.

  • Experience conducting research and synthesizing information into actionable recommendations.

  • Experience managing multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.

Required Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Exceptional organizational and project-management abilities.

  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.

  • Ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. 

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across departments and functions. 

  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, CRM platforms, and reporting tools. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience with Salesforce or comparable CRM systems. 

  • Experience in foundation, corporate, individual giving, or institutional philanthropy. 

  • Knowledge of prospect-research methodologies and philanthropic landscape analysis. 

  • Experience with grant budgeting and financial management. 

  • Experience developing operational systems and business processes. 

  • Experience supporting executive decision-making through data and analysis. 

Success Measures :

Operational Excellence: 

  • CRM data accuracy and integrity. 

  • Timely and accurate reporting. 

  • Adoption and effectiveness of philanthropy systems and processes. 

  • Quality and consistency of operational documentation. 

Financial & Planning Performance: 

  • Forecast accuracy. 

  • Budget accuracy. 

  • Quality of pipeline visibility and reporting. 

  • Leadership confidence in revenue projections and portfolio data. 

Prospect Development:

  • Number and quality of qualified opportunities identified. 

  • Growth in prospect pipeline value and volume. 

  • Quality and usefulness of funder intelligence. 

  • Research support provided to cultivation efforts. 

  • Pipeline conversion and advancement metrics. 

Organizational Impact: 

  • Improved fundraising decision-making. 

  • Stronger cross-functional coordination. 

  • Increased fundraising efficiency and scalability. 

  • Enhanced ability to identify and pursue new revenue opportunities. 

  • Greater visibility into organizational fundraising performance.

We understand that not everyone will match the above qualifications 100%. If your background isn't perfectly aligned but you feel you would be a great addition to the team, we'd love to hear from you.

We're a tight-knit team of world-class innovators, business minds, and change agents who believe passionately in our mission and put our team ahead of self. We are committed to the continued development and growth of our employees and invest in your success!

jobs.description:
Overview:

Connor provides highly specialized accounting and advisory solutions to ensure contract, license, and royalty compliance. Founded in 2009, the practice has more than doubled in size every year. Presently we serve as trusted advisors to a broad range of clients across geographies and industries, including several Fortune 500 companies.

The world’s largest software vendors have entrusted Connor in the delivery of professional contract compliance services for over seven years. Our continued pursuit for excellence through experienced teams ensures our clients are served by the best with tenured industry experience.

We are excited to be rapidly expanding our team and seek a Manager to help us further build our capabilities and manage global client projects. With the support of other regional Managers, and Directors, you will advise our clients on license compliance initiatives and execution of audits. This role is involved with various compliance-related projects, including audit execution, data analytics, process improvement, and targeting analysis. We rely heavily on our Managers and expect a high degree of professionalism to carry out the highest quality of professional service our clients require and expect. The Manager will be responsible for performing, supervising, and reviewing each client engagement; and for being the liaison between our clients and their customers/licensees.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and perform all facets of the audits for existing clients: audit planning, audit execution, and reporting activities, which includes data analytics, licensee/client interviews, and preparation of client deliverables.
  • Perform extensive excel analysis as part of audit execution, internal client initiatives, and other services.
  • Manage audit KPIs, including deadlines and project milestones.

jobs.description:
TRAINING BUSINESS OPERATIONS LEAD

Kotter Training | Job Description

About Kotter

Kotter helps organizations turn strategy into results. Through our consulting and training offerings, we help leaders mobilize people, lead change, and achieve meaningful business outcomes.

The Opportunity

Kotter Training delivers learning experiences that help leaders and organizations create lasting change. As our business grows, we need strong operational leadership to ensure our programs run smoothly, our resources are used effectively, and our operating model can scale.

The Senior Training Business Operations Lead will own and continuously improve the operational foundation of Kotter Training. This role brings together program delivery, business operations, systems, processes, and performance data to ensure we deliver an exceptional client experience while running an effective and financially healthy business.

Working closely with the Head of Training, this person will oversee the details that keep our corporate and public training programs running while helping the business make better decisions about performance, capacity, resource allocation, and growth. The role requires someone who can move comfortably between hands-on execution and broader business problem-solving: someone who sees what needs to be done, understands why it matters, and finds better ways to accomplish it.

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad ownership and cross-functional influence. It is an opportunity for a resourceful, analytically minded operator to shape how a growing professional services training business works, not simply coordinate delivery or maintain existing processes.

This is a Remote, U.S.-Based position.

Responsibilities

Own Program Operations

Oversee the operational details of Kotter’s corporate and public training programs, from initial planning through delivery and follow-up.

Sales Handoff + Onboarding. Partner with the training sales team to transition closed deals into active projects, ensuring all client requirements, customizations, and SOW details are clearly understood and documented.

Client Liaison. Act as a point of contact for clients post-sale. Manage logistical communications leading up to the training delivery, including facilitation requirements, materials production, and participant preparation.

Delivery Coordination. Coordinate delivery resources assigned to client engagements. Ensure facilitators have the materials, context, and support they need prior to stepping into the room (or Zoom).

Program Logistics. Own the end-to-end execution of the open-enrollment public training calendar. Ensure registration pages are set up, manage attendee communications, order materials, and oversee event logistics (virtual platform management or physical venue coordination).

Attendee Experience. Serve as the primary concierge for public attendees, handling inquiries, distributing pre-session instructions, and tracking post-session certificates and surveys.

Delivery support. Occasional on-site or virtual event support and session production, including on-site attendee and vendor management for in-person sessions and technical support for virtual sessions (breakout room management, in-session participant troubleshooting, etc).

Strengthen Business Performance

Partner with the Head of Training, Sales Enablement, and Finance to monitor the health and performance of the business. Use performance data to identify trends, surface risks, and recommend actions.

Corporate Contract Scope Management. Monitor project health and proactively flag any scope creep or necessary change orders to the SOW.

Delivery Economics. Monitor vendor spend, venue costs, translation costs, and other inputs to track margin and product performance. Help identify opportunities to improve financial performance and operational efficiency.

Quality Monitoring. Gather client feedback post-delivery, conduct internal debriefs with facilitators, and ensure project closure protocols are established and followed. Ensure success stories are shared with the Training and Marketing teams to feed our library of case studies for use in marketing, business development, and instructional design.

Strategic Internal Initiatives. Manage the timeline and actions required to deliver projects, such as core training curriculum asset updates and new product development

Stabilize and Scale Processes, Systems, and Ways of Working

Evaluate how work gets done across the training business and identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce friction, and improve consistency. Build and maintain practical workflows, tools, documentation, and systems that support reliable delivery as the business grows.

Establish operating rhythms that create visibility into priorities, upcoming programs, business performance, and emerging constraints. Ensure responsibilities are clear, issues are surfaced early, and important decisions lead to action.

Resource Management. Collaborate directly with the Heads of Training and Consulting to forecast capacity, allocate delivery resources effectively across both corporate and public programs, and prevent team burnout.

Product Launch Operationalization. Coordinate dependencies, ensure go-to-market and delivery readiness, and help keep stakeholders accountable to timelines and deliverables.

Materials Management. Organize – and track access to – training materials, including folder structures in Google Drive and the central asset manager in our LMS. Establish tight version control protocols to ensure all accessible materials reflect the most current copies.

Certified Trainer License Maintenance. Track progress of delivery requirements for Kotter Certified Trainers, and alert the Head of Training when a Certified Trainer has not met annual requirements to maintain their facilitation license.

Process Optimization. Standardize templates, status reports, and delivery checklists to make our operations more repeatable and scalable. Bring ideas that improve our back-of-house processes.

Tool Administration. Maintain project management tools (e.g. Asana), ensuring all data is accurate, tasks are updated, and the team is adhering to operational best practices. Optimize and standardize the use of delivery tools (e.g. Zoom, Miro, Mentimeter, and Jotform).

Coordinate Across Teams and Partners

Work across Training, Consulting, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and external facilitators and partners to align priorities and keep work moving. Build productive relationships, communicate clearly, and influence outcomes without relying on formal authority.

Internal Communications. Implement mechanisms that keep the work of the Training team visible to the rest of the firm so the entire firm feels informed and appropriately engaged. Make it easier for stakeholders to understand what is happening, what is needed, and where decisions or action are required.

Strategy Execution. Partner with the Head of Training to translate business priorities into operational plans, identify dependencies, and ensure the business is ready to deliver new programs, initiatives, and growth opportunities.

Marketing Alignment. Collaborate tightly with the marketing team to align on promotional schedules and campaigns. Ensure marketing has the correct dates, program descriptions, and assets needed to drive enrollment, and report back on registration pacing.

Sales + Delivery Alignment. Work with Sales and Training leadership on pipeline visibility, delivery feasibility, capacity constraints, and readiness for new offerings.

Translation Management. Manage translations of training materials into new languages – including coordinating with our third-party translation service and global partners.

Based on skill set and expertise, there is also potential to support:

  • Facilitation

  • Product development

  • Proposal production

What We Are Looking For

An Experienced Operations Owner. You bring a proven track record in professional services or leadership development, using business judgment and financial data to drive performance and streamline complex delivery systems.

An Orchestrator. You can seamlessly manage the schedules, capacity, and priorities of multiple stakeholders, from senior leaders to external contractors, keeping work moving across organizational boundaries.

A Master of Context Switching. You can jump from a client onboarding call to an internal capacity planning meeting without missing a beat, moving effortlessly between high-level strategy and ground-level tactics.

Detail-Obsessed but Strategy-Aware. You sweat the small stuff while understanding how operational performance, utilization, and client experience directly impact revenue and growth goals.

A Clear Communicator. You are comfortable holding boundaries, defending scope, managing up to firm leadership, and bringing people together to solve complex operational challenges.

Self-Directed and Independent. You are exceptionally organized and take complete ownership to anticipate issues, bring structure to ambiguous situations, and follow through on solutions without rigid playbooks.

A Voracious Learner. You love learning new technologies and skills, seeking out root causes rather than temporary workarounds to continuously improve core systems.

We Are Most Interested In

  • Candidates with experience in business operations, professional services, consulting, training as a service, or leadership development.

  • People who combine operational excellence with business acumen and use data to improve performance, resource utilization, and profitability.

  • Operators who are able to build scalable processes, strengthen systems, and improve how teams work.

  • People who take ownership, solve problems, and influence across functions to turn business priorities into results.

This Role Is Not Aligned To

  • Traditional project management, PMO coordination, PMP, or administrative support.

  • Traditional Training, L&D and Instructional Design professionals.

  • Training Coordinators or people focused only on managing schedules and deliverables without broader ownership of operational performance or continuous improvement.

  • Candidates who prefer strategy without hands-on execution or who are looking for a people-management role.

  • People who focus on completing tasks without connecting their work to business performance, client outcomes, or growth.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in business operations, training operations, program operations, service delivery, or a related field.

  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Master’s degree or MBA a plus.

  • Experience managing complex operational workflows and coordinating multiple stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines.

  • Demonstrated ability to improve processes, systems, or operating practices and translate ideas into lasting changes.

  • Experience using data, reporting, and performance metrics to identify issues, evaluate results, or inform decisions.

  • Business and financial acumen, including an understanding of operating costs, resource utilization, and factors that affect profitability.

  • Strong planning and organizational skills, paired with the judgment to prioritize and adapt as circumstances change.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across functions.

  • Comfort working independently, navigating ambiguity, and influencing without formal authority.

  • Proficiency with business productivity tools and operational systems. Experience with CRM, learning management, scheduling, or reporting platforms is a plus.

  • Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer-sponsored visa support.

Reports To

Executive Director, Head of Training

Location

Remote US Based. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, client programs, or company events.

Compensation and Benefits

Salary Range: $85K-120K

Compensation will be based on experience and qualifications. Kotter offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, 401(k), unlimited paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Accessibility Commitment

ADA and Physical Requirements | Accessibility Commitment

Kotter is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in all aspects of employment.

Physical Requirements

● The ability to communicate effectively in person, over video, and via digital platforms.

● The ability to operate standard office equipment (computer, phone, video conferencing tools).

● Occasional lifting of materials up to 20 pounds (e.g., training materials or presentation equipment).

● Travel (up to 10%) for client meetings, workshops, and events, which may involve extended periods of sitting, standing, or presenting.

About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role:
Lyra developed an innovative video therapy program called Lyra Care Therapy: Blending live video sessions with between-session digital psychoeducation and customizable skill building tools. The Lyra Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) program capitalizes on Lyra Care Therapy to supplement standard individual DBT and DBT skills groups with novel between-session DBT-relevant digital activities—activities that help promote skill generalization and integration into your clients’ daily lives. Lyra DBT clients also have 24/7 access to a team of licensed clinicians who have been trained in DBT skills coaching for around the clock support.

As a Lyra DBT Therapist, you’ll provide individual DBT and DBT skills groups via live video to adolescent clients. You’ll also assign DBT-relevant digital lessons, videos, and assessments to your clients to enhance learnings and monitor outcomes between sessions. Lyra's clients come from a multitude of backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care—an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience.

Our therapists enjoy connecting with their colleagues who share a passion for providing evidence-based care. You’ll attend weekly consultation team meetings as well as one-on-one consultation meetings with an expert DBT team lead, co-lead DBT skills groups with other DBT providers, and attend robust trainings to enhance your clinical skills. You always have a team behind you if a crisis comes up. You’re never alone, even while working remotely in the US.

This role is a great fit if you’re a MA licensed DBT clinician who enjoys working with complex clients in a supportive, collaborative, and feedback rich environment. You may also find this role rewarding if:

- You are passionate about helping others improve their lives through skills-based interventions and work to understand your clients through a lens of compassion and curiosity.

- You enjoy evidence-based practice, continual learning, and professional improvement.

- You prefer to work within a collaborative team environment.

- You are accountable for your own outcomes and performance, and are willing to embrace challenges that others may shy away from.

Requirements

  • Unrestricted, active Massachusetts license (able to work independently without supervision from a licensed supervisor) without current or pending disciplinary action

  • Formal didactic training in DBT required (e.g., in-house training with consultation team, tape review, 1:1 supervision; Behavioral Tech; DBT Foundational Training; DBT Intensive Training)

  • One year minimum experience providing comprehensive DBT to adolescents which includes: individual DBT therapy with clients through Stage 1 of treatment, facilitating skills groups utilizing Linehan materials, participation on a consultation team, skills coaching

  • DBT-LBC certification preferred but not required

  • Experience, comfort, and passion working with clients who present with high risk behaviors, including suicidal ideation and/or self-injury

  • Willingness to obtain cross-licensing in additional states as needed to support program growth

  • Experience providing telehealth therapy services in a virtual environment (video and teletherapy) preferred but not required

  • Computer and live video tools literacy (e.g., Zoom, Google Meets, DoxyMe, Skype, etc.)

Le Senior Sales Executive 360° (Acquisition de biens) est responsable de la croissance du portefeuille de biens et prend en charge l'intégralité du cycle de vente sur nos marchés cibles. Dans ce rôle, vous prospectez de nouveaux leads, convertissez les demandes entrantes de propriétaires, réactivez les opportunités dormantes du pipeline et développez des réseaux stratégiques de recommandation B2B au niveau local.

Même si vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe solidaire, ce poste exige un profil de closer autonome, qui aime assumer l'entière responsabilité de son pipeline. Vous devez être à l'aise dans les conversations difficiles à fort enjeu et savoir lever des objections complexes pour conclure des contrats.

Missions et responsabilités

  • Gestion complète du cycle de vente : piloter l'ensemble du cycle de vente à 360°, de la prospection et des appels de découverte jusqu'à l'émission et la signature des contrats.
