  • Traitement des objections et négociation : mener avec assurance des échanges complexes à fort enjeu et lever les objections des clients tout en maintenant la dynamique de la vente, afin d'atteindre des taux de closing élevés.
  • Gestion du CRM et du pipeline : tenir un CRM rigoureusement à jour, en suivant l'ensemble des actions de prospection, le statut des contrats, les étapes du pipeline et les indicateurs de conversion.

Profil recherché

  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en vente sur l'ensemble du cycle, en B2B direct ou en vente de services en mode conseil.

  • Forte discipline en prospection sortante et volonté de s'impliquer concrètement dans la prospection à froid.

  • Temps plein

Ce que Nestify vous offre

ABOUT onX

We’re a team of builders, adventurers, and risk takers using technology to help people confidently explore the outdoors. Driven by our mission to awaken the adventurer inside everyone, we build products that optimize every outdoor experience and inspire confidence to get out and go further.

We’re a high-growth tech company. The pace is fast, the work takes grit, and ambiguity is part of the job. As the world changes around us, we adapt - continuously evolving how we build, prioritize, and deliver.

Our business moves quickly, and there’s real opportunity to shape what we build next. Each of our verticals - Hunt, Offroad, Backcountry, and Fish - is at a different stage of maturity, which means the challenges you encounter and the impact you have will vary depending on where you sit and what the business needs most.

We operate with an experimentation mindset, continually iterating and improving how we solve problems. We expect our people to use the latest tooling, including AI, thoughtfully and responsibly, pairing human judgment with technology to increase quality, speed, and impact.

Our impact comes to life through the products we build, in the stories of our customers, and in our growing commitment to land stewardship and recreational access.

ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY

onX is seeking a Senior Logistics & Fulfillment Manager to help bring an exciting new connected product experience to market, designed to complement the onX Hunt app and create new possibilities for our customers.

In this role, you'll independently lead the development and execution of logistics and fulfillment operations, ensuring products move efficiently and reliably from manufacturing through delivery and returns. You'll work closely with external partners and cross-functional teams to establish practical processes, manage operational complexities, and create a seamless experience for customers.

As onX expands into new product experiences, you'll have the opportunity to shape our approach to logistics and fulfillment, proactively identifying risks, navigating complex decisions, and building a strong operational foundation that can evolve with the business.

This role reports to the Director of Connected Devices.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
Essential Job Duties & Functions

  • Independently lead the development and execution of end-to-end logistics and fulfillment operations, from manufacturing through customer delivery and returns.
  • Evaluate fulfillment models and third-party logistics (3PL) solutions, recommending approaches that balance operational efficiency, cost, scalability, and customer experience.
  • Select, establish, and manage relationships with logistics and fulfillment partners, including warehousing, freight, and distribution providers.
  • Develop and manage inventory processes and systems in partnership with Finance and external providers, ensuring accurate tracking, visibility, and operational accountability.
  • Partner with Finance and Accounting to support inventory valuation, landed cost tracking, and other financial requirements related to physical product operations.
  • Establish and manage returns, warranty, and reverse logistics processes to support an efficient and reliable customer experience.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional partners to align fulfillment processes with product activation, purchasing, and customer experience needs.
  • Proactively identify operational risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks, navigating day-to-day challenges independently and escalating significant trade-offs when appropriate.
  • Provide clear visibility into fulfillment performance, inventory movement, and operational risks, helping stakeholders make informed decisions and stay aligned.
  • Continuously improve logistics and fulfillment processes, identifying opportunities to strengthen efficiency, reliability, and scalability as business needs evolve.
  • Demonstrate onX's Company Values by building trust across internal and external partners, fostering accountability, and proactively addressing challenges.
  • Look for opportunities to embed AI as a repeatable co-pilot in daily workflows, integrating experimentation into real work and refining its use with sound judgment and validation

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, fulfillment operations, or related work involving complex operational processes and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently develop, manage, and improve logistics and fulfillment operations, including establishing processes in evolving or ambiguous environments.
  • Experience evaluating, selecting, and managing third-party logistics (3PL) providers and other external partners.
  • Strong operational and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate costs, identify risks, navigate trade-offs, and recommend effective solutions.
  • Working knowledge of inventory management and accounting concepts, including landed costs, cost of goods sold, and inventory valuation, with the ability to partner effectively with Finance and Accounting.
  • Experience collaborating across Finance, Legal, Product, and other teams to align priorities, resolve operational challenges, and drive initiatives toward completion.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate challenges, manage competing priorities, and make sound decisions with incomplete information.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate operational plans, risks, and recommendations to diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to thoughtfully explore and apply AI tools to improve operational workflows, support problem-solving, and enhance day-to-day effectiveness while exercising sound judgment and validating outputs.
  • A shared passion for and ability to demonstrate onX’s Company Values.
  • Permanent US work authorization is a condition of employment with onX.
  • Ability to travel as needed, including domestic and occasional international travel, to support fulfillment vendor and 3PL site visits, manufacturing partner coordination, and other strategic business needs

ADDED BONUSES

Though not required, we would be thrilled to consider candidates with any of the following:

  • Experience supporting the launch or expansion of logistics and fulfillment operations for physical products.
  • Experience coordinating international freight, customs, and cross-border logistics.
  • Experience supporting fulfillment operations for products that combine physical goods with subscription or membership services.

THE ONX EXPERIENCE

onX is a distributed company with more than 400 employees across the country. We come together regularly to work in person and stay connected through regional basecamps and a culture that balances individual ownership with deep collaboration.

While we move quickly, we’re not a scrappy start-up. We operate with clear goals, structure, and frameworks that guide how we prioritize and execute. Priorities matter. While they may shift, data shapes how we evolve as our business, products, and the world around us change.

Clear priorities and structure don’t limit ownership - they make it possible. You’ll have the autonomy to define your work and make meaningful decisions within clear strategic boundaries. You’ll partner closely with others to solve complex problems and build solutions that scale across teams and platforms. Along the way, you’ll be supported with feedback, tools, and opportunities to grow your craft as you take on new challenges.

WHERE YOU CAN WORK

onX is a distributed company with employees across the U.S. We have physical offices in Bozeman and Missoula, MT, along with virtual workforce “Basecamps” in Austin, TX; Denver, CO; Kalispell, MT; Minneapolis, MN; Portland, OR; Salt Lake City, UT; and Seattle, WA. Basecamps are not physical offices; they are geographic hubs made up of remote employees who live within a 60-mile radius of the city center, creating opportunities for local connection and collaboration.

We have a strong preference for hiring candidates who live near one of our offices or within a Basecamp, and we prioritize candidates in these locations first. Candidates who live elsewhere in the U.S. may still be considered, provided they reside in a state where onX is currently able to employ team members.

At this time, we are NOT able to employ individuals whose primary work location is in: Alabama, Alaska, Arkansas, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia (D.C.), Florida, Hawaii, Illinois, Kansas, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

HOW YOU’LL BE COMPENSATED

onX is committed to compensating all employees fairly and equitably for their contributions. For this position, applicants can expect to make between $115,000 and $144,000 upon hire. The pay range will vary based upon experience, skills, certifications, education among other factors as required in the job description. In addition, full-time onX employees are eligible for a grant of common share options with a vesting schedule and an annual bonus of 10% based on company performance.

WHAT WE’RE OFFERING YOU

  • Competitive salaries, annual bonuses, equity, and opportunities for growth
  • Comprehensive health benefits, including a no-monthly-cost medical plan
  • Paid parental leave of 13 weeks for birthing parents and 5 weeks for non-birthing parents
  • 401k matching at 100% for the first 3% you save and 50% from 3-5%
  • Company-wide outdoor adventures and amazing outdoor industry perks
  • Annual “Get Out, Get Active” funds to fuel your active lifestyle
  • Flexible time away package that includes PTO, STO, VTO, and paid holidays

PERFORMANCE ESSENTIALS

In this role, success is driven by cognitive abilities such as concentration and problem-solving, essential for our computer-centric tasks. onX will explore reasonable accommodations to ensure that individuals with diverse abilities can fully engage in and contribute to the essential physical and mental functions of the job. If you need assistance or accommodation, please contact us at .

Position open until filled.

At onX, we believe that unique perspectives make us stronger. By bringing together people with different experiences, ideas, and viewpoints, we fuel innovation and move closer to our mission of awakening the adventurer in everyone. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fairness not only in hiring, but also in development, compensation, and promotion. Our goal is to build an inclusive community where every team member can show up authentically and thrive. Together, we win as one team. Come join us!

onX Maps will never ask for credit card or SSN details during the initial application process. For your digital safety, apply only through our legitimate website at onXmaps.com or directly via our LinkedIn page.

onX does not sell any Personal Information, but we may transfer employment related records to our service providers or third parties that provide business services to onX or as required by law. For more information, see our Privacy Policy.

As part of our interview process, your conversation may be recorded for documentation purposes to allow interviewers to focus fully on the discussion. Recordings are confidential and accessible only to authorized personnel. Please note, onX respects all applicable laws regarding recording consent, and you will have an opportunity to opt-out if preferred.

jobs.title: VP Sales Enablement
jobs.excerpt: BforeAI is an innovative and rapidly expanding scale-up dedicated to deterring cybercrime through cutting-edge predictive and preemptive technologies.
jobs.description:
BforeAI is an innovative and rapidly expanding scale-up dedicated to deterring cybercrime through cutting-edge predictive and preemptive technologies. We've harnessed the power of prescriptive AI to revolutionize the way we tackle cyber threats, stopping attacks before they launch.

Named by Gartner® in 48 reports over the last 4 years and recognized as a Tech Innovator for Preemptive Cybersecurity in the 2025 Emerging Tech report, BforeAI is the industry’s fastest, most accurate solution for automated protection against online fraud.

Join us in the fight for a safer cyberspace!

🚀 Why it’s great to work here

We are a location-independent company with a fully distributed team. We believe diversity of experience, background, and thinking leads to stronger teams and a better product. We value autonomy, intellectual honesty, practical decision-making, and engineers who take ownership of outcomes rather than waiting for perfectly defined tasks.

We offer an intellectually stimulating company environment and you’ll be working with a bright, dedicated team from across the globe. Additionally, we offer flexible time off, sick days, all public holidays, and stock options.

✨ What’s cool about this job

BforeAI stops cyberattacks before they launch. That means many customer conversations start with explaining a capability buyers haven't purchased before. Enablement here is a direct revenue lever, not a support function. You'll work across Sales, Sales Engineering, Product, and Marketing on a hard and rewarding problem: turning deeply technical, predictive security capabilities into stories that win deals.

We are hiring a VP of Sales Enablement to build BforeAI's sales education program from the ground up and to be the person our commercial teams turn to for how to pitch, demo, and win.

📣 What you’ll be doing

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set the strategy for how BforeAI's commercial teams learn and win, and you'll do much of the building and coaching yourself. We're a small team where everyone is a doer, VPs included.

Build the sales education program

  • Design and launch BforeAI's sales education program, standardizing how commercial team members learn, from onboarding through ongoing development.
  • Define the knowledge and skills required to win customer opportunities, and formalize them into a clear learning journey for Account Executives and Sales Engineers.
  • Build the scripts and supporting materials the team uses every day, and keep them current as the product and market evolve.

Analyze and improve the sales motion

  • Synthesize current sales motions and assess how well they open opportunities and close deals.
  • Analyze wins to document what successful pitches look like, and examine losses to run gap analyses and improve performance.
  • Join customer presentations to observe, document recurring challenges and objections, and feed what you learn back into training and messaging.

Create playbooks and messaging

  • Create and present playbooks for our product and target verticals, covering pitches, product demonstrations, value propositions, and objection handling.
  • Review messaging with team members for both live and written customer communications.
  • Partner closely with Product and our product experts to understand every capability of the platform and translate it into what the commercial team needs to win deals.

Coach, assess, and report

  • Build realistic opportunity scenarios, run role-play sessions, grade participants, and create improvement plans where needed.
  • Maintain an ongoing record of Account Executive and Sales Engineer performance to guide targeted enablement.
  • Report regularly to leadership on individual and team capability in delivering product messaging.

Be a hands-on technical voice for BforeAI

  • Support customer calls alongside Account Executives and Sales Engineers when volume requires it.
  • Create content for public outreach, including blogs, LinkedIn posts, white papers, and SEO content.
  • Represent BforeAI as a technology expert at webinars, industry events, and other outreach opportunities.

💥 You’ll be a great fit if

  • You have significant experience building and leading sales enablement, education, or training programs for B2B SaaS, including at least one high-growth startup.
  • You have worked as a Sales Engineer or in a comparable technical presales role, and you know what it takes to demo and defend a technical product in front of a buyer.
  • You are deeply technical in cybersecurity, fraud prevention, predictive analytics, or data analytics, and can explain complex technology clearly to technical and business audiences alike.
  • You turn win/loss analysis and deal observation into specific, measurable improvements in how a team sells.
  • You design and run effective role-plays, assessments, and coaching, holding people to a clear standard while helping them reach it.
  • You write well and present confidently, whether it's a playbook, a customer email, a blog post, or a webinar.
  • You have built certification programs with readiness metrics tied to pipeline and win rates
  • You are a hands-on leader who sets the strategy and does the work, and you're comfortable without a large team or ready-made infrastructure.
  • You collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, and Marketing in a fully remote, distributed environment.

You do not need every item below, but relevant experience may help you have an immediate impact:

  • Experience in a quota-carrying sales role
  • Experience selling to enterprise security, fraud, or risk teams
  • Familiarity with threat intelligence, digital risk protection, brand protection, or online fraud
  • A public profile as a speaker, writer, or industry voice in cybersecurity

At BforeAI, we're dedicated to building a diverse workplace based on merit, work ethics, and character, and we believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success! If you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we hope you’ll still consider applying!

The target annual base salary range for this role is $200,000 to $225,000, plus equity. Final compensation is determined by geographic location, relevant experience, and role-level benchmarking.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, so you will need to be authorized to work in the US. We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed.

💡 Want to know more about BforeAI?

  • About BforeAI
  • BforeAI on YouTube
  • Our Values & Benefits at BforeAI
  • Celebrating 41 Gartner® mentions
  • BforeAI has been recognized by Gartner® as a Tech Innovator in the 2025 Emerging Tech
Salary: $200,000 to $225,000 per year

jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

Prenuvo is building a longitudinal care model, where patients have an ongoing clinical relationship rather than a single scan. Our nurse practitioners are the clinicians patients talk to after their scan.

You will review imaging and laboratory results with patients by phone and video, explain what the findings mean, and agree on the right next step together. You will work scheduled consult blocks alongside our full-time nurse practitioner team, to the same clinical and documentation standards.

This is a remote contract role, and it reports to a Nurse Practitioner Manager. This is a 3-month contract position, with the possibility of extension based on business needs.

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct results review consultations by phone and video, reviewing imaging and laboratory results and explaining what they mean
  • Prepare for each consult by reviewing the patient's report, intake, history and prior scans
  • Identify care gaps and recommend next steps, including follow-up imaging, referrals and the interval to the next scan
  • Follow established protocols for actionable findings, and escalate urgent findings to Radiology and Preventive Medicine physicians through the defined escalation pathway
  • Work with care coordinators and registered nurse navigators on follow-up and referral loop closure
  • Document every encounter to clinical standard in HealthCloud, including a care plan the patient can access
  • Work the consult blocks you commit to, and give advance notice of schedule changes
  • Participate in quality reviews and complete required onboarding and protocol training
  • Maintain active licensure and credentialing in assigned states

What You’ll bring

  • Active, unrestricted Nurse Practitioner license (minimum of 10 licenses) and national board certification (FNP, AGNP or ANP), with the ability to obtain licensure in additional states as required; compact state nursing license required
  • Two or more years of clinical practice as a Nurse Practitioner, preferably in primary care, internal medicine, preventive medicine or a related field
  • Demonstrated ability to explain complex clinical findings clearly and without alarming patients
  • Comfortable delivering care by phone and video
  • Strong documentation practice and comfort working in an electronic health record
  • Strong commitment to patient privacy and the handling of protected health information
  • Experience with imaging interpretation in a clinical context preferred
  • Experience in preventive or longevity medicine preferred
  • Experience working remotely in a clinical role preferred

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • The hourly compensation range is $60 to $65 USD depending upon experience

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain []. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to .

jobs.description:
Medical Biller & Coder 4 (Team B)

Argentina (Remote)

SERVICE OVERVIEW

Remote LATAM role. Compensation listed in USD with local currency equivalent. This particular role is an Argentina-based independent contractor engagement.

ABOUT FREEDOM HEALTH SYSTEMS, INC:

Freedom Health Systems, Inc. is a mission-driven healthcare advisory and management consulting firm that partners with behavioral health and human services organizations to improve access, equity, and operational excellence. We specialize in guiding providers through program development, accreditation, compliance, and clinical best practices.

While Freedom Health Systems does not provide direct clinical services, the organization delivers critical operational support through revenue cycle management, prior authorization, medical billing and coding, compliance consulting, and administrative services to outpatient behavioral health providers.

DISCLOSURES:

This document defines the scope of work and service expectations for an independent contractor engagement and does not create an employment relationship. Scope, deliverables, tools, priorities, and assignments may be modified through written amendment based on client needs, regulatory requirements, or contractual obligations.

COMPANY INFORMATION

COMPANY WEBSITE:

COMPANY PHONE NUMBER: 667-239-9572

HUMAN RESOURCES PHONE: 667-239-9572 EXT 10

HUMAN RESOURCES EMAIL:

SERVICE TITLE:

Medical Biller & Coder 4 (Team B)

ALTERNATE SERVICE TITLES:

Medical Billing Specialist (Contractor)

Medical Coding Specialist (Contractor)

CONTRACTING ENTITY:

Freedom Health Systems, Inc.

(In support of outpatient mental health center clients under contract)

DIVISION: Accounting & Finance

DEPARTMENT: Accounts Receivables

UNIT: Medical Billing & Coding (Revenue Cycle Management Services)

BENEFITS PACKAGE: Not applicable (Independent Contractor)

SERVICE HOURS:

Monday – Friday, aligned with U.S. Eastern Time business hours
(8:00 AM EST – 5:00 PM EST or as otherwise contractually agreed)

REPORTING & COORDINATION:

The contractor will coordinate daily service delivery with the Medical Billing & Coding Analyst 2 (Team Lead – Team B). Escalations, risks, or unresolved issues will be routed through the Team Lead to the Accounts Receivables Department Manager as required.

CONTRACT CLASSIFICATION: W8BEN – Independent Contractor

COMPENSATION RANGE

USD $5.00–$6.50 (≈ ARS 5,000–6,500/hr)

ANTICIPATED TRAVEL: None

SCOPE OF ASSIGNMENT

This scope of work applies to Team A, supporting one or more outpatient mental health center clients. The Medical Biller & Coder is responsible for executing accurate, compliant, and timely billing and coding services to support end-to-end revenue cycle operations.

SUMMARY OF CONTRACT SCOPE

The Medical Biller & Coder provides medical billing and coding services for outpatient mental health center clients. This includes translating clinical documentation into accurate diagnosis and procedure codes, entering charges, submitting claims, correcting errors, and supporting accounts receivable workflows.

All services are performed under the functional oversight and quality review of the Medical Billing & Coding Analyst 2 (Team Lead – Team A) and are a critical component of the Revenue Cycle Management process.

CORE SCOPE OF WORK & DELIVERABLES

  • Review clinical documentation to confirm required elements are present prior to billing (signed notes, treatment plans, service dates, units, provider credentials)
  • Assign accurate CPT, ICD-10-CM, and applicable HCPCS codes based on documentation
  • Enter charges accurately into the EHR or billing system
  • Submit claims timely and in compliance with payer-specific requirements
  • Verify patient demographics, insurance information, and payer details prior to claim submission
  • Identify and correct claim rejections, coding errors, and data entry issues
  • Support denial resolution activities by correcting coding or documentation issues as directed
  • Ensure all services rendered are captured and billed; escalate suspected missed charges
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready billing records and supporting documentation
  • Adhere to workflows, quality standards, and productivity expectations established by the Team Lead
  • Communicate documentation gaps, authorization issues, or system barriers promptly to the Team Lead

UNSCHEDULED / SUPPORT DUTIES

  • Assist with billing backlogs or high-volume periods
  • Support internal quality assurance reviews and audits
  • Participate in training, coaching, and cross-training activities
  • Provide coverage for essential billing tasks during team member absences
  • Support process improvement initiatives related to billing accuracy and turnaround time

TECHNOLOGY, DATA SECURITY & MONITORING REQUIREMENTS

  • All work must be performed exclusively on the assigned Amazon Workstation (AWS virtual workstation) authorized by Freedom Health Systems.
  • Use of personal devices, local storage, screenshots, external email forwarding, or unauthorized systems is strictly prohibited.
  • The Amazon Workstation environment is monitored by the Company for security, compliance, productivity, and quality assurance purposes.
  • System access logs, activity monitoring, and usage metrics may be reviewed to ensure compliance with HIPAA, client contracts, and Company policies.
  • Failure to comply with technology, security, or monitoring requirements may result in immediate termination of the contract.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

Service quality and contract effectiveness will be evaluated using, but not limited to, the following KPIs:

  • Coding accuracy rate
  • Charge entry accuracy and completeness
  • Clean claim submission rate
  • Claim rejection rate
  • Timeliness of claim submission
  • Error correction and resubmission turnaround time
  • Audit findings and error trends
  • Adherence to established workflows and instructions
  • Responsiveness to Team Lead requests and escalations

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Continuous use of EHR and billing platforms
  • Frequent virtual communication via chat, phone, or video

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Fully remote (Argentina-based) via assigned Amazon Workstation
  • Production-driven, deadline-oriented revenue cycle environment
  • Collaboration across time zones with U.S.-based leadership and client operations

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERTISE

  • Minimum 2–4 years of U.S. medical billing and coding experience
  • Outpatient mental health or behavioral health billing experience preferred
  • Working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10-CM, and basic HCPCS coding
  • Familiarity with U.S. insurance, Medicaid, and managed care billing processes
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to follow defined workflows and quality standards
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Experience working in secure virtual workstation environments preferred
  • Professional coding certifications (CPC or equivalent) preferred
Salary: USD $5.00–$6.50 (≈ ARS 5,000–6,500/hr)

jobs.description:
MPLC provides a legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. Our business has been running for over 30 years, and we are the number one trusted partner to studios and producers for public performance licensing. We work with every major Hollywood studio and hundreds of independents, and we are a key player in the entertainment and intellectual property ecosystem.

We are on a truly exciting journey as a company. We're growing quickly, investing in our teams, and have bold plans for the future. To support that growth, we're looking for a Senior Customer Success Executive to join our Customer Success Team.

The job in two bullet points:
  • Own and grow a portfolio of higher-complexity and enterprise customers, taking direct accountability for minimizing churn while driving renewal and expansion revenue.
  • Build genuine, long-term relationships with senior stakeholders and lead complex renewal negotiations using a business-development approach rather than a fixed outreach cadence.

You will love this job if...

  • You have 5-8 years of experience in customer success, account management, or licensing, with a track record of managing renewals and mitigating churn.
  • You have a background in business development or strategic account management and experience building long-term relationships at senior stakeholder level.
  • You are comfortable handling commercial objections, including cost-driven pushback, in a calm and consultative way.
  • You have strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • You are comfortable working across internal teams and directly with client contacts at varying seniority levels.
  • You are proficient with CRM tools.
  • Experience with licensing, media, or intellectual property is a plus.

Let's be honest!
This is a senior, commercially focused role involving higher-complexity and enterprise accounts. You will be expected to lead the hardest renewal conversations, build relationships with senior stakeholders, protect and grow the customer portfolio, coach colleagues, and help shape how the team works.
Collected revenue, not simply a signed renewal, is what counts toward your book of business and your results. The team is focused on moving net revenue retention from 102% to 105% in Year 1, calculated as expansion plus renewal minus churn. Individual measures roll up to the team target rather than a standalone quota.

If you need a bit more information...

jobs.excerpt: Knak is a mission-driven companyWhy?  Because our time is limited, our competition is fierce, and our margin for error is small.
jobs.description:
Knak is a mission-driven company

Why? Because our time is limited, our competition is fierce, and our margin for error is small. To have the biggest impact on the world, we stay focused on our core mission, which is...

Empowering marketers to be creative.

That’s why Knak exists.

In a world where AI has made everyone a creator, Knak helps marketers turn ideas into on-brand, high-performing campaigns at scale. The world's most AI-forward companies, including Meta, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Vercel, Notion and Stripe, use Knak as their agentic marketing production layer.

Here's what they and our investor Insight Partners figured out: creation got easy, but that’s making production harder. Every new idea and brief still has to be built, versioned, checked, approved, and shipped across every channel, and that work runs on handoffs, review cycles, and a lot of copy-paste. That middle stretch of the marketing stack has no system, no standard, and no owner.

Knak is the flexible factory for that work. Our customers set the brand rules, choose the tools that feed in and the platforms that send, and decide where AI does the work and where people do. We handle the repeatable parts, so marketers get their time back for the parts that aren't.

We're built by marketers, for marketers. We started with email because it's the hardest channel to get right and where many campaigns win or lose. Now we're bringing that same production discipline to every channel our customers use.

The Role: Senior Software Developer, Editor

We're looking for an experienced full-stack developer to join the team behind Knak's editor, where marketers design on-brand emails and landing pages without writing code. It's a complex, stateful application: a structured document model, a canvas that renders it live, reusable and lockable modules, translations, version history, and realtime collaboration so whole teams can build together.

You'll work across the entire editor and take ownership of our realtime collaboration engine: the CRDT-based sync layer, running on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects, that lets multiple people, and increasingly AI agents, edit the same asset at once. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves hard frontend architecture and isn't afraid of the distributed-systems problems underneath it. You'll also contribute to architecture decisions, mentor teammates, and work with product and design to shape how marketers create.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build the editor: Design and ship features across our Vue 3 and TypeScript editor, including the canvas, attribute panels, undo/redo, selection, modules and locks, and translations. Keep it fast and correct on large, complex designs.
  • Own realtime collaboration: Evolve and scale our multi-user editing engine (CRDTs, WebSockets, and Cloudflare Workers with Durable Objects). Harden it against reconnects, stale clients and partial failures, and make sure every editor feature behaves correctly when several people are editing at once.
  • Evolve the document model: Extend the structured document format behind every asset, and the pipeline that turns it into production-ready email and landing-page HTML.
  • Enable AI-driven editing: Partner with our AI team so agents can edit designs through the same operations and sync model as people.
  • Build reliable APIs: Develop and maintain the Laravel (PHP) APIs and persistence behind the editor, with a focus on testability, observability and performance.
  • Own it in production: Instrument, monitor and roll out changes safely with feature flags, and debug issues end to end, from the browser through the edge to the database.
  • Elevate code quality: Lead design and code reviews, write down architectural decisions, and keep the bar high.
  • Collaborate and mentor: Work with product, design, QA and DevOps, and share deep knowledge of the editor so the whole team can work on it confidently.

What You Should Bring

  • 6+ years of software development experience, with significant full-stack work
  • Experience building complex, stateful, editor-style web applications, such as design tools, page builders, or rich-text or canvas editors
  • Deep expertise in TypeScript and a modern frontend framework (Vue 3 preferred), including reactivity internals, state management and performance tuning
  • A product mindset: you care about the marketers using the editor, push back on requirements when there's a better solution for them, and judge your work by whether it solves their problem, not just by whether it shipped
  • A progressive, hands-on approach to AI in your own workflow, using coding agents and AI tools every day to move faster, and with the judgment to review, test and own everything they produce
  • Strong web fundamentals: JavaScript, HTML, CSS, the DOM, browser storage, rendering performance and profiling
  • Solid backend experience with PHP/Laravel or a comparable framework, plus MySQL
  • A good grasp of distributed-systems concepts such as consistency, idempotency, ordering and failure handling
  • Production experience with realtime systems such as WebSockets, presence and reconnection
  • Expertise in RESTful APIs, TDD and CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, strong written communication and a collaborative mindset

Nice to Have

  • Experience with collaborative editing technology (CRDTs or OT, e.g. Yjs, Automerge, Loro)
  • Experience with edge or serverless runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, AWS Lambda)
  • Email HTML rendering or cross-client compatibility experience
  • Experience integrating LLMs or AI agents into product features
  • Prior experience in a fast-growing SaaS company

Base Salary

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $130,000 – $160,000/year. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. This range reflects base salary only and does not include other forms of compensation that may be available as part of the total rewards package.

What We Offer

At Knak we have four foundational pillars. Culture, customers, product and growth. Culture is our number one pillar because we know that is at the core of building a strong company that can build amazing products and delight our customers. We do this with a laser focus on hiring the right people who are smart, positive and who want more than the typical nine-to-five offers.

We offer an extremely rewarding, second to none work environment as acknowledged by Ottawa’s Best Places to Work 2026! We show our investment in our people through our competitive salaries, great benefits, paid vacation, Life leave days (because life happens), team lunches and off-sites, and most importantly our commitment to YOUR career growth.

If this sounds like something you’re looking for, then we’d love to hear from you!

If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that women and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply. Knak believes in creating an inclusive, barrier-free working environment. If you require ANY accommodation to the interview process please contact Knak, our recruitment process includes AI screening for keywords and minimum qualifications as well as video interviews which are transcribed with AI. Humans are still at the core of our decision making! Please note that this job post is for an existing vacancy.

CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote, United States

Role Type: Full-Time

Reporting to: Chief Product Officer

Total Compensation: $165,000 to $239,000 per year

  • Base salary: $165,000 to $200,000
  • Total compensation includes the base salary plus a guaranteed supplement

The Senior Director of Curriculum is a senior leadership role responsible for the vision, strategy, and execution of CodePath’s entire curriculum portfolio. You will set long-term curriculum direction while directly shaping high-impact courses, particularly in AI-native software engineering, technical interview preparation, cybersecurity, and web development.

You will partner closely with Learning (Programs & Student Experience), Engineering, Platform, Revenue, and Employer Partnerships to ensure CodePath courses remain rigorous, engaging, and aligned to rapidly evolving industry needs. You will own the systems, processes, roadmap and initially manage a small, high-impact team and own hiring as the function scales that allow CodePath to move faster without compromising quality.

Check out our Course Catalog and our 2024 Annual Report to learn more!

Software engineering is changing faster than traditional academic programs can adapt. Generative AI is reshaping how engineers design, build, debug, and ship software—and employers increasingly expect new graduates to be AI-native from day one.

As Director of Curriculum, you will define how CodePath bridges the gap between academic computer science programs and industry expectations. You will lead the transition to a more modular, flexible curriculum architecture that enables rapid iteration, targeted updates, and new delivery models across:

  • Undergraduate, for-credit university partnerships

  • Undergraduate, Direct-to-student programs

  • Employer-focused upskilling and reskilling offerings

Our programs, run both online and in-person, begin with inspiration and build toward technical excellence and practical mastery, supported by learning pathways and strong student support systems. Our curriculum is grounded in proven learning principles — proper leveling, balanced pacing, spaced repetition, blended synchronous and asynchronous learning, peer collaboration, and project-based work.

You will define how we prepare students to become AI-native software engineers and steward our course portfolio to support CodePath’s growth from 20,000 to 100,000 students per year.

Key Responsibilities

Curriculum Strategy & Portfolio Ownership

  • Lead CodePath’s long-term curriculum strategy and transition to a modular, flexible architecture that supports AI- native skills, rapid iteration, and multiple delivery models

  • Own the curriculum product roadmap, maintaining 12-month visibility into new courses, major revisions, and portfolio investments

  • Maintain and evolve a comprehensive course catalog across Web Development, Mobile Development, Cybersecurity, Technical Interview Prep, Foundational CS, and AI-native offerings

Course Development & Quality

  • Lead the design and launch of new courses aligned to emerging industry needs, particularly in AI-native engineering and applied AI workflows

  • Oversee ongoing maintenance, revision, and improvement of existing courses to ensure relevance, rigor, and student impact

  • Ensure curriculum combines rigorous learning science with real-world engineering practice, clear career pathways, and applied experiences including open-source and industry-aligned projects

Team Leadership & Operations

  • Build, manage, and develop a high-performing curriculum team, including full-time staff and external contractors

  • Establish clear processes for curriculum planning, development, QA, feedback, and continuous improvement

  • Partner with senior leadership to forecast hiring needs and scale curriculum capacity in line with organizational growth

Cross-Functional & External Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Learning to ensure curriculum translates effectively into classroom delivery, aligned pedagogy, and student experience

  • Collaborate with Engineering to align curriculum with tooling, content systems, and delivery infrastructure within the CodePath Platform

  • Represent CodePath externally with university partners, employers, funders, and at industry events, clearly articulating curriculum quality and rigor

Key Success Metrics

12–18 Month Success Outcomes

You will be successful in this role if, within your first 12–18 months, you:

  • Establish a clear, opinionated curriculum strategy and modular architecture that reduces the amount of resources required to develop and launch and maintain curriculum by incorporating AI-first curriculum process/tooling

  • Refresh or significantly improve the majority of the existing course catalog with targeted improvements, raising the overall quality bar

  • Launch 2-3 new AI-focused courses that meet industry expectations, strong student satisfaction, and learning outcome benchmarks. Completion (70%), Job attainment (60%) and student NPS (50-60) are expected to be upheld or improved upon

  • Improve curriculum alignment with delivery, contributing to higher completion rates, clearer value propositions, and stronger student confidence entering internships and full-time roles

  • Build a scalable, disciplined curriculum function that is capable of accelerating CodePath’s continued growth and improving quality with successful hiring of two new FTEs and onboarding of key resources

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong software engineering background with the technical credibility to shape CS and AI-native curriculum

  • Demonstrated excellence in curriculum design, computer science education, or instructional leadership

  • Experience owning end-to-end technical curriculum used by thousands of learners, from design through iteration and measurable outcomes

  • Experience or excitement to incorporate an AI-first curriculum process/tooling that accelerates and improves quality

  • Proven ability to lead and develop teams, including managing full-time staff and contractors

  • Deep understanding of the computer science degree journey and the gap between academic preparation and industry expectations

  • First-principles thinker with evidence-based curriculum expertise, high ownership, and a bias towards action grounded with disciplined execution

Preferred

  • Experience designing AI-native, GenAI, or applied ML curriculum

  • Familiarity with open-source software development or community-based contribution models

  • Experience operating in fast-growing, mission-driven organizations

  • Exposure to platform-based or large-scale learning environments

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re hiring for a Senior Director level position at an annual salary of $165,000 to $200,000. Total compensation is $165,000 to $239,000, which includes base salary plus a guaranteed supplement. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits:

This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program

Company Overview

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

Job Summary

Support applied research across the Orbis AI focus areas — agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, and high-performance analytics — working alongside senior research engineers on questions with real product stakes. You will reproduce baselines, build evaluation datasets and harnesses, run experiments, and write up what actually happened. This role exists to bring strong early-career engineers into applied AI research and grow them toward owning a research area.

Travel: Occasional, up to 10%, for conferences, training, and team collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Reproduce baselines and published methods, and document precisely where your results diverge from what was reported.

  • Perform error analysis — characterize what the system got wrong and why, and report it without smoothing it over.
  • Implement well-scoped prototype components with design direction and code review from senior engineers.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. jobs.description:
About Us

Boundless Life is a family-focused living, working and academy operator building a new model for how families live, their children learn, and parents work around the world. Across eight global destinations — Sintra (Portugal), Syros (Greece), Tuscany (Italy), Andalusia (Spain), Kotor (Montenegro), Bali (Indonesia), Kamakura (Japan), and La Barra (Uruguay) — we offer families the infrastructure to spend one, three, or 6+ months living in a new country: fully furnished homes, dedicated coworking hubs, and our own academy project based learning programs for children ages 1.5 -14.9 years old.

Our members are professionals, entrepreneurs, remote workers, and their families who want their children to grow up as global citizens without pausing their careers or their kids' education. We are asset-light where we can be, hybrid where it makes sense, and long-term partners with our landlords and local communities in every market we enter.

The future of family life and work is global, seamless, and community-driven — and we are building it. Join us as we scale toward our next wave of destinations across Europe, Asia, and the Americas.

About The Opportunity

Boundless Life is seeking a highly capable Real Estate Legal Transaction Manager to join our Real Estate & Expansion team and support the growth of our global portfolio across eight active markets today, an active expansion pipeline.

The ideal candidate will bring solid, hands-on experience in commercial real estate legal practice — with a particular focus on complex, multi-jurisdictional lease negotiations and hybrid deal structures (leases with management, operating, or revenue-share components).

This role will serve as a dedicated legal transaction partner to the Real Estate & Expansion team, reporting directly to the General Legal Counsel and working shoulder-to-shoulder with our Global Head of Real Estate, in-house counsel, external local counsel, and business stakeholders across each market. A core focus of the role is the negotiation, drafting, and interpretation of commercial and residential leases, together with all associated ancillary documents — LOIs, addenda, side letters, management agreements, SNDAs, estoppels, guarantees, and building/regulatory authorizations.

Beyond transactional execution, the successful candidate will help build the legal-operational backbone of a fast-growing global platform: standardizing playbooks, coordinating local counsel across jurisdictions, and translating legal risk into commercially usable guidance for the business.

Boundless Life operates across eight very different legal environments — from Portuguese and Spanish commercial lease frameworks to Indonesian Hak Pakai regimes, Italian, Greek, and Montenegrin civil law traditions, and Japanese and Uruguayan market practice — with active expansion pipeline (France, Costa Rica) adding further complexity. Candidates must be comfortable quickly grasping the intricacies of new jurisdictions, working through unfamiliar frameworks with local counsel, and holding the commercial line while doing so.

This position reports to the General Counsel, with a strong working line into the Head of Real Estate & Expansion. Location is flexible (remote-friendly, EMEA time zone preferred), with regular travel expected to active and prospective markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Transactional Execution: Lead the drafting and negotiation of a diverse deal flow, including commercial leases (education centers, coworking hubs, family lounges), residential portfolio leases and management agreements, LOIs, MOUs, lease amendments, SNDAs, estoppels, guarantees, and hybrid lease-plus-management structures. Ensure every document protects Boundless Life's commercial and operational interests while unblocking the growth pipeline.
  • Multi-Jurisdictional Coordination: Manage and quality-control external local counsel across our active markets (currently Portugal, Greece, Italy, Spain, Montenegro, Indonesia, Japan, and Uruguay), our active expansion markets (France, Costa Rica), and any new jurisdiction we enter. Own the relationship, the scope, and the output — including translating local legal advice into clear, actionable direction for the business.
  • Asset Management & Operational Support: Provide legal interpretation of the existing lease portfolio and day-to-day support to Operations, Finance, Local Hosts, and Community teams on lease questions, escalations, disputes, permits, and landlord communications.
  • Real Estate Due Diligence: Lead legal due diligence on new locations and strategic initiatives — identifying and pricing regulatory, title, zoning, ERP/permitting, tax withholding, and structural risks — and translating findings into go/no-go recommendations.
  • Playbook & Process Optimization: Help build the RE Legal function from the inside out: templates, redline playbooks by jurisdiction, approval workflows, contract repository standards, and lease management processes. Turn one-off work into repeatable systems.
  • Strategic and Practical Legal Advice: Deliver timely, commercially oriented legal advice to internal stakeholders across all levels — from Development Managers and Project Managers up to the CEO and Board — translating complex legal concepts into clear, risk-based recommendations the business can act on.
  • Dispute Management: Support the resolution of landlord, tenant, and vendor disputes across markets, working with local counsel where litigation, arbitration, or termination scenarios arise.

About You

  • Education: Law degree (JD, LLB, Licenciatura en Derecho, or foreign equivalent) from an accredited institution. LLM or dual-jurisdiction qualification is a plus.
  • Bar Admission: Qualified to practice law in at least one relevant jurisdiction.
  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of direct experience in commercial real estate, contract management and leasing practice OR 7 years dealing with high volume complex commercial agreements. A background combining top-tier law firm training with in-house exposure is strongly preferred. Prior experience in hospitality, coliving, education, or multi-jurisdictional real estate portfolios is a significant plus.
  • Languages — Required: Excellent professional proficiency in both English and Spanish, spoken and written. Comfortable negotiating and drafting complex legal documents in both languages.
  • Languages — Strong Plus: Working proficiency in one or more of: Portuguese, Italian, French, or Japanese. Given the geographic footprint, any additional Boundless Life market language materially improves the fit.
  • Multi-Market Fluency: Demonstrated ability to quickly grasp the intricacies of new legal systems, distinguish market convention from negotiable position, and work effectively with local counsel across civil and common law jurisdictions.
  • Technical Mastery: Proven ability to identify novel and complex legal issues, escalate them appropriately, and translate them into clear, risk-based recommendations for both business and legal stakeholders.
  • Judgement & Ownership: Takes full ownership of work product. Operates effectively and independently with minimal oversight, while maintaining a high standard of accuracy, quality, and efficiency.
  • Organizational Skills: Exceptional organization and prioritization. Comfortable holding many parallel workstreams — often across multiple time zones and markets — without dropping detail or missing deadlines.
  • Travel: Willing and able to travel regularly (indicatively 15–25% of the time) to active and prospective markets for site visits, negotiations, and closings.
  • Cultural Fit: Collaborative, low-ego, mission-aligned. Comfortable in a fast-paced, ever-evolving scale-up environment where roles stretch, priorities shift, and resilience matters. Believes in what Boundless Life is building for families.

What's next?

  • First call with our Recruiter (30 min)
  • Interview with the Head of Real Estate (60 min)
  • Final call with the Hiring Manager (60 min)

The process might change slightly as we go along - we’ll keep you posted at all times.

Want to know more about working at Boundless Life? Check out our story!

Digital PR Lead at Blue Array

Lead a growing team and shape the future of Digital PR at Blue Array 🚀

Are you leading a Digital PR team, or an experienced people manager ready for your next step? At Blue Array, we’re looking for a Digital PR Lead to lead our growing Digital PR team, help develop our Digital PR offering and work alongside our Head of SEO to bring Digital PR and SEO even closer together.

It’s an exciting time to join us. We’re growing, we’ve just launched our Spanish office, and this role offers real opportunities for progression and development.

About the Digital PR team

Our Digital PR team supports clients across all sectors, from finance to fashion and lifestyle. We help them earn the visibility they deserve in the press, in search and increasingly in AI search, and drive growth. We care about results, and we care just as much about the relationships behind them, with our clients, with journalists and with each other.

The team is growing, so you’ll play a big part in shaping who joins, how we work and what we offer.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead the Digital PR team day to day, help shape our Digital PR strategy and offering, and look after some of our largest accounts. Your role will include:

  • Team leadership: Lead, mentor and develop a growing Digital PR team so everyone keeps building skills and confidence. You’ll run regular 1:1s and performance reviews, give ongoing feedback, support hiring and onboarding as the team grows, and create a collaborative culture where creativity and new ideas thrive.
  • Developing our Digital PR offering: Help shape how our Digital PR service evolves, from campaign formats and outreach approaches to building brand mentions and visibility in AI search. You’ll spot opportunities for new ideas, tools and better ways of working, and bring them into the team.
  • Strategy and standards: Design and deliver Digital PR strategies that support client objectives, SEO strategy and the agency’s vision. You’ll set clear standards for campaign quality, outreach, and reporting; build best-practice processes; and ensure the team is trained on them, so every client gets a consistent, high-quality experience.
  • Working with SEO: Partner with our Head of SEO and SEO teams to align Digital PR and SEO activity, so our campaigns have maximum impact on visibility, links and key SEO metrics.
  • Key client relationships: Be the main point of contact for some of our largest clients. You’ll oversee campaign delivery, lead strategy and performance conversations, and build long-term relationships based on trust and results.
  • Media relations: Make sure the team is building high-quality, relevant media lists, and work directly with top-tier press titles to secure interviews, exclusives and standout coverage.
  • Performance and insight: Make sure client performance meets agreed KPIs. You’ll use data to show what’s working, spot where to improve and change strategy when needed. You’ll also help the team run well, including resourcing, profitability and time utilisation.
  • New business: Support the Digital PR input on new business pitches, from shaping the ideas and pitch decks to presenting in the room. You’ll find opportunities to grow the services we offer existing clients, and work with the senior leadership team on renewals and outbound new business.
  • Industry knowledge and knowledge sharing: Keep a close eye on what’s changing in media, Digital PR and search, and share it. You’ll champion high standards of work and communication (the Blue Array Way), help upskill the team and the wider agency through BA Sessions and knowledge-sharing workshops, and represent Blue Array at industry events.

Who you are

We know that great candidates don’t always tick every box. If you’re excited about this role and our mission, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t meet every single requirement.

You don’t need to be a Head of Digital PR already. This role suits someone who is leading a team now, or who has solid people-management experience and is ready for more. Some qualities and experience that will help you succeed:

  • Strong Digital PR experience, ideally in an agency, including line managing or leading a team.
  • A track record of campaigns that earn significant media coverage, quality links and audience engagement.
  • Experience contributing to new business, such as shaping pitch ideas, building pitch decks or presenting to prospective clients.
  • A people-first approach to leadership, with the ability to motivate, develop and support a diverse team.
  • Good industry knowledge and curiosity about where Digital PR is heading, including its growing role in AI search and brand visibility.
  • A strong grasp of SEO and how Digital PR supports it.
  • Confidence with Digital PR tools, platforms and media databases.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly.
  • A proven track record in media relations and outreach.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience measuring campaign success through qualitative and quantitative metrics.
  • The ability to juggle priorities in a fast-paced environment and tackle challenges proactively.
  • A passion for storytelling and a keen interest in current events and digital media trends.

If you’re ready to lead, grow your career and help shape the next chapter of Digital PR at Blue Array, we’d love to talk to you!

Please note: We can only consider applicants who have the right to work in the UK and are currently based in the UK, as we are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.

Who we are

Blue Array is the UK’s most popular and largest specialist SEO agency.

We pride ourselves on doing things differently from others in our industry, providing open, honest and actionable SEO consultancy to our clients. Regular communication and insights are core to our service, and exceptional client satisfaction is the main reason we continue to grow so quickly.

Aerodynamics Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you can choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Aerodynamics Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational fluid dynamics, aerodynamic analysis, engineering simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid.

Required Skills

  • Python

  • Aerodynamics

What You’ll Work On

  • Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.

  • Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.

  • Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.

  • Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings.

  • Run CFD and aerodynamic-analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools.

  • Use Python to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation.

Required Qualifications

  • An MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or

  • A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.

  • Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics.

  • Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses.

  • Practical proficiency with Python.

  • Experience with at least one engineering tool or library that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.

  • Ability to select and justify modeling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, and solver settings.

  • Ability to diagnose non-convergence, unstable solutions, incorrect results, and physically invalid outputs.

  • Ability to communicate technical reasoning and engineering trade-offs clearly.

  • Relevant tools may include Python, OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy, or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

  • Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.

  • Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

  • Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

  • Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

  • Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

jobs.description:
CD PROJEKT RED recherche un Chef d'équipe de programmation - Quêtes (Lead Quest Programmer) pour se joindre à l'équipe responsable de Cyberpunk 2, la suite de Cyberpunk 2077 et le prochain titre majeur de la franchise Cyberpunk, développé sous la direction de notre équipe nord-américaine établie à Boston.

Il s'agit d'un rôle clé au sein du projet, consistant à diriger l'équipe d’ingénieurs axée sur les technologies narratives pour Cyberpunk 2. Notre système narratif joue un rôle central dans la concrétisation d'expériences riches et immersives. Dans ce rôle, vous servirez d’intermédiaire entre la vision créative et l'exécution technique, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les créateurs de contenu narratif, les responsables de quêtes, les directeurs ainsi que les architectes principaux et responsables principaux de la maintenance de notre système narratif sur mesure et partagé. Ensemble, vous veillerez à ce que nos outils et flux de travaux offrent aux créateurs la flexibilité et le soutien nécessaires pour créer des expériences narratives captivantes.

Responsabilités quotidiennes :

Gestion des personnes et gestion d'équipe :

  • Gérer les membres de votre équipe directe et soutenir leur développement professionnel ainsi que leurs ambitions de carrière.
  • Mener régulièrement des rencontres individuelles (1:1), des évaluations de rendement, ainsi que gérer le processus de recrutement et les plans de promotion.
  • Guider et encadrer votre équipe d’ingénieurs concernant la qualité du code, l'efficacité des flux de travaux collaboratifs et l'exécution technique.

Mener le développement des systèmes et des outils :

  • Travailler directement avec les concepteurs de quêtes (créateurs de contenu et chefs d'équipe) et les directeurs afin de traduire les exigences créatives et narratives en besoins techniques clairs.
  • Collaborer avec les architectes principaux et responsables principaux de la maintenance de notre système de quêtes sur mesure et partagé, afin de formuler les demandes de fonctionnalités, d'en assurer l'intégration et de veiller à leur amélioration continue entre les projets.
  • Mener le développement, l'intégration et l'évolution des fonctionnalités de quêtes pour notre projet, en veillant à ce que le travail d'ingénierie requis soit mis en œuvre et livré de manière efficace.
  • Veiller à ce que les outils de quêtes fonctionnent de manière efficace sans pour autant compromettre la performance du temps d’exécution, garantissant des flux de travaux itératifs fluides pour les créateurs de contenu.
  • Assurer la maintenance et l’optimisation des fonctionnalités narratives et de quêtes, en s’assurant de leur intégration harmonieuse avec les autres composantes du jeu.

Exécution et collaboration en technologies partagées :

  • Favoriser les flux de travaux collaboratifs et éprouvés avec des équipes qui partagent leurs technologies tout en travaillant sur plusieurs projets.
  • Écrire du code C++ de haute qualité, propre, optimisé et dont il est facile d’assurer la maintenance.
  • Rechercher, diagnostiquer et résoudre les bogues au sein des fonctionnalités de quêtes et des outils auteur.
  • Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes chargées des cinématiques, du récit et de la jouabilité centrale (core gameplay) pour veiller à l'intégration parfaite des systèmes de quêtes dans toutes les composantes du jeu.
  • Avoir au moins 7 ans d'expérience professionnelle en programmation dans l'industrie du jeu vidéo AAA.
  • Avoir au moins 1 an d'expérience dans le leadership technique, dans la gestion de personnel ou à la tête d'une équipe d'ingénieurs.
  • Avoir une excellente maîtrise de la programmation en C++.
  • Pouvoir démontrer avoir de l’expérience dans le développement de systèmes de quêtes personnalisés, d'outils narratifs personnalisés ou de flux de travaux pour un éditeur dont le fonctionnement repose sur des nœuds (node-based editor).
  • Pouvoir démontrer avoir travaillé au sein d'un environnement hautement collaboratif de technologies partagées, couvrant plusieurs équipes ou projets.
  • Être capable de cerner les besoins des membres des équipes plus créatives que techniques, et de traduire la vision de leurs concepts en exigences techniques claires.
  • Avoir d’excellentes compétences en communication et en travail collaboratif pour pouvoir travailler efficacement dans des environnements multiculturels et sur plusieurs fuseaux horaires.

Compétences optionnelles recherchées :
(veuillez noter que ces compétences ne sont pas obligatoires pour postuler)

  • Avoir une connaissance de l'architecture d'Unreal Engine.
  • Avoir une compréhension de l’architecture d’un réseau multijoueur et de la synchronisation client-serveur pour l'état du jeu et les quêtes.
  • Avoir participé au développement et au lancement d'au moins un jeu AAA utilisant des outils narratifs ou de quêtes sur mesure ou personnalisés.
  • Avoir une connaissance des outils d'interface utilisateur d'Unreal Engine ou de la création de scripts d'édition pour des outils de contenu personnalisés.

Vous avez jusqu’au 15 décembre 2026 pour envoyer votre candidature pour ce poste.

Ce poste peut être pourvu entièrement en télétravail depuis le Canada.

Santé et bien-être

  • Assurance maladie prise en charge par l'employeur (soins dentaires, de la vue et santé mentale).
  • Soutien gratuit en santé mentale, incluant l'accès à des services de consultation, des soins psychiatriques et une variété de webinaires sur le bien-être.
  • Congés payés : 26 jours de vacances, 10 jours de congé maladie et 12 jours fériés par année.
  • REER collectif avec cotisation équivalente de l'employeur.
  • Compte de dépenses lié au style de vie (LSA) : 100 $ CAD par mois applicables pour l’exercice physique, le bien-être, les frais d'Internet, l'équipement de télétravail, la formation, les services de diffusion en continu (streaming), et plus encore.
  • Congé menstruel : les personnes qui ont leurs règles peuvent prendre un jour de congé supplémentaire en cas de douleurs menstruelles.
  • Réseau RED Parents : soutien offert aux parents qui travaillent.
  • Horaires de travail flexibles.

Avantages et développement professionnel

  • Formations, séminaires et cours : des ateliers de travail en interne, des initiatives pour le partage des connaissances, des didacticiels en ligne et des cours via e-learning sont disponibles.
  • Un kit de bienvenue rempli de cadeaux : pour vous aider à vous sentir rapidement chez vous dès votre arrivée.
  • Un environnement de travail véritablement international : vous aurez l’opportunité de faire la connaissance de personnes diverses venant des quatre coins du monde, et de travailler avec elles.
  • Aucun code vestimentaire : nous privilégions une ambiance décontractée.

Ce poste est à pourvoir dans le cadre d'un remplacement.

Échelle salariale annuelle estimée pour ce poste : 180 100 $ CAD à 247 600 $ CAD

Ce poste peut également donner droit à des options d'achat d'actions discrétionnaires.

Chez CD PROJEKT RED, la rémunération globale pour nos postes en Amérique du Nord est établie selon les données concurrentielles du marché, la localisation géographique et des facteurs individuels liés aux besoins de l'entreprise. L'échelle salariale de base est sujette à changement et pourrait être modifiée à l'avenir. Les offres finales sont déterminées en fonction de facteurs liés à l'emploi, tels que l'expérience, les qualifications et le lieu de travail.

Si vous avez constaté des irrégularités (par exemple des violations légales ou éthiques) au cours de notre processus de recrutement, veuillez cliquer ici pour les signaler de façon anonyme.

Notre mission : créer des jeux de rôle narratifs révolutionnaires qui parlent au cœur des joueurs. Souhaitez-vous en savoir davantage sur notre culture d’entreprise ? Nous vous invitons à nous voir sur les réseaux sociaux et à vous rendre sur notre chaîne YouTube et notre blog Beyond the Game où des membres de nos équipes vous font directement part d’anecdotes et d’idées provenant de l’envers du décor!
