jobs.excerpt: iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience.
jobs.description:
iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.

We're hiring a Director, Digital Analytics & Experimentation to own the numbers behind our direct-to-consumer business on nordictrack.com. This is a global role spanning analytics, reporting, forecasting and experimentation, with subscription growth and the customer journey at the center. Leaders across the company make spending, pricing and merchandising decisions on your numbers.

Why join iFIT and NordicTrack

Connected fitness is a growing category at the center of health and wellness, and iFIT and NordicTrack are right in it. We sell more than equipment: the iFIT membership keeps customers training, so every conversion, test and forecast is a lifetime-value decision, not a one-time sale.

As our Director, you'll be the person leadership turns to for what's working, what's next and what it's worth, with a direct line to the executives making the calls. You'll shape the nordictrack.com experience, grow customer lifetime value, and help us move to a new AI-driven personalization platform.

What you'll do

The role splits roughly evenly across three areas, and you own the integrity of all three.

Analytics and data

  • Pull and validate data from web analytics, order, media and finance sources, and keep documented KPI definitions as one source of truth.
  • Diagnose performance changes by traffic source, product and funnel step, and make recommendations supported by quantified evidence.
  • Track, analyze and report on our subscription economics, including customer lifetime value (LTV) and the annual iFIT subscription attach rate, and show what moves them.
  • Map the customer journey from first visit through purchase and subscription, find what drives conversion and what blocks it, and tell us where to optimize first.

Reporting and forecasting

  • Own the daily, weekly and monthly performance reporting and the dashboards behind it, including LTV and subscription attach.
  • Prepare executive-ready summaries of results versus plan and prior year, with the drivers behind each variance.
  • Build and maintain the full P&L forecast for the DTC business, from traffic, conversion and subscription attach through revenue, margin and marketing spend, including media mix.
  • Reconcile forecasts to actuals and finance, explain every variance, refresh the outlook regularly, and model scenarios (promotions, media shifts, pricing) with the assumptions written down.

Experimentation and CRO

  • Run the testing program end to end, from hypothesis and design to QA, readout and decision, and prioritize tests by their potential to lift conversion.
  • Report test results with the correct statistical method, and state clearly what a result can and cannot support.
  • Track the cumulative revenue and conversion impact of shipped tests.
  • Help improve our personalization program by measuring what works, where it falls short and where to expand it. You will partner closely with marketing, digital product, site merchandising and finance, and manage and develop one direct report.

What you bring

  • 8+ years in analytics, at least 5 in ecommerce, DTC or subscription businesses, with people management experience.
  • Proficient in SQL and AI tools, and able to validate everything they produce.
  • Proven experience running a statistically rigorous experimentation program, with strong CRO instincts for what drives conversion and what blocks it.
  • Experience building P&L or revenue forecasts and reconciling them to finance or ERP actuals.
  • A proven record of accurate, reconciled numbers, with QA habits you can describe, and the ability to explain a number, its source and its caveats to executives.
  • Hands-on experience with session analytics and multi-touch attribution tools, such as FullStory and Rockerbox.

What success looks like in year one

  • Your work drives measurable top-line and bottom-line growth, through higher conversion, subscription attach and customer lifetime value.
  • A prioritized roadmap of customer journey and CRO improvements is live, with measured conversion lift.
  • Leadership trusts the numbers without double-checking them: core KPI definitions are documented, reported figures tie to finance, and forecasts land close to actuals.

jobs.title: Ehrenamt · 5–8 Std./Woche: Legal Counsel / Compliance (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Du bist Jurist:in oder kennst dich mit Vereinsrecht, Compliance und Governance aus – und möchtest dein Wissen für das Gemeinwohl einsetzen?
jobs.description:
Du bist Jurist:in oder kennst dich mit Vereinsrecht, Compliance und Governance aus – und möchtest dein Wissen für das Gemeinwohl einsetzen? Vielleicht suchst du neben deinem Beruf ein Pro-bono-Engagement mit Sinn, oder du bist im (Vor-)Ruhestand und willst deine Erfahrung weitergeben. Bei uns sorgst du dafür, dass eine wachsende Organisation rechtlich sauber aufgestellt ist – von der Satzung über die Geschäftsordnung bis zur Compliance.

Gleich vorweg: Das ist ein Ehrenamt

Die Aufgabe ist unbezahlt und begründet kein Beschäftigungsverhältnis. Sie lässt sich gut neben einem Hauptberuf ausüben.

Wer wir sind

Der Deutsche Hilfsbund e.V. (DEHIB) bündelt humanitäre, soziale und wirtschaftliche Initiativen und bringt Hilfsorganisationen mit Menschen aus Wirtschaft, Politik und Wissenschaft zusammen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir nachhaltige Strukturen für Chancengleichheit und soziale Unterstützung. Damit das auf einem festen Fundament steht, brauchen wir klare Regeln, saubere Verträge – und dich.

Deine Aufgaben

Recht, Satzung & Gremien

  • Satzung, Geschäftsordnung und weitere Ordnungen gemeinsam mit uns im Blick behalten, pflegen und weiterentwickeln
  • Bundesvorstand und Geschäftsführung bei rechtlichen und organisatorischen Fragen beraten
  • Verträge begleiten: Kooperations- und Projektvereinbarungen, Mandate, interne Richtlinien
  • Gremiensitzungen und Vorstandsbeschlüsse rechtlich vor- und nachbereiten
  • Disziplinarische Fragen und interne Verfahren nach unseren Ordnungen begleiten

Compliance, Datenschutz & Risiko

  • Compliance-Vorgaben verwalten und mit Vorstand und Geschäftsführung sicherstellen, dass sie eingehalten werden
  • Datenschutzfragen klären – zusammen mit unserem externen Datenschutzbeauftragten
  • Rechtliche Risiken früh erkennen, pragmatische Lösungen finden und unser Risiko- und Eskalationsmanagement mit aufbauen
  • Nachvollziehbare Abläufe für Dokumentation und Freigaben schaffen

Was du mitbringst

  • Juristisches Studium, eine vergleichbare Qualifikation oder fundierte Praxiserfahrung in Recht, Compliance oder Governance
  • Erfahrung im Vereins- oder Gesellschaftsrecht, im Datenschutz oder mit Non-Profit-Organisationen ist ein Plus
  • Du erklärst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich und pragmatisch – auch gegenüber Vorstand und externen Partnern
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, verantwortungsbewusst und mit Fingerspitzengefühl für sensible Themen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1/C2) und sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft 365; Erfahrung mit Teams, OneDrive oder SharePoint ist von Vorteil
  • Verlässlichkeit: Du bist bereit uns regelmäßig mit 5–8 Stunden pro Woche zu unterstützen

Was wir dir bieten

Sinn & Gemeinnutz

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Hilfe auf einem rechtlich sicheren Fundament steht – und damit dort ankommt, wo sie gebraucht wird.
  • Du arbeitest mit Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und gesellschaftlich etwas bewegen wollen.

Exklusives Netzwerk

  • Zugang zu einem wachsenden Netzwerk aus Wirtschaft, Politik, Wissenschaft und Non-Profit-Organisationen
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Bundesvorstand, Geschäftsführung und zentralen Entscheidungsträger:innen
  • Austausch mit Unternehmer:innen, Führungskräften und Expert:innen ganz unterschiedlicher Fachrichtungen

Gestaltung & Verantwortung

  • Du gestaltest Governance, Compliance und Strukturen eines modernen Sozialverbands von Anfang an mit
  • Viel Eigenverantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum und hohe Sichtbarkeit

Entwicklung & Referenz

  • Praxis in Vereinsrecht, Governance und Organisationsentwicklung einer bundesweit tätigen Organisation
  • Eine starke Referenz für deinen Lebenslauf und auf Wunsch ein qualifiziertes Ehrenamtszeugnis

So arbeiten wir zusammen

  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung, gut vereinbar mit deinem Hauptberuf – digital über Microsoft 365
  • Klare Absprachen: Aufgaben, Zeitumfang und feste Termine halten wir in einer kurzen Ehrenamtsvereinbarung fest
  • Gute Einarbeitung, eine feste Ansprechperson und eine Kennenlernphase von zwei bis drei Monaten

So meldest du dich – ganz unkompliziert

Du möchtest den DEHIB rechtlich und strukturell mit aufbauen? Dann schreib uns in drei, vier Sätzen, was du mitbringst und warum dich dieses Ehrenamt reizt. Danach lernen wir uns virtuell für 30 Minuten kennen und schauen gemeinsam, ob es passt.

Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As Staff Product Designer, you will own the end-to-end design of MEDvidi's AI Track, the core line of AI-powered clinical tools where providers interact with model outputs in a regulated healthcare environment. Your design decisions directly shape how clinicians review, accept, and correct AI-generated notes, treatment plans, and recommendations, impacting both provider efficiency and patient outcomes.

You will work closely with product managers and engineers, reporting to the Director of Product. This is a senior IC role with no direct reports: you drive product design from problem definition through delivery, gather requirements independently, and bring solutions to release. Your scope includes provider-facing tools (Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist), patient portal, and internal operational systems, all web-based.

Why this role

  • Zero-to-one in AI-first environment. You will shape new interaction patterns for agentic AI features: Chart Review, AI Scribe, AI Receptionist, where design quality directly affects clinical decisions.
  • Prototype in real code, not Figma mockups. Prototyping happens in Claude Code and Cursor on the actual codebase with production components. Your prototypes go straight to engineering without redrawing.
  • Co-own a design system built for humans and AI agents. You will evolve reusable components, tokens, and documentation that are readable by both your teammates and code-generation agents, a rare opportunity to define what design systems look like in an AI-native workflow.

Responsibilities

  • Own product design in your areas of the AI Track end-to-end: from defining the problem with the product manager, through user analysis, to working with engineers on the solution and accepting the build.
  • Design and iterate on human-AI interaction patterns: interfaces where providers verify, accept, edit, or reject model output and bring those patterns to a state where other teams can reuse them.
  • Ensure quality of design decisions: validate solutions with users when needed, perform design acceptance with engineering, analyze post-release results, and feed learnings back into the product.
  • Contribute to the design system within product initiatives: turn your solutions into reusable components in Storybook with tokens, naming, and documentation that are usable by both designers and AI code-generation agents.
  • Gather requirements independently: go to providers, medical operations, and product managers, identify problems, and bring back a proposal. There is no standing PM brief in AI Track, you shape the brief.
  • Accelerate design delivery using AI tools: build functional prototypes in Claude Code or Cursor on the real codebase with production components; prototypes go to engineering without redrawing.

This role is not for you if

  • You need a detailed brief before starting work. Requirements here are gathered by you, not handed to you, there is no PM or BA writing specs for AI Track.
  • You prefer managing people over hands-on design. This is an IC role with no direct reports; the impact comes from the quality of your own design decisions.
  • You design exclusively in Figma and hand off static specs. Prototyping at MEDvidi happens in code on the real codebase using AI agents, comfort with a code editor is a daily requirement, not a nice-to-have.

Requirements

  • 6+ years in product design, with a focus on complex work interfaces: EHR, admin panels, CRM, operational tools, or other systems where specialists perform their core work.
  • Demonstrable experience designing human-AI interaction: interfaces where users verify, accept, edit, or reject model output. Building a 0-to-1 agentic product is ideal; experience with review-and-approval interfaces for automated decisions also qualifies.
  • Hands-on prototyping in code using AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) on an existing component library or codebase, not just design tools.
  • Track record of contributing to a design system within product work: shipping reusable components, tokens, and documentation as part of feature delivery, not as a standalone project.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements independently, finding problems, talking to users and stakeholders, and driving a solution to release without waiting for a mandated brief.
  • Advanced English (B2+) and fluent Russian.
  • Availability to work within CET-compatible hours.

Would be a plus

  • Experience in healthcare or telemedicine products: understanding of HIPAA, clinical compliance constraints, and the provider's role in decision-making.
  • Experience leading a design team's transition to AI tools: setting up shared agent workflows, running workshops, driving adoption across peers.
  • Hands-on user research with specialist users: usability testing and interviews with doctors, nurses, or clinical operators (not only end consumers).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.

  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

jobs.description:
Job Description: Elastic Stack Engineer

(Search & Observability)

Role Overview

As an Elastic / Observability & Security Platform Engineer, you will lead the design,

implementation, monitoring and continuous improvement of our Elastic-based observability and security stack. You will take ownership of detection rules, watchers, ML-models, health monitoring of data streams, alerting frameworks, and tracking of data pipeline latency/integration times. You will work closely with data engineers, security operations, platform engineering, and business-units to ensure robust real-time monitoring, anomaly detection, alerting, and data integration observability.

Key Responsibilities

•

Architect, deploy, configure and optimise the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana,

Beats, Logstash, Elastic Machine Learning, Elastic Watcher/Alerting).

•

Develop and maintain JSON-based configuration files, logic and pipelines for

detection rules, watchers and alerting states.

•

Design, build and operationalise machine-learning jobs within Elastic ML (e.g.,

anomaly detection, forecasting, classification) for observability/security use-cases.

•

Monitor, maintain and improve the health and performance of data-streams (logs,

metrics, events, traces) ingesting into the Elastic cluster: ensure data freshness,

minimal latency, correct mapping, index lifecycle management (ILM), shard

management, and cluster health.

•

Implement and maintain alerting/notification frameworks: watchers/triggers, custom

alert-logic via JSON, integration with downstream systems (Slack, Teams,

PagerDuty, email, webhook).

•

Track and report on the integration time between upstream data sources and the

Elastic ingestion pipeline (i.e., latency from source → pipeline → index →

availability), diagnose and mitigate delays or bottlenecks.

•

Develop dashboards, visualisations and reports in Kibana to communicate KPIs,

SLAs (data-ingestion, alert-response, model accuracy), and to drive continuous

improvement.

•

Collaborate with data engineering, DevOps, security operations (SecOps), SRE and

business stakeholders to define requirements and deliver effective

observability/security solutions.

•

Establish best‐practices, standards and documentation for JSON rule-configs,

watchers, ML-jobs, dashboarding and monitoring.

•

Participate in incident-response processes: support triage, root-cause analysis and feed

learnings back into detection rules/ML jobs/monitoring.

•

Stay up-to-date and contribute to improving the Elastic ecosystem in our

environment: new features, upgrades, tuning, cost-optimisation, benchmark/scale

testing.

Required Skills & Experience

•

Strong hands-on experience with the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats,

Logstash or equivalent ingestion pipelines) – you should be comfortable deploying,

configuring and operating production Elastic clusters.

•

Proficiency in writing and using JSON configurations and logic for detection rules,

watchers, alerting frameworks, and monitoring pipelines.

•

Experience building and operationalising Elastic Machine Learning jobs (anomaly

detection, forecasting, classifications) and interpreting model output for

observability/security use-cases.

•

In-depth experience monitoring and maintaining the health of high-volume data

streams: log/metric/event/tracing data, with attention to data latency, ingestion

batching, pipeline failures, index lifecycle, and cluster resource optimisation.

•

Experience designing end-to-end alerting workflows (trigger logic, thresholds, multi-

condition rules, escalation, notification integration).

•

Experience tracking and measuring integration times (data latency from source

ingestion to availability in index/dashboards) and implementing improvements to

reduce that latency.

•

Strong scripting or programming ability (e.g., Python, Bash, or similar) to automate

tasks, integrations or alert-logic.

•

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: ability to diagnose

ingestion/pipeline/cluster issues, chain of events, root causes, and propose

mitigations.

•

Excellent communication skills: able to articulate detection logic, ML-model results,

data‐latency issues and dashboards to technical and non‐technical stakeholders.

•

Good understanding of DevOps/SRE practices (CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code,

Monitoring, Logging, Alerting).

•

Ability to document clearly: JSON rule setups, watchers, dashboards, models,

runbooks.

•

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent

experience; or equivalent relevant industry experience.

Desirable / Bonus Skills

•

Experience with elastic security (formerly SIEM) use‐cases using Elastic.

•

Experience with other observability/tracing stacks (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger,

Prometheus, Grafana) and integrating them into Elastic.

•

Knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience managing

Elastic clusters in cloud or hybrid deployments.

•

Experience with large scale index management, shard tuning, ILM policies, cluster

scaling, and cost optimisation.

•

Experience with advanced ML-techniques (unsupervised learning, time‐series

forecasting, advanced feature engineering) applied to observability/security.

•

Knowledge of security operations (SecOps) and detection use-cases: threat hunting,

anomaly detection, SOC workflows.

•

Familiarity with infrastructure instrumentation (logs, metrics, traces) and analysing

telemetry from microservices/distributed systems.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

Our Values

At Elemica, we believe that embodying our values is essential for all team members. These qualities show up in our interactions with each other, our clients, and our collective community:

  • Curiosity – we delight in the discovery of new challenges and feel compelled to solve them

Elemica is seeking a Director of Revenue Operations to improve the processes, reporting, and coordination that support our global sales organization. You will manage day-to-day sales operations, including forecasting, pipeline reporting, sales planning support, and incentive compensation administration. Working closely with Sales leadership, Finance, Human Resources, and Sales Enablement, you will help ensure our teams have reliable information, clear processes, and the operational support needed to execute effectively.


This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong analytical skills with attention-to-detail and consistent follow-through. You will bring structure to sales reviews, identify operational gaps, and help turn decisions into completed actions.


What You’ll Do

Forecasting and Sales Reviews

  • Manage the weekly forecasting cycle, including submission deadlines, data checks, consolidated reporting, and meeting preparation
  • Facilitate forecast and pipeline reviews with sales leaders, highlighting changes, risks, and actions requiring follow-up
  • Track forecast performance and investigate variances with the relevant sales teams

  • Document decisions and action items, follow up with owners, and escalate unresolved issues

Pipeline Management and CRM Discipline

  • Monitor pipeline coverage, opportunity progression, conversion rates, deal slippage, and sales-cycle length

  • Work with sales teams to keep opportunity values, close dates, next steps, and account information accurate
  • Identify gaps in pipeline data and support timely resolution
  • Provide analysis that helps sales leaders prioritize opportunities and address performance risks

Sales Reporting and Analysis

  • Maintain dashboards and reports covering bookings, pipeline, forecast performance, quota attainment, and sales productivity
  • Work with Finance to ensure consistent definitions and reconcile reporting discrepancies
  • Respond to sales performance questions with clear analysis and practical recommendations
  • Prepare accurate, timely reporting for commercial leadership
  • Coordinate renewal and expansion reporting with the relevant account owners and Client Service teams

Sales Planning Support

  • Support annual and in-year planning through analysis of territories, account coverage, sales capacity, and quota allocation
  • Maintain account and territory assignments and coordinate approved changes
  • Model productivity, ramp time, and coverage scenarios with Sales leadership and Finance
  • Track performance against approved plans and highlight emerging gaps
  • Document and communicate planning decisions to affected teams

Incentive Compensation Administration

  • Support the modeling of sales compensation plans under the direction of Sales leadership, Finance, and Human Resources
  • Maintain approved quotas, plan documentation, and sales-crediting records
  • Prepare and validate commission inputs with Finance and other relevant teams
  • Investigate compensation queries and route exceptions through the agreed approval process
  • Ensure approved plan changes are accurately documented and communicated

Sales Processes and Technology

  • Identify opportunities to simplify sales workflows and reduce administrative effort
  • Gather business requirements for Salesforce enhancements, reporting, and automation
  • Maintain process documentation and support consistent adoption across sales teams
  • Coordinate deal approval workflows with Sales, Finance, and Legal
  • Support accurate handoffs from Sales to implementation and Client Service

Enablement and Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales Enablement on training related to sales processes, reporting, and CRM use
  • Support new-hire onboarding through territory information, reporting access, and operational guidance
  • Provide data and operational support for sales kickoffs and other planning activities
  • Build effective relationships across regional sales teams and supporting functions
  • Manage competing requests transparently and prioritize work according to business needs

What You’ll Need

  • 7+ years of experience in Sales Operations or a closely related commercial operations role, preferably within enterprise B2B software or SaaS
  • Experience supporting international sales teams or working in supply chain technology, enterprise integration, manufacturing, or logistics is very highly preferred
  • Hands-on experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, reporting, and CRM data quality
  • Experience supporting sales planning and incentive compensation processes
  • Strong Salesforce reporting and dashboard skills, with the ability to translate business needs into clear system requirements
  • Advanced Excel or equivalent analytical skills; experience with business intelligence tools is an advantage
  • Understanding of enterprise sales cycles and recurring-revenue business models
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify and resolve data inconsistencies
  • The confidence to facilitate discussions with sales leaders, question incomplete information, and follow up on commitments
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage recurring deadlines alongside improvement projects
  • Clear communication skills and a practical, collaborative approach

What Success Looks Like

Expectations for the First 90 Days

  • Understand the sales structure, forecasting process, reporting requirements, and compensation workflows
  • Establish reliable delivery of recurring sales reports and forecast submissions
  • Identify and address priority pipeline and CRM data-quality issues
  • Implement clear action tracking for sales reviews
  • Agree a focused operational improvement plan with your manager and key stakeholders

Expectations for the First Year

  • More timely, reliable forecasts and sales reporting
  • Better pipeline visibility and more consistent CRM data
  • Accurate, well-documented compensation inputs and timely resolution of queries
  • Effective operational support for territory and quota planning
  • Reduced administrative friction through process improvements and automation
  • Consistent follow-through on actions agreed in sales reviews

Who We Are

Elemica is a leading provider of Digital Supply Chain Management solutions and the premier multi-enterprise collaboration network for global process manufacturing industries. Its portfolio of SaaS-based, network-powered digitization and visibility solutions automate critical information flows, enable multi-channel data strategies, and improve end-to-end supply chain performance. Elemica solutions connect many of the world’s largest manufacturers to their direct material suppliers, logistics service providers and end customers, helping them realize the promise of, and return on, their investments in supply chain digitization. Today, global leaders—including Arkema, BASF, Continental, Dow, Goodyear, Michelin, and Shell—use Elemica, driving over $1 trillion in commerce annually.


It is the responsibility of all Elemica employees to ensure the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of Elemica systems and data and the data of our customers. Using best practices in these areas, all Elemica employees will observe a ‘security first’ approach to their daily responsibilities. All employees are accountable for securing their work devices, work areas, and communications in the execution of their daily duties.


Our use of artificial intelligence in hiring

jobs.excerpt: Uno Platform est un framework moderne et open-source d’interface utilisateur qui permet aux développeurs de créer des applications performantes à base de code unique pour Windows, iOS, Android, macOS, Linux et WebAssembly, en utilisant C# et XAML.
jobs.description:
Uno Platform est un framework moderne et open-source d’interface utilisateur qui permet aux développeurs de créer des applications performantes à base de code unique pour Windows, iOS, Android, macOS, Linux et WebAssembly, en utilisant C# et XAML. Il facilite le développement multiplateforme rapide avec des performances natives, une intégration fluide à Visual Studio et un support des modèles de conception modernes. Grâce à des outils avancés et un support intégré pour l’intégration et le déploiement continus (CI/CD), Uno Platform est idéal pour les équipes souhaitant offrir des expériences utilisateur cohérentes et de haute qualité sur tous les appareils et plateformes.

Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons un développeur .NET alliant une expérience dans le développement multiplateforme, avec un fort intérêt pour l’engagement communautaire. Si vous avez travaillé avec WPF, Silverlight, UWP, WinUI, MAUI ou Xamarin, vous connaissez déjà les outils de base utilisés dans Uno et vous vous y sentirez comme chez vous !

Compétences techniques

  • Expérience .NET, C# et des technologies XAML, en particulier pour le développement d’applications multiplateformes.
  • Expérience en développement pour iOS, Android, WebAssembly, Windows, Linux et macOS est un atout
  • Une expérience avec React Native, Flutter ou Skia est un atout.
  • Concevoir, développer et maintenir des fonctionnalités et des bibliothèques au sein de l’écosystème Uno Platform.
  • Garantir le bon fonctionnement sur toutes les plateformes prises en charge.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les chefs de produit, designers et développeurs pour assurer une expérience utilisateur fluide.
  • Connaissance des systèmes de design et des outils comme Blend et Figma est un atout
  • Se tenir à jour sur les tendances du développement .NET et multiplateforme.
  • Maîtrise de l’anglais écrit et parlé pour la documentation, les démonstrations et le travail en équipe asynchrone.

Chez Uno Platform, nous offrons un travail 100 % à distance, avec un siège social basé fièrement à Montréal — vous offrant la flexibilité de travailler de n’importe où tout en restant connecté à une équipe dynamique et innovante.

Uno Platform is a modern, open-source UI framework that empowers developers to build performant, single-codebase applications for Windows, iOS, Android, macOS, Linux, and WebAssembly using C# and XAML. It enables rapid cross-platform development with native performance, seamless Visual Studio integration, and support for modern design patterns. With advanced tooling and built-in support for CI/CD, Uno Platform is ideal for teams looking to deliver consistent, high-quality user experiences across devices and platforms.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a .NET developer with cross-platform experience and a strong drive for community engagement. If you’ve worked with WPF, Silverlight, UWP, WinUI, MAUI or Xamarin, you already know the core tools used in Uno and will feel right at home!

Technical Skills

  • Knowledge of .NET, C#, and XAML technologies, especially for building cross-platform apps.
  • Experience developing for iOS, Android, WebAssembly, Windows, Linux, and macOS is a plus.
  • Experience with React Native, Flutter, or Skia is a plus.
  • Design, develop, and maintain features and libraries within the Uno Platform ecosystem.
  • Ensure smooth functionality across all supported platforms.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and developers to ensure seamless user experiences.
  • Knowledge of design systems and tools like Blend and Figma is a plus.
  • Stay current with trends in .NET and cross-platform development.
  • Clear written and spoken English for documentation, demos, and async teamwork.

At Uno Platform, we offer 100% remote work, with our headquarters proudly based in Montreal—giving you the flexibility to thrive from anywhere while staying connected to a vibrant, innovative team.

Your Opportunity

Graphic DesignerRemote

As Graphic Designer at Community Choice Financial® Family of Brands, you are a creative partner who brings strong visual judgment and execution to every project. You collaborate closely with the Creative Director and other designers, marketing partners, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to develop on-brand creative solutions for multiple brands including advertising, direct mail, in-store materials, email campaigns, digital advertising, social media, and other customer-facing communications. You will help ensure brand consistency, user-focused design, and high-quality execution while balancing customer needs, compliance requirements, and project timelines.

What We Offer

Benefits and Perks*

  • Uncapped Flexible Paid Time Off.
  • Paid on-the-job training and a comprehensive new hire program.
  • Access to a robust learning management system, full of e-learning modules to help boost your professional and personal development.
  • Performance-based career advancement.
  • Educational Reimbursement Program.
  • Multiple coverage choices for medical insurance, all include telemedicine and medical spending account options (HSA/FSA).
  • Traditional 401(k) and Roth 401(k) Retirement plan with a generous Company match program.
  • Company-Sponsored Life and AD&D Insurance.
  • Basic and Enhanced Voluntary benefits so you may choose the right coverage at the right price for you and your family. Plans include dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability plans, supplemental life and AD&D insurance, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, ID theft protection, legal services program, and pet insurance.
  • Free access to mental health resources, life coaching, and more for you and your family members through our Employee Assistance Program.
  • Free access to exclusive discounts from nationwide and local retailers through our Discount Marketplace.
  • A relaxed, business casual dress code that includes jeans and sneakers!

*Based on current benefit offering, which is subject to change with or without notice. Certain benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of the governing plan documents which should be consulted for additional details and eligibility requirements.

What You’ll Do - Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop concepts, mockups, and final creative assets for print and digital marketing initiatives that align with brand standards, campaign objectives, and customer experience goals.
  • Design and deliver creative assets for:
    • Print and digital advertising campaigns
    • In-store printed materials (e.g., posters, rack cards, signage)
    • Web assets, including hero banners, promotional graphics, and landing page visuals
    • Email and direct mail templates, layouts, and campaign imagery
  • Apply best practices in layout, typography, color theory, visual hierarchy, composition, and user-centered design principles.
  • Manage creative projects through all stages of development, from concept and design to implementation handoff and final delivery.
  • Preflight designs and prepare production ready files, ensuring accuracy, color consistency, and alignment with print and digital specifications.
  • Communicate directly with print and mail vendors to deliver final artwork, address technical requirements, and coordinate any variable data or specialty print needs.
  • Assist in tracking stock image usage and managing extended license needs.
  • Stay current on emerging design trends, technologies, tools, and best practices across print and digital channels
  • Subject Matter Expertise
    • Apply specialized graphic design, visual communication, and creative production expertise to assigned work
    • Stay current on design tools, standards, technologies, and industry best practices
    • Serve as a go to resource for creative questions
    • Provide informed recommendations regarding creative strategy, design execution, and production methods
  • Execution of Core Work
    • Execute tasks, projects, and deliverables across print and digital channels
    • Follow established creative, marketing, and brand processes while applying professional judgment
    • Meet deadlines and quality standards
    • Manage workload and competing priorities effectively
  • Quality & Accuracy Assurance
    • Ensure creative work meets brand guidelines, accuracy, compliance, and quality standards
    • Review deliverables for errors, inconsistencies, accessibility considerations, and production readiness
    • Uphold professional and organizational standards throughout the creative process
    • Maintain organized files, documentation, and project records
  • Problem Solving & Analysis
    • Analyze project requirements, campaign objectives, and customer needs
    • Identify design challenges, production issues, or process inefficiencies
    • Develop and implement practical, creative solutions
    • Escalate complex issues when appropriate
  • Collaboration & Cross-Team Support
    • Collaborate with stakeholders across teams or departments through concepts, design review and proofing processes, contributing to final sign-off before implementation
    • Provide creative input on cross functional initiatives and campaigns
    • Communicate project status, risks, recommendations, and design rationale clearly
    • Respond effectively to stakeholder requests aligned with business priorities
  • Process & Continuous Improvement
    • Identify inefficiencies, risks, or gaps in existing design processes
    • Recommend best practices that enhance quality, consistency, and speed to market while working to reduce costs
    • Participate in process improvement initiatives and testing efforts
    • Share insights and lessons learned with team members
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing
    • Assist in the creation, maintenance, and application of brand guidelines across multiple brands
    • Share expertise through training, mentoring, and collaborative feedback
    • Support onboarding of new team members
    • Document creative requirements, decisions, and project outcomes
  • Other duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For – Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Graphic Design, Advertising, Marketing, Fine Arts or a related field.
  • 2-4 years of relevant functional experience in Graphic Design, Advertising or related field.
  • A strong portfolio with a variety of samples is required.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma and Microsoft applications.
  • Have an understanding of visual design, digital layout, hierarchy, composition, illustration, typography, and color theory.
  • Innovative, creative, and strong critical problem-solving skills—ability to think outside the box.
  • Proven ability to maintain brand identity across all projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to complete work independently with limited supervision.
  • Consistent record of meeting deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Working knowledge of tools, systems, processes, or methodologies used in the role.
  • Ability to apply standard practices and procedures correctly.
  • Understanding of role‑specific policies, guidelines, or compliance requirements.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks and priorities independently.
  • Strong organizational and follow through skills.
  • Ownership of assigned work from start to completion.
  • Ability to handle non-routine issues within a defined scope.
  • Use of sound judgment to determine when to solve vs. escalate.
  • Basic analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • History of producing accurate, reliable work.
  • Awareness of downstream impacts of errors.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills

jobs.excerpt: About Terawatt InfrastructureThe once in a century transition to autonomous and electric vehicles is underway and will require a multi-trillion-dollar investment in energy and charging infrastructure, and the real estate to site it on.
jobs.description:
About Terawatt Infrastructure

The once in a century transition to autonomous and electric vehicles is underway and will require a multi-trillion-dollar investment in energy and charging infrastructure, and the real estate to site it on. Terawatt is the leader in delivering large scale, turnkey charging solutions for companies rapidly deploying AV and EV fleets. Whether it’s an urban mobility hub, or a carefully located multi-fleet hub for semi-trucks, Terawatt brings the talent, capabilities, and capital to create reliable, cost-effective solutions for customers on the leading edge of the transition to the next generation of transport.

With a growing portfolio of sites across the US in urban hubs and along key logistics and transportation corridors. Terawatt is building the permanent transportation and logistics infrastructure of tomorrow through a robust combination of capital, real estate, development, and site operations solutions. The company develops, finances, owns, and operates charging solutions that take the cost and complexity out of electrifying fleets.

Our Values

Six core values guide how we work: commitments we make to each other. Our pace is set by a simple conviction: imperfect action beats perfect inaction, so we move with purpose, adapt without ego, and measure ourselves by progress rather than activity. Ownership travels with autonomy. Your name is on the work, and the best answer wins the conversation, wherever it lives. That candor works because of what surrounds it: people who show up with intention and have each other's back, tough on ideas and generous with people. Our customers feel this as reliability earned daily, every interaction treated as a chance to build something lasting. And underneath it all is why the work matters. The climate doesn't wait, and the stakes are also human: behind every checklist and every inspection is a person going home safely. We call it "This work has a heartbeat” — it's what the other five rest on.

Our Technology

Terawatt is not a traditional infrastructure operator. Our technology platform transforms a portfolio of sites into a reliable, intelligent network — through advanced power management, operational optimization, and data-driven systems that back our customers with hard performance guarantees. That's what makes us a de-risked operator and a category-defining company.

We sit at a rare intersection: software, hardware, real estate, energy systems, and live site operations. The work is concrete and the stakes are real. The code you write today runs physical infrastructure tomorrow. You'll build systems that orchestrate megawatts of power across hundreds of chargers, ingest millions of telemetry events per day, and keep autonomous fleets, rideshare vehicles, and heavy-duty trucks moving — in real time.

Role Description

    Join Terawatt’s innovative technology team as a Staff DevOps Engineer and help drive the evolution of our platform to support one of the leading fleet EV charging solutions in North America. In this role, you will lead the development and reliability of Terawatt’s charging network management system and the capabilities that enable a high-quality site experience for customers.

    Working closely with the SVP of Technology, the Product team, and other technical partners, you will play a key role in expanding our platform and delivering meaningful value in a rapidly evolving industry. This role will help scale our cloud infrastructure and support organizational growth by implementing best practices that improve the reliability, performance, and maintainability of our charging infrastructure and software systems.

    You will also own the infrastructure behind Terawatt's internal tools and AI platform, partnering with our AI Product Manager and engineers to deploy, secure, observe, and scale agentic workflows across the company.

Core Responsibilities

  • Set technical direction for DevOps and platform engineering, mentor engineers, and champion infrastructure standards across the organization.

  • Lead planning for team goals that align with overall business goals and technology roadmap

  • Lead and architect the evolution of our cloud infrastructure using Terraform, building resilient and scalable systems to support business growth.

  • Maintain helm charts and deployment patterns that enable teams to manage the lifecycle of their services while adhering to established deployment standards.

  • Build tooling to enable engineering teams to own the application deployment process through CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions.

  • Drive security across every layer of the stack, using industry-standard tools to detect vulnerabilities and anomalies and automating SOC 2 compliance controls.

  • Extend security controls to AI and agentic systems, covering risks such as prompt injection, over-permissioned tool access, and sensitive data exposure.

  • Advance observability with OpenTelemetry and Grafana Cloud across services, infrastructure, and AI workloads.

  • Build developer tooling for local and remote container-based development, plus automated production-like scenarios for testing and release validation.

  • Build and operate infrastructure for ML and internal AI workloads, including compute for model training, hosting for agents and MCP servers, and least-privilege access to internal data.

  • Partner with the Data team on core data infrastructure, including our Databricks data lake and Kafka event streams (Aiven/AWS).

  • Contribute to building a highly available, web-based depot operations platform that supports the future of EV charging using NodeJS.

  • Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation and lead incident response and blameless postmortems.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years building and operating high-availability production systems, including leading DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering initiatives.

  • Deep experience with building and maintaining AWS, managed Kubernetes (EKS), and infrastructure as code (Terraform).

  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) and observability with tools such as OpenTelemetry and Grafana.

  • Experience leading SRE or DevOps initiatives supporting production cloud platforms.

  • Experience with managed databases such as PostgreSQL or MongoDB.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and infrastructure teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with multi-region AWS and EKS at scale

  • Experience operating LLM-based applications or agents in production, including monitoring, cost optimization, evaluations, and LLM-specific security controls.

  • Experience with data platforms such as Databricks or Kafka (MSK) or similar streaming/data platforms.

  • Proficiency in Python or NodeJS.

Compensation for this role is determined by several factors, including the cost of labor in specific geographic markets, and these ranges are intended to provide a helpful reference. The actual compensation offer will be based on the candidate’s location, skills, level of expertise and experience, and internal equity considerations. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package and, where applicable, performance-based incentives.
We are building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. At Terawatt, we continuously strive to foster inclusion, humility, energizing relationships, and belonging, and welcome new ideas. We're growing and want you to grow with us. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.excerpt: We’re building something powerful.  Let’s build it together.
jobs.description:
We’re building something powerful. Let’s build it together.
We've delivered high-performance embedded computing solutions for four decades across industries including defence, telecoms, and aerospace. We’re proud to be experts in what we do and are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our brilliant team.

The Role
The constant requirement for new, better, and more complex products means that the company requires an additional BIOS Engineer. The Software Engineering team is responsible for breathing life into our computer products by creating and maintaining the BIOS, and Board Support Packages (as well as additional software) required for their operation.

What will I be delivering?
Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, develop and maintain the UEFI BIOS and other bootloader software. Including integration of board-level hardware: PCIe, USB, Ethernet, I2C, GPIO, UART, and other common embedded interfaces.
  • You will be involved in end to end development as part of a small team.
  • Work with our hardware designers:
    • During the design phase to specify the product
    • During board bring up to get the prototype hardware working
    • During the design proving phase to validate the product
  • Work closely with the realisation team in defining test software plans.
  • Work on challenging customer issues that get escalated to engineering team.
  • Working with the hardware design authorities and software architect to support product specification.
  • Participate in security feature implementation.
The hardware and software platforms vary, but most of the devices used are complex and a good appreciation of the hardware is a pre-requisite for this role.

What do I need to bring with me?
Demonstrated knowledge and experience
  • Substantial experience developing UEFI BIOS, or related bootloader firmware based on EDK2, Slimboot or Intel FSP.
  • Proficient in Embedded C programming for x86, PowerPC, or high-performance ARM processors.
  • Practical experience programming a variety of hardware devices at the register level.
  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Familiarity with schematics and datasheets to support hardware bring-up and debugging.
  • Ability to apply a systematic approach to software debugging, ensuring thorough and efficient resolution of issues.
  • Ability to communicate in English and to work in an interdisciplinary engineering and project team.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multi-disciplinary engineering team.

What sort of people are we looking for?
  • You have fearless curiosity, embracing change as the catalyst for progress and performance.
  • You’re committed to the customer and delivering great service.
  • You are agile in the way that you work and are able to work at pace. You're always considering how to work smarter to go above and beyond for our customers.
  • You want to try new things, learn, and are not afraid to fail.
  • You love technology and are passionate about what we do.

Benefits for Working at Concurrent
  • 20 days’ vacation + 7 public holidays
  • 5 sick/personal days per year
  • Annual profit share bonus
  • Employee referral scheme
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Health insurance
  • Health Reimbursement Account
  • One paid volunteering day per year
  • Principal 401K Plan
  • YuLife wellbeing app

Work Eligibility
In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. To conform to U.S. Government export control regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or Department of Commerce.

Equal Opportunity Statement
We are an equal opportunity employer and believe in the power of a diverse, inclusive team. We welcome all applications from all suitably qualified people, regardless of race, sex, disability, religion / belief, sexual orientation or age.Please let us know if you require anything which would enable your success throughout our interview process.

Job Description

Join Us as a Senior Safety Specialist – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our expert team, you’ll have the opportunity to ensure operational excellence that makes a real difference in patient safety. As a Senior Safety Specialist, you'll perform and may oversee day-to-day Pharmacovigilance (PV) activities within a highly regulated environment driven by strict timelines. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the collection, monitoring, assessment, evaluation, research, and tracking of safety information. You will effectively collaborate with various parties such as project team members, client contacts, investigators, adverse event reporters, and third-party vendors.

What You’ll Do:

  • Works independently to perform day-to-day PV activities. May participate in on-call duties for specific projects to ensure 24-hr coverage for intake of cases from investigative sites.
    •Operates in a lead capacity. Provides assistance in the development of program and departmental procedural documents. May prepare for and attend audits. Mentors less experienced staff.
    •Reviews regulatory/pharmacovigilance publications and information sources to keep updated on current regulations, practices, procedures and proposals. Maintains medical understanding of applicable therapeutic area and disease states.
    •Reviews cases entered for quality, consistency and accuracy, including review of peer reports.
    •Responsible for routine project implementation and coordination (e.g., Clinical Trials, Endpoint Assessment Committee/Data Safety Monitoring Committee), including presentations at client/investigator meetings, and review of metrics and budget considerations

    Education and Experience Requirements:
    •Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
    •Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years).

    In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

    Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
    •Thorough understanding of pathophysiology and the disease process
    •Strong knowledge of relevant therapeutic areas as required for processing AEs
    •Excellent critical thinking and problem solving skills with ability to evaluate and escalate appropriately
    •Proficient at complex clinical study administration including budget activities and forecasting
    •Excellent oral and written communication skills including paraphrasing skills
    •Good command of English and ability to translate information into local language where required
    •Computer literate with the ability to work within multiple databases

Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. Ton rôle

Dans ce rôle, tu seras au cœur de l’expérience employé : c’est toi qui assures un support fiable, humain et efficace pour toute l’équipe de Workleap. Tu touches à une belle variété de demandes, de la gestion des accès et des outils SaaS à l’administration du parc informatique, et ton objectif reste simple : aider vite et bien.

Tu travailles main dans la main avec l’équipe sur les incidents et les projets ponctuels, en gardant tes priorités claires dans un environnement qui bouge vite, et c’est exactement ce qui rend le poste stimulant.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Enterprise Product team is responsible for bridging the gap between Stripe's core capabilities and the bespoke needs of the world's largest organizations. We are hiring product managers who will be aligned to specific priority industries (e.g., insurance, healthcare, public sector), with each product manager acting as the "CEO" of their assigned vertical—identifying high-leverage opportunities, building 0-to-1 products to solve industry-specific blockers, and influencing our global product roadmap. You will be a critical partner to GTM leadership (Sales, Partnerships, Marketing) and a navigator across the broader Product organization. We are looking for high-agency builders who thrive in ambiguity and know how to move mountains through both direct execution and cross-functional influence.

What you'll do

We're hiring a product manager to own Stripe's product strategy and execution across our priority industry verticals, starting with complex, regulated industries like insurance, healthcare, and public sector. We are seeking a highly-entrepreneurial, data-driven product leader who will define where Stripe plays, build 0-to-1 products to unlock new revenue, and influence Stripe's broader Product organization to meet the unique needs of enterprise customers in your vertical. The products you build will directly shape how the world's largest companies use Stripe—and how Stripe grows within one of its most strategic segments.

Responsibilities

  • Own the industry product roadmap—Define and execute the multi-year product strategy for your priority vertical. Translate your "where to play and how to win" thesis into a concrete roadmap—deciding what Stripe builds natively, what we solve through platform extensibility, and where we partner. Own measurable outcomes tied to revenue, adoption, and merchant satisfaction.
  • Ship 0→1 products—Identify unmet needs through deep customer research, data analysis, and market intelligence. Lead the full product lifecycle for industry-relevant functionality—from problem definition and technical scoping with engineering, through PRD, API and UX design, build, launch, and post-launch iteration. You'll make hands-on trade-off decisions about scope, technical approach, and sequencing with your engineering team.
  • Be a strategic partner to GTM and customers—Work deeply with our largest customers, partners, and GTM teams. Translate "market noise" into clear product signal—shaping feature requirements, and defining the data models and integration patterns that enterprise customers in your vertical need.
  • Act as a force multiplier across Stripe's platform—Influence Stripe's core product teams (Payments, Billing, Connect, and beyond) to ensure their roadmaps reflect the requirements of enterprise customers in your vertical. To do this credibly, you'll need to go deep on Stripe's platform—understanding our APIs, infrastructure constraints, and extensibility model—so you can advocate for changes with technical specificity, not just business cases.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping successful products in complex, regulated environments.
  • Technical fluency—You don't need to write code, but you're comfortable reading an API spec, reasoning about system design trade-offs, and holding your own in engineering discussions. You've shipped products where the "how we build it" mattered as much as the "what."
  • Deep customer obsession—A talent for getting close to customers—talking to merchants and partners—and distilling complex pain points into simple, elegant product requirements.
  • Analytical rigor—You use data—not just intuition—to prioritize. You're comfortable defining metrics frameworks, digging into usage data, and making quantitative arguments for (or against) product investments.
  • A master communicator—Stripe is a writing-heavy culture. You must be able to articulate deep technical and strategic concepts through precise, persuasive prose—your narrative docs are things of beauty.
  • High agency and influence—Adept at finding "homes" for initiatives, building consensus across disparate teams, and driving momentum without needing formal authority.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and bias for action—Comfortable with ambiguity, skilled at prioritizing high-impact initiatives, and experienced operating with limited resources to unlock outsized outcomes.

Preferred qualifications

  • Direct experience building products in Healthtech, Insurtech, Public Sector, or similarly complex, regulated industries.
  • Experience building platform, API, or developer-facing products.
  • Experience working closely with Enterprise Sales teams and C-suite stakeholders at Fortune 500 companies.

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US.

What you will do

  • Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on.
  • Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off.
  • Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive.
  • Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers.
  • Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed.
  • Be our customer to engineering. Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done.
  • Cut bugs reaching learners. Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend.

Requirements

Must have

  • End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch.
  • Solid mid-level coding. Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests.
  • English for requirements work. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions.

Nice to have

  • Leading engineers. Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation.
  • EdTech and content validation. LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness.
  • Automation and data stack. Claude Code, MCP, n8n or Make; SQL and dashboards.

What we can offer you

  • Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
  • Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration
  • Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

As a Sr. Solutions Architect on the team supporting the strategic Digital Natives Business (DNB) customers, you will shape the future of the Data & AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated data engineering and data science teams in the world.

Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with customers, product teams, and the broader customer-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform and APIs. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.

The impact you will have:

  • You will partner with the sales team and provide technical leadership to help customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems.
  • Lead technical discovery and design architectures, implement proof of concepts for strategic projects spanning data engineering, data science and machine learning, and SQL analysis workflows. You will also help customers build solutions that integrate with cloud services, home grown tools, and other 3rd party applications.
  • Act as strategic technical advisor to customers to help them drive business outcomes.
  • Collaborate with your fellow Solutions Architects, using your skills to support each other and our users.
  • Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks inspired open-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Omnigent) across the developer community.

What we look for:

  • 7+ years in a data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or similar pre-sales/consulting role
  • Experience building distributed data systems
  • Comfortable programming in and debugging Python and SQL
  • Have built solutions with public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Expertise in one of the following:
    • Data Engineering technologies (Ex: Spark, Hadoop, Kafka)
    • Data Science and Machine Learning technologies (Ex: pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Tensorflow)
  • Available to travel to customers in your region
  • [Desired] Degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research)
  • Nice to have: Databricks Certification
  • Location: Remote (Pacific Time preferred; Mountain Time considered).

NOTE: If your experience isn’t a perfect match for the job description, but you feel like you’re a good fit for the role, apply. We want to work with smart, passionate, people who are good at their job, and, a lot of times, those people have non-linear career paths.

Pay Range Transparency

Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here.

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

jobs.excerpt: About UsAt #paid, we’re on a mission to empower creators to do what they love—create.
jobs.description:
About Us

At #paid, we’re on a mission to empower creators to do what they love—create. Our marketplace connects vetted creators with some of the world’s most iconic brands, like McDonald’s, Samsung, and Disney, fostering authentic collaborations that drive real business results. We’ve built a marketplace that solves big challenges in the creator ecosystem, from fair pricing to algorithmic matching and content usage rights, ensuring every partnership is seamless and impactful.
With our proprietary technology and an unwavering commitment to trust and transparency, we’re revolutionizing the way brands and creators come together to make magic. Rated #1 for customer support and managed services, #paid is leading the creator marketing space. Through innovative technology and a team of ambitious humans, we're transforming the future of the creator economy.

The Role

As a Senior Client Success Manager covering our Key Accounts, you’ll be a trusted strategic advisor and operational expert for some of our most valuable brand partners. This role blends high-touch campaign execution (inclusive of Creator Management) with relationship-based account and client management.
You’ll lead complex creator marketing programs from start to finish while nurturing long-term relationships with enterprise-level clients. You will not only ensure campaigns align with client objectives but also collaborate with the Client Partners on account renewal and growth.
You’ll partner cross-functionally with teams like Product, Sales, Media, Analytics, and Strategy to drive exceptional outcomes, retain and grow key accounts, and shape how #paid works with its largest customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee and execute campaigns for larger, strategic accounts with enterprise-level complexity
  • Daily tasks include: running program kick-off calls, finalizing program briefs, building creator rosters, contracting creators, scheduling content creation and posts, tracking performance, and leading post-campaign reviews
  • Build and maintain strong relationships across multiple client stakeholders and departments, acting as a strategic advisor to internal initiatives and broader marketing objectives
  • In partnership with sales leads you will identify, qualify, and pursue upsell and expansion opportunities across your book of business (100% existing clients)
  • Own and drive client happiness through: fast response times to inquiries, maintaining professionalism in all interactions, and ownership of individual NPS scores
  • Understand and consult on internal client processes, pain points, and bottlenecks to align #paid's approach to their strategic priorities
  • Manage multiple programs simultaneously with periods of varying workload and complexity
  • Proactively identify process inefficiencies and knowledge gaps, collaborating with peers and your Team Manager to implement improvements
  • Partner closely with cross-functional internal stakeholders to ensure timely delivery, feedback resolution, and continuous improvement
  • Collaborate with Sales on customer growth and expansion by providing insights, surfacing opportunities, and presenting value-based solutions
  • Maintain accurate records in Salesforce and other internal systems to track account health, campaign details, and revenue opportunities

To be successful, you'll need to

  • Execute campaigns with minimal oversight, resolving issues and meeting or exceeding client objectives
  • Develop and present data-driven recommendations to support account growth and retention
  • Address client concerns proactively, leveraging data and internal experts as needed
  • Seamlessly manage creator relationships and campaigns to deliver operational excellence
  • Consistently meet and exceed KPIs across satisfaction, retention, and revenue metrics
  • Be flexible and available for in-person meetings as needed, whether for internal events or key customer meetings

About you

  • You’re client-obsessed and driven to go above and beyond to keep clients happy
  • You create meaningful relationships and deeply understand client campaign goals and broader business objectives
  • You’re confident in communicating with senior stakeholders, from Influencer Marketing Managers to CMOs
  • You bring a commercial mindset, able to balance execution with long-term account growth and strategic thinking
  • You’re detail-oriented, organized, and thrive in managing multiple complex accounts at once
  • You’re data-driven, using insights to tell compelling stories and guide decisions
  • You’re a strong collaborator who shares learnings, best practices, and resources with your team
  • You have a growth mindset and consistently seek feedback for self-improvement
  • You have experience in digital and creator marketing and a strong understanding of social media platforms
  • You have at least 5 years of experience in a client-facing role, ideally with key or enterprise-level accounts
  • You’ve owned commercial targets such as revenue retention, upsell quotas, or account growth goals
  • Experience working with enterprise-level clients in agency, or creator tech is highly preferred

Why #paid

  • We are a group of passionate and thoughtful people working together to fundamentally change the way brands are built while empowering creators to make a living doing what they love
  • We are growing quickly! Plus, #paid is the highest-rated platform on the popular G2 Crowd software review website
  • We have all the fun perks you’d expect—flexible vacation policy, competitive vision, dental and health benefits, team offsites and working hubs, and socials (yes, even remotely!)
  • We invest in our team members, with L&D budgets and RRSP/401K Matching Programs
  • We are proud of our culture and care about it deeply—we live by our team values and are always trying to make #paid a better company today than it was yesterday
  • We empower learning through meaningful career progression and the autonomy to test new ideas

Equal Employment Opportunity

#paid is an equal opportunity employer and as such, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.
