jobs.excerpt: Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era.
jobs.description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google, meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Minimum qualifications

  • 5 years of experience in technical enablement, GTM operations, RevOps, or AI content management in a B2B SaaS environment.
  • Experience building, configuring, or managing enterprise AI chatbots, agentic workflows, or AI-driven knowledge platforms.
  • Experience with prompt engineering and LLM behavior.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools (e.g., Zapier, Make) and connecting disparate systems via APIs to build content feedback loops.
  • Experience managing cross-functional programs, juggling multiple priorities simultaneously, and delivering against tight deadlines.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a cybersecurity environment.
  • Deep understanding of GTM motions, sales enablement best practices, and content lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with modern sales enablement platforms and CMS architecture.
  • Ability to use analytics to measure tool adoption, improve program outcomes, and prove ROI on AI initiatives.
  • Strong ability to navigate ambiguity, experiment with bleeding-edge technology, and rapidly shift priorities.

Responsibilities

  • Develop the strategy and infrastructure to power GTM content for our enterprise AI chatbot platform, transforming static content into dynamic, on-demand enablement.
  • Design, build, and deploy customized AI "skills" that leverage our internal content repository to surface hyper-relevant, just-in-time enablement materials and deal-specific insights for Account Executives (AEs).
  • Architect prompt frameworks and AI workflows that automatically generate customer-facing assets, meeting prep materials, and competitive talk tracks based on real-time deal context.
  • Build and maintain agentic workflows that proactively ping content owners, automate feedback loops, and flag outdated materials to ensure all source data remains governed, accurate, and consistently fresh for AI ingestion.
  • Develop a robust GTM content framework, optimizing taxonomy, tagging, and metadata specifically for AI searchability and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to identify content gaps and align AI-driven deliverables to business priorities, including new product introductions, onboarding, and strategic campaigns.
  • Build and manage the GTM content calendar to seamlessly align with sales cycles and product marketing campaigns, while leading end-to-end content programs.
  • Optimize the discoverability and usability of content within our AI search experiences and broader enablement tech stack.
  • Collaborate with the data and analytics team to measure the effectiveness of AI skills and generated assets (e.g., usage, deal impact, time-saved), and continuously refine prompt architecture based on field feedback.
  • Provide regular enablement communications, highlighting new AI capabilities, automated workflows, and high-value content.
  • Ensure all content meets brand, messaging, and compliance standards before being integrated into our AI ecosystem.

Compensation + Benefits

Compensation for this full-time position includes base salary + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. At Formula5, we’re a Microsoft Partner with a focus on Data and AI, Security,Identity, andCloud Automation. You will be responsible for building and maintaining close relationships with Microsoft Sellers, shaping joint opportunities, building offerings,and guiding customers through their Microsoft Fabric journey – from early discovery through deal closure and handover to delivery.

Fabric Services Growth

Client Engagement & Executive Presence

  • Facilitate workshops, solution briefings, and executive sessions-translating customer goals into a Fabric roadmap and services plan.

Solution & Services Commercialization

  • Drive demand generation with Microsoft and internal teams (campaigns, events, enablement) and help customers access Microsoft programs/funding where applicable.

Personal Traits

  • Strong ownership mindset with accountability for outcomes.

  • Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset focused on customer success.

jobs.excerpt: Dentro de nuestro servicio a los clientes, creamos una posición de Consultor de integración y asistencia para encargarse del desarrollo de proyectos y apoyo a los clientes de nuestros servicios y soluciones financieras a empresas.
jobs.description:
Dentro de nuestro servicio a los clientes, creamos una posición de Consultor de integración y asistencia para encargarse del desarrollo de proyectos y apoyo a los clientes de nuestros servicios y soluciones financieras a empresas. En un entorno internacional, tendrás el foco en el mercado español.

Después de una formación completa sobre nuestros productos y con el apoyo continuo de nuestros equipos, apoyaras en el desarrollo de nuestros proyectos y apoyaras a nuestros clientes en las plataformas de deuda, riesgo de tipo de cambio y garantias.

Tu objetivo principal será dar apoyo al equipo de consultoría y poco a poco ir consiguiendo independencia a la hora de dar respuesta a las solicitudes de asistencia de nuestros clientes, contando con el apoyo de nuestro back office en Casablanca. También formaras parte del equipo de integración de los nuevos proyectos que vayan formalizándose, colaborando y asegurando un correcto desarrollo de los mismos

Misiones principales :

  • Asistir a los clientes existentes en sus consultas
  • Apoyar en la ejecución de nuevos proyectos
  • Hacer de enlace entre los clientes y el backoffice para asegurar el correcto desarrollo de la actividad
  • Apoyo en la ejecución de nuevos proyectos, formando parte de un equipo de integración y teniendo contacto con el cliente
  • Acudir a reuniones con potenciales clientes para mostrar las soluciones
  • Dar información acerca de la actividad de los clientes de cara a sus renovaciones

Estudiante en sus últimos años de estudios superiores relacionados con economía, disponible para practicas curriculares.

Interesado en la digitalización e innovación, aunando un espíritu financiero y tecnológico.

Dominio del español e Ingles. Un buen nivel en francés sería una ventaja.

Buscas un trabajo en equipo con objetivos individuales y eres capaz de actuar con facilidad en las relaciones sociales. Calidades de organización y atención son imprescindibles, tanto como el gusto del servicio al cliente y del resultado.

Te proponemos un entorno estimulante y dinámico, que sabe reconocer el espíritu de empresa y la participación de sus empleados asociándoles a proyectos ambiciosos y ofreciéndoles posibilidades de evolución en España e internacionalmente.

• Contrato: Beca

• Categoría: Becario

• Duracion: 6 meses

• Disponibilidad : inmediata

  • Remuneración : según perfil y experiencia
  • Residencia en Madrid con potenciales desplazamientos (Carne de Conducir ventaja)

Creada en el año 2000, Finance Active suministra servicios tecnológicos y financieros de gestión de la deuda, del riesgo de cambio, de las inversiones, de la prospectiva financiera y garantías bancarias a los responsables financieros. La doble propuesta de Finance Active combina plataformas Web constantemente conectadas con la información financiera y un acompañamiento personalizado.

Con oficinas en Francia, Alemania, Benelux, Italia, Reino Unido y Suiza, y una oficina de delegación en España, Finance Active se impuso como líder de los servicios tecnológicos y financieros. Únete a una empresa innovadora, ambiciosa y responsable.

Datos claves: más de 13.000 usuarios en más de 20 países en el mundo, 96% de tasa de fidelización de nuestros clientes, 25M€ de cifra de ventas, más de 170 colaboradores, más de 25% de las ventas invertidas en investigación y desarrollo.

Actualmente, Finance Active forma parte del grupo Altus, que es una compañía canadiense especializada en software financiero, concretamente en productos enfocados a empresas de Real Estate. Sin embargo, este foco se ha expandido con la adquisición de varias empresas de software europeas, ampliando su horizonte y ofreciendo un portfolio de servicios más diversificado.

Cotizada en la bolsa canadiense, el grupo Altus es un referente del sector Real Estate a nivel mundial, especialmente en los mercados americano y canadiense, pero cada vez con más presencia en el mercado europeo.

Encuentra más información en: www.financeactive.com y altusgroup.com

jobs.description:
Trax Inc. provides cloud-based solutions and services to automate and manage freight invoice auditing and payment processing for buyers and sellers of logistics services. The Trax platform enables companies to optimize supply chain performance through greater visibility into their logistics ecosystem and predictive analytics based on over one billion logistics transactions from all industries, modes, and countries. Trax operates on a global scale with offices in the U.S., Latin America, Asia and Europe. 

The Logistics Data Analyst will execute Trax’s audit process to resolve exceptions for client accounts globally. They will collaborate with carriers and customers to ensure high-quality service, prioritize tasks, and achieve customer metric targets and service level agreements. Additionally, they will lead reconciliation meetings and audit reviews.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute Trax’s comprehensive audit process to identify and resolve audit exceptions for client accounts across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.

jobs.excerpt: Join Our Team – Contractors or Employees Welcome | Remote Across Europe We’re on the lookout for talented AWS Cloud Engineers and Architects at all levels to join our growing team.
jobs.description:
Join Our Team – Contractors or Employees Welcome | Remote Across Europe

We’re on the lookout for talented AWS Cloud Engineers and Architects at all levels to join our growing team. Whether you're an experienced Senior Engineer or have 2+ years in the field, this is your opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking company where innovation drives our success and shapes the future of cloud technology.

Who we are

We’re a professional services company with a difference!

We work as a 100% remote team, engineering cutting-edge, transformational technology solutions that deliver rapid business results for our clients. Our core expertise lies in serverless architecture and implementation, cloud migration, and modernisation of critical business systems. While many prefer to build complex solutions from scratch, we excel at simplifying complex problems and delivering simple, effective solutions.

As a certified AWS Consulting Partner, we bring advanced cloud expertise to every project.

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!

What will you do

As an AWS Cloud Engineer/Architect, you’ll play a pivotal role within our team, specialising in designing, building and implementing cloud solutions, creating and optimising cloud infrastructure, developing software applications, integrating systems, and defining architecture best practices. In collaboration with both our team at fourTheorem and our clients, you'll contribute to crafting solutions that tackle complex business challenges. Your expertise will be instrumental in shaping and empowering our clients' teams by providing valuable guidance and knowledge. Tasks include:

  • Architect and design scalable, secure, and highly available cloud solutions on AWS, using best practices in DevOps and cloud-native design.
  • Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like CloudFormation or Terraform to enable efficient and consistent deployments.
  • Work collaboratively with fourTheorem colleagues and our customers to understand business goals, incrementally deliver new technology to meet those goals, reduce complexity and demonstrate the impact of our approach.
  • Automate the deployment, configuration, and management of infrastructure and services using CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitHub Actions.
  • Collaborate with development and operations teams to define and implement strategies for monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Amazon CloudWatch or third-party solutions.
  • Optimise applications for cost, performance, and security and work with clients on best practices for infrastructure, data, and application deployment.
  • Mentor and guide teams on AWS architecture patterns, DevOps methodologies, and operational best practices.
  • Evaluate and integrate third-party tools and services into applications to enhance automation, performance, and security.

What will you bring

  • 2+ years of experience building and/or architecting distributed applications on AWS.
  • Software development skills with a focus on cloud applications.
  • An understanding of the benefits and drawbacks of any approach, with the ability to make trade-offs to ensure that a solution is right for the customer.
  • Strong proficiency in AWS services such as ECS, Lambda, EC2, API Gateway, IAM, or S3.
  • Hands-on experience with automation and IaC tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
  • Proficiency in building and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or AWS CloudWatch.
  • Proven ability to architect solutions that meet business and technical requirements while balancing performance, scalability, and cost.
  • Communication skills, with a focus on listening and understanding first, but also presenting high-level solutions and implementation details to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Our aim is not to intimidate our customers or colleagues by the un-necessary use of jargon - translating complex technology into plain english understandable by all is our main goal.

Looking for the right fit, not just a checklist

We believe in finding the right fit, not just ticking boxes. While we’re looking for the experience above, we also value the unique skills and experiences you bring. If you're passionate about cloud technology, eager to learn, and ready to make an impact, we encourage you to apply. We're flexible and open to making trade-offs to find the right fit for you and the team.

Some of what we offer

Fully Remote: No office, no commute, no problem!

Flexible Hours: We trust you to manage your time - flex your schedule to fit your life.

Annual Leave: 25 days annual leave, in addition to public holidays.

Team Meet Ups: Meet the crew four times a year.

Macbook: Relax - your MacBook is taken care of.

Co-working Allowance: Need a change of scenery? We’ll chip in for your co-working spot.

A culture of respect, collaboration, and inclusion

We respect and value learning at all stages of your career. We believe in listening to ideas from everyone, regardless of experience, and fostering a culture of collaboration. We prioritise team performance over individual contribution, supporting each other and stepping outside the "lane" of any given role to get the job done.

We’re building a team where everyone’s welcome, no matter your background, identity, or how you show up in the world. We believe in respect, fairness, and giving everyone a real shot to grow, thrive, and do great work together.

If you require any reasonable accommodations during the hiring process, please reach out via email to

If you enjoy being part of a collaborative, creative team that is not afraid to challenge others or be challenged, you’ll be a great fit here!

WHY WE NEED YOU? GLAD YOU ASKED...

We are looking for a Strategic Account Executive to lead commercial growth across a designated portfolio of our high-value customer accounts.

At our core, we help organizations transform weather and environmental uncertainty into a predictive operational and commercial advantage. This role is central to that mission. You will deepen executive relationships, expand the use of our platform across the enterprise, and help customers embed weather-driven intelligence into critical decisions across operations, supply chain, infrastructure, merchandising, and customer engagement.

This is not a traditional account management or renewal role. It is a strategic growth role focused on account expansion, stakeholder orchestration, and complex solution selling. You will work within a high-performance account pod alongside Solutions Engineering and technical executive leadership, forming a commercial and technical team built to solve complex customer challenges and drive long-term value.

Together, you will engage senior technology and business leaders, uncover operational and data challenges, and position our platform as essential infrastructure for organizations that need to anticipate disruption, improve resilience, and act on real-time weather and environmental insight.

Location: Remote (Canada/US), with travel required to key customers within your territory.

Please note, despite being a remote role, it requires you to be located in and be eligible to work in the US (United States of America) OR Canada and occasional travel to client locations within North America.

WHAT DOES THE DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE

  • Own and grow a strategic portfolio: Lead the commercial strategy for a portfolio of key accounts, protecting recurring revenue while delivering aggressive net growth and expansion against your territory baseline.

  • Elevate weather into executive priorities: Engage senior technology and business leaders - including CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, and VPs across Infrastructure, Supply Chain, Merchandising, Marketing, and Operations - to position weather and environmental intelligence as a core driver of resilience, forecasting, and competitive advantage.

  • Drive enterprise-wide expansion: Lead complex, multi-threaded sales motions that expand usage beyond individual teams and transform localized use cases into enterprise-wide, cross-functional partnerships.

  • Sell strategic solutions, not products: Lead consultative sales cycles across cloud-native platforms, modern data architecture, risk mitigation, workflow automation, and operational decision support, connecting our solutions directly to measurable business outcomes.

  • Translate weather data into business value: Help customers understand how real-time and predictive weather insights can improve planning, reduce disruption, strengthen asset protection, optimize inventory and staffing, and support faster, smarter decision-making.

  • Lead post-sale commercial ownership: Partner closely with Account Executives during transition and onboarding, then assume full commercial ownership of the customer relationship, identifying and capturing expansion opportunities from year one onward.

  • Orchestrate your account pod: Work cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing to maximize adoption, accelerate ROI, and develop compelling customer success stories.

  • Run disciplined account strategy: Maintain rigorous visibility into pipeline, account health, stakeholder maps, opportunity progression, and technical environments, ensuring each account is mapped across decision-makers, business priorities, and technology ecosystems.

WE ARE HOPING YOU HAVE

  • Experienced enterprise seller: 5-10+ years of B2B sales experience with a strong record of success in strategic account growth, revenue retention, and expansion within complex mid-market or enterprise environments.

  • Fluent in platforms and data: Experience selling SaaS, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, analytics, or technical solutions into complex organizations. Familiarity with cloud ecosystems and marketplaces such as Snowflake, GCP, and Azure is strongly preferred.

  • Understands high-impact data use cases: You know how to sell solutions tied to operational performance, risk reduction, and strategic planning. Experience with geospatial, GIS, environmental, climate, or meteorological data is a strong advantage.

  • Strong solution seller: Proven ability to navigate long sales cycles, engage multiple stakeholders, uncover technical and business pain points, and convert them into high-value commercial outcomes.

  • Executive relationship builder: Strong presence with senior buyers and the ability to build trust, influence priorities, and lead value-based conversations at the C-suite and VP level.

  • Highly collaborative: Comfortable working in close partnership with Solutions Engineers, Architects, Product leaders, and Customer Success teams to shape tailored solutions and articulate measurable ROI.

  • Curious and commercially sharp: Deep interest in modern SaaS, cloud ecosystems, secure data sharing, workflow automation, and the growing role of predictive intelligence in enterprise decision-making.

WHY JOIN US

  • Sell a strategic mission: Help leading organizations move from reacting to weather-related disruption to using weather intelligence as a predictive advantage across the enterprise.

  • Focused, high-value sales model: Be part of a specialized go-to-market structure designed to remove generalist distractions and let you focus on strategic growth within high-impact accounts.

  • Deep technical partnership: Work alongside an elite technical pod that helps solve complex data, integration, and compliance challenges while strengthening customer outcomes.

  • Shape the future of our platform: Play a foundational role in helping customers move off legacy, siloed environments and adopt a modern, real-time platform for weather, climate, and environmental intelligence.

jobs.title: General Counsel
jobs.excerpt: AE Studio is a ~160-person, fully bootstrapped applied AI company.
jobs.description:
AE Studio is a ~160-person, fully bootstrapped applied AI company. We've spent over a decade building and shipping production AI for clients in finance, defense, aviation, healthcare, and education, including generating millions per week in additional revenue for a major airline and building the AI-enabled school of the future, where students are performing in the top 1% nationally. Without outside investors we are able to choose where the money goes, and we put it into alignment research through the AI Alignment Foundation, a nonprofit we founded to scale this work.

We're running a DARPA seedling on alignment and control, our policy team engages directly with the government on AI alignment, and our work has been featured many times in the Wall Street Journal. We collaborate with researchers at Anthropic, Princeton University, University College London, Redwood Research, and MATS. The research team is 25 people and growing.

About this role

We need our first in-house lawyer. Demand and our own expansion have outpaced what we can handle today: research grants closing, government and national-security work opening up, university and lab partnerships forming, and a shift toward outcome-based commercial work. All of it carries real legal weight and business urgency, and today it sits largely on the founders' shoulders, backed by excellent outside counsel.

You'd start by learning what already works here and helping scale it, then improving and adapting it as new opportunities arise. The timing is the real opportunity: we're 10 years in, established and growing fast, and right at the start of a major inflection point. You'd be here during a step change.

What you'll work on

A handful of things are happening at once, and the legal side of each is the core of the role.

  • We're shifting the commercial business toward outcome-based and productized work. That moves delivery ownership to us, meaning stronger margins and tighter focus on outcomes; you'd shape these deal terms.
  • Major research grants are coming in to fund our foundational AI Alignment work, and you'd help us win them and put them to work.
  • Government agencies, research labs, and universities are coming to us to collaborate. These partnerships are often first-of-their-kind, and you'd help shape them.
  • Our government work is expanding fast, opening a category of contracts and programs that are new ground for us and full of upside.

Intellectual property runs through all of it, and there's real opportunity in how we own, license, protect, and publish it. Underneath sit the steady in-house workstreams: NDAs and vendor agreements, employment, corporate governance, and the processes that let legal scale.

About you

We're after a strong generalist more than a specialist: solid fundamentals, judgment from real experience, and the ability to pick up new areas fast and get good at them. Day to day you'd work alongside executives, making the key calls and scaling the function.

Specifically, someone with:

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Role Title: Senior ML Engineer (MSc. or PhD)

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contract (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible-you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

Required Skills:

  • Machine Learning

We are looking for highly skilled Machine Learning Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving model development, training and inference systems, numerical computing, performance optimization, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging machine-learning engineering tasks. A representative task may require implementing or modifying a model, constructing a reproducible training or inference workflow, optimizing memory or throughput, debugging numerical or system-level failures, and verifying that the resulting implementation satisfies objective correctness and performance requirements.

Required Qualifications:

  • A master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.

  • Strong professional or research experience in machine learning.

  • Practical proficiency with Python and coding agents.

Equivalent tools may also be considered when the candidate demonstrates directly relevant depth.

Experience at a well-established technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or other recognized engineering environment is strongly preferred. Exceptional open-source or academic experience may also qualify.

Process:

  • Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

  • Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply.

Typically, roles are filled within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

What You’ll Be Doing - the day to day

  • Design, deploy, and maintain cloud and hybrid network infrastructure across environments.

  • Troubleshoot complex network issues methodically, communicate findings clearly, and document resolution paths that the whole team can learn from
  • Identify gaps and improvements proactively, bring forward recommendations with context, and follow through on the work
  • Support a culture of continuous improvement, not through dramatic overhauls, but through consistent, deliberate progress

  • A growth mindset: you measure yourself not against perfection but against where you were last quarter

How you work

At ESO, the strongest signal of a great engineer is not what they know on day one, it is how they approach learning, collaboration, and accountability over time. We are looking for someone who:

  • Asks the questions that move conversations from stuck to forward
  • Takes ownership without needing to own everything alone

Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth.   • Lead sandbox lifecycle management, deployment strategies, and version control using enterprise Gearset Pipelines to enforce rigorous testing protocols and release hygiene.

Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

Position Overview:

Connor Consulting is a fast-growing, modern, international company comprised of top-caliber professionals. This role sits within the Software Publisher Services (SPS) line of business and is dedicated to a single, high-volume compliance program delivered on behalf of a global enterprise software publisher.

This is a platform-led program rather than a traditional audit role. Licensees complete their own compliance review through a dedicated audit platform, and the Program Associate drives that process end to end. You will own a large portfolio of engagements over the course of the year, with a large number active at any given time, and you will be accountable for getting each one started, unstuck, and closed. The work is high-cadence and relationship-driven: daily outreach, structured follow-up, clear escalation, and disciplined tracking. It is a strong fit for someone from a compliance, audit support, renewals or customer success background who is energized by volume, ownership, and consistent execution.

This is also a build role. The program is expanding, and the person who establishes the operating rhythm in the US will be positioned to add supporting staff and grow into a Manager role.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own an assigned portfolio of active compliance engagements and drive each one from initial outreach through closure against defined cycle-time and service level targets.
  • Conduct daily outreach and structured follow-up with licensee contacts by email and phone, maintaining persistent and professional contact cadences on unresponsive accounts and applying defined escalation triggers.
  • Onboard licensees onto the audit platform: explain the process and timeline, direct them to the platform, walk them through the required inputs, and resolve access or usability issues that stall completion.
  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for licensee questions, objections, and concerns; handle pushback diplomatically and escalate contractual, disputed, or legal matters to the Senior Manager.
  • Lead the verification call with the licensee to confirm and clarify the data submitted through the platform.
  • Identify licensees unwilling or unable to use the platform and coordinate the exception path to a standard, manually executed review with the engagement team.
  • Review submissions for completeness and obvious anomalies, apply the program’s standardized methodology and templates, and prepare findings for Senior Manager review.
  • Maintain complete and accurate account status, contact history, and next actions in Connor’s engagement platform as the single system of record for the program.
  • Produce recurring program reporting for the client and internal leadership, including pipeline by stage, aging, response and completion rates, and results to date.
  • Monitor throughput, flag bottlenecks and recurring licensee objections, and recommend improvements to outreach templates, platform guidance, and process documentation.
  • Support the onboarding and day-to-day direction of additional program staff as the program scales.
  • Other duties may be assigned without notice.
  • Senior Associate: Carry a larger portfolio, own the most sensitive or highest-value accounts, quality review the work of supporting staff, and act as backup program lead.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • BA/BS in Business Administration, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
  • 2+ years in software license compliance, contract or audit compliance support, customer success, account management, renewals, inside sales, or a comparable high-volume client-facing role.
  • Exposure to software licensing concepts and contract terms. Prior license compliance or software asset management experience is preferred but not required; the ability to learn a publisher’s licensing model quickly is essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing a high volume of concurrent accounts or cases without loss of accuracy or follow-through.
  • Comfort working from a repeatable playbook: applying the same process consistently across hundreds of accounts while recognizing the exceptions that require escalation.
  • Fluency with CRM, ticketing, or case management platforms (for example Salesforce, HubSpot, Monday.com, or Zendesk) and a track record of disciplined data hygiene.
  • Proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite with solid Excel skills including lookups and pivot tables. Advanced modeling is not required.
  • Excellent written communication, with the ability to maintain a consistent and professional tone across a high volume of outbound correspondence.
  • Confident verbal communication and the ability to lead a call with a licensee’s technical, procurement, or finance contacts.
  • Professional persistence: comfortable following up repeatedly with unresponsive contacts and navigating resistance without escalating tension.
  • Self-directed, organized, and reliable with minimal day-to-day supervision.
  • Based in and available to work United States business hours, with occasional flexibility for licensees in other regions.
  • Minimal travel expected, up to 10%.

Preferred Additional Experience

  • Prior experience on a publisher-side or Big 4 software license compliance team.
  • Experience supporting customers through a self-service or customer-completed data collection platform.
  • Familiarity with common software deployment and usage data sources.
  • Second language capability (Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, or Polish) in view of planned EMEA expansion.

Competencies and Skills

  • Ownership mentality; treats the assigned portfolio as a book of business to be advanced every day
  • Consistency and follow-through
  • Resilience in the face of non-response, delay, and pushback
  • Strong organization and prioritization across many small, simultaneous commitments
  • Clear and concise communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Sound judgment about when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate
  • Collaborative and professional demeanor with clients, licensees, and internal teams
  • Genuine interest in process improvement and in building something repeatable and scalable

Measures of Success

  • First 30 days: Program mechanics and licensing model learned, platform fluency established, outreach templates in use, and the full portfolio loaded and accurate in the engagement platform.
  • First 60 days: Daily outreach cadence running consistently, the first cohort of licensees onboarded to the platform and submitting data, and program reporting delivered on schedule.
  • First 90 days and beyond: Consistent throughput against agreed volume and cycle-time targets, exception and escalation paths operating cleanly, and documented improvements to the program playbook.

Working Conditions

  • Remote role in the US, aligned to United States time zones
  • Sustained periods of computer and telephone-based work with a high volume of daily contacts
  • Occasional flexibility to work varied schedules to accommodate licensees in other time zones
  • Minimal travel; occasional mobility within office and client site environments

Join our Finance Division as an International Record to Report Manager to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every code line we write and every interface we design is another opportunity for us to enrich our customers’ experiences.

The R2R Manager owns the record-to-report process across our international entities and leads the team that delivers it. The role makes sure the books close accurately and on time, that technical accounting positions are sound and documented, and that audits, statutory accounts and controls run smoothly.

Some of the other responsibilities include :

  • Fully qualified accountant (CIMA, ACCA, ACA or equivalent such as CPA).

  • Strong controls experience (SOX preferred).
  • Experience managing external audit to tight deadlines.
  • Proven people leader with remote teams across several locations.
  • Strong analytical skills, and clear written and verbal communication, including technical memos.

Desirable

  • Hands-on experience with acquisition accounting, impairment testing and revenue recognition.

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

  • Say it straight
  • Win together

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

As a Technical Owner you’ll own every technical decision behind our programs, from the first conversation with a course author to the bug that never reaches a learner. This is a technical partner role, not a coding job: you weigh each decision against cost, time to learner, and bugs shipped, and you lead one engineer who writes autotests. The role is fully remote and full-time, for candidates based outside the US.

What you will do

  • Own each program’s technical setup. Know its environments, services, providers, and autotests, and keep a written map of what each program depends on.
  • Shape new and updated programs. Collect requirements from authors and constraints from product, test the options, and land on a workable trade-off.
  • Replace what no longer fits. Find, cost, and run the switch when a tool, provider, or setup is outdated or too expensive.
  • Manage providers. Compare offers, negotiate terms, and own integrations with external providers.
  • Lead autotest coverage. Set coverage and priorities for the autotest engineer, and write or fix tests yourself when needed.
  • Be our customer to engineering. Write specs with acceptance criteria for automation, API, and platform needs, and chase each one to done.
  • Cut bugs reaching learners. Trace each bug to where it entered, close the gap with a test, check, or process change, and track the trend.

Requirements

Must have

  • End-to-end technical ownership. 3+ years in engineering, QA automation, or technical operations, including choosing a product’s setup and living with the trade-off after launch.
  • Solid mid-level coding. Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, Git, CI, containers, and REST APIs: enough to read unfamiliar code, fix bugs, and write autotests.
  • English for requirements work. Strong enough to run requirements sessions and write specs engineering teams accept without a round of questions.

Nice to have

  • Leading engineers. Leading or mentoring at least one engineer, ideally in test automation.
  • EdTech and content validation. LMS or autograded courses, QA or release work, or agents that check content for accuracy and freshness.

What we can offer you

About TNT Growth

TNT Growth is a performance-driven growth marketing agency that embeds directly into our clients' businesses to produce measurable outcomes across paid media, creative strategy, and analytics. We drive impact!

About the Role

We are looking for a senior Conversion Tracking & API Engineer who can independently own complex, production-grade tracking across browser, server, CRM, and ad-platform APIs. You combine deep backend and data-integration expertise with a practical understanding of paid-media measurement and strong client-facing communication.

This is not a tag-only or passive back-end role. You will work directly with Growth Managers, Client Success, client engineering teams, and external platforms. You will own the path from consented browser and session capture through forms and CRM lifecycle events, event processing, ad-platform delivery, diagnostics, reconciliation, and monitoring. If you can build reliable systems, prove that they work end to end, and explain them clearly to non-engineers, this role was designed for you.

What You'll Do

  • Strong Communication
    • Proactively flagging implementation gaps, risks, and unverified assumptions before a campaign goes live — and separating confirmed root cause from a working hypothesis
    • Writing implementation and QA summaries that a Growth Manager without an engineering background can read, understand, and act on
    • Responding to questions in Slack within a reasonable window during working hours
    • Asking a clarifying question rather than building the wrong thing for two days
  • Conversion Tracking Architecture & Identity
    Design, build, and maintain client-side and server-side conversion tracking across Meta Pixel/CAPI, Google Ads API and Data Manager API, Enhanced Conversions and offline uploads, TikTok Events API, and other major platforms. Own signal design, event taxonomy, account and action routing, timestamps, value and currency, attribution windows, and accuracy from landing page to ad platform.
  • CRM Integration & Event Pipeline Management
    Build and maintain integrations among client sites and forms, CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho, call-tracking and scheduling tools, TNT infrastructure, and ad-platform APIs. Use webhooks, change data capture, OAuth, and queues to deliver events with validation, idempotency, retries and backoff, dead-letter handling, replay and backfill, and a complete audit trail.
  • Browser, Identity & Cross-Domain Instrumentation
    Implement and debug GTM, server-side GTM, Google tag and GA4, platform pixels, deterministic dataLayer events, first-party session IDs and cookies, URL propagation, and form injection across redirects, subdomains, SPAs, embedded forms, and booking tools. Preserve and validate GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, FBCLID, FBP, FBC, TTCLID, MSCLKID, UTMs, and consent state through the funnel.
  • Ad-Platform API & Payload Engineering
    Build platform-correct payloads and matching logic: normalize and hash permitted identifiers exactly once, send consent signals, pair browser and server events with stable event or order IDs, prevent double counting, handle adjustments and redactions, diagnose partial acceptance and attribution-window failures, and improve match quality using platform diagnostics.
  • End-to-End QA, Reconciliation & Production Operations
    Create synthetic tests that follow the real user journey from landing page through CRM and queue to the ad-platform UI. Reconcile source, database, CRM, internal reporting, and platform counts; monitor match quality, attribution lag, and delivery failures; produce evidence, alerts, runbooks, and incident updates; and verify fixes after launch.
  • TypeScript Development
    Write clean, well-tested TypeScript across the stack, including API clients, webhook handlers, and event workers. Own engineering quality through automated tests, code review, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Data Layer & Database Work
    Design and operate PostgreSQL schemas for attribution sessions, identities, conversion events, attempts, and delivery status. Write diagnostic SQL, optimize queries and indexes, plan retention, and trace data from ingestion through reporting without exposing sensitive data.
  • AI-Assisted Development & Tooling
    Use AI systems (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and others) as force multipliers for debugging, code generation, documentation, and pattern recognition. Validate generated work and never trade tracking correctness, security, or maintainability for speed.
  • Cross-Functional Communication & Ownership
    Communicate clearly and proactively with Growth Managers, Client Success, client engineers, and platform support. Translate root cause, risk, evidence, dependencies, and ETA into updates non-engineers can act on. Own incidents through verification and follow-up, not just code deployment. Create reusable standards, runbooks, and guidance that raise the capability of the broader team.
  • Version Control & Collaboration
    Own your work in Git. Strong branching strategy, meaningful commit history, clean PRs, and collaborative review habits. You treat version control as a professional practice, not a formality.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Senior-level, hands-on production experience with complex conversion tracking across Meta Pixel/CAPI and Google Ads API or Data Manager API, including Enhanced Conversions and offline conversions; additional TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft Ads, or Reddit CAPI experience is strongly preferred
  • Hands-on browser and server-side instrumentation with GTM, server-side GTM or equivalent, Google tag and GA4, deterministic dataLayer events, SPAs, redirects, cross-domain and subdomain flows, embedded forms, and booking tools
  • Expertise in attribution identity and matchback: GCLID, GBRAID, WBRAID, FBCLID, FBP, FBC, TTCLID, MSCLKID, first-party session IDs, cookies or URL propagation, consent state, and CRM persistence
  • Deep knowledge of ad-platform payload semantics, including event names, action source, account and action IDs, value and currency, timestamps and time zones, stable event or order IDs, browser and server deduplication, attribution windows, conversion adjustments or redactions, and partial-acceptance diagnostics
  • Experience mapping CRM objects and lifecycle stages and integrating systems such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Attio, GoHighLevel, Typeform, or call-tracking platforms through webhooks, change data capture, and APIs
  • Demonstrated ability to prove delivery end to end with synthetic tests, platform diagnostics, source, CRM, database, internal-reporting, and ad-platform reconciliation, match-quality monitoring, alerting, incident response, and written QA evidence
  • Experience implementing consent-aware tracking and privacy controls under GDPR, CCPA, and ad-platform policies, including permitted PII collection, normalization and hashing exactly once, data minimization, and sensitive-category restrictions
  • Strong understanding of API client design, REST and webhook integrations, OAuth and secrets handling, change data capture, rate limits, partial failures, and inter-service communication patterns
  • Direct production experience with message queues (RabbitMQ, BullMQ, SQS, or similar), including idempotency, deduplication, retries and backoff, dead-letter handling, replay, and high-volume backfills
  • Proficient in TypeScript — clean, typed, testable, and maintainable across API clients, services, and asynchronous workers
  • Strong PostgreSQL and ORM fundamentals (Prisma, TypeORM, or equivalent), including diagnostic SQL, schema design, query and index optimization, and data retention
  • Strong working knowledge of paid-media measurement: funnel and lifecycle event design, primary and secondary conversions, values, attribution windows, match quality, platform learning-volume tradeoffs, and channel differences across Meta, Google, TikTok, and related platforms
  • Strong Git skills — branching, PR workflows, code review participation, and version control discipline
  • Practical fluency with AI development tools and the judgment to validate their output; AI expertise is secondary to conversion tracking, API, and backend engineering depth
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, including client-facing technical discovery, implementation documentation, incident updates, and evidence-based explanations

Compensation

This is a non-US, long-term contract role.

  • Non-US Salary Range: $40k-$80k (Based on Location and Skillset)
  • 12 Paid Holidays and 18 Paid Days Off

You will collaborate with a highly specialized team of statisticians, health economists, and researchers on global projects supporting evidence generation, comparative effectiveness research, health technology assessment (HTA), and decision-making for pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients.

About You

Experienced Quantitative Researcher: You have a background in statistics, biostatistics, epidemiology, health economics, data science, or a related quantitative discipline, along with experience applying statistical methods in healthcare, life sciences, or outcomes research.

Evidence Synthesis and Statistical Methods Experience: You have experience planning, conducting, and reporting analyses that support evidence synthesis and comparative effectiveness research. You can critically assess clinical evidence, evaluate methodological assumptions, identify evidence gaps, and apply appropriate analytical methods to address complex research questions. Experience with indirect treatment comparison methodologies and analyses involving aggregate and/or individual patient-level data is desirable.

Technical Proficiency: You demonstrate strong statistical programming skills, particularly in R, and experience developing reproducible analytical workflows. You are comfortable working with complex datasets and applying a range of statistical methodologies appropriate to the research question.

Deliverable Creation: You contribute to client-ready deliverables including analysis plans, technical reports, presentations, manuscripts, and conference materials, and can communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver statistical analyses supporting evidence generation, comparative effectiveness research, and healthcare decision-making projects.
  • Design and implement fit-for-purpose analytical approaches that address client objectives and research questions.
  • Conduct statistical analyses and develop reproducible analytical workflows using R.
  • Lead analytical workstreams and contribute to project planning, delivery, and quality assurance activities.
  • Interpret and communicate complex analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support HTA, reimbursement, market access, and Joint Clinical Assessment evidence-generation activities.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to methodological best practices.
  • Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, proposals, and thought leadership activities.

Required Experience and Competencies

  • Master's degree or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Health Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Approximately 4 years or more of relevant professional experience.
  • Strong R programming skills and experience conducting statistical analyses.
  • Experience applying statistical methods to healthcare, outcomes research, evidence generation, or related research areas.
  • Experience with evidence synthesis and comparative effectiveness research.
  • Strong analytical reasoning and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly and effectively.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Helpful Experience and Competencies

  • Knowledge of indirect treatment comparison methodologies such as network meta-analysis (NMA), matching-adjusted indirect comparison (MAIC), simulated treatment comparison (STC), or similar approaches.
  • Experience with external control arm (ECA) analyses
  • Experience with survival analysis, time-to-event modelling, or utility and health-related quality of life analyses.
  • Experience working with individual patient leveldata.
  • Understanding of Bayesian and/or frequentist statistical methods.
  • Experience supporting HTA, reimbursement, market access, or evidence-generation activities.
  • Familiarity with Python, or other programming languages.
  • Experience contributing to scientific publications or conference presentations.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)

  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend

  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced, detail-oriented Virtual Medical Assistants to support a growing U.S.-based pulmonary specialty practice operating across three clinic locations.

This role combines front-desk patient communication with back-office medical records management. The ideal candidate is comfortable managing high volumes of incoming calls, coordinating patient requests, processing medical records, and working closely with an established clinical team.

You will help streamline daily clinic operations while ensuring patients receive prompt, professional, and compassionate assistance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Patient Communication & Call Management

  • Answer high-volume inbound patient calls, address general inquiries, confirm appointments, and direct requests to appropriate clinic personnel.

  • Triage incoming calls, emails, and AthenaHealth EMR messages, ensuring accurate documentation and timely routing to designated staff.

  • Coordinate with the bilingual Virtual Medical Assistant to assist Spanish-speaking patients through live call transfers or scheduled callbacks.

2. Medical Records & Administrative Support

  • Process medical records requests from insurance companies, referring providers, and patients accurately and within required timelines.

  • Coordinate with the in-house billing team to organize, track, and complete medical records requests while maintaining HIPAA compliance.

  • Assist with other clinical administrative workflows, including referrals, insurance verification, and prior authorizations, as assigned during future workflow expansion.

3. Team Collaboration & Workflow Management

  • Collaborate with clinic supervisors, billing personnel, and fellow Virtual Medical Assistants to ensure smooth communication across multiple locations.

  • Provide backup inbound call coverage during peak hours while balancing assigned medical records and administrative responsibilities.

  • Maintain accurate EMR documentation and contribute to developing standard operating procedures (SOPs) for consistent and efficient workflows.

Minimum Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of experience as a Virtual Medical Assistant supporting U.S.-based healthcare practices in similar clinical administrative functions.

  • Hands-on experience in patient communication, inbound call handling, medical records processing, or related medical administrative workflows.

  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills, with a professional, empathetic, and patient-centered approach.

  • Familiarity with U.S. healthcare workflows, medical terminology, patient confidentiality, and HIPAA requirements.

  • Ability to multitask, prioritize time-sensitive requests, and work independently in a high-volume remote healthcare environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using AthenaHealth EMR for patient messaging, clinical documentation, or administrative workflows.

  • Previous experience supporting pulmonology practices or other U.S. specialty outpatient clinics.

  • Experience coordinating with billing departments, clinic supervisors, and remote healthcare teams.

Technical & Work-From-Home Requirements

  • Computer or laptop with at least an Intel Core i5 processor or equivalent/higher.

  • Reliable high-speed primary internet connection with a dedicated backup internet source.

  • Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or reliable backup power solution.

  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for handling confidential patient information and inbound calls.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is dependable, proactive, highly organized, and confident communicating with patients over the phone. You should be comfortable transitioning between live patient calls and back-office administrative responsibilities while maintaining accuracy, professionalism, and a strong commitment to patient service.

Responsibilities & Qualifications

Clean sheet development and maintenance of legacy PHP based applications is in your wheelhouse.

You will also be involved with the co-creation of project plans and pre-sales activities (information architecture, estimates, scope, schedule, risks, etc.).

Your keen insight into data consumption, manipulation, and presentation will be tested. A passion for problem solving and self governance is a necessity.

It is important to understand that maintenance is a large part of our business, which means building software but also maintaining it over time.

Also, because of our clients we tend towards conservative development approaches instead of bleeding edge. This means managing aging projects, as well as upgrading them to the latest best practices.

As with all of our projects, we pride ourselves on our customer service on all levels. Constant, clear communication in both good and challenging times keeps our customers active for many years.

Education & Experience

jobs.description:
About Us

Snif is setting the new standard in fine fragrance. The search for high-quality scented products should be simple, accessible, and fun. We bring our customers what they want to smell and develop new, unexpected ways for them to incorporate fine fragrance into their daily routines.
Every scent we develop is designed to be an immersive experience. From the name, packaging design, and creative campaigns to someone’s first spray, we want them to see and smell the quality behind every release. Our formulas are always made with top-shelf ingredients and are genderless, non-toxic, vegan, and cruelty-free.
Snif and its sub-brands are sold on our DTC site . Select products can also be found at Ulta Beauty and on Amazon. We’ve been featured across notable press outlets including Forbes, Fast Co., WWD, Vogue, Allure, Cosmopolitan, NY Mag, Harper’s Bazaar, and more. Additionally, we’re backed by some of the most revered investors in the consumer goods space.
We’re a lean team that’s expanding quickly, and we’re looking for someone who believes in our vision to shift the way people experience scents.

The Role:

As Retail Operations Manager, you will own how our retail orders move from receipt through fulfillment, delivery, and invoicing as we expand our distribution. Success means orders are processed accurately, shipment and invoice requirements are met, and exceptions are resolved early enough to protect retailer commitments.

You will be Snif’s primary owner for retail order execution, responsible for keeping each order moving, resolving operational exceptions within agreed guidelines and escalating inventory allocation, commercial, or spending decisions that require approval. You will work closely with Sales, Procurement and Inventory, Finance, and our manufacturing and fulfillment partners to make sure requirements are clear and commitments are met.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. When inventory is short, an EDI document is rejected, or a shipment is at risk, you will identify the issue early, bring the right partners together, and drive it to resolution.

As Snif expands its retail distribution, you will help shape the processes, reporting, and tools the business relies on, working directly with the VP of Operations to improve how we serve our retail partners.

This role will report directly to the VP of Operations.

While we are based in New York City, we operate as a remote team. This job may require travel ~10-20% of the time depending on business needs.

What You'll Do:

    Order Management and Inventory Coordination
  • Own daily order management across our retail channels, including Ulta, Ulta International, Amazon, and future distribution expansion
  • Validate incoming purchase orders against approved item data, pricing, quantities, inventory availability, and delivery requirements; resolve discrepancies before confirming orders
  • Partner with Procurement and Inventory to identify shortages, execute agreed fulfillment priorities, and communicate risks with recommended actions
    • Fulfillment and Retailer Requirements
  • Coordinate with fulfillment providers to meet retailer requirements for order confirmation, routing, labeling, shipping documentation, pickup, and delivery
  • Monitor EDI transactions and retailer portals, resolve missing or rejected documents, and verify that required order, shipment, and invoice information has been successfully received
    • Invoicing and Chargebacks
  • Prepare and submit accurate invoices, reconcile ordered, shipped, and invoiced quantities, and partner with Finance to resolve discrepancies and deductions
  • Investigate operational chargebacks, prepare dispute documentation, track deadlines, and address recurring causes
    • Retail Launch Readiness
  • Own retail order-execution readiness for new retailer and item launches, including operational data checks, test orders, documented workflows, and clear handoffs with Commercialization, Sales, Procurement and Inventory, and fulfillment partners
    • Reporting and Process Improvement
    • Maintain accurate order records and reporting by retailer and distribution center, with clear deadlines, shipment status, exceptions, and next actions
    • Improve procedures, service reporting, and backup coverage; simplify or automate repetitive work and verify that changes improve accuracy and reliability

What You'll Bring:

    • 3+ years of relevant experience in wholesale order management, retail operations, or customer operations within a consumer products business
    • Experience personally managing national retailer orders from receipt through delivery and invoicing, including resolving exceptions across internal teams and fulfillment partners
    • Experience supporting multiple distribution centers and meeting retailer routing and compliance requirements
    • Hands-on experience monitoring EDI transactions, diagnosing operational errors, and working with providers to resolve them
    • Experience working directly with third-party warehouses and transportation partners on fulfillment and delivery issues
    • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including reconciling order, inventory, shipment, and invoice data
    • Sound judgment when priorities compete, with the ability to explain risks, recommend actions, and recognize when a decision requires approval
    • Clear communication, careful attention to detail, and consistent follow-through
    • Examples of improving an operating process, with a clear explanation of your contribution and the resulting change in accuracy, service, or manual effort

Bonus Points:

  • Experience in beauty, fragrance, personal care, or home products
  • Familiarity with OpenText, ShipIQ, Partners Online, or comparable retailer systems; experience improving workflows through ERP systems or automation
  • Proficiency in LLMs (e.g., Claude, GPT)
  • Experience supporting new retailer launches or managing Amazon fulfillment alongside national wholesale accounts

What You'll Get

  • Be part of a fast-growing company with an awesome mission
  • Highly competitive salary and equity so you’re a part of the Snif family
  • An opportunity for growth and ability to widen your role and responsibilities
  • Medical, Dental and Vision healthcare insurance
  • 401K Retirement Plan with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible vacation and PTO policy
  • Industry-leading well-being and mental-health benefits
  • Virtual and remote work as well as work-from-home setup
  • Snif product on us!
