Position Overview

The Senior Project Manager independently leads complex projects and engagements across multiple workstreams, stakeholder groups, vendors, and delivery dependencies. This role integrates scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, governance, and change into a coherent delivery approach, using sound judgment to navigate ambiguity, manage tradeoffs, and maintain momentum when plans or assumptions change.

The role anticipates delivery risks, facilitates difficult tradeoff and recovery discussions, and gives senior stakeholders clear, decision-ready recommendations. It also mentors project managers and strengthens governance and delivery discipline while remaining focused on assigned projects rather than assuming ownership of a broader program or account portfolio.

Location: Remote – United States

Key ResponsibilitiesComplex Project Delivery
  • Independently own delivery of complex projects and engagements with minimal oversight, aligning delivery activities to intended client outcomes.
  • Build and maintain integrated plans across workstreams, milestones, teams, vendors, and dependencies; coordinate cross-functional contributors through ambiguity and changing priorities.
  • Apply sound judgment to scope, schedule, budget, quality, resource, commercial, and delivery-recovery tradeoffs as conditions change.
  • Protect quality, acceptance criteria, operational readiness, team health, and delivery commitments throughout the project lifecycle.
Risk, Governance & Stakeholder Leadership
  • Anticipate risks and constraints, develop contingency and recovery plans, and escalate material issues with clear analysis and recommendations.
  • Lead complex governance forums and stakeholder discussions; communicate delivery health, options, impacts, decisions, and required actions clearly.
  • Manage project financials, forecasts, change requests, resource needs, commitments, and delivery variances with the appropriate business and delivery partners.
Adobe Platform & Cross-Team Coordination
  • Coordinate technical delivery across relevant Adobe Experience Cloud platforms and integrations, aligning workstreams, data flows, environments, and deployment dependencies.
  • Work effectively with technical and business teams across platform implementations, integrations, migrations, and environment promotion from development and QA through staging and production.
Team Development & Continuous Improvement
  • Mentor Associate Project Managers and Project Managers through coaching, plan reviews, and practical delivery guidance.
  • Strengthen project standards, reusable practices, reporting, and lessons learned within the assigned delivery area

Required Skills & ExperienceProject Leadership & Delivery
  • 4–8 years of relevant professional experience, or equivalent practical experience, managing projects or engagements.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex projects with multiple workstreams, stakeholder groups, dependencies, vendors, or significant delivery risk.
  • Strong command of integrated project planning, scope and change control, scheduling, budgeting, resource coordination, quality, governance, and delivery reporting.
  • Sound judgment in resolving competing priorities and recommending scope, schedule, budget, resource, or recovery tradeoffs.
  • Experience anticipating delivery risks, creating mitigation or recovery plans, and escalating material decisions with actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to manage project financials, forecasts, commitments, change requests, and delivery variances in partnership with relevant teams.
Stakeholder & Team Collaboration
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, including leading complex stakeholder forums and presenting decision-ready options to senior audiences.
  • Ability to coordinate cross-functional client and internal teams through ambiguity, shifting priorities, and changing delivery conditions.
  • Experience coaching or mentoring less experienced project delivery practitioners and reinforcing consistent project discipline.
Adobe & Technical Delivery Context

  • Understanding of technical integration dependencies, data flows, multi-environment delivery, and release or deployment coordination across development, QA, staging, and production.
  • Experience with Agile, scaled Agile, or CI/CD-enabled delivery models and complex cross-team integration efforts.

Preferred Qualifications / Experience

  • Experience leading Adobe platform implementations, migrations, or integrations involving multiple technical and business workstreams.
  • Experience improving project governance, reporting, reusable delivery practices, or lessons-learned processes.

Role Expectations

  • Operate independently on complex work with minimal oversight, using strong judgment to solve problems and improve delivery outcomes.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to the success and delivery discipline of the broader project team.
  • Travel up to 30% as project and client needs require.

Join Our PhD in Nursing Faculty Team (Remote, Part-Time)

We are seeking experienced nurse scholars to teach and mentor doctoral students in our fully online PhD in Nursing program. As Walden grows, we continue its tradition of quality. The School of Nursing seeks faculty for the PhD program. Share your professional experience and academic knowledge with students across the country and around the world. With a computer and a high-speed Internet connection, you can work on your own schedule while supporting other professional and personal commitments.

Training:

All new Faculty Members receive specific training from Walden University in the techniques of teaching, use of an electronic learning platform, dissertation management technologies, specifics of the policies, procedures and degree programs of the School or College in which they are going to teach, socialization into the Walden University culture, assessment of academic integrity of student work (including use of www.turnitin.com), and research supervision of dissertations.

Qualifications and Faculty Expectations:

Candidates must hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in nursing and an earned PhD or doctoral degree (preferably in Nursing or a closely related field) from an accredited institution. An active, current, and unrestricted RN license in one of the 50 U.S. states is required, and faculty must maintain all appropriate credentials and licensure throughout their appointment.

Successful candidates will demonstrate a strong record of scholarships, including research, publication, committee service, and academic advisement. Preferred areas of expertise include nursing theory, research methods, leadership, nursing education, and population health. A distinguished record of peer-reviewed publications and externally funded research is highly valued. Faculty are expected to remain current in their discipline through ongoing engagement with research, scholarship, and professional activities, and may publish work acknowledging the university when appropriate.

A minimum of one year of online teaching experienceat the master’s (MSN) or doctoral level is preferred. Experience mentoring doctoral students and serving on dissertation committees is expected. Candidates must demonstrate a strong commitment to student learning and development, with excellent communication, collaboration, emotional intelligence, organizational, data management, and student-centered teaching skills.

Faculty are responsible for teaching assigned courses using the Canvas learning management system and actively engaging with students in the online classroom environment. Faculty are expected to log into their courses a minimum of four days per week and respond to student inquiries within 48 hours. All participation and feedback must align with established faculty guidelines, the handbook, and academic standards.

Faculty members are expected to use online technologies effectively to deliver substantive, thoughtful, and timely instruction and feedback in a respectful, professional learning environment. Performance will be evaluated based on fulfillment of essential duties and adherence to university standards. Reasonable accommodations may be provided in accordance with applicable policies.

General Summary:

The School of Nursing seeks Adjunct (Part-Time) faculty for the PhD program who have experience teaching in a master's or PhD program in an online environment and mentoring doctoral students in the dissertation. Adjunct (Part-Time) academic faculty members will report to the Academic Program Coordinator and will work closely with Academic Coordinator, academic advising, research team, and staff within the School of Nursing.

Required Qualifications:

  • PhD in Nursing (or related discipline with strong researchmethods expertise)
  • Active, unrestricted RN license in the U.S.
  • Experience teaching online in a master's or doctoral nursing program
  • Experience serving on dissertation committees
  • Expertise in theory, research methods, leadership, nursing education, or population health
  • Demonstrated program of scholarship (publications, research, presentations)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Externally funded research experience
  • Experience chairing dissertation committees

Additional Opportunities for Adjunct Faculty:

  • Serve as committee chair or member of doctoral project study committees
  • Instruct online courses or modules when needed
  • Participate in program and university-based residencies

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is as follows:

  • Graduate Course Instruction: $1,560 - $4,080 per Quarter or Semester, depending on type of course taught and length of course
  • Undergraduate Course Instruction: $700 - $2,200 per quarter, depending on type of course taught and length of course

    Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Walden also offers other opportunities for its contributing faculty members, such as dissertation/doctoral study committee chair positions, research reviewing, and dissertation and doctoral study mentoring.

    For more information regarding these opportunities, including the Faculty Compensation Schedule, please Click Here.

Equal Opportunity – Minority / Female / Disability / V / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation

About Walden University

Walden University, a Covista institution, supports a diverse community of adult learners from across the U.S. and other countries, who look to achieve their academic goals and make positive, lasting social change in their professions and communities. Walden offers more than 100 online degree and certificate programs, for students pursuing a bachelor’s, master’s, doctoral or certificate. Walden University has graduated with more than 174,000 students and is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission.

Walden University is an accredited institution that has been serving the higher education needs of professionals for more than 40 years. Offered online, Walden's doctoral, master's, and bachelor's degree programs are designed to help students achieve their goals so that, as graduates, they can help advance the lives of others.

  • In partnership with ADs and GPD, provides input to program Gantt Charts

  • Advanced understanding and applications of PMO standards and processes 

  • Experience leading the delivery of complex, technology, strategy and creative based projects 

  • Ability to develop a creative, strategic or technical heavy project plan 

  • Ability to tailor and flex process to provide solutions to proactively facilitate a project 

  • Experience leading a wide range of different functional groups and project teams 

  • Comprehension of project forecasting and reforecasting throughout lifecycle of project 

  • Expert project and program burn analysis and remediation 

  • Excellent scope and change management tracking and adherence 

  • Comfortable with client-facing communication 

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate, assess and mitigate risk 

  • Ability to build trust, negotiate and influence decision-making with Account, SMEs, Clients, Partner Agencies and third-party vendors

  • Strong decision-making and implementation, especially when faced with uncertainty 

  • Experience working with Project Management Information Systems such as Workfront, Workfront Proof, Smartsheet, MS Project 

  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Excel 

  • Launch experience a plus

Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, readiness, and execution of complex cybersecurity verification and validation activities across large-scale data center construction and commissioning programs.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This is a highly technical program leadership role positioned at the intersection of data center construction, commissioning, controls engineering, operational technology, networking, cybersecurity, facility operations, and OEM/vendor management.

The Technical Program Manager will coordinate activities across construction teams, commissioning organizations, data center operations, controls and automation teams, OEMs, system integrators, network teams, cybersecurity specialists, and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents.

The successful candidate must be capable of understanding both the construction/commissioning lifecycle and the underlying technical systems being validated. This is not a general administrative project-management position.

Key Responsibilities

1. Program & Multi-Site Delivery Management

  • Lead technical program coordination across multiple concurrent data center projects.
  • Align all sites with integrated program plans covering cybersecurity verification and validation, construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and technical dependencies.
  • Coordinate activities across multiple geographic regions, sites, delivery teams, and Cybersecurity commissioning agents.
  • Maintain visibility of site readiness, schedules, dependencies, risks, constraints, and required technical resources.
  • Maintain program-level schedule, effort, resource utilization, budget, and financial health tracking.
  • Own and coordinate program and site-level prerequisites required for successful execution.
  • Develop standardized governance and execution processes that can scale across a large multi-site portfolio.
  • Coordinate work allocation and execution across multiple cybersecurity assurance vendors while maintaining consistent program expectations.

2. Construction & Commissioning Integration

  • Integrate cybersecurity V&V activities into the overall data center construction and commissioning lifecycle.
  • Understand and coordinate dependencies between construction completion, equipment installation, controls integration, functional testing, commissioning, and cybersecurity validation.
  • Work with General Contractors, commissioning teams, system integrators, technical PMOs, and site teams to determine when systems are sufficiently ready for cybersecurity activities.
  • Prevent premature mobilization by establishing clear technical and operational readiness criteria.
  • Coordinate cybersecurity activities around critical project milestones without unnecessarily affecting construction or commissioning progress.

3. Controls / Data Center Engineering / OT Systems Coordination

Provide technical coordination across data center control and monitoring environments, including systems such as:

  • Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • Power Management Systems (PMS)
  • SCADA
  • DCS and industrial control platforms
  • PLCs and industrial controllers
  • RTUs, gateways, meters, relays, and IEDs
  • EPMS and electrical monitoring systems
  • Environmental and mechanical controls
  • Industrial networking infrastructure
  • Engineering workstations and management platforms
  • Associated servers, applications, interfaces, and communications infrastructure
  • Maintain sufficient technical knowledge of controls and OT platforms to understand system architecture, ownership, technical dependencies, testing prerequisites, and escalation requirements.

· 4. Data Center Operations Integration

  • Establish strong coordination between project delivery teams and Data Center Operations.
  • Ensure cybersecurity verification activities consider operational constraints and production-readiness requirements.
  • Coordinate technical handover requirements between construction/commissioning teams and operations.
  • Track ownership of systems, credentials, documentation, configurations, software, and technical artifacts necessary for validation.
  • Help resolve gaps between global program objectives and actual site execution conditions.

5. OEM, Vendor & System Integrator Coordination

  • Serve as the program-level coordination point for OEMs, system integrators, contractors, controls vendors, and Cybersecurity Commissioning Agent organizations.
  • Identify the correct technical owner for equipment and systems requiring verification.
  • Coordinate vendor availability during testing windows.
  • Ensure required engineering software, documentation, configurations, credentials, access, technical SMEs, and testing support are available.
  • Escalate unresolved vendor or technical dependencies before they affect execution.
  • Coordinate common requirements across OEMs rather than repeatedly resolving the same issues independently at each site.

6. Technical Logistics & Readiness

Own the technical-readiness process covering:

  • Site access
  • Assessment workstations
  • Network connectivity
  • Engineering system access
  • Required documentation
  • Network and controls architecture
  • Asset inventories
  • Configuration documentation
  • OEM technical resources
  • System integrator resources
  • Cybersecurity commissioning agent requirements
  • Testing windows
  • Evidence collection
  • Technical repositories
  • Finding and workflow-management systems

Establish a formal readiness gate before site mobilization.

7. Cybersecurity Verification & Validation Program Coordination

  • Coordinate execution between program stakeholders and independent Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents.
  • Translate program objectives into executable site-level technical activities.
  • Maintain consistent V&V expectations, evidence requirements, acceptance criteria, and reporting across multiple providers.
  • Coordinate testing activities involving OT devices, controls platforms, industrial networks, applications, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Track systemic findings and recurring issues across the portfolio.
  • Facilitate escalation of findings requiring program-level rather than site-level resolution.
  • Support integration of lessons learned into future design, procurement, commissioning, and operational requirements.

8. Program Governance & Reporting

  • Maintain integrated RAID logs covering risks, actions, issues, dependencies, and decisions.
  • Develop program dashboards covering readiness, execution status, testing progress, findings, dependencies, and blockers.
  • Facilitate technical program reviews and readiness meetings.
  • Maintain clear RACI across site teams, operations, controls teams, OEMs, integrators, Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents, and other stakeholders.
  • Escalate systemic issues requiring enterprise or program-level decisions.
  • Drive consistent methods across sites while accommodating genuine technical differences between facilities.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None

Skills

The requirements listed below are representative of acquired skills required.

Candidates must demonstrate relevant experience across all of the following areas. These requirements represent the core technical and program-management capabilities necessary for the role.

Data Center Experience

  • Significant experience delivering technical programs within hyperscale, colocation, mission-critical, or similarly complex data center environments.
  • Demonstrated understanding of data center construction, commissioning, operational readiness, and handover.

Construction Experience

  • Demonstrated experience working within major construction or infrastructure delivery programs.
  • Strong understanding of construction schedules, contractor dependencies, site readiness, commissioning gates, and project controls.

Controls / OT Experience

  • Strong working knowledge of building automation, industrial control, power-management, SCADA/DCS, PLC, and related cyber-physical systems.
  • Ability to interpret controls architecture, network diagrams, system interfaces, and technical dependencies.

Networking Experience

Working understanding of:

  • TCP/IP
  • VLANs
  • Routing and switching
  • Firewalls
  • Network segmentation
  • Industrial Ethernet
  • Remote access
  • IT/OT integration

Demonstrated ability to engage effectively understand and interact with network engineering teams on architecture, segmentation, routing, switching, firewall, remote-access, and IT/OT integration requirements.

Cybersecurity Experience

  • Experience leading or coordinating cybersecurity programs involving OT, industrial systems, critical infrastructure, or cyber-physical systems.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity verification, validation, assessment, risk management, remediation, and technical assurance.
  • Ability to translate cybersecurity requirements into activities that engineering and commissioning organizations can execute.

Commissioning Experience

  • Direct experience working with commissioning organizations or commissioning programs.
  • Understanding of FAT, SAT, functional testing, integrated systems testing, commissioning, acceptance, turnover, and operational readiness.
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate additional assurance requirements into an active commissioning environment.

Program Management Experience

  • Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, multi-site technical programs.
  • Experience managing multiple contractors, vendors, engineering organizations, and technical workstreams simultaneously.
  • Strong dependency, escalation, risk, schedule, and stakeholder-management capabilities.

Competencies

The requirements listed below are competencies required to perform the job successfully.

Technical credibility
Demonstrates sufficient technical depth to actively lead discussions with controls engineers, network engineers, commissioning teams, cybersecurity specialists, and data center operations personnel.

Construction fluency
Demonstrates strong understanding of construction execution, commissioning sequences, schedule pressures, project dependencies, and operational-readiness milestones.

Systems and Safety thinking
Identifies cross-functional dependencies affecting cybersecurity execution, including OEM contracts, construction schedules, controls integration, configurations, credentials, network readiness, technical ownership, and operational constraints.

Execution discipline
Turns program requirements into owners, dependencies, readiness gates, dates, escalation paths, and measurable outcomes.

Vendor orchestration
Can coordinate multiple Cybersecurity Commissioning Agents and technical vendors without allowing delivery methodology or quality to fragment between sites.

Executive communication
Can convert complex construction, OT, commissioning, cyber, and vendor issues into concise program-level decisions.

Technical curiosity
Demonstrates strong root-cause analysis and technical problem-solving skills to identify and resolve underlying readiness and execution constraints.

Education, Certifications, and Experience (required)

Experience Level

12+ years of overall relevant industry experience, including substantial experience across data center construction/commissioning and technical infrastructure programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Electrical, Controls, Automation, Mechanical, Network, Computer, Systems, or related engineering degree.
  • PMP or PgMP.
  • Commissioning credentials such as CxA, CCP, CBCP, or equivalent experience.
  • CISSP, GICSP, IEC 62443, or comparable cybersecurity certification.
  • Experience with controls ecosystems from Schneider Electric, Siemens, Rockwell Automation, ABB, Honeywell, Johnson Controls, or similar OEMs.

  • Experience coordinating third-party testing, assurance, validation, inspection, or commissioning organizations.
  • Experience supporting global programs spanning multiple regions and delivery organizations.

jobs.description:
MissionOne Media is a brand within BarkleyOKRP that combines full-funnel media planning and buying services, CRM, data, analytics, retail media, SEO, and digital experiences. We're an independent media partner offering transparency, integration, and a relentless focus on business impact.

We're looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to act as the operational backbone of our engineering team. The initial focus of this role is to take operational ownership of our legacy environment, while helping shape the architecture and strategy for our future-facing projects.

You'll ensure the stability, security, and high availability of our core production VMs running Java/Tomcat applications and MySQL 5.7 instances. You'll manage incidents, diagnose root causes, tune performance, and keep these critical legacy systems stable.

At the same time, you'll partner with us on our long-term growth. We're actively developing multiple new products and services on modern tech stacks and need someone who can balance maintaining legacy reliability with helping us design and scale our next-generation cloud architecture.

Responsibilities:

  • Incident Response & Operational Stability: Own the incident management lifecycle for production. Triage alerts, troubleshoot OS-level bottlenecks, debug performance issues, and drive rapid root-cause analysis.

  • Performance Monitoring & Debugging: Actively monitor system performance, application logs, and resource health using modern observability platforms (such as Observe by Snowflake) to quickly diagnose and resolve operational issues.

  • Legacy Infrastructure Management: Proactively maintain, patch, and secure our existing virtual machines on GCP.

  • Legacy Database Operations & Health: Monitor MySQL 5.7 instances, manage backups, and troubleshoot connection pool exhaustion or locking issues.

  • Cloud Architecture & Modernization: Collaborate to design, provision, and scale forward-looking cloud infrastructure for our new products and services, incorporating modern cloud-native tools and managed services (such as Cloud SQL and BigQuery).

  • Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Gradually replace manual operational tasks with clean automation scripts and infrastructure tools to reduce toil and improve repeatability.

  • Security & Compliance: Ensure systems comply with enterprise security baselines through rigorous OS hardening, access controls, and vulnerability patching.

Qualificiations:

  • Experience: 5+ years in a System Administration, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Infrastructure Operations role within an enterprise environment.

  • Legacy Stack Mastery:

    • Deep expertise in Linux administration, performance tuning, and troubleshooting (including storage and file system management, specifically ZFS).

    • Proven experience running, tuning, and debugging Java/Tomcat applications in production.

    • Strong working knowledge of MySQL 5.7, including query tuning, replication, backup/restore strategies, and migration troubleshooting.

    • Proficiency in shell scripting and writing lightweight automation (Bash)

  • Cloud & Modernization Experience:

    • Practical experience with Google Cloud Platform and managed services, including operational databases (Cloud SQL) and data warehousing platforms (BigQuery).

    • Production experience architecting and running containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes to support new product stacks.

    • Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform) and modern CI/CD deployment workflows.

  • Mindset & Soft Skills:

    • Calm under pressure: A methodical, safety-first approach to live-site incident response.

    • Pragmatic problem solver: You understand the realities of legacy software and prefer practical, stable solutions over chasing unproven tech fads.

    • Strong communication skills to collaborate with developers and stakeholders during high-stakes migrations or outages.

Ideal Experience / But Not Required:

  • Familiarity with Java development, enabling you to read application code, assist developers with debugging, or understand internal stack traces more deeply.

  • Experience with transitioning legacy tech stacks to modern GCP / cloud-native setups.

The annual gross base salary range is $90,000 - $150,000USD. This range represents the anticipated target salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and are based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and geographic location. Salary is one component of BarkleyOKRP's total compensation package, which includes multiple health insurance options, flexible PTO, life insurance, and 401K.

We're hiring a Director of Commercial Marketing to build and lead marketing for our commercial business, which spans the Freemotion, NordicTrack and iFIT brands. You’ll support several sales motions with very different buyers, from gym chains and large institutions to luxury hotels and independent studio owners. Hospitality is where we have the most to gain and the most to prove, so we're looking for someone who has marketed to hotels and resorts before. The role is fully remote, open anywhere in the US.

You'll report into marketing and be marketing's main partner to our commercial sales leaders. You'll own the Freemotion brand and set NordicTrack's commercial go-to-market within its brand standards. You’ll work with a designer embedded from our creative team and with outside agency partners, and you’ll help shape the right mix of in-house and agency support over time. Expect to build a fair amount yourself and to use AI to produce what sales needs.

The sales motions you'll support

Each of these has its own buyers, sales cycle and proof points. Part of the job is knowing which materials and programs can be shared across motions and which need to be built separately.

Motion

Buyers

How deals are won

What marketing does

Key accounts and institutions

Gym chains and franchise groups, universities, hospitals, military, corporate fitness, multifamily

Consumer-like research, but a high-stakes business decision shaped by community, education and trusted peers

Customer discovery, business-case content, referral and education partnerships, lead capture and nurture, launch support

Connected subscriptions

Gyms, universities, corporations and hotels buying iFIT content

An emerging B2B software motion

Positioning and sales support as the motion grows

Role commitments

  • Tie marketing to commercial revenue: Work with commercial sales leadership to turn their priorities into a marketing plan and budget, and show what marketing contributes to pipeline in each sales motion.
  • Win in luxury hospitality: Help our hospitality team win more hotel, resort and spa business by building the credibility and proof we need in a segment where we’re still establishing ourselves.
  • Help sales win more deals: Make sure reps and dealers have current, accurate materials for every customer conversation, and turn new requests around quickly.
  • Make iFIT a reason to buy: Position connected equipment and iFIT content as a differentiator against competitors, and support iFIT subscription sales into gyms, universities, corporations and hospitality.
  • Own Freemotion: Be the Freemotion brand owner, responsible for its positioning, standards and reputation with commercial buyers.
  • Earn NordicTrack credibility in commercial: NordicTrack is best known as a home fitness brand. Build its standing with commercial buyers, leading with Pilates, through proof such as premium installations, case studies and partnerships, within the standards set by the NordicTrack brand team.
  • Build the right support model: Get the most from our in-house and agency resources, and shape the mix over time so sales gets faster, better support.

Essential duties and responsibilities

Strategy and positioning

  • Define and prioritize segments across fitness facilities (big-box, franchise, university, military, corporate, multifamily), hospitality and wellness (luxury hotels, resorts, spas, residential), and Pilates studio founders.
  • Build segment positioning, messaging and proof points for Freemotion and NordicTrack Commercial, applying NordicTrack brand standards set by the NordicTrack brand team, and partner with the Senior Creative Director on Freemotion's visual identity and commercial creative standards.
  • Track competitors (e.g., Technogym, Life Fitness, Matrix, Precor; Balanced Body and Merrithew in Pilates) and buyer trends, and turn them into guidance sales can use.
  • Own commercial launch planning: timelines, assets, training and success metrics.

Sales enablement and partnership

  • Partner with sales leaders across every motion, including domestic, rest-of-world, our VP of Hospitality, and iFIT B2B, on priorities and target accounts.
  • Build a hospitality marketing program in partnership with our VP of Hospitality: flagship properties, case studies, design-trade presence and experiential events.
  • Own the sales toolkit: segment decks, brochures, spec sheets, proposal templates, ROI and total-cost-of-ownership tools, battlecards and rep onboarding materials.
  • Build a proof engine: case studies, testimonials, reference customers and co-marketing around new installations.
  • Run a customer advisory board and referral program with hotel, gym and studio customers.
  • Support distributors and dealers, including localized materials for European markets.
  • Run a simple intake and prioritization process so sales requests are delivered quickly and predictably.

Demand and pipeline

  • Partner with the paid media and web teams on website lead capture, conversion and lead generation across every sales motion.
  • Build on the studio founder discovery completed before you join: launch a pilot quickly, then scale the channels that produce qualified leads.
  • Give territory managers simple playbooks for following up on studio leads, and coach them on using them.
  • Brief any paid media to studio prospects within the paid media team's standards, and track leads, cost per lead and conversion.
  • Run account-based campaigns and LinkedIn programs for priority gyms and hotel groups.
  • Work with sales operations to make sure inbound leads are captured, routed and followed up, with clear reporting on lead sources, conversion and pipeline sourced and influenced.
  • Own trade show and commercial event strategy and content, partnering with the events manager on execution.

Team and operations

  • Use AI within iFIT's policies on AI use, data privacy and intellectual property, and train the team to do the same.
  • Build key materials hands-on, and set the embedded designer’s commercial priorities in partnership with the Senior Creative Director.
  • Assess which work is best done in-house and which by agencies, recommend changes, and manage vendors for PR, freelance and production work.
  • Own the commercial marketing budget and report results to marketing and commercial leadership.

What success looks like

In your first 30 days

  • Sales has a single front door to marketing, with a known turnaround for requests.

jobs.description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

What this job involves:

Lead the end-to-end delivery of the program’s complex, high-value, and high-profile mission-critical and data-center infrastructure projects. This is a senior project management role for the large and technically demanding engagements — projects where the technical scope, financial exposure, schedule risk, and client profile demand the deepest level of experience and commercial command. The Senior Project Manager owns performance across cost, schedule, scope, procurement, and client outcomes for their assigned projects, directs PMs, APMs and Project Coordinators supporting those projects, and operates as the primary point of accountability to the client and internal leadership on every engagement they carry.


Your day-to-day tasks will include:

  • Lead full project delivery on the program’s complex and high-value engagements, owning all performance outcomes across cost, schedule, scope, weekly OAC meetings, quality, and client satisfaction.
  • Provide guidance and direction to PMs, APMs and Project Coordinators assigned to support their projects, maintaining delivery standards, documentation integrity, and workstream alignment.
  • Lead pre-design and feasibility efforts alongside engineering, including due diligence, constructability review, capacity validation, and value engineering, to establish viable design paths and ROM estimates with the highest confidence possible given compressed timelines.
  • Drive the compressed, parallelized delivery methodology required for speed-to-market commitments, adapting conventional pre-planning sequencing and contractor coordination norms for projects of the large scale and technical complexity.
  • Develop and review Method of Procedures (MOPs) for critical infrastructure, providing detailed status reports and maintaining comprehensive project documentation.
  • Execute procurement and commercial execution, including RFP development, vendor qualification, negotiation, and direct contracting of vendors and suppliers under NTE/GMP arrangements.
  • Coordinate prime and trade contracts (electrical, mechanical, controls, fire protection, structural, and general trades) through complex, phased, and overlapping delivery.
  • Manage project-level performance, including GMP/NTE budgets, ROM development, change orders, forecasts, pay applications, and variance analysis, exercising the greatest degree of commercial discipline on projects where cost risk is highest.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day client interface on assigned projects, translating technical requirements into actionable plans and delivering rigorous, data-driven reporting to demanding clients.
  • Identify, document, and escalate risk on projects with notable technical, schedule, and commercial exposure, exercising sound judgment on decisions within established guidelines and escalating high-stakes issues appropriately.
  • Ensure quality assurance and commissioning of critical power, cooling, life-safety, and control systems within active, energized environment.
  • Perform comprehensive field assessments including onsite electrical equipment evaluations, operational testing, and commissioning activities. Conduct regular inspections of buildings and equipment to identify maintenance and repair needs, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and industry best practices. Supervise electrical equipment maintenance, testing activities, and contractor work to ensure quality standards are met.
  • Collaborate on designing project plans, specifications, and engineering drawings using CAD software. Ensure all designs comply with applicable codes, regulations, and industry standards. Provide technical expertise in building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety systems, and reliable power systems (UPS, batteries, emergency generators, transfer switches, switchgear, and distributed generation).
  • Enforce site safety protocols, including lockout-tagout (LOTO) and safe work practices; lead safety stand-downs and corrective actions when incidents occur on assigned projects.
  • Support contract administration, compliance, insurance documentation, and governance on all assigned engagements.

Desired experience and technical skills:

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years of construction project management experience in data center, industrial, or other mission-critical environments, with demonstrated ownership of full project delivery on large, complex, high-value projects.
  • Proven track record delivering projects at scale: $50M+ total project cost, high schedule intensity, and technically complex MEP scopes.
  • Direct oversight of trade contractors (electrical, mechanical, generator, controls, structural) in active, energized construction settings.
  • Proven commercial and contract leadership, including RFP development, negotiation, and administration of GMP, NTE, or similar contract structures on large, consequential project scopes.
  • Advanced proficiency with project management, scheduling, and financial management software.
  • Deep working knowledge of MEP systems, critical power/cooling infrastructure, and commissioning standards (NFPA, ASHRAE) across the full range of data center system types.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and executive-level presentation and reporting skills; comfortable as the primary face of the project to the most demanding clients.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate with high autonomy and decisive judgment in ambiguous, high-pressure, fast-track environments where conventional sequencing does not apply.
  • Availability to travel up to 100% for specific projects as needed.

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

In addition to providing guidance on how and where to access support, BLA has also administered grant funding programs on behalf of the government.

BLA collaborates with a wide range of service providers, funding organizations, and small business support agencies throughout the province. Each year, BLA serves more than 5,000 clients from across Alberta, including those in rural communities, and urban centers.

Our Mission

BLA helps Alberta’s small businesses start and succeed.

Our Values

  • Impactful
  • Non-Judgmental

Our Culture

  • Innovative
  • Transparent
  • Open-Minded
  • Collaborative

Reporting to the Manager, Client Service, the Strategist delivers client-centered guidance that supports entrepreneurs in starting and growing their businesses.

Through one-on-one engagements, the Strategist provides practical, tailored support, helping clients navigate programs, connect with ecosystem supports, and clarify their goals. The role focuses on building client capability and confidence, enabling informed decision-making at each stage of the business journey.

The Strategist also plays a key role in strengthening the broader entrepreneurial ecosystem. Through meaningful outreach and relationship-building, they increased awareness of services and ensure more entrepreneurs can access and benefit from available supports.

In addition, the Strategist contributes to continuous improvement by capturing client insights, identifying emerging needs, and supporting data-informed enhancements to programs and service delivery.

  • Occasional travel elsewhere in Alberta, approximately 4-6 times per year

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, client-focused environment.
  • Commitment to inclusive, client-centered service delivery.
  • Valid Class 5 Driver’s License is an asset.

jobs.excerpt: About Summit:Summit Therapeutics Inc.  is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs.
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role: Summit Therapeutics is seeking a dynamic and strategic Associate Director of Patient Engagement and Advocacy to support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of patient engagement and advocacy strategies for ivonescimab across oncology indications including bladder, breast and gynecological cancer. We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.

Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.

Location & Team Gatherings

Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016. We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.

We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture.

About this role

As a Project Manager - Natural Gas Projects on Intersect's Datacenters and Fuels / Natural Gas Power Projects team, you'll lead the execution of critical power generation and energy infrastructure projects at the convergence of electrification, digitalization, and decarbonization. Acting as the owner's representative across the project lifecycle, you'll guide complex natural gas-fired facilities—including reciprocating engine plants, gas turbine facilities, HV switchyards, substations, BESS, and large-scale data center power infrastructure—from development through commissioning and commercial operation.

Engineering oversight and technical judgment are central to this position. You will apply engineering principles to review technical designs, evaluate equipment and EPC contractor proposals, and resolve complex field and design issues while driving safety, quality, schedule, and budget performance.

Team overview

This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition by delivering reliable, dispatchable power infrastructure that supports large-scale digital and electrical loads. The Datacenters and Fuels / Natural Gas Power Projects team partners across engineering, construction, commercial, and operations to execute resilient generation assets from initial design through commercial handover. Joining this group means taking direct ownership of high-impact infrastructure projects and growing alongside seasoned technical leaders committed to operational excellence.

What you'll do

Lead Complex Project Execution and Controls

  • Develop and execute comprehensive project plans, schedules, budgets, forecasts, and risk registers for natural gas-fired power generation facilities from development through commercial operation and turnover.

  • Drive project performance against safety, quality, schedule, budget, and operational readiness objectives while providing clear, actionable updates to executive leadership.

  • Lead risk identification, mitigation planning, project closeout activities, and commissioning support to ensure seamless handover to operations teams.

Manage EPC and External Partner Performance

  • Serve as the primary owner's representative for EPC contractors, consultants, utilities, and equipment vendors across all project phases.

  • Oversee contractor compliance, commercial negotiations, change orders, and claims resolution, including rigorous technical evaluation of contractor proposals.

  • Review and approve construction strategies, procurement plans, and execution methodologies while maintaining productive alignment across stakeholder groups.

Deliver Technical and Engineering Excellence

  • Partner with engineering teams to review and approve technical designs, vendor submittals, and construction approaches, guiding decisions on design basis, equipment selection, and technical scope.

  • Oversee the integration of reciprocating engine plants, gas turbine facilities, HV switchyards and substations, BESS assets, and large-scale data center power infrastructure.

  • Drive QA/QC processes, technical bid evaluations, equipment performance guarantees, and startup/commissioning test procedures across engineering, procurement, and construction.

Champion Safety, Compliance, and Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Foster a culture of safety excellence by conducting site inspections, field reviews, and audits to verify adherence to safety management systems, environmental permits, and federal, state, and local regulations.

  • Partner closely with internal engineering, construction, commercial, and operations teams to resolve technical challenges, maintain project momentum, and build long-run value.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (Required).

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in project execution, construction management, or engineering leadership within power generation, energy infrastructure, oil & gas, utility, or heavy industrial sectors.

  • Direct experience executing natural gas-fired power generation projects (reciprocating engine plants or gas turbine facilities) from either the Owner's or EPC Contractor's side through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operational handover.

  • Strong technical grounding in HV switchyards, substations, BESS integration, and large-scale power infrastructure, with proven ability to evaluate technical designs, equipment proposals, and change orders.

  • Working knowledge of QA/QC frameworks, commissioning and startup test procedures, and safety management systems.

  • A hands-on leadership style that emphasizes face-to-face collaboration, composure under competing priorities, and disciplined commercial and technical negotiation.

  • A commitment to collaboration, continuous learning, inclusion, and long-term value creation aligned with Intersect's values of Equity, Humility, Authenticity, Long-run Value, and People Come First.

Health & wellness: 100% premium coverage for you and your dependents on medical, dental, and vision

Start Your Adventure at Via Logic

Role: Mid-Level ServiceNow Developer
Location: Remote, work must be performed with the U.S. Preference for candidates located in the following states: CA, CO, DC, GA, FL, IL, MS, NC, NY, OH, PA, TN, TX, UT, VA, and VT.

Eligibility & Clearance Requirements

Due to federal contract requirements supporting USCIS programs, applicants must:

  • Be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Currently reside within the United States.
  • Have lived within the U.S. for at least 3 of the past 5 years.
  • Be eligible to obtain and maintain a government Public Trust clearance.

Your Route Into ServiceNow Development

At Via Logic, we believe great technology should make complex work simpler, faster, and more reliable. We’re looking for a Mid-Level ServiceNow Developer who enjoys building scalable solutions, solving technical challenges, and collaborating with both technical and non-technical teams.

In this role, you’ll support the design, development, and implementation of solutions across the ServiceNow platform, including custom and scoped applications, integrations, workflow automation, Service Catalog capabilities, and locally developed applications.

You’ll work closely with ServiceNow architects, developers, citizen developers, analysts, and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into secure, maintainable technical solutions. You’ll also support CI/CD movements between environments, participate in code reviews and demonstrations, troubleshoot complex issues, and help ensure development follows ServiceNow and enterprise best practices.

This role provides the opportunity to contribute directly to mission-critical systems supporting the Department of Homeland Security while continuing to deepen your ServiceNow expertise across application development, integrations, automation, and platform delivery.

Your Mission Today

Your Responsibilities:

  • ServiceNow Development: Design, develop, configure, and deploy custom applications and solutions within the ServiceNow platform.
  • Scoped Applications & Workflow Automation: Create and configure scoped applications, Service Catalog items, Flow Designer workflows, and other platform-based solutions that support client needs.
  • Custom Application Development: Support the design and development of locally developed applications (LDAs) using ServiceNow development best practices.
  • Integrations: Lead and support integrations between ServiceNow and external systems, ensuring reliable data exchange and platform functionality.
  • CI/CD & Deployment: Support the movement of ServiceNow components, collections, and deployable assets through CI/CD pipelines and across development environments.
  • Technical Collaboration: Work closely with ServiceNow architects, developers, analysts, and stakeholders to map business requirements and services to appropriate ServiceNow capabilities.
  • Code Reviews & Demonstrations: Participate in code reviews, proofs of concept, technical discussions, and product demonstrations.
  • Troubleshooting & Configuration: Perform troubleshooting, coding, scripting, and ServiceNow configuration activities of moderate to high complexity.
  • Citizen Developer Support: Provide guidance and mentorship to citizen developers and other team members working within the ServiceNow ecosystem.
  • Platform Administration: Support the administration, deployment, and management of USCIS systems and PaaS, SaaS, and IaaS platforms as required using authorized privileged access.

What Helps Explorers Succeed Here

Your Required Skills and Experience:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience developing solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
  • Certification: At least one current ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification.
  • ServiceNow Development: Hands-on experience designing, developing, configuring, and deploying ServiceNow applications and platform solutions.
  • Integrations: Experience developing and supporting ServiceNow integrations with external systems.
  • ITSM & Scoped Applications: Experience working with ServiceNow ITSM capabilities and scoped application development.
  • CI/CD: Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes within a ServiceNow environment.
  • Technical Development: Strong scripting and development capabilities, including JavaScript and related ServiceNow development technologies.
  • Communication: Strong client-facing communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively within Agile, cross-functional development teams.

Types of Badges and Certifications:

  • Experience working with the ServiceNow Configuration Management Database (CMDB).
  • Experience developing custom ServiceNow applications.
  • Familiarity with federal government or DHS environments.
  • Experience working in Agile and DevSecOps delivery environments.
  • Current Public Trust clearance or previous experience successfully completing a federal background investigation.

Why Explorers Stay

  • Remote-first flexibility within the U.S.
  • Comprehensive healthcare benefits.
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO).
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture focused on growth and continuous learning.
  • Opportunities to expand into broader engineering and DevSecOps ownership areas.
  • Meaningful work supporting mission-driven programs with real-world impact.

How We Work

  • This is a client-facing role that includes virtual collaboration and occasional customer interaction.
  • Team members are expected to actively engage through Slack, Teams, email, Monday.com, and other collaboration tools during standard business hours.
  • Availability for meetings and collaboration between 9AM–5PM EST is expected.
  • Cameras on during virtual meetings is part of our collaborative culture.

About Via Logic

Via Logic LLC is an information technology partner supporting mission-driven work across DevSecOps, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data science, and national security analytics for federal and commercial clients. Our teams help modernize complex systems through automation, secure engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, and scalable infrastructure solutions that support real-world impact. But beyond the work itself, we care deeply about how we work. We believe great teams are built through collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and trust. Whether you're supporting customer missions, strengthening business operations, or leading expeditions of your own, Via Logic is a place where Explorers are encouraged to grow, contribute, and continuously evolve.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Via Logic LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all Explorers are valued and supported. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. We believe different perspectives strengthen teams, improve innovation, and help us build better solutions for the missions we support.

Accessibility & Accommodations

Via Logic is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience for all candidates. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application and interview process to support accessibility needs and ensure every candidate has an equitable opportunity to explore a career with our team.

Recruiting Fraud Notice

Via Logic takes recruiting fraud seriously. We will never ask candidates for payment, banking information, cryptocurrency, gift cards, or other personal financial information during any stage of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from our team will come directly from authorized Via Logic representatives using official company channels. Due to the rise of fraudulent recruiting activity across the industry, we encourage candidates to use caution if something feels unusual, rushed, or too good to be true. Real adventures should involve solving meaningful challenges -not wiring money to strangers pretending to be recruiters on the internet. If you have concerns about the legitimacy of a communication claiming to represent Via Logic, please verify the information through our official website before sharing personal information or taking further action.

jobs.title: VP, People Services
jobs.excerpt: In 2008, Propeller reinvented the way venture-stage companies build finance teams, and in the process we defined the category the market now calls fractional.
jobs.description:
In 2008, Propeller reinvented the way venture-stage companies build finance teams, and in the process we
defined the category the market now calls fractional. Today we are building what comes next: a professional
services firm where human judgment and AI-enabled intelligence work as one system. The technology is
moving fast. The people side is harder. AI changes what our teams produce, how engagements are staffed,
what a career path looks like, and what great looks like in every seat. Firms that treat that as a software
rollout will stall. Firms that lead their people through it deliberately will define the next decade.
We are hiring the leader who will make that change stick at Propeller. You will be the strategic people
partner to our CEO and leadership team: someone who has lived inside a professional services business,
ideally finance and accounting, who understands that the expertise, judgment, and client relationships of
our people are what clients actually buy, and who has a strong point of view on why driving people change is
harder than driving technology change and what it actually takes.
This role has a second dimension. Our clients are the same founders and operators who need HR
infrastructure as they scale, and many already rely on Propeller for payroll. You will build that foundation
into a People Services practice with its own P&L: payroll at the core, augmented by the policies, handbooks,
compliance, and HR advisory that small and growth-stage companies need but are not ready to hire for.
This is a leadership role for someone ready to build both a function and a practice, not just run a
department.
Who We Are
Today, Propeller's 250+ professionals serve as the embedded finance and accounting partner to some of the
most iconic emerging companies in Consumer, Technology, Blockchain, and Business Services. All are fulltime employees, across three continents; none are contractors or freelancers. Behind us: 1,500+ companies
served, $105B+ in enterprise value created, 26 unicorn alumni, and $29B+ raised. Ahead of us: the
transformation of professional services through AI-enabled intelligence.
Our embedded teams integrate seamlessly into client operations in multi-year partnerships. We attend
weekly leadership meetings, participate in board prep, collaborate on strategic decisions, and have direct
access to client CEOs and CFOs. This embedded positioning creates trust, access, and influence that
traditional providers never achieve.
PropellerOS, our financial operating platform, combines human judgment, precision accounting, data
infrastructure, and AI-enabled insight to transform finance from a back-office function into the central
nervous system of growth. The system enables finance-grade standards of lineage, reconciliation,
auditability, and explainability, with a named human accountable for every number we ship.

Key Responsibilities

Most HR leadership roles emphasize one dimension. This role requires three.
In a professional services firm, the people are the product. Every decision about hiring, development,
compensation, and role design shows up directly in client experience, retention, and the reputation that
drives referrals. At the same time, AI is reshaping the work itself. The market treats the internal HR leader,
the change leader, and the HR services entrepreneur as three separate jobs. At Propeller they are one, and
each makes the others stronger.
Strategic People Partner
You are a member of the leadership team and the strategic partner to our CEO and practice leaders on
everything people. You understand what creates value in a professional services business: the depth of
client relationships, the continuity of the teams that serve them, the expertise that compounds over a
career, and the institutional knowledge that has to outlast any one person. You build the workforce plan
that keeps talent ahead of growth, the career architecture that lets Controllers and CFOs grow on parallel
tracks rather than one ladder, and the compensation and performance systems that reward client impact
and the outcomes clients pay for. You lead and guide our internal People team, including our recruiting, HR,
and compliance leads: you set the strategy, standards, and priorities, and they run execution in their areas.
You earn credibility with delivery teams by connecting with them at their level: you understand their work,
their clients, and their pressure. If you see HR primarily as administration and compliance, this isn't your
role.
• Serve as strategic advisor to the CEO and leadership team on organization design, workforce planning,
and talent strategy.
• Lead and develop the internal People team (recruiting, HR, and compliance), guiding strategy and
standards while team leads own day-to-day execution.
• Design the career architecture, compensation, and performance systems for client-facing
professionals across all practices.
• Shape talent strategy for attracting, developing, and retaining the expertise our clients rely on,
working through our recruiting lead.
• Ensure Propeller's own HR, payroll, benefits, and employment compliance are best-in-class, so we run
internally what we sell externally.
Transformation Leader
You own the people side of Propeller's transformation into an AI-enabled firm. You redesign roles as AI takes
on the mechanical work, build the AI fluency programs that move every team member from awareness to
daily practice, and reshape performance expectations so the new behaviors are the ones that get recognized
and rewarded. You know that resistance is rarely about the tool; it is about identity, trust, and what people
believe the change means for them. You bring a clear, tested point of view on how to lead through that, and
you hold leaders accountable for doing it with you. You also partner with our Transformation practice to
bring change management to client system and process implementations, where the people side decides
whether the technology delivers. If your change playbook is a launch email and a training deck, this isn't
your role.
• Lead the people side of Propeller's AI transformation: role redesign, AI fluency training, change
management, and adoption measurement.
• Redefine what great looks like in each role as the work shifts from producing outputs to exercising
judgment.
• Partner with practice leaders and the Transformation practice to bring change management capability
to client engagements.
Practice Builder
You own the People Services practice end to end: offering, pipeline, delivery, and P&L. You accelerate our
existing payroll services and build around them the HR services small and growth-stage companies need:
handbooks and policies, multi-state compliance, onboarding and offboarding, compensation benchmarking,
benefits guidance, and fractional HR leadership. You package and price those services, sell them into our
existing client base alongside our embedded finance teams and through our referral network, and build a
lean delivery team that runs them to Propeller's standards. You think like a business owner. If you have
never carried a number, this isn't your role.
• Own the financial performance of the People Services practice: revenue, margins, client retention, and
profitability.
• Grow payroll services and launch complementary HR offerings (policies, handbooks, compliance,
advisory) for small and growth-stage clients.
• Drive business development in coordination with our GoToMarket team, embedded client teams, and
referral partners.
• Use AI and automation in service delivery, and codify what works so the practice scales without adding
headcount linearly

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

15+ years in HR and People leadership, with at least 7 years as head of HR or senior strategic HR
partner in a professional services firm. Finance, accounting, or advisory firm experience strongly
preferred.
• A strong, articulated point of view on transforming a professional services business, and on why
people change is harder than technology change. You can walk us through a transformation you led:
what worked, what broke, and what you would do differently.
• Direct experience building or running an HR services offering for small companies (fractional HR, HR
consulting, payroll or PEO provider, or similar), including pricing, selling, and delivering it.
• Track record leading HR functions through other leaders: guiding recruiting, HR, and compliance leads
rather than doing the work yourself.
• Deep working knowledge of payroll operations: multi-state payroll and tax, benefits administration,
and the major small-business payroll and HRIS platforms.
• Command of US employment law and multi-state compliance; experience supporting employees
across multiple countries is a plus.
• Experience designing compensation, career paths, and performance systems for client-facing
professionals.
• Demonstrated AI fluency: you use AI in your own HR workflow today and can show us how it changes
what you produce.
• Commercial instinct: comfortable owning a P&L, building pipeline, and closing business.
• Executive presence and credibility with both senior leadership and delivery teams; comfortable
delivering difficult messages with clarity.
• SPHR or SHRM-SCP preferred.
Professional Services Expertise
You understand how professional services firms work: why client trust and team continuity are the real
assets, how reputation and referrals are earned engagement by engagement, the career expectations of
credentialed professionals, and the tension between developing people and serving clients. You know what
it takes for a CPA or controller to trust a change in how their work gets done. Experience in a finance and
accounting firm, Big 4, or advisory practice is strongly preferred; experience serving small and growth-stage
companies as clients is a plus

Job Benefits

• Base salary range $210,000 - $250,000 + significant variable compensation tied to People Services
practice performance and new business.
• Equity participation.
• Investment in your development: AI/automation training, executive coaching, and access to
Propeller's network.
• Remote-flexible with travel for team leadership, client meetings, and conferences.
Current Benefits Offered: Generous Paid Time Off and Holiday pay, Comprehensive health benefits plus
dental, vision, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. HSA contribution, Paid Family Leave, 401k
match and Remote Work. We also help you grow in your professional life

Security Engineer

Overview: Supply Chain Security and Compliance

The Security Engineer is a critical role responsible for implementing and enforcing robust security practices across our entire integrated supply chain e-commerce platform. You will safeguard e-commerce transactions, secure internal tool integrations, and establish the trust framework for our AI agent operations, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards like PCI-DSS and GDPR.

Internship Details

  • Duration: 3 months (extendable based on performance and project scope)

  • Start Date: Immediate

  • Location: Remote

  • Stipend: Unpaid initially; may convert to a paid internship, full-time role, or even direct client absorption (FTE) based on your performance

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will secure all layers of the application, from the Next.js frontend to the NestJS modular monolith and the cloud infrastructure.

  • Security Architecture & Threat Modeling: Perform vulnerability assessments, code reviews, and threat modeling for all new features and systems, focusing on the critical MES $\rightarrow$ WMS $\rightarrow$ OMS business process flow.

  • Compliance Enforcement: Lead the implementation and auditing of security controls necessary for PCI-DSS compliance (for Payment module) and GDPR compliance (for user/tenant data handling).

  • Access Control & Authentication: Implement and manage secure API authentication methods, including OAuth 2.0 and SAML, utilizing Authentik/Ory Kratos and leveraging PostgreSQL's Row-Level Security (RLS) for tenant isolation.

  • Secrets & Encryption: Manage secrets and key rotation using Vault, define and enforce encryption protocols for data both in transit and at rest, and manage certificates via Traefik.

  • Abuse Prevention: Implement and monitor controls for API rate limiting, Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules, and traffic monitoring to prevent abuse and denial-of-service attacks.

  • Incident Response: Develop and practice incident investigation and response protocols. Conduct security awareness training for development and operations teams.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess hands-on security experience with our core stack and compliance tools:

  • Platform Security: Node.js/NestJS security best practices, Next.js/React security, PostgreSQL RLS.

  • Compliance Focus: Experience with PCI-DSS and GDPR controls and auditing.
