We believe in the power of process and its potential to unlock growth in teams everywhere.

Who we are

Process Street is an AI software and compliance operations platform startup from San Francisco. We help our customers build, document, automate, and track recurring workflows. Our platform automates the work, enforces the standards, and proves compliance so our global customers can run their businesses. We service over 3k customers around the world, and are VC-backed by Accel, Salesforce, and Atlassian.

Our Mission

To make work fun, fast, and faultless for teams everywhere.

Our culture

Process Street was founded on a strong belief in the work-life benefits of a healthy, collaborative remote culture. We value flexibility because many of us are parents, travelers, or just creatives who aren't inspired by the construct of a mundane 9-to-5. Spread across 9 different time zones, we communicate asynchronously, work autonomously, and take real ownership of our work. We know human connections are what make teams strong, so we regularly do coffee chats, game-playing, story-telling, and more, to build strong relationships.

If you're entrepreneurial and seek an environment that values impact, ownership, and flexibility we look forward to meeting you!

The Opportunity

Dash is a managed AI teammate for small teams, built by Process Street. It picks up the recurring work that falls between people — the follow-ups, the handoffs, the things everyone assumes someone else did — and does it in Slack or Microsoft Teams, checking with a human before anything goes out.

Dash is new, and most of the people who'd love it haven't heard of it yet. Your job is to change that, and to turn the attention you create into pipeline.

This is demand creation, not demand capture, and the distinction shapes everything. There's no proven channel to scale, no playbook to inherit, and no installed base to build referral or expansion programs on. Every source of growth has to be invented and proven before anyone can optimize it.

The role has four connected parts: create attention, produce the content that sustains it, convert it into pipeline, and keep finding the next advantage. They're one job. The campaigns only work because there's a content engine behind them, the content only compounds because there's a conversion engine in front of it, and none of it holds for long without constant experimentation.

Dash runs like a startup inside a funded one. Process Street has investors behind it. Dash has a small team, its own budget, and has to earn its next dollar — which is exactly why this role exists. Budget won't be the lever that makes a campaign succeed. Creativity, timing, partnerships, and earned attention will be. We want someone whose instinct is to manufacture reach rather than purchase it, and who treats a small budget as a design constraint rather than an obstacle. The same discipline applies to the direct marketing engine: spend should be deliberate, measured, and defensible against the pipeline it produces.

You'll have real leverage behind you. Much of our content, research, and distribution runs on an automated production layer, so one person here can put far more into market than they could at a company doing this by hand. You won't be limited by how much you can produce. You'll be limited by what you decide is worth making — and whether it's good enough to ship, backed by a system that moves as fast as you think.

What You'll Do

  • Run stunts that earn attention. Conceive and execute the kind of campaign people stop for and share. This is a distinct craft, and we're hiring for it deliberately.
  • Build launch moments. Time the creative, the paid push, and partner distribution to land together. One well-built moment is worth more than months of steady output.
  • Build creative partnerships. Source, negotiate, and close deals with creators, communities, and complementary brands, including working out what makes each one worth their while.
  • Invent channels, online and off. Prove new routes to an audience that doesn't know us yet, using events and activations as part of an integrated campaign, and be as quick to abandon what doesn't work as to pursue what does.
  • Own the content calendar and the output. We publish at high volume across search, video, social, and community. You own what gets made, when it ships, and whether it's good enough.
  • Direct the automated production layer. Brief the agents, review what comes back, correct what's wrong, and extend the system into new formats and channels. Make modern content — short-form video, images, ads, and written work — at a pace that only works if you use AI as a genuine force multiplier.
  • Own discovery in both directions. Traditional search optimization and AI-assisted discovery, where a growing share of buyers now form their shortlist. Work the conversation through community and reply marketing where our audience already is, kept human rather than automated into noise.
  • Hold the brand line. Dash has a distinct voice and personality. Everything that ships sounds like it, including the work the agents produced. You make the final call.
  • Convert attention into pipeline. Stand up and operate the direct marketing engine, run the ad accounts across the major platforms, and keep a clear, measurable path from spend to qualified opportunity. Direct agencies and partners with content and context, challenge their thinking, and verify their numbers rather than accepting their reporting.
  • Keep finding the next advantage. Maintain a prioritized experiment backlog with a visible record of what each one produced, assess new AI tools and formats weekly and adopt the few that matter, mine customer and market data for insight, and track what competitors are doing that's worth beating.

About You

  • You've created demand for something people weren't looking for, and you can show what you did.
  • You generate ideas that travel, and you can tell those apart from ideas that only sound good internally.
  • You're commercially minded. Awareness that doesn't become pipeline doesn't interest you.
  • You get more out of a small budget than most people get out of a large one.
  • You work quickly and would rather run several experiments than plan one perfectly.
  • You have a sharp eye for detail and can tell immediately when AI-assisted output is off or missing the point.
  • You learn new tools fast, go deep on them without being asked, and enjoy that part most.
  • You're comfortable across analytics, publishing, and advertising platforms, and you understand how search, AI-assisted discovery, and outbound fit together. Depth in every one isn't expected — the appetite to learn whatever an experiment needs is.
  • You want responsibility for an outcome that's genuinely undecided.

Useful, but not required:

  • Partnerships, influencer, or creator marketing, particularly deals you sourced and closed yourself
  • Events or activations you've planned and run
  • Building with AI tools, including agents, automations, and content workflows
  • Short-form video production and editing
  • Editing and copywriting
  • Marketing a product distributed through a platform ecosystem such as Slack or Microsoft Teams
  • Community and conversational marketing on X, LinkedIn, or Reddit
  • A working growth stack: web and product analytics, search console, advertising platforms, CRM, and retention tooling
  • A/B testing and conversion rate optimization
  • Enough technical literacy to wire tools together, such as HTML and CSS, SQL, or no-code automation platforms
  • Taking a product to market from zero rather than scaling one that already works

Our Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO policy — most take 3–4 weeks, plus their major holidays, AND a company-wide week off in December.
  • Company offsite and sponsored small-group meetups.
  • Social time — coffee chats, games, story-telling, optional house tours.

  • Generous health insurance for US employees and their families, including dental and vision plans.
  • A chance to shape how companies around the world run through the future of no-code automation.

Apply, even if you're not sure

jobs.description:
Construction Advisor

Trillium Advisory Group is seeking an experienced, client-facing construction professional to help project teams plan, visualize, and execute work more effectively through Advanced Work Packaging, model-based planning, 4D schedule simulation, visual production tracking, and practical project controls expertise.

The Opportunity

Are you an experienced construction professional who understands what it takes to successfully deliver complex capital projects? Do you enjoy working directly with project teams to solve planning challenges, improve execution readiness, and create innovative approaches to project delivery?

This role combines deep construction execution experience, project controls knowledge, and visual planning technologies to help client teams improve how work is planned, coordinated, and executed. The role has a strong focus on visual planning support, including 3D model-based planning, 4D schedule simulation, Advanced Work Packaging, and visual production tracking.

The ideal candidate understands how construction projects actually get built. Tools and technology can be taught; meaningful on-site construction experience is essential.

Position Details

  • Location: Calgary, AB / Remote
  • Travel: Project dependent; typically targeted at no more than one week per month
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, with occasional evenings or weekends as project needs require
  • Compensation: Salary ($115k - $135k annually)
  • Management Role: No

Why Join Trillium?

At Trillium Advisory Group, we help organizations improve how projects are planned, managed, and delivered.

Our team combines deep construction experience with modern digital solutions to drive measurable improvements in project performance. We work at the intersection of construction execution, project controls, Advanced Work Packaging, visual planning, data analytics, BIM, and digital delivery.

As demand for visual planning and digital project delivery continues to grow, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative initiatives that are shaping the future of construction execution while collaborating with experienced industry practitioners and leading client teams.

What You Will Do

Construction Planning & Visual Project Delivery

  • Support client teams in implementing Advanced Work Packaging processes and practical execution planning practices.
  • Develop and support model-based planning solutions that improve construction visibility, sequencing, and execution readiness.
  • Create and maintain 4D schedule simulations to communicate construction strategy and project sequencing.
  • Facilitate visual planning sessions with project stakeholders, including construction, engineering, project controls, and leadership teams.
  • Support visual production tracking initiatives that improve field execution, readiness, and progress visibility.
  • Help client teams identify constraints, sequencing risks, and opportunities to improve workface readiness.

Advisory & Client Consulting

  • Work directly with client teams to assess project challenges and identify opportunities for performance improvement.
  • Facilitate workshops, planning sessions, stakeholder interviews, and client working sessions.
  • Develop practical recommendations and implementation strategies for project delivery and process improvement initiatives.
  • Present findings, recommendations, and project insights to project leaders and client stakeholders.
  • Support development and deployment of project processes, procedures, governance frameworks, and implementation plans.

Analytics & Performance Improvement

  • Analyze project performance data and identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop dashboards, visualizations, and reporting tools that support project decision-making where appropriate.
  • Conduct project audits, health assessments, productivity reviews, and performance analyses.
  • Prepare technical reports, presentations, and client deliverables that translate complex information into clear recommendations.

What We Are Looking For

Required Experience

  • 7+ years of construction project execution experience; exceptional intermediate candidates will be considered. Project Controls experience is preferred.
  • Significant experience on active construction projects and project sites.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, work packaging, field execution, and project delivery best practices. Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) experience is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with 3D model-based planning. 4D planning and schedule simulation, visual production tracking is preferred.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and facilitation skills.
  • Experience working with stakeholders across field execution, engineering, construction management, and project controls teams.
  • Ability to engage confidently with clients, project teams, and leadership stakeholders.

Preferred Technical Skills

  • Primavera P6
  • Synchro
  • Navisworks
  • Power BI
  • Microsoft Excel

The Ideal Candidate

You understand construction. You have spent time on projects, worked with field teams, and understand how schedules, work packages, constraints, and execution plans translate into real work in the field.

You are comfortable engaging with superintendents, planners, project controls professionals, construction managers, and senior project leaders. You enjoy solving complex project challenges and are motivated by helping teams plan and execute work more effectively.

You may already have experience with AWP, project controls, model-based planning, or 4D simulation. More importantly, you bring practical project execution judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn new tools and methods quickly.

About Trillium

Trillium Advisory Group, a Zachry Group Company, provides specialized advisory services in industry best practice deployment, process optimization, and digitalization for organizations and project teams seeking to enhance operational outcomes and unlock project potential.

Headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, Trillium colleagues support global project teams in their pursuit of project delivery excellence. Key areas of focus include project controls, Advanced Work Packaging, BIM, visual planning, data analytics, machine learning, and digital twinning.

Salary: $115k - $135K Annual Salary

Clinical Trial Manager - Full Service

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for site management oversight, clinical monitoring and central monitoring deliverables with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity. Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities. May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).
  • Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/CeMs) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters. Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables. Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
  • Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations. Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.
  • Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.
  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality. Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs), Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. Develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development.
  • May be assigned to larger, more complex trials or may coordinate clinical activities for a team of CTMs across a portfolio of projects
  • May coach and mentor CTMs regarding functional clinical delivery, evaluation of project risks, and action implementation.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues
  • Moderate travel may be required, approximately 20%

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

jobs.description:
Vilka är vi?

Vår vision är att vara den absolut bästa arbetsgivaren för en skicklig och ambitiös IT-konsult. Därför lägger vi stor vikt vid dig då du är det viktigaste vi har. Vi lyssnar på dig, vi arbetar för dig och vi gör vårt yttersta för att du ska må bra hos oss. Dessutom älskar vi tech, teambuilding och framförallt: att ha kul tillsammans! Klyschigt tänker du kanske? – helt sant menar vi!

Vem är du?

Ja, vem är du? Vad vill du göra? Vad brinner du för? Vi arbetar fram det uppdrag som går i linje med din plan för framtiden. Om du inte har någon plan så fixar vi en tillsammans!

Som fullstackutvecklare hos oss arbetar du vanligtvis över hela teknikstacken med alltifrån Serverless, Cloud, REST-tjänster, scripting och NoSQL-databaser till frontnära JavaScript-programmering. Några vanliga buzzwords som vi ser i våra projekt just nu är open source (såklart), Java, Kotlin, JavaScript, C#, .NET core, Node.js, Go, Git, NoSQL, Docker, Amazon AWS, Azure, Continuous Delivery, React, Vue.js, Angular, microservices, async, ReactiveX.

Vi ser gärna att du har några års arbetslivserfarenhet efter dina studier från något tekniskt universitet. Sannolikt är du systemvetare eller ingenjör. Viktigast är dock att du är en relationsbyggande person som trivs i konsultrollen.

Vad erbjuder vi?

Hos oss får du roliga uppdrag som du själv är med och styr över. Kompetensutveckling öser vi över dig och den är naturligtvis betald och individuell. Du får passionerade kollegor som gärna delar med sig av sin kunskap, och vill lära sig av dig. Kulturen är inkluderande och förutom fast lön har vi även marknadens bästa förmånspaket (ja, vi benchmarkar).

Vill du också arbeta på Sveriges bästa arbetsplats?

Ansök då med att fylla i formuläret nedan, men innan dess så kan det vara bra att veta, att intervjuerna sker på svenska så vi förutsätter att du behärskar det väl i både tal och skrift.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

The Picus Platform spans Autonomous Penetration Testing, Exposure Validation, and Breach and Attack Simulation, unified by Picus Swarm, a swarm of AI agents that runs the whole validation loop continuously. It reaches across on-prem, hybrid cloud, and endpoint environments, with 75+ integrations that ingest from scanners like Tenable and Wiz and operationalize through your EDR, SIEM, firewall, and ticketing tools.

The pioneer of Breach and Attack Simulation, Picus proves and improves the security controls you already own, doubling control effectiveness within three months. jobs.description:
Foxtrot Division is positioned at the forefront of cyber systems engineering, driven by a mission to create secure systems that empower our clients to excel in their endeavors. At the heart of our success are our people-our dedicated engineers and team members-whose expertise, creativity, and passion are the bedrock of our success. We understand that our strength lies in the collective spirit and the unique talents of our team, which is why we deeply value and invest in their growth and well-being. Our mission is rooted in transcending the ordinary, a force that unites us and propels us forward. We are not content with business as usual; we are the rockstars of our industry, challenging the status quo, and setting the pace for innovation and excellence. Our DNA-thinking deeply, speaking boldly, leading by example, and striving to be great-defines us and our approach to everything we do. At Foxtrot Division, we are committed to leading the way, ensuring that our products, services, and team members are aligned with our core purpose. Through this alignment, we aim to leave a lasting, positive impact on the world, driving us further and faster towards our vision of excellence, with our people leading the charge.
This role will directly consult with and advise customer security, architecture, infrastructure, network, cloud, and operations leaders on the design and modernization of enterprise security capabilities. The Enterprise Security Architect will translate strategic objectives and identified risks into practical target-state architectures, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps spanning secure ingress and egress, firewalls, application delivery and web application security, PKI, IAM, cloud security, encrypted traffic inspection, network visibility, SIEM, logging, and infrastructure automation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the lead architect and subject matter expert for enterprise security strategy, design, and modernization across on-premises, managed hosting, hybrid, and cloud environments.
  • Define and maintain a cohesive, layered security architecture that clearly establishes trust boundaries, control placement, security responsibilities, and where prevention, detection, response, and visibility should occur throughout the environment.
  • Establish standardized front-door patterns for externally accessible applications and services using technologies such as F5 BIG-IP, Akamai, cloud-native web application firewalls, and other approved edge-security controls.
  • Develop phased migration strategies to place existing public-facing websites and applications behind approved enterprise ingress and application-security services, including workloads hosted in data centers, managed hosting environments, Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services.
  • Identify and address direct-to-origin exposure and other paths that could allow traffic to bypass approved application delivery, certificate management, logging, or security controls.
  • Design secure and resilient enterprise ingress and egress architectures, including additional egress capabilities, security service chaining, load-balancer-based architectures, centralized certificate management, and highly available traffic-management patterns.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of border, upstream, mid-tier, and downstream firewall controls. Identify opportunities to simplify rule sets, eliminate unnecessarily permissive access, improve early-path blocking, and reduce the operational burden placed on downstream security platforms.
  • Validate whether network and application-security controls are operating as intended through architecture reviews, configuration analysis, traffic-flow validation, and telemetry assessment. Collaborate with service providers and engineering teams to identify enforcement, visibility, and ownership gaps across security layers.
  • Establish and lead an enterprise PKI architecture, including certificate authority and trust models, certificate enrollment and issuance, key protection, revocation, lifecycle management, governance, automation, and integration with enterprise and cloud-hosted systems.
  • Define enterprise IAM architecture patterns addressing authentication, authorization, identity federation, privileged access, machine and workload identities, network access control, and the integration of identity context with infrastructure and application-security controls.
  • Provide architectural oversight and hands-on technical guidance for technologies including Cisco ASA, Cisco Identity Services Engine, Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls, F5 BIG-IP, IAM platforms, web application firewalls, and related enterprise security capabilities.
  • Define reusable security architecture patterns for Azure and AWS, including secure ingress and egress, network segmentation, cloud WAF services, identity integration, certificate management, security logging, and connectivity to enterprise security platforms.
  • Provide security architecture leadership for the modernization of large-scale WAN and MPLS-based network environments, including segmentation, resiliency, routing, inspection points, traffic flows, availability requirements, and future-state security objectives.
  • Develop an enterprise strategy for encrypted traffic inspection and TLS decryption at scale. Determine appropriate inspection locations while accounting for security value, application compatibility, privacy, performance, availability, certificate handling, and exception management.
  • Define and optimize the role of Gigamon and similar network-packet-brokering technologies within the enterprise visibility architecture, including traffic collection points, filtering, replication, optimization, and distribution to SIEM, NDR, threat-hunting, and analytics platforms.
  • Lead the development of a future-state SIEM, logging, and security-telemetry architecture. Evaluate centralized logging, security data lakes, telemetry pipelines, and platforms such as Cribl while balancing security value, signal quality, scalability, retention, cost, and operational overhead.
  • Incorporate infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, configuration management, version control, automated testing, and repeatable deployment principles into enterprise security architecture and operational patterns.
  • Develop current-state and target-state architecture diagrams, security reference architectures, technical standards, data-flow diagrams, decision records, implementation guidance, and phased modernization roadmaps.
  • Communicate complex security architecture concepts, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to executive leadership, engineering teams, security operations personnel, application owners, service providers, and other technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Eight or more years of progressive experience in cybersecurity engineering, network security, cloud security, or enterprise infrastructure, including significant responsibility for enterprise-scale architecture and technical design.
  • Demonstrated experience developing security architectures for large, complex, and distributed organizations spanning on-premises, managed hosting, hybrid, and cloud environments.
  • Broad knowledge of enterprise security architecture, including network security, cloud security, application delivery, web application protection, PKI, IAM, firewalls, SIEM, security logging, threat detection, and network visibility.
  • Strong hands-on experience with F5 BIG-IP, including application delivery, load balancing, secure ingress and egress, SSL/TLS services, certificate management, traffic policy, and application-security use cases.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Cisco ASA, Cisco Identity Services Engine, and Palo Alto Networks next-generation firewalls or comparable enterprise firewall and network access-control technologies.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise network architecture, including routing, segmentation, MPLS and WAN environments, ingress and egress design, high availability, security service placement, encrypted transport, and traffic-flow analysis.
  • Experience designing security for externally accessible applications using application delivery controllers, reverse proxies, web application firewalls, edge-security services, DDoS protections, and centralized certificate-management capabilities.
  • Experience designing security architectures for Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services, including cloud networking, identity integration, cloud-native WAF services, logging, segmentation, certificate management, and hybrid connectivity.
  • In-depth understanding of enterprise PKI, including certificate authority hierarchies, trust models, digital certificates, cryptographic keys, enrollment protocols, revocation, TLS, certificate lifecycle management, and automation.
  • Experience designing IAM architectures involving authentication, authorization, federation, privileged access, machine identities, workload identities, network access control, and policy-based access enforcement.
  • Experience assessing and improving enterprise firewall policies, including rule-base analysis, policy rationalization, least-privilege enforcement, application identification, control placement, and reduction of unnecessary rule complexity.
  • Experience designing SIEM, centralized logging, network detection and response, threat-hunting, telemetry-routing, or security-data architectures.
  • Understanding of network-packet visibility and traffic-brokering architectures. Experience with Gigamon or a comparable platform is highly desirable.
  • Experience developing or supporting enterprise encrypted-traffic inspection and TLS decryption strategies.
  • Familiarity with security data pipelines, observability platforms, data-lake architectures, and telemetry-routing technologies such as Cribl or comparable platforms.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, policy automation, version control, and repeatable security deployment practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate cybersecurity strategy, business requirements, and technical risks into practical architectures, standards, implementation plans, and prioritized roadmaps.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural concepts and technical risks to both engineering and executive stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving infrastructure, network, cloud, application, security operations, vendor, and managed-service-provider teams.
  • Relevant professional certification such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, or an equivalent security, cloud, network, or architecture certification.
  • Authorization to work in the United States.

Benefits and Perks

  • Competitive salary, paid biweekly
  • $100 monthly reimbursement for cell phone and Internet
  • $3000 yearly training budget
  • Top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums covered 100% by Foxtrot Division
  • Unlimited PTO policy including 11 paid holidays
  • Parental leave
  • On-the-spot cash awards
  • Foxtrot Division sponsored events and activities

jobs.description:
Overview: Supply Chain API and Microservices Development

The Backend Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for the development, scaling, and maintenance of the core API services that power our entire integrated platform. You will build highly reliable, secure, and performant backend services within the NestJS modular monolith, focusing on critical supply chain logic, complex payment integrations, and the orchestration backbone for our AI agents.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will own the backend development for the most complex domain logic, ensuring scalability and transactional integrity.

  • API Development & Implementation: Design, develop, and deploy highly scalable APIs for all platform components using Node.js 22 and NestJS within the TypeScript modular monolith. This includes the backends for the e-commerce checkout, internal tool APIs, and the B2B portal.

  • SCM Domain Logic: Implement complex, transactional business logic within the core supply chain modules: Order Management (OMS), Warehouse Management (WMS), and Manufacturing Execution (MES). Ensure data integrity using PostgreSQL 15.

  • Integrations & Payments: Implement secure, reliable integrations with third-party payment gateways and external shipping/logistics providers.

  • Performance & Reliability: Implement effective caching strategies using Redis to boost API performance. Design and implement asynchronous processing and event-driven workflows to ensure system reliability and handle high-volume operations.

  • Security & Monitoring: Ensure all services adhere to security standards (JWT authorization, API security). Integrate backend services with the observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki) for monitoring and tracing.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess deep, hands-on experience with our core backend and data stack:

  • Core Backend: Expert proficiency in Node.js 22, NestJS, and TypeScript (mandatory).

  • Data Layer: Strong expertise in PostgreSQL 15 (schema design, query optimization) and utilizing Redis for caching.

  • Architecture: Experience designing and implementing APIs (REST/GraphQL), asynchronous communication, and event-driven patterns.

  • Workflow: Experience working within a Monorepo structure, contributing to CI/CD via Makefile, and utilizing Docker for local development.

AI Agent Focus

You will build the reliable, secure services required for AI agent orchestration.

  • Agent Orchestration: Develop the backend services and API endpoints necessary to securely orchestrate, manage, and scale the AI agent systems.

  • Data Access Services: Implement secure, high-performance services that allow AI agents (using frameworks like LangChain) to access and write necessary data to the WMS/OMS modules without compromising transactional integrity.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Service Reliability: Uptime and stability of deployed services, achieving defined SLOs.

  • Code Quality & Efficiency: Delivery of clean, well-tested, and performant code that scales effectively.

  • Feature Velocity: Timely and efficient delivery of complex backend features, particularly within the critical OMS and WMS modules.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Technical Architect or Engineering Lead, working directly with Frontend, QA, and SRE teams to deliver high-quality supply chain functionality.

Description

We're hiring a C++ developer to work primarily on engraving within the MuseScore Studio team. This is hands-on, experienced independent contributor role with lots of autonomy. You'll take on ambiguous, complex problems and see them through from design to shipping and long-term maintenance.

MuseScore Studio is free, open-source software used by millions of musicians, students, and composers worldwide, so the code you write here has a lot of impact and is used by an active community of creators around the world.

Key responsibilities

  • You'll work on the layout and rendering engine that turns musical data into beautifully typeset, readable scores. It's one of the most interesting and rewarding problems in the product: the difference between a score that looks professionally published and one that just barely conveys the notes. The team is responsible for:
  • Domain model - representation of elements of music theory as objects in code (including parts)
  • Engraving - arrangement and drawing of objects on the canvas
  • Playback - generating events for a synthesizer from objects
  • Editing - changing objects and their relationships, taking into account the rules of musical theory
  • Infrastructure - read, write to file, import, export, API, commands.

Requirements

  • Significant professional experience as software developer, including modern C++ in a large, long-lived, performance-sensitive desktop codebase.
  • Experience owning solutions end to end, from design through delivery and maintenance, not just implementing tickets.
  • Committed to code quality, with good judgment for making solid architectural decisions.
  • Experience with OOP and domain model design.
  • Able to read and understand fairly complex sheet music, with a good understanding of music theory.
  • Solid communication and collaboration, comfortable working async across a distributed, global team.
  • AI coding-savvy, applying critical thinking to discern when it is the right tool for the job
  • Attention to detail: in engraving, small inconsistencies are immediately visible to the musicians who rely on the output.
  • An eye for visual design: you know what a beautiful score looks like and care about making that happen.

Desirable

  • Hands-on experience with MuseScore Studio or a competing notation/composition tool, as a user, arranger, or composer.
  • Experience with MIDI and synthesizers
  • Experience with asynchronous and multi-threaded code
  • Experience working with fonts, with freetype
  • Experience in rendering and OpenGL

Bonus Points

  • Experience working on engraving for a music composition software or publisher

Sustainability in the NHS

Course Developer and Skills Coach

Permanent, full-time | Remote within the UK
Salary: up to £37,500 per annum, dependent on experience

Start date: Available for an immediate start

Closing date: Monday 9th November

(We may close this advert early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications. We encourage early applications.)

Bring your NHS experience into learning

Have you worked in the NHS and helped turn sustainability commitments into practical action? This is an opportunity to use that experience to shape relevant learning for NHS colleagues and support them as a Skills Coach.

Direct experience of working within the NHS is essential for this appointment. We will prioritise candidates who bring practical NHS sustainability, procurement or related operational experience, as this is the expertise we are looking to add to our team.

Join KnowledgeBrief

KnowledgeBrief is an apprenticeship and training provider helping people and organisations build the skills they need across business management. Our expertise spans leadership and management, digital, and business and professional services. Through apprenticeships, professional qualifications, workshops and coaching, we connect learning to real work, helping people make better decisions, lead change and improve organisational performance.

Our vision is a future where every organisation can turn learning into measurable performance through confident people, modern leadership and practical capability. We bring together specialist expertise, our own learning technology and personalised support to help people apply what they learn and make a meaningful difference in their roles.

We are a values-driven organisation: inspirational, innovative and authentic, with relationships at the heart of how we work. Joining KnowledgeBrief means being part of a team that values the joy of learning and cares about the impact we create for our learners, clients and each other.

About the Role

You will help adapt our established Level 4 Corporate Responsibility and Sustainability Practitioner apprenticeship for NHS and healthcare learners, then coach apprentices through the programme over the long term. Development is planned from early 2027, with a proposed spring launch.

The course framework and core curriculum are already in place. Working with the Curriculum Development and Sustainability teams, you will review the content through an NHS lens, adapting examples, workplace activities and evidence opportunities while preserving the apprenticeship standard and its knowledge, skills and behaviours.

Your understanding of NHS structures, local priorities and procurement arrangements will help learners apply the programme in their own trust, integrated care board or department. The role sits within Operations and reports to the Curriculum Team Leader.

You may currently work in NHS sustainability, procurement, estates, operations or management and be ready to move into learning and coaching. We will support you to develop your apprenticeship delivery and coaching skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and adapt learning cycles, workshops, case studies and workplace activities for different NHS settings, retaining existing content where it remains relevant.
  • Apply NHS sustainability, governance, budgets, commissioning and procurement knowledge to connect learning with employers’ Green Plans, contracts and improvement priorities.
  • Check NHS policy references and resources for accuracy, work to editorial standards and deadlines, and share your subject expertise with colleagues and employer partners.
  • Coach adult apprentices through individual learning plans, monthly one-to-one sessions and relevant workshops, adapting support to their roles and working patterns.
  • Monitor progress, provide developmental feedback and hold reviews with learners and line managers every 6–8 weeks; identify barriers early and agree practical support.
  • Help learners prepare for gateway and end-point assessment, maintain accurate progress and off-the-job learning records, and contribute to programme improvement.
  • Follow safeguarding, Prevent, equality, inclusion, funding and quality requirements, raising concerns promptly.

Interpersonal Fit

You will bring curiosity, clear communication and an approachable manner, building credibility with NHS colleagues at every level. We value people who take ownership, collaborate with stong working relationships, welcome feedback and share our commitment to the joy of learning, sustainable patient care, quality, safeguarding and inclusion.

Experience, Skills & Qualifications

Essential

  • Substantial first-hand experience working within an NHS trust, integrated care board or national NHS body in sustainability, procurement, estates and facilities, operations or management, with hands-on involvement in net zero or social value activity.
  • Experience preparing papers or business cases for senior leaders, boards or committees and managing budgets, resources or contracts within NHS governance requirements.
  • Understanding of NHS structures and governance, Green Plans, the 2040 and 2045 net zero targets, climate duties under the Health and Care Act 2022 and CQC Well-led expectations on environmental sustainability.
  • Knowledge of the Procurement Act 2023, Provider Selection Regime, NHS Net Zero Supplier Roadmap, supplier Carbon Reduction Plans and social value; an understanding of how procurement arrangements differ across NHS organisations and functions.
  • Awareness of sustainability across healthcare estates, energy, clinical waste, medicines, anaesthetic gases, travel, food, digital services and lower-carbon care pathways.
  • Understanding of corporate responsibility and sustainability, including ESG, sustainability frameworks, GHG Protocol scopes, reporting standards, stakeholder theory and risk management.
  • Ability to review and adapt learning materials, check credible evidence and meet deadlines; experience coaching, training or developing adults, facilitating workshops and giving feedback.
  • A relevant degree in health management, environmental management, sustainability, business or procurement, or equivalent professional experience; a teaching or training qualification such as the Level 3 Award in Education and Training, or willingness to achieve one.
  • Clear communication, confidence with online delivery, strong organisation and accurate record keeping; GCSE
  • English and Mathematics at grade C/4 or above, or an accepted equivalent.

Desirable

  • Experience in a Green Plan role, supporting a board-level net zero lead or working with healthcare suppliers on net zero commitments.
  • Familiarity with the Five Case Model, Core20PLUS5, NHS anchor institutions, the NHS 10 Year Health Plan, NHS charities, the NHS Social Value Playbook, Evergreen or SusQI.
  • Experience developing learning resources or delivering apprenticeships; relevant professional membership, assessor, CIPS, NHS leadership or project management qualifications; experience with learning platforms or e-portfolios.

Why Work With Us?

At KnowledgeBrief, we are committed to creating an environment where people feel supported, challenged, and able to grow.

You’ll benefit from:

  • 5.6 weeks’ annual leave
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Programme
  • Dedicated monthly CPD days on successful completion of probation
  • Two weeks’ paid time off over Christmas and New Year on successful completion of probation
  • Company sick pay on successful completion of probation
  • Opportunities to contribute to cross-team projects and organisational growth
  • A remote-first environment with opportunities to connect in person

Our Commitment to Safer Recruitment and Inclusion

KnowledgeBrief is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of learners, and all colleagues are expected to share this commitment.

Offers of employment are subject to pre-employment checks, including right to work, references, and DBS checks where appropriate.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds. Reasonable adjustments are available throughout the recruitment process.

Application Process

Submit your CV, clearly highlighting your NHS employment experience and involvement in sustainability, procurement, net zero or social value activity.

  • Initial screening with the People & Culture Team
  • Interview stage(s) with the hiring team
  • Final decision and feedback

We aim to keep the process timely, transparent, and respectful of your experience.

Ready to Apply?

If you would like to use your NHS experience to help others learn and make a practical difference, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and we will be in touch.

The Hiring Team

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer (AWS / Windows) to join our National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) team in Rockville, MD. You will use Terraform to create, modify, and automate the AWS infrastructure that hosts NIAID's Windows-based scientific and business applications.


Our ideal candidate is a senior engineer who manages infrastructure through code. You have built and maintained AWS environments in Terraform, delivered changes through Git-based pipelines, and automated the manual work that usually comes with hosting Windows applications. You are as comfortable writing a Terraform module as you are troubleshooting an application running on IIS.

As a senior member of our Cloud DevOps team, you will run and improve our existing AWS platform and help move the remaining on-prem Windows workloads into AWS. You will work closely with application owners, software developers, and security teams, own your work from design through operations, and help shape how the team builds and ships infrastructure. After-hours work is occasionally required for planned maintenance or for troubleshooting service-impacting outages.


HOW A SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

  • Create, modify, and maintain AWS infrastructure and services in Terraform. That means writing new modules and configurations, extending existing ones, and managing state across environments.
  • Deliver infrastructure changes through GitHub Actions and AWS CodeBuild pipelines, so every change is reviewed in a pull request, planned, and applied the same way every time.
  • Build and maintain the AWS environment that hosts Windows Server and IIS applications running .NET, including EC2, load balancers, AWS WAF, Route 53, IAM, and TLS certificates, all defined in Terraform.
  • Migrate on-prem Windows applications into AWS and improve them once they land, including moving applications into containers on Amazon ECS where it makes sense.
  • Automate routine operational work such as certificate renewal, service account credential rotation, patching, and service restarts, using Terraform, PowerShell, and AWS Systems Manager. Where possible, turn these tasks into self-service options for application owners.
  • Troubleshoot problems across the application and infrastructure layers (IIS, .NET, networking, and AWS services) and fix the root cause in code rather than by hand.
  • Build and tune monitoring with Amazon CloudWatch and native AWS observability services, including metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards, and the CloudWatch agent on Windows servers, all defined in Terraform. Set service level objectives and alerts so the team hears about real problems before users do.
  • Work with the security team to remediate vulnerabilities and apply hardening standards to Windows servers and AWS resources.
  • Review teammates' Terraform and pipeline changes, share what works, and help shape the team's standards for infrastructure as code and deployments.

Required Experience:

  • BA/BS and 7+ years of related IT experience, or equivalent experience. This must include 3+ years of hands-on DevOps or cloud engineering in AWS supporting production workloads.
  • 3+ years using Terraform to create, modify, and automate AWS infrastructure, including writing modules, safely changing existing configurations, and managing remote state.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines that deploy infrastructure changes, using GitHub Actions, AWS CodeBuild, or similar tools, with Git branching and pull request workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with core AWS services, including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, Elastic Load Balancing, Route 53, and Systems Manager.
  • Experience implementing monitoring with Amazon CloudWatch, including metrics, logs, alarms, and dashboards, and collecting Windows and IIS logs and metrics with the CloudWatch agent.
  • 3+ years supporting Windows Server and IIS environments that host .NET applications, including deployment, configuration, TLS certificates, and troubleshooting.
  • Strong PowerShell scripting skills, plus working knowledge of Python or Bash.
  • Ability to work independently on complex problems and to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain an NIH Public Trust.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience migrating Windows and .NET applications from on-prem infrastructure to AWS.
  • Experience containerizing applications and running them on Amazon ECS.
  • Experience with Application and Network Load Balancers, AWS WAF, CloudFront, and Route 53 routing policies.
  • Experience with AWS Secrets Manager or Parameter Store and AWS Certificate Manager, including automated rotation of credentials and certificates.
  • Patch and configuration automation using SSM Patch Manager and State Manager, or PowerShell DSC.
  • Datadog experience, including dashboards, SLO design, and alert tuning.
  • Experience with additional AWS observability services, such as CloudTrail, EventBridge, AWS X-Ray, or CloudWatch Synthetics.
  • Familiarity with Amazon RDS for SQL Server from the hosting side, such as connectivity, backups, and migrations.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, or AWS Solutions Architect certification.

jobs.description:
Come join a growing financial technology company that's leading the marketplace in both the marketing and servicing of credit cards! Continental Finance Company specializes in credit card options for consumers with less than perfect credit.

We are seeking a creative UI Developer with a passion for building intuitive, polished user experiences to support our Technology team. We are seeking a UI Developer with strong experience in React, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, and front-end architecture. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining responsive, accessible, high-performance user interfaces for our customer-facing and internal applications. You'll work closely with product, design, and back-end engineers (who work primarily in .NET Core and AWS) to turn ideas into seamless digital experiences. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced setting, can work independently, has a strong eye for detail, and contributes to front-end architecture and UI standards across teams. This position will play a key role in shaping how millions of customers interact with our financial services products.

Essential Functions

  • Design, develop, and maintain modern, responsive web applications using React, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Build reusable, well-structured component libraries and contribute to a consistent design system.
  • Translate wireframes, mockups, and design specs (e.g., Figma) into pixel-accurate, accessible user interfaces.
  • Manage application state and data flow using tools such as Redux, React Query, Context, or similar.
  • Integrate front-end applications with RESTful APIs and microservices built on .NET Core and AWS.
  • Optimize applications for performance, responsiveness, and cross-browser/cross-device compatibility.
  • Ensure UI accessibility (WCAG) and usability best practices are followed.
  • Contribute to mobile experiences using React Native as needed.
  • Implement secure front-end coding practices aligned with financial services industry standards.
  • Participate in front-end architecture discussions and help define UI standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with product, design, business, and cross-functional technical teams.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code, including unit and component tests (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or similar).
  • Troubleshoot production issues and provide technical leadership on UI-related matters when needed. Required

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of professional software development experience, with a strong focus on front-end/UI development. • Expert-level experience with React, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript.
  • Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and modern styling approaches (Sass, CSS-in-JS, Tailwind, or similar).
  • Experience building responsive, mobile-first, and accessible web applications.
  • Experience consuming and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • Familiarity with front-end build tools and workflows (Webpack, Vite, npm/yarn).
  • Experience with front-end testing frameworks and practices.
  • Experience using Git and Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Strong knowledge of front-end security best practices (XSS, CSRF, secure authentication flows).
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with React Native for mobile application development.
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET Core to collaborate effectively with back-end teams.
  • Exposure to AWS services (S3, CloudFront, Lambda, etc.).
  • Experience with Next.js or other React frameworks.
  • Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library.
  • Background in financial services or other regulated industries.

Why Continental Finance?

Continental Finance Company (the “CFC”) is one of America's leading marketers and servicers of credit cards for consumers with less-than-perfect credit. Since our founding in 2005, we have prided ourselves on corporate responsibility to customers in terms of a strong customer support program and fair treatment. With our success, we have also grown into an innovative financial tech company! With a state-of-the-art consumer marketing and servicing platform, we provide a variety of services to consumers when other financial institutions will not accommodate them. With more than 2.6 million credit cards managed and serviced since our founding, we pride ourselves on putting the customer first. We are not a chartered banking financial institution, nor are we a debt originator or a credit card issuer.

jobs.description:
Location: United States (Remote, Eastern Coast)

About LemonEdge

LemonEdge is a next-generation accounting platform purpose-built for private capital markets. Our technology gives fund administrators and asset managers the tools to automate complexity, improve transparency, build trust, and scale faster. With strong early traction in North America and EMEA, we are now entering our next phase of growth focused on customer expansion, operational discipline, and world-class client experience.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer at LemonEdge, you’ll own meaningful parts of our accounting platform, from data model to production. You’ll design and ship the features and services that move fund operations from manual and fragile to automated and dependable, and you’ll have the latitude to fix what’s in the way, whether that’s a performance bottleneck, a test gap, or architecture that has outlived its usefulness.

You’ll be building alongside a market in the middle of real change. Private capital is growing fast, and the way funds are created, administered, and managed is being rebuilt around modern software rather than spreadsheets and systems designed for a different era. LemonEdge is purpose-built for that shift, and what you ship goes straight to the fund administrators and asset managers who run on it. The engineering is hard and the impact is visible: your work changes how an entire industry operates.

The financial logic must be exactly right, the platform needs to hold up at real scale, and customers feel every improvement you make. You’ll be trusted to keep a living codebase healthy, not just to build on it. We use AI-assisted development pragmatically and with clear guardrails, and you’ll help shape how the team puts it to work.

LemonEdge is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in the United States who can work core Eastern Time hours. Expect occasional travel for team and customer onsites, typically up to four times per year. The role participates in an engineering on-call rotation, which is light and infrequent.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and ship features and services on the LemonEdge platform end-to-end — from data model and API design through testing, deployment, and production operation.
  • Identify and implement high-impact improvements: performance baselines, reliability hardening, refactoring of high-traffic paths, and optimizing data-access patterns the rest of the platform sits on.
  • Partner with Product, Client Success, and peer engineering teams to scope work, own delivery of committed customer-visible milestones across the quarterly roadmap, and surface trade-offs and risks early rather than late.
  • Work directly with technical and subject-matter accounting experts both internally and from our clients to shape the solution and rapidly iterate on their feedback.
  • Raise the engineering bar through thorough code review, design feedback, and mentoring of mid-level engineers toward production ownership.
  • Leverage agentic coding tools pragmatically in your day-to-day work, and expand the safe operating patterns that make AI-accelerated delivery trustworthy such as automated test coverage at PR time, regression prevention, validation of generated code, and norms for where AI output can and cannot yet be trusted.
  • Champion supportability and customer experience: strong observability, disciplined incident response, SLA adherence, and a proactive posture on defects rather than a reactive one.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years building production software, with a track record of shipping non-trivial systems on committed timelines.
  • Strong technical depth in a modern server-side stack. Working experience with .NET / C# is strongly preferred; we will consider candidates with equivalent depth in another typed, managed-runtime ecosystem who can ramp quickly.
  • Demonstrated success improving an existing platform at scale; you are energized by making a living codebase faster, safer, and easier to change, not only by greenfield work.
  • Comfort across the full delivery lifecycle: data modeling, API design, testing strategy, CI/CD, observability, and production operations in a cloud-hosted SaaS environment.
  • Working fluency with AI-assisted development tools, paired with the judgment to know where they accelerate you and where they cannot yet be trusted.
  • A high bar for quality: you own every line of code you ship, you write tests as a habit rather than an obligation, and you hold the line on regression prevention.
  • Self-direction and pragmatism; you can take an ambiguous problem, scope it honestly, and drive it to a shipped outcome without waiting to be unblocked.
  • Strong written communication and a collaborative working style that holds up across engineering, product, and client-facing teams in a distributed company.

Nice to Have

  • Experience operating SaaS systems on Kubernetes or a comparable cloud-native platform — observability, on-call practice, cloud cost awareness.
  • Background in fintech, fund administration, partnership accounting, or another domain with non-trivial financial logic and audit expectations.
  • Experience defining team-level guardrails for AI-assisted development — usage policies, evaluation of generated code, prompt and context practices, or building LLM-backed product capabilities safely.
  • Experience contributing to a platform migration, modernization, or re-architecture while continuing to deliver value to existing customers.
  • Experience operating in an early-stage or high-growth environment where shape and process are still being defined.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision
  • Remote work options
  • 401(k) plan with employer contributions
  • Paid time off
  • Generous parental and family leave policies
  • Challenging problems to tackle with a supportive, entrepreneurially driven team
  • A strong work culture centered on integrity, excellence, and transparency

Equal Opportunity Employer

LemonEdge is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fair and equitable hiring practices. All hiring decisions are based on strategic business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications — without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
