jobs.description:
Position Summary

Scicom Infrastructure Services is seeking aDatabricks Data Operations Specialistto support the operational stability, reliability, performance, and security of a large-scale Databricks data platform.

This role will work as part of a multidisciplinary Databricks team that includes data engineers, architects, business analysts, governance specialists, and technical managers. The Data Operations Specialist will be responsible for monitoring production data pipelines, responding to incidents, troubleshooting platform and data-processing issues, coordinating deployments, and ensuring that data products meet established availability, quality, and service-level requirements.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience operating Databricks environments and supporting production data workloads using Apache Spark, Delta Lake, SQL, Python, cloud infrastructure, monitoring tools, and automated deployment practices.

Key Responsibilities

Databricks Platform Operations

  • Monitor the health, availability, performance, and capacity of Databricks workspaces, jobs, pipelines, clusters, SQL warehouses, and related cloud services.
  • Provide day-to-day operational support for production Databricks environments.
  • Monitor scheduled and event-driven data pipelines for failures, delays, data-quality issues, and performance degradation.
  • Troubleshoot Databricks jobs, Spark workloads, cluster failures, notebook errors, connectivity issues, and data-processing exceptions.
  • Restart, rerun, recover, or coordinate remediation of failed workflows according to documented procedures.
  • Support Databricks Workflows, Lakeflow, Delta Live Tables, Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, and batch-processing workloads.
  • Review driver and executor logs, Spark UI metrics, cluster event logs, audit logs, and application telemetry to identify root causes.
  • Support configuration and maintenance of Databricks clusters, serverless compute, instance pools, cluster policies, and SQL warehouses.
  • Monitor resource utilization and recommend changes to cluster sizing, autoscaling, workload scheduling, and compute policies.
  • Help maintain consistent configurations across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
  • Support platform upgrades, runtime-version changes, library updates, and configuration changes.
  • Coordinate with Databricks support and cloud-service providers when vendor assistance is required.

Production Pipeline Support

  • Monitor ETL, ELT, streaming, API, and file-based data-integration processes.
  • Validate that scheduled data loads complete within required processing windows.
  • Investigate missing, late, duplicated, incomplete, or inconsistent data.
  • Perform controlled data reprocessing, backfills, reconciliation, and recovery activities.
  • Support ingestion and transformation processes involving JSON, CSV, XML, Parquet, APIs, databases, message queues, and cloud storage.
  • Monitor Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers within a medallion architecture.
  • Validate source-to-target record counts, control totals, schema consistency, and business-rule compliance.
  • Coordinate with data engineers to resolve recurring pipeline or transformation defects.
  • Maintain operational runbooks for common failures, recovery procedures, escalation paths, and recurring support tasks.
  • Ensure production interventions are documented and performed in accordance with change-control procedures.

Incident and Problem Management

  • Serve as a first or second level of support for production Databricks and data-pipeline incidents.
  • Triage incidents based on severity, business impact, affected systems, and service-level commitments.
  • Coordinate incident response among engineering, cloud, security, governance, and business teams.
  • Provide timely status updates during active incidents.
  • Escalate issues to technical leads, architects, vendors, or program leadership when appropriate.
  • Conduct or support root-cause analyses for production incidents.
  • Document incident timelines, contributing factors, corrective actions, and preventive measures.
  • Track recurring problems and recommend permanent engineering or process improvements.
  • Participate in post-incident reviews and ensure assigned corrective actions are completed.
  • Help develop automated remediation for common operational failures.
  • Maintain incident, problem, and service-request records in the organization’s ticketing system.

Monitoring and Observability

  • Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and operational reports for Databricks and associated data services.
  • Monitor job success rates, pipeline latency, processing duration, cluster utilization, data freshness, data quality, and compute consumption.
  • Configure actionable alerts that minimize unnecessary notifications while identifying material operational issues.
  • Integrate Databricks monitoring data with enterprise observability platforms.
  • Support tools such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, or comparable platforms.
  • Define operational health indicators, service-level indicators, and service-level objectives.
  • Produce daily, weekly, and monthly operational metrics for program leadership.
  • Identify performance trends and operational risks before they result in production failures.
  • Maintain dashboards showing system availability, incident volume, recovery time, pipeline status, and data freshness.

Data Quality and Data Contract Operations

  • Monitor compliance with established data contracts between data producers and consumers.
  • Validate schema, field, data-type, frequency, freshness, completeness, and quality requirements.
  • Detect schema drift, unexpected source-system changes, and contract violations.
  • Coordinate resolution of data-contract issues with business analysts, data owners, and engineering teams.
  • Execute automated and manual data-quality controls.
  • Monitor data-quality rules related to accuracy, completeness, uniqueness, consistency, validity, and timeliness.
  • Track exceptions and ensure data-quality issues are assigned to the appropriate owner.
  • Support reconciliation of contracting, procurement, financial, and operational datasets.
  • Assist with validation of data structured according to the Open Contracting Data Standard when applicable.
  • Maintain operational evidence supporting data quality, lineage, audit, and governance requirements.

Deployment and Change Management

  • Support the release and deployment of Databricks notebooks, jobs, workflows, libraries, configurations, and infrastructure changes.
  • Coordinate deployments across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
  • Verify deployment readiness, approvals, testing results, dependencies, and rollback plans.
  • Participate in release validation and post-deployment monitoring.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or comparable tools.
  • Assist with infrastructure-as-code deployments using Terraform or similar technologies.
  • Maintain deployment logs, implementation records, configuration documentation, and release notes.
  • Ensure emergency changes follow established approval and documentation requirements.
  • Support environment comparisons and investigate configuration drift.
  • Coordinate production changes with technical and business stakeholders to minimize operational disruption.

Security, Access, and Governance Support

  • Support Databricks identity, access, and entitlement administration.
  • Assist with user onboarding, offboarding, group membership, workspace permissions, and service-principal access.
  • Support Unity Catalog permissions, catalogs, schemas, tables, volumes, external locations, and storage credentials.
  • Apply role-based and least-privilege access-control principles.
  • Monitor access failures, unusual activity, audit events, and policy violations.
  • Coordinate access requests with security, governance, and data-ownership teams.
  • Support secret management through Databricks secrets, Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or comparable services.
  • Maintain operational documentation supporting security reviews and audits.
  • Assist with data retention, archival, backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery procedures.
  • Ensure production-support activities comply with applicable security and privacy requirements.

Cost and Performance Management

  • Monitor Databricks and cloud-resource consumption.
  • Identify idle, oversized, inefficient, or improperly configured compute resources.
  • Analyze job duration, cluster utilization, query performance, storage consumption, and workload patterns.
  • Recommend cluster right-sizing, autoscaling, scheduling, caching, partitioning, and workload-isolation improvements.
  • Support implementation of compute policies, tagging standards, budgets, and cost alerts.
  • Produce usage and cost reports for technical and program leadership.
  • Work with engineers and architects to reduce unnecessary compute consumption.
  • Track the operational impact of optimization initiatives.

Documentation and Continuous Improvement

  • Create and maintain operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, escalation matrices, and support runbooks.
  • Document platform configurations, dependencies, schedules, service accounts, integrations, and recovery requirements.
  • Maintain an accurate inventory of production jobs, pipelines, data products, and system interfaces.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive monitoring, support, recovery, and reporting activities.
  • Participate in operational-readiness reviews for new data products and pipelines.
  • Ensure new solutions include appropriate monitoring, alerts, logging, support procedures, and ownership assignments before production deployment.
  • Share lessons learned and common troubleshooting practices across the Databricks team.
  • Contribute to platform standards, operational policies, and continuous-improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, data engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • At least four years of experience in data operations, production support, data engineering, cloud operations, DevOps, platform support, or a related technical role.
  • At least two years of hands-on experience supporting Databricks environments or production Databricks workloads.
  • Experience supporting production ETL, ELT, batch, or streaming data pipelines.
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Databricks
    • Apache Spark
    • PySpark or Python
    • SQL
    • Delta Lake
    • Databricks Workflows or Jobs
    • Cloud object storage
    • Data pipeline monitoring
    • Log analysis and troubleshooting
  • Experience investigating failed jobs, delayed pipelines, schema issues, data discrepancies, and performance problems.
  • Familiarity with medallion architecture and Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience using ticketing and service-management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or a comparable platform.
  • Experience with monitoring, alerting, logging, or observability tools.
  • Understanding of incident, problem, change, and release-management processes.
  • Ability to write and maintain technical procedures and operational documentation.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineers, business analysts, architects, security teams, and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Ability to support multiple production priorities in a structured and timely manner.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional.

This is a remote position.

Power BI Adoption Lead

Most Power BI roles ask you to build what someone else has already specified. This one asks you to decide how an entire enterprise uses Power BI — and then to make it happen.

A leading UK financial services organisation is standing up a modern cloud data platform, with Power BI as the strategic reporting layer on top of it. The governed semantic layer, certified datasets, enterprise design standards and community of practice are still being shaped — and the organisation is serious enough about data capability to have already invested in it. You will decide what good looks like, and own it end to end.

This is deliberately not a pure Power BI developer role, and equally not a change-management role. It is the rarer combination: someone who can build a performant enterprise semantic model, credibly challenge a developer's DAX, then stand in front of the business and teach it.

What you'll do

  • Own the enterprise Power BI adoption roadmap, with measurable adoption and value targets.
  • Build engagement from the ground up: stakeholder buy-in, a champions network, forums, clinics and a genuine community of practice.
  • Design and personally deliver structured training — workshops, learning materials and guidance, pitched from Excel-refugee to seasoned analyst.
  • Shape the governed semantic layer alongside data engineering: consistent KPI definitions, certification processes, naming conventions and refresh strategy.
  • Author the enterprise reporting Design Guide — standards, templates, palettes, UX conventions — and hold the organisation to it.
  • Establish workspace governance: deployment pipelines, Dev/QA/Prod design, RLS/CLS, sensitivity labelling and auditability.
  • Build and optimise flagship dashboards yourself, and troubleshoot performance where others are stuck.
  • Reduce duplicated, ungoverned reporting — and prove you have.

Requirements

Essential experience

  • Power BI technical depth — you have personally delivered enterprise-scale Power BI. Advanced DAX, Power Query/M, semantic model design and optimisation, large and complex datasets, workspace strategy and administration, RLS, certified datasets. You can coach on all of it and push back on poor implementation.
  • Adoption & change leadership — you have created an enterprise adoption roadmap, run champion networks, driven cultural change around data-driven decision making, and measured adoption and business value. This is the most critical dimension of the role.
  • Training & enablement — you have designed and personally delivered structured training programmes and built the materials yourself. Occasional knowledge-sharing is not what we mean.
  • Governance & operating model — reporting standards, dashboard design principles, workspace management, certified dataset processes and self-service controls. You know how to scale Power BI without creating a governance problem.

Desirable

  • Microsoft Fabric — architecture, capacity and medallion/lakehouse patter
  • Power Apps, ideally integrated with Power BI.
  • Sensitive, confidential or regulated data; Azure exposure; PL-300 and/or

Interview process

Shortlisted candidates will prepare a maximum of two PowerPoint slides on their approach to enterprise Power BI adoption, and demo a Power BI dashboard they personally designed and built on a dataset of their choice — covering the business problem, auorytelling, accessibility and how they would drive ongoing usage. Format and style are entirely your own.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism.
jobs.description:
ABOUT 321 THE AGENCY

321 is a full-funnel creative agency built for brands that operate in complex, regulated industries — healthcare, insurance, legal services, home services, entertainment, and travel and tourism. We're a remote, AI-first team that combines strategic creative with CRM infrastructure, performance marketing, and paid media to drive real, measurable business outcomes for our clients.

Technology is central to how 321 competes and grows. From our CRM and automation programs to 321 AIM, our proprietary performance marketing platform, the systems we build are a core part of the value we deliver. The Chief Technology Officer is the executive who sets the vision for that technology and turns it into a lasting competitive advantage.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Chief Technology Officer at 321, you will own the agency's technology vision, strategy, and execution at the executive level. This is a C-suite role with company-wide authority — you'll shape how 321 builds, buys, secures, and monetizes technology, lead the technology organization, and help define the agency's direction as a member of the executive leadership team.

The right person for this role thinks in platforms and business models, not just systems. You understand that the right architecture decisions compound over years, that proprietary technology and data can become defensible products, and that AI is reshaping what an agency can deliver and how it should be priced. You're as comfortable advising on a High Level or Salesforce architecture as you are presenting a multi-year technology strategy to ownership, investors, or enterprise clients — and you build the organization that executes it.

You'll provide executive technology leadership in partnership with 321 AIM, guiding platform architecture, scalability, and roadmap decisions so that our proprietary technology and client service delivery grow together.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Executive Leadership & Technology Vision

  • Define and own the agency's multi-year technology vision and strategy, aligned with company growth goals, service offerings, and market positioning
  • Serve as a member of the executive leadership team, contributing to company strategy, annual planning, and major business decisions
  • Own the technology budget, including platform, licensing, infrastructure, and headcount investments, with clear return-on-investment expectations
  • Lead build-versus-buy-versus-partner decisions for major platforms and capabilities
  • Report on technology performance, risk, and investment outcomes to ownership and, where applicable, investors or a board

Technology Organization & Talent

  • Build, lead, and scale the technology organization, including the Director of Technology and teams spanning CRM/MarTech, integrations, data, AI, and systems administration
  • Design the organizational structure, leadership roles, and hiring plan needed to support the agency's growth
  • Set the culture, engineering standards, and operating principles for how technology is built, shipped, and supported across the agency
  • Develop leaders within the technology organization through coaching, succession planning, and clear career paths

Proprietary Platforms & Product Strategy

  • Provide executive technology leadership for 321 AIM in partnership with its leadership, guiding platform architecture, scalability, reliability, and roadmap priorities
  • Identify opportunities to turn repeatable agency solutions, data assets, and automations into proprietary products, platforms, or productized services
  • Oversee product development practices, including requirements, release management, quality assurance, and technical documentation
  • Protect and grow the agency's technology intellectual property

AI Strategy & Innovation

  • Set the company-wide AI strategy, positioning 321 as a leader in AI-powered marketing, CRM, and performance services
  • Govern responsible AI use, including data privacy, model selection, accuracy standards, and client disclosure practices
  • Lead the evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies that create new service lines, improve margins, or strengthen client outcomes
  • Partner with department leaders to embed AI into creative, paid media, CRM, reporting, and agency operations

Enterprise Architecture, Security & Risk

  • Own the agency's enterprise architecture across internal systems, client platforms, data infrastructure, and integrations
  • Lead the information security program, including policies, access management, vendor risk, incident response, and business continuity
  • Ensure agency and client technology meets regulatory and contractual requirements in healthcare, insurance, legal, and other regulated industries, including HIPAA, business associate agreements, TCPA, GDPR, and CCPA
  • Guide the agency toward formal security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 as client and growth needs require

Data Strategy & Measurement

  • Define the agency's data strategy, including how client, campaign, and performance data is collected, governed, stored, and used
  • Oversee the measurement and attribution infrastructure that connects marketing activity to closed revenue for clients
  • Build the data foundation needed to support performance-based pricing, benchmarking, and predictive insights across the client portfolio

Client, Partner & Agency Growth

  • Serve as the agency's senior technology executive with clients, partners, and prospects — including CMO, CIO, and ownership-level audiences
  • Lead the technology narrative in new business pitches, RFP responses, and strategic client relationships
  • Build and manage strategic technology partnerships with platforms such as High Level, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google, and Meta
  • Lead technical due diligence for partnerships, acquisitions, or major client engagements as the agency grows

WHAT YOU HAVE

  • 12+ years of experience in technology leadership, with demonstrated depth in MarTech, CRM architecture, data infrastructure, and platform or product development — agency, MarTech, or SaaS experience strongly preferred
  • At least 5 years in an executive or senior technology leadership role (CTO, VP of Technology or Engineering, or Director overseeing multiple teams), including building and scaling technology organizations
  • Proven track record of setting technology strategy and delivering measurable business results, including revenue growth, margin improvement, or new product lines
  • Experience leading the development of proprietary platforms or software products, from architecture and roadmap through launch and scale
  • Deep understanding of CRM and marketing automation ecosystems — High Level strongly preferred; Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and HubSpot also valued
  • Strong command of enterprise architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure), APIs, integrations, and data platforms
  • Experience leading security and compliance programs in regulated industries, including HIPAA; SOC 2 or similar framework experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated leadership in AI strategy and adoption, including LLM-powered products or workflows, with sound judgment on governance and responsible use
  • Experience owning technology budgets, vendor strategy, and build-versus-buy decisions
  • Executive-level communication skills — able to present technology strategy to ownership, investors, boards, and enterprise clients with clarity and credibility
  • Comfort operating in a fast-growing, remote, multi-client environment with competing priorities
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrated experience; advanced degree a plus

REPORTING STRUCTURE

The Chief Technology Officer reports directly to the CEO and is a member of the agency's executive leadership team. This role leads the full technology organization, including the Director of Technology and teams spanning CRM/MarTech, integrations, data, AI, and systems administration. The CTO partners with 321 AIM leadership on platform strategy and works closely with the SVP of Strategy, Director of Digital Marketing, Director of Client Strategy, and Creative Director to align technology with client delivery and agency growth.

COMPENSATION

Salary Range: $120K+ annually, based on experience

321 uses a structured compensation framework aligned to role scope, company impact, and agency revenue contribution. Salary placement within range is based on demonstrated executive experience, organizational leadership, and a track record of technology-driven business results. The Solution Architect is a strategic leadership role responsible for defining the complete, end-to-end technical architecture for our integrated supply chain e-commerce platform.   • Data/Storage: PostgreSQL 15 (RLS), Redis, Meilisearch, MinIO

  • DevOps/Infra: Terraform, Docker, Traefik, pgBackRest

  • Security/Auth: Authentik/Ory Kratos, Vault

AI Agent Focus

You will architect the platform for integrating advanced AI capabilities into our operational systems.

  • Framework Integration: Define best practices for production AI agents utilizing frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen.

jobs.excerpt: ​Job Description - Senior Software Engineer Reports To - Engineering ManagerSummaryAxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote Senior Software Engineer to help us build, ship, and maintain the market-leading SaaS platform powering the home care industry, and to help us reimagine how software gets made in the age of AI.
jobs.description:
​

Job Description - Senior Software Engineer

Reports To - Engineering Manager

Summary

AxisCare is hiring a full-time, fully remote Senior Software Engineer to help us build, ship, and maintain the market-leading SaaS platform powering the home care industry, and to help us reimagine how software gets made in the age of AI.

We're no longer building the car by hand, so to speak. We're building the factory that makes great cars, with humans in the loop where the human touch matters most. (Read more about how we think AI is changing product development.)

We're looking for engineers who've already internalized this shift. Engineers who push AI tools to their breaking point, then push again three months later when the models improve. Engineers who move from idea to working software in hours instead of weeks, and who bring the judgment to know when the output is actually good.

There will always be a need for people who deeply understand our customers' most important problems, solve them with high-quality software, and run that software reliably in production. That's the work that endures, and that's the work we're hiring for.

What You'll Do

Collaborate with product leaders to spike on possibilities and prototype aggressively, often putting working software in front of stakeholders before the old process would have finished a PRD, then quickly iterate from there.

Mentor junior and mid-level engineers in code design, systems thinking, and driving AI agents effectively: when to trust output, when to throw it out, and how to maintain code quality when the machine is doing the typing.

Write backend business logic, extend our API, integrate with third-party services, build frontend UI, and tackle issues throughout the codebase. All using AI fluently as a force multiplier, not a crutch.

Improve system performance and resilience, upgrade our tech stack, and go after the pipe dreams that used to be too expensive to try.

Own what you ship in production. Home care agencies rely on our software to run their business every day, so we instrument, observe, and debug what we build. We treat reliability as a first-class feature, not an afterthought.

What We're Looking For

A product-minded engineer who deeply interrogates user problems before jumping to solutions. AI makes it dangerously easy to build the wrong thing quickly.

A systems thinker who looks beyond the element at hand to the broader system and the dynamics at play within it.

An AI power user with substance. You've moved past "I tried Cursor once." You drive agents to carry out real intent on real codebases, have opinions about where today's models break down drawn from real experience, and have habits for catching those failures before they ship.

A quality-conscious builder. High-quality software is both valuable to the business now and easy to change later. AI lets us change software quickly, which makes the "easy to change later" part more important than ever.

A strong writer. Remote work demands it, clear writing is clear thinking, and clear thinking is how you get the biggest impact from AI.

A team lead for 1–2 engineers, but also fully capable of taking substantial features from concept to completion solo.

Experience required:

  • 5+ years as a professional software engineer on teams building full stack cloud-native web apps. Ideally with PHP, but any object-oriented language works too.
  • React apps in TypeScript
  • Experience building well-structured, readily comprehensible, easily maintainable software that balances practicality with elegance
  • MySQL, using both PHP-based ORMs and raw SQL
  • Designing and building RESTful APIs, and integrating with third-party APIs
  • Able to work remotely from the Eastern, Central, or Mountain time zones
  • Qualified to work in the United States or Canada

What We'd Be Excited to Find

  • Experience building HIPAA-compliant software
  • Experience with EMR/EHR systems used in clinical care
  • Concrete examples of AI-enabled workflows you've built that meaningfully changed how your team ships. Custom agents, evals, prompt libraries, internal tooling, etc.

Working Conditions

  • Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals

Compensation and Equipment

  • Salary (TBD based on job experience and skill level)
  • Medical insurance is covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental and Vision)
  • Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment

How to Apply

Apply with a brief resume and either a written or video cover letter.

We review the cover letter before anything else in your application, so this really matters. This is your single biggest opportunity to improve your chances, and video submissions go right to the front of the line.

Prompt: Tell us about something you're proud to have built. Tell us how AI has changed the way you work in the last six to twelve months with specific examples. Tell us why this position is the one you've been hoping to find.

Written: No more than 600 words. We're looking for clarity of thought and strong communication. Use AI if you want, but don't send slop.

Video: 1–2 minutes, linked in the "Website, Blog, or Portfolio" section of your application. Doesn't need to be highly produced. We care about how you think and communicate.

We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds and every walk of life to apply. Every person on our team brings their own unique perspective, and it’s what makes our products better and our work more rewarding. We’re eager to support you so that you can ship work you’re proud of.

Candidates only. No recruiters, please.

About AxisCare

According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non-medical (also referred to as non-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.

AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more user-friendly and mobile-compatible solution. Our product is a web-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 6 other countries. We are a fast-growing company seeking high-performing individuals looking for a fast-paced, autonomous working environment.

jobs.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We are looking for an experienced and versatile software engineer to work on the tools and systems that support Firefox engineering.

This is a broad software engineering role spanning internal engineering systems, developer tooling, workflow automation, and the infrastructure required to operate them. We are looking for an engineer with strong software development skills and meaningful experience deploying and operating production systems.

Our Cloud Engineering teams provide shared platforms and foundational services, while engineering teams own the applications and services they run on them. A key part of this role is helping teams succeed in that model by solving difficult operational problems, establishing standards and patterns, and building tooling and automation that makes systems easier to operate. You will also contribute directly to the software, tools, and systems that support Firefox engineering.

You will work across projects and technical domains, joining teams or existing efforts when needed and independently taking on problems that require focused ownership.

We build in the open. Open source is fundamental to how we work, and contributing back to the broader open-source ecosystem is an important part of the role.

What you'll do:
  • Design, build, deploy, and operate software and systems supporting Firefox engineering.
  • Contribute to developer tooling, CI/CD, workflow automation, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Own complex technical problems end-to-end across software, cloud, and operational layers, improving reliability, performance, observability, and cost efficiency.
  • Work with Firefox engineering, Cloud Engineering, IT, and other teams to solve problems that span technical and organizational boundaries.
  • Use telemetry, metrics, and data analysis to investigate problems and guide engineering decisions.
  • Contribute to architecture and technical strategy, identifying recurring problems and solutions that can be applied across teams.
What you'll bring:

Strong software engineering skills and substantial hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems are core requirements for this role. We do not expect you to be an expert in every technology or domain listed below.

  • Strong programming skills in languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with C++ or Rust is useful.
  • Experience building and deploying and operating production systems in cloud environments, including utilizing infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Experience across several areas such as CI/CD, containers and orchestration, networking, databases, observability, or developer tooling.
  • Experience using data, telemetry, and metrics to investigate technical problems and make decisions.
  • Familiarity with modern AI-assisted development tools and an understanding of their capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use.
How you work:
  • You are comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems and getting them into a sustainable state.
  • You enjoy moving across projects and technical domains, taking ownership of problems and looking for patterns that make the next one easier to solve.
  • You work effectively across disciplines and can translate between software, infrastructure, and operational concerns.
  • You combine hands-on engineering with systems thinking and longer-term technical judgment.
  • You communicate openly, consistently, and respectfully, and enjoy teaching and helping others build skills in unfamiliar technical areas.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. jobs.description:
AI Product Engineer (Full-Stack)

Location: Remote (India-based), Bengaluru preferred, with daily overlap with our UK and US teams

Engagement Type: Contract-to-hire, 3 months then ongoing

Reports to: CEO

About MarcoPolo Learning

MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.

Backed by top-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion & Coach for early-learning educators.

Role Overview

We’re looking for an AI Product Engineer who builds with AI by default and cares deeply about the product. You’ll partner closely with our CEO to shape and move Audrey forward. You’ll turn ideas into clear decisions, then build them end to end alongside a small, collaborative engineering team.

This role suits someone who leads through clarity and trust, brings people with them, and helps the whole team do its best work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with the CEO on product direction: shape priorities, test assumptions, and turn ideas into clear, buildable plans.
  • Design and build AI features end to end, including prompts and agents, retrieval, and the experience around them.
  • Put evaluation and testing in place so AI quality is measurable and keeps improving.
  • Ship full-stack features across front end, back end and cloud deployment.
  • Work hand in hand with fellow engineers: share context, pair on problems, and help everyone get more from AI tools.
  • Communicate progress, risks and trade-offs early and clearly.
  • Build with privacy and safety in mind, including FERPA/COPPA alignment.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • First 30 days: learn the product, the teachers who use it and the team; get hands-on and ship a first improvement.
  • By 60 days: own a meaningful part of the AI experience and deliver improvements on agreed timelines.
  • By 90 days: help shape the next phase of the product roadmap with the CEO.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5–8 years of full-stack software engineering: React/TypeScript front end; Node.js or Python back end; AWS.
  • You’ve personally built and shipped at least one production LLM application used by real users. What you’ve built matters more to us than years on a résumé.
  • Hands-on experience with prompt and agent design, RAG (embeddings, vector search, re-ranking), and evaluating LLM output quality.
  • An AI-native way of working: you use AI tools every day and can show the speed it gives you.
  • Leadership capability: you’ve owned a product area or driven product decisions, and you influence through ideas, trust and collaboration.
  • A genuine product mindset: you’re curious about the teachers who use what you build, and you let that shape your work.
  • A collaborative style: you make the people around you better and handle different viewpoints with tact.
  • Self-directed: you move work forward with minimal oversight and speak up early when things go off track.
  • Clear written and spoken English; comfortable with technical and non-technical colleagues across UK and US time zones.
  • Bonus: ed-tech or early-childhood experience; FERPA/COPPA familiarity; early-stage startup experience.

What to Be Ready to Demonstrate

Be ready to walk us through an LLM feature you shipped: what you decided, how you built it, how you measured quality, and what you’d do differently. The process includes a paid take-home build exercise (AI tools encouraged). Sanitized examples are welcome; please don’t share confidential employer or customer information.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote role with flexibility over how you structure your day.
  • Ownership of the AI experience in a flagship product, with real influence over its direction.
  • Direct work with the CEO and a real voice in product decisions.
  • A collaborative, family-friendly, mission-driven environment at the intersection of education, media, and technology.

Why Join Us

This is a rare chance to shape the AI product of a growing global education company at a defining moment, and to help take Audrey into thousands of classrooms. If you want work that’s visible, technically meaningful, and genuinely useful for young learners and their teachers, this is it.

Note: This is an India-based engagement. Applicants must have the right to work in India; visa sponsorship is not available at this time.

MarcoPolo Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Job Description

Maisha Meds is hiring! We’re seeking an engineering manager to manage our wonderful engineers to build technology to improve healthcare in Africa.

About Maisha Meds

Maisha Meds is an organization dedicated to improving health care in Africa through best-in-class technology.

Founded in 2017, Maisha Meds has created the largest digital network of private pharmacies and clinics across Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Nigeria, and Zambia through our mobile software. Our platform not only helps these providers improve business by making sales, managing inventory, and tracking patients. It also reimburses them for providing high-quality care for malaria, family planning, and HIV prevention at discounted costs.

Maisha Meds logs millions of patient visits every year and has provided hundreds of thousands of reimbursements to date. We harness data from our network of pharmacies and clinics to reveal health and market trends, which allows us to design better solutions that work for the people we serve. We have worked with leading academic institutions such as UC Berkeley, Emory University, and KEMRI to evaluate the effectiveness of our programs. Research shows that our system is able to significantly increase the uptake of long-acting contraceptives and appropriate malaria case management.

Our work is funded by a range of partners including scale-up funding from USAID Development Innovation Ventures and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. This will help Maisha Meds greatly expand its mobile software to 7,500 total pharmacies and clinics by late 2026, delivering subsidized care to nearly a million new patients in the process.

About the role

Maisha Meds builds a point-of-sale Android app for pharmacies to track their sales and manage their inventory and leverage AI to improve directions of use for medicines. On top of the Android app, we have a layer of features to help us run patient programs so that patients visiting pharmacies can receive subsidized care. We also built a suite of back office tools to help our operational staff manage the subsidy programs. This role is for an individual to manage a remote team of engineers across North America, Europe, and Africa, initially managing our patient programs projects team, eventually starting a new team for new projects. Our organization operates in Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, and Tanzania and we would love to have you join us onsite a couple of times a year.

This role is remote (worldwide) with expected travel to our countries of operation. You will report to Chief Technology Officer. The salary range is $90,000 - $160,000 USD commensurate with experience and location.

Responsibilities

People and Team

  • Manage a remote team of 3-6 creative engineers spanning across several projects
  • Foster a welcoming friendly and culture
  • Grow and mentor engineers and help them pursue their career interests
  • Provide good feedback for performance management and coaching
  • Recruiting and hiring for your team when necessary.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership (architecture and design, code reviews, and incident management) to your reports.
  • Independently contribute to projects 20% of your time to gain a deep technical understand of the infrastructure end-to-end.
  • Preferred prior experience with Ruby on Rails and devops with AWS infrastructure.

Product and Project Management

  • While we have product managers at Maisha Meds, at times, you’ll need to engage with stakeholders directly and product manage yourself
  • Translate ambiguous stakeholder desires into concrete requirements and action plans
  • Work across teams and both internal and external stakeholders to execute on projects
  • Understand customers and users and be able to provide product direction

Our Technologies:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Vue.js
  • Android Kotlin

Nice to haves

  1. You have worked at startups as well as mature tech organizations
  2. You have experience in both B2B and B2C environments
  3. You have prior experience in healthcare and/or Africa

Why You Should Join Us

  • On a roll: We are doubling year-over-year with new funding partnerships that are boosting expansion in multiple countries
  • Great team: We are founded, managed, and backed by successful veterans of Stanford School of Medicine, Google, mPharma, and I&M bank. We have technologists, doctors, and economists working side by side to solve difficult problems.
  • Great funders: We’re supported by the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, USAID Development Innovation Ventures, CIFF, WHO FIND, and Pfizer to pay for healthcare on behalf of patients, with others to be announced soon.
  • Huge market: We are disrupting a massive, growing $50+ billion market for healthcare payments for low-income patients, with a focus on paying for health outcomes to ensure patients get the best quality care.
  • Great customers: We create financial incentives that ensure our health care providers deliver excellent care.
  • Impact: We have cultivated a fun and exciting start-up culture that empowers its talented staff to make a huge impact.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Abnormal AI is looking for a Threat Researcher to join our Threat Intelligence team.

This is an analyst role for someone who is equally interested in understanding threats and figuring out how to make intelligence useful.

You will conduct original research into active campaigns, attacker behavior, and emerging email and identity attack techniques. You will also draw on research and data produced by other parts of the Threat Intelligence organization. Your job is to connect those inputs, determine what is meaningful, and turn them into the right intelligence product for the audience and objective.

That might mean a concise threat brief for a security practitioner, a deeper analytical report, tailored intelligence content for Customer Success to use in a customer QBR, a briefing for a prospect, a webinar for a broader audience, or content supporting a high-priority sales pursuit.

The defining skill for this role is intelligence synthesis: combining technical research, data, threat context, and audience needs into a clear assessment and compelling narrative.

You will work closely with Threat Intelligence, Detection, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing teams. You will also interact directly with customers and prospects, bringing intelligence to life through briefings, presentations, webinars, and tailored content.

Success in this role is not measured by how many documents you produce. It is measured by whether you can identify the important intelligence, explain what it means, and put it in a form that helps the audience understand and act on it.

What You Will Do

Analyze & Research

  • Independently scope and lead complex or ambiguous threat intelligence investigations into active campaigns, attacker behavior, TTPs, and emerging email and identity attack techniques. Determine appropriate research approaches, evaluate incomplete or conflicting evidence, and develop defensible intelligence assessments with limited direction.
  • Use Abnormal's platform, internal telemetry and data, threat intelligence sources, and external research to investigate threats and develop intelligence assessments.
  • Identify meaningful patterns, connections, and emerging trends across threat activity.
  • Develop a strong understanding of how Abnormal detects and responds to the threats you analyze.

Synthesize Intelligence

  • Independently synthesize complex and sometimes conflicting intelligence from disparate sources, determine the most consequential insights, and develop defensible assessments and recommendations tailored to the audience and decision at hand.
  • Determine what is most relevant to a particular audience, customer situation, or business objective.
  • Translate raw findings into insight, implications, recommendations, and a clear narrative.
  • Adapt the depth, framing, terminology, and format of intelligence based on the audience.
  • Connect technical threat activity to business risk and explain why it matters.

Create Intelligence Products

  • Produce a range of intelligence deliverables, including:
  • Threat briefs
  • Analytical reports
  • Intelligence content and narratives for customer QBRs
  • Customer and prospect briefings
  • Webinars and presentations
  • Marketing and outreach content
  • Executive-level intelligence summaries
  • Create both rapid-turnaround intelligence products and deeper analytical work.
  • Build reusable narratives, templates, and content structures that improve consistency and scale.
  • Maintain high standards for sourcing, analytical accuracy, clarity, and editorial quality.

Engage Customers & Prospects

  • Independently lead customer and prospect intelligence engagements, including complex or high-visibility threat briefings, webinars, and presentations. Adapt technical depth and narrative in real time, respond to challenging questions, and ensure the intelligence supports the audience's decisions.
  • Work with Sales and Customer Success to understand the context behind a customer or prospect request and tailor intelligence accordingly.
  • Respond to time-sensitive customer questions and high-priority pursuits with accurate, relevant, and well-sourced analysis.
  • Develop trusted relationships with customer-facing stakeholders and use their feedback to improve intelligence products.

Partner Across the Organization

  • Collaborate with Threat Intelligence and Detection teams to incorporate research and technical findings into customer-ready intelligence.
  • Serve as a technical resource and mentor to P1 and P2 analysts, strengthening analytical judgment, research methods, intelligence synthesis, and product quality through coaching, peer review, and knowledge sharing.
  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to understand upcoming customer moments, pursuits, and content needs.
  • Provide targeted enablement and supporting materials that help GTM teams understand and use intelligence effectively.
  • Feed insights from customer and field interactions back to Threat Intelligence teams to inform research and detection priorities.

Work Smarter

  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, and similar technologies to accelerate research, synthesis, drafting, tailoring, and editing.
  • Develop practical workflows and automation that reduce time spent on routine work while maintaining analytical rigor.
  • Apply appropriate human review and validation to ensure AI-assisted work is accurate, well-sourced, and analytically sound.

What We're Looking For

Must Have

  • 4+ years of experience in threat intelligence, SOC operations, or a closely related cybersecurity discipline.
  • Working knowledge of email and identity attack techniques and the ability to understand and explain IOCs, TTPs, attack campaigns, and threat behavior.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting security research and producing written intelligence or security content for different audiences.
  • Strong ability to synthesize technical research and data from multiple sources into clear intelligence assessments, narratives, and recommendations.
  • Demonstrated analytical judgment in complex or ambiguous investigations, including the ability to evaluate incomplete or conflicting evidence, determine the most consequential findings, and develop defensible assessments and recommendations with limited direction.
  • Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms, intelligence-sharing communities, and threat hunting concepts.
  • Strong writing skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical subjects clearly and concisely.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently present complex technical intelligence to customers, executives, security practitioners, or other stakeholders, adapting communication to the audience and responding confidently to questions or challenges.
  • Experience working directly with customers or cross-functional stakeholders and translating technical findings into business relevance.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, or similar tools to enhance research, analysis, and writing.
  • Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage competing requests and deliver high-quality work on time.
  • Ability to remain calm, accurate, and responsive in high-pressure or time-sensitive situations.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently scope, prioritize, and deliver complex intelligence work from initial investigation through final assessment and customer-ready communication, while identifying opportunities to improve analytical quality and production workflows.
  • Ability and willingness to strengthen the technical capabilities of other analysts through constructive peer review, knowledge sharing, coaching, and collaborative problem-solving.
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools or automation to scale research, analysis, or content production.
  • Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and common attack techniques, including phishing, business email compromise (BEC), credential harvesting, malware, and account takeover, with the ability to apply this knowledge to threat research, analysis, and intelligence assessments.
  • Basic proficiency in SQL, including the ability to write and modify queries to retrieve, filter, and analyze datasets in support of threat intelligence research and investigations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in email security, phishing detection, anti-abuse systems, or email threat containment.
  • Experience in detection engineering, incident response, and email security analysis.
  • Experience with Abnormal Security or similar security platforms.
  • Public-facing security content experience, such as published research, blogs, conference talks, webinars, or industry reports.
  • Experience creating intelligence content for sales cycles, customer QBRs, or other customer-facing security engagements.
  • Experience creating training or enablement materials for Sales, Customer Success, or other non-technical teams.
  • Experience mentoring, coaching, or training earlier-career security analysts.
  • Experience using Python or other scripting tools to automate data analysis, investigate threat activity, or improve intelligence research workflows.
  • Security certifications such as Security+, GIAC (GCTI, GCIH), CISSP, CEH, or similar.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

One introductory call, which will also cover the technical side; potentially a small practical task; then a fast decision. The work is available now and waiting - we will come back to you immediately, so if this sounds interesting, please get in touch as soon as you can.

jobs.description:
Faria is a leader in international education systems & services, offering an integrated suite across learning, admissions, school-to-home, and online courses — trusted by 10,000+ schools and 4 million students across 155 countries.

Our product family includes ManageBac (curriculum, assessment & reporting for international schools), OpenApply (admissions management & CRM, used by 600+ leading international and independent schools), SchoolsBuddy (co-curricular & activity management), and Vectare (school transport management).

Behind these products is a globally distributed engineering team that keeps a large multi-cloud production environment running reliably around the clock.

We’re looking for a Middle DevOps / SRE Engineer to help keep our multi-cloud production environment reliable, secure, and fast. You’ll join a globally distributed team working follow-the-sun — on everything from research and PoCs for new applications to deployment automation, security hardening, and day-to-day support for our developers.

What you’ll do

  • Operate, monitor, and improve production infrastructure across AWS and Azure (incl. China regions)
  • Automate deployments and infrastructure with Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Proactively improve stability, performance, and security — preventing incidents before they happen
  • Respond to incidents within SLA, troubleshoot, and drive root-cause fixes
  • Support developers with infrastructure-related questions and unblock their work
  • Participate in the on-call rotation

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years in DevOps / SRE, including hands-on AWS experience
  • Strong AWS: EC2, VPC, RDS, S3, ElastiCache, OpenSearch, EKS, ECS, Lambda, ELB (ALB/NLB), CloudFront, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Secrets Manager, SES, Security Hub, Inspector
  • Azure: App Service, Container Apps, Front Door, CDN, Azure SQL Database, Storage Accounts, Virtual Network (VNet), Azure DevOps
  • Containers & orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, ArgoCD
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible
  • CI/CD & version control: GitHub Actions, solid Git workflow
  • Scripting: Bash and Python
  • Linux administration, networking, firewalls, web servers (Nginx/Apache)
  • Monitoring & observability: Prometheus (Kubernetes), Grafana, ELK, Loki, incident management with PagerDuty
  • Solid understanding of SDLC and SLA-based incident response
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and a structured, methodical approach
  • English B2+

Nice to have

  • AWS / Azure certifications
  • Alibaba Cloud experience
  • Experience with Ruby, Python, C# web application frameworks (deploying and troubleshooting)
  • Basic understanding of disaster recovery & database backups (PITR, restore procedures)
  • Experience with compliance-driven environments (GDPR, ISO 27001, China data residency)
  • Cost optimization / FinOps awareness
  • Experience with AI applications

Who you are

  • Proactive — you suggest improvements and work ahead of problems, removing risks before they become incidents
  • Calm under pressure, able to juggle multiple complex tasks with a clear head
  • A team player who takes ownership and is accountable for their area of responsibility
  • Eager to learn and grow to support both current and new products

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, or sex. Faria operates a safer recruiting policy, and the successful applicant may be required to complete an enhanced disclosure from the DBS and an Enhanced Check for Regulated Activity.

Please note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to a high volume of applicants.

Working conditions

  • Globally distributed team operating follow-the-sun across time zones
  • On-call rotation during business hours plus weekend coverage. Urgent off-hours/night escalations happen only for major incidents — these are rare, and we actively invest in keeping them that way

What we offer

  • Compensation - Competitive compensation and opportunities for career development
  • Learning - We encourage continued education, providing an online learning platform, unlimited book purchases, and diverse internal and external training programs.
  • Team - Friendly atmosphere, group activities, and corporate events
  • Equipment - MacBook Pro or another laptop of your specification, peripherals, and displays included

ABOUT FARIA EDUCATION GROUP

For over 15 years, Faria Education Group has deeply understood the needs of schools, leveraging extensive experience in education. Our dedication to reaching every learner and inspiring every educator has supported over 10,000 schools and 4 million students across 155 countries. We are committed to driving transformative experiences for learners, educators, and families globally.

Our integrated SaaS solutions suite supports all aspects of curriculum management (Atlas), teaching and learning (ManageBac), admissions (OpenApply), and school-to-home communications (SchoolsBuddy). With an unwavering commitment to innovation, our technology meets rigorous data protection and security standards, ensuring first-class training and support.

Through our innovative online schools (Pamoja and Wolsey Hall), we provide comprehensive educational experiences with IB Diploma and Cambridge online courses, delivering high-quality education to schools and homes worldwide.

Join us in our commitment to transforming education and empowering communities worldwide.

jobs.excerpt: Overview: Reliability and Operational ExcellenceThe Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is responsible for the ultimate stability, performance, and scalability of our entire integrated supply chain e-commerce platform.
jobs.description:
Overview: Reliability and Operational Excellence

The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is responsible for the ultimate stability, performance, and scalability of our entire integrated supply chain e-commerce platform. You will apply software engineering principles to operations, ensuring the high availability and resilience of the customer-facing e-commerce storefront, internal SaaS tools (WMS, OMS), and specialized AI agent services.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will be the champion of uptime, performance, and automated operations for systems handling the critical MES → WMS → OMS flow.

  • Availability & SLO Management: Define, implement, and track Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs) for core business processes and all application layers. Manage the platform's overall Service Level Agreement (SLA).

  • Observability & Alerting: Architect, maintain, and optimize the comprehensive observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry). Develop high-fidelity alerting and ensure distributed tracing across the NestJS modular monolith and associated data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis).

  • Incident Response & Review: Own the incident response workflow, ensuring rapid triage, mitigation, and root cause analysis. Conduct thorough post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement and eliminate recurring toil.

  • Scalability & Capacity Planning: Optimize auto-scaling policies for all services running on Docker containers. Conduct capacity planning based on business projections, especially for peak e-commerce and manufacturing load.

  • Disaster Recovery (DR): Design, implement, and regularly test Disaster Recovery procedures, including backup and restoration workflows for PostgreSQL 15 using tools like pgBackRest.

  • Automation: Eliminate operational toil through automation, managing infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines (Makefile).

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess deep experience in cloud operations, observability, and infrastructure automation:

  • Observability Stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry (mandatory).

  • Infrastructure & Platform: Terraform, Docker, Traefik, Oracle Cloud Free VMs (or equivalent public cloud).

  • Data & Resilience: PostgreSQL (Deep knowledge), Redis, pgBackRest.

  • Automation: Strong scripting skills (Python/Bash) and experience with CI/CD tools and Makefile.

  • Methodology: Expert knowledge of SRE principles, toil reduction, and error budgeting.

AI Agent Focus

You will be responsible for the operational reliability of the emerging AI layer.

  • Agent Reliability: Implement specialized monitoring and logging for the AI agent services, ensuring LLM integrations and multi-agent systems (built with frameworks like LangChain) meet defined performance and availability SLOs.

  • Resource Optimization: Efficiently manage resource allocation for computationally intensive AI workloads to maintain platform stability and cost-efficiency.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Uptime/Availability: Achieving defined SLAs/SLOs across the platform.

  • MTTR: Reduction in Mean Time To Recover from production incidents.

  • Toil Reduction: Measured percentage reduction in manual, repetitive operational tasks through automation.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Head of Technology/CTO, working collaboratively with DevSecOps and development teams to ensure software is designed for reliability.
